I didn't really want to work, but I couldn't advance in the dungeon with the mediocre equipment I had.

I figured that the 'blacksmith' and 'magic store' would have a bunch of useful upgrades that would let me beat even those Giant Toads…

Once class ended, I went over to the soccer field without having Mitsurugi coerce me.

He was surprised to see me come of my own volition.

"I didn't think you'd actually come on your own…"

"Like you said, it's an easy way to grind stats. I'm just taking your advice."

"...Just to clarify, I actually like playing soccer. I'm not just using club activities just to grind stats."

"The fact you need to clarify that makes me suspicious of your real intentions."

"...Believe whatever you want."

He gave me a blank look.

I guess he wasn't easy to tease.

We headed over to the field and I resumed doing my passing training with the coach.

This time, I didn't get a boost to my 'Dexterity'. I suppose I couldn't just spam the same practice over and over.

"...Ah, I'd like to work on my dribbling next."

"Satou-kun… You're truly inspirational!"

If only he knew why I was actually doing this.

But I still didn't get any stat increases.

"Satou-kun… Please don't check your phone so much during practice…"

"I'm using a fitness app to track my activity."

"You're an exemplary member of this club!"

Your 'Cunning' has increased by +1!

Why was it only that stat that increases every time?!

When we took a break, I asked Mitsurugi why my stats weren't increasing.

"...Stats only increase with meaningful practice or the production of meaningful outcomes. If your 'Cunning' score keeps increasing, that must mean that the lie you told has changed things in your favor. But if you're just lazily dribbling around cones, that doesn't count as a meaningful practice or a meaningful outcome."

I kept forgetting that Mitsurugi was more knowledgeable than me when it came to the app.

Not that I'd tell him that.

"Here, let's have some 1v1 practice together."

"...Shouldn't you play with the main squad?"

"It's fine, it's fine. Those guys can handle themselves. A team is only as strong as its weakest link."

I knew he was just telling the truth, but I hated getting called the weakest link.

Mitsurugi kicked the ball over to me. I trapped it under my foot.

"Alright, let's do some real dribbling practice. You won't improve just by going around cones. Try to get past me."

From what I saw, Mitsurugi was a pure striker.

Since he didn't specialize in defense, maybe even a beginner like me had a chance.

I walked towards him, with a lazy look in my eyes.

Then, I suddenly dipped into a more athletic position and sprung forward.

"...Whoa!"

Mitsurugi got caught off guard.

However, he turned just before I passed him completely and snatched the ball away from me.

"Ah…"

I actually thought I got past him.

"That actually wasn't bad, Satou. You knew you couldn't beat me in terms of techniques, so you used that cunning that you're so good at…"

"You know, it's not like I'm proud of having such a high cunning stat…"

"You say that, but I did get some kind of sneaky [Feint Slash] skill from your bond rank-up reward…"

This app viewed me as a despicable character, huh?

"Ah, but it's a really useful skill! A lot of my skills and attacks are really straightforward, so I could use some lessons in subterfuge…"

His idea of praise just pissed me off even more.

We kept practicing. Mitsurugi gave me some pointers on how to tighten my dribble.

I never did get past him, but the practice was certainly more practical and effective than using those cones.

Your 'Dexterity' has improved by +1!

Just like Mitsrugui predicted, it worked.

"Oh…! My 'Intuition' increased after facing your tricky movements, Satou!"

Was I really that much of a trickster type of character?

Part 6

Mitsurugi wanted to hang out after school to increase our bond again.

I rejected the offer, since I wanted to go to the convenience store and apply for the job.

"You're hired."

"Huh…? That easily?"

I said, when the store manager accepted me within 15 minutes of me giving him my resume and doing an interview.

"As a matter of fact, can you start now?"

"...Alright, what kinda shady thing is going on in this store?"

He sighed and rubbed his face.

He was a typical middle aged man with hairy arms. He also wore a shirt that was a size too small for him.

"One of our cashiers was caught stealing a few days ago. A bunch of our other regulars quit because they didn't want to get involved in the mess."

They wanted to avoid the whole 'guilty by association' stigma, huh?

"So that's the only reason why you're hiring?"

"Look, do you want the job or not?"

I wouldn't really get affected by the crime stigma, since I wasn't around when it happened.

In fact, this was a really good situation for me.

I accepted the job.

"Alright, can you start now? Don't worry, I'll pay you right after your shift is over."

"...This sounds really shady."

"Like I said, I'm in a tough spot here!"

I accepted the terms, since I did want to get my money right away.

The manager threw me to the fire without any training whatsoever.

Even if that was the case, the cash register was more or less automated. I was just there to smile and scan products for customers.

It was a straightforward enough job that I didn't really need training for.

However, it was probably a lot more stressful if I did this full-time. The fact that I only had to do it for three hours was what made it seem easy in my eyes.

"Welcome… Ugh…"

"Eh? Kazuma? Kishishishi! What are you doing here?!"

Just when I thought the job was easy, Aqua showed up in casual clothes.

"I work here now."

"Pffft! You look so lame in that outfit! Let me take a picture!"

She took out her phone and started taking pictures of me in the conbini uniform.

Since it was my job, I forced myself to smile while she took pictures.

"...Those pictures will cost 1,000 yen each."

"Hah?! What do you mean by that?! Whatever. Hurry up and scan these already."

She dumped a bunch of snacks and treats in front of me.

"You'll get fat."

"A goddess like me can't get fat! Besides, we're gonna go to the dungeon tonight, anyway!"

"We are?"

"Yeah, I just decided!"

"And who says that you get to decide what I do?"

"On my way here, three guys begged me to go to a tea shop with them, yet you still don't understand my value?! If I wanted to, I could easily become an idol or actress in this country! You should be honored by the fact that I'm willing to go dungeon diving with you!"

"That'll be 3,550 yen."

I ignored her and scanned the items for her.

She brought out the money my parents gave her and handed it over to me.

This freeloader was using my own parents' money to pay for the items she was buying in the store I was working at.

Aqua eventually left after paying for her treats.

I spent the rest of the three hour shift without any trouble.

Once it was done, the manager came over and said that my shift was over.

"Good work, kid. You're a fast learner. Here's your pay."

He handed me 3,000 yen. I gladly accepted it.

You gained +1 Willpower and +1 Bravery from your part-time work!

After changing out of the uniform, I left the store and headed to the blacksmith.

Aqua made me promise to go to the dungeon, but I wasn't in a hurry to entertain her whims.

The so-called 'blacksmith' just ended up being a pawn shop.

"...Seriously?"

I said, looking at the cheap-looking pawn shop.

I double-checked the Service Locator to see if it was in the right place, but there wasn't any mistake.

Deciding to give it a chance, I entered the store.

"...Welcome."

A disinterested looking elderly man gave me a bored greeting.

He had a muscular body, especially for an elderly man. He was reading a magazine and only spared me a quick glance when I entered.

"Sorry, kid, I don't sell porn to minors."

Did I look like that much of a pervert?

"...No, I'm here for blacksmith services."

I decided to take a chance and said 'blacksmith' as if it was a code word.

If the app made some kind of mistake, then I could just brush it off as a joke.

The man looked up from his magazine and squinted at me.

"You an app user?"

I nodded and showed him the app. I said,

"I guess this run-down pawn shop is just a front, huh?"

"Are you trying to pick a fight or something? I'm actually running a pawn shop, asshole!"

"My mistake… So what's the deal with this place?"

"The 'blacksmith' shit is just a side gig. I got that weird app on a phone my daughter gave me for my birthday. At first I thought it was a joke, but I ended up entering that dungeon."

Aqua said that it was usually youth who qualified for the app.

Well, I guess there were exceptions like this guy.

Then again, he didn't even have a combat class. Maybe adults could qualify for trades classes...

"Did you manage to go deep into the dungeon?"

"Not really. Maybe back in the day, I could have explored more of the dungeon, but I'm an old man now."

"I guess those muscles are just for show…"

"Want to see if they're really just for show or not?"

He raised a fist, threatening me with it. When I shook my head, he said,

"...Well, since I got the 'Blacksmith' class, I just focused on gathering materials and making weapons and armor. Figured I could sell them to other app users. Most of them tend to be kids like you, but I've seen some adults. It's very rare, but it happens. A lot of those adults end up making it a business opportunity, like what I'm doing."

It made sense that it wasn't only young people who had the potential to enter the dungeon, despite what Aqua said.

This wasn't some kids anime meant to sell toys, after all.

Rather, the fact that Aqua barely knew the demographic of the app-users really reinforced her stupidity. Not like there were any doubts.

Or maybe she didn't bother giving cheat items to adults who didn't have combat classes. This guy didn't explore much of the dungeon, after all.

"So are you gonna buy something, kid? I've got the [Intermediate Smith] skill, so I can craft gear from monsters in the level 15-30 range. I can even create custom equipment for you."

"...[Intermediate Smith]? Is there a way to improve the standard [Smith] skill?"

"Yeah. Once you've reached the max rank in a skill, there's sometimes more advanced versions of them available that you can unlock after meeting some special requirements. They cost a lot of skill points to rank-up, though."

"How much does it cost to make a custom item?"

"I usually charge 8,000 yen."

"Why is it so damn expensive?!"

"Do you want it or not?!"

I sighed and took out my app, selling the Horn-tipped Spear for 5,000 yen.

Spears were useful in almost every scenario, but I couldn't use it in conjunction with the [Quick Draw] skill.

I also took out 3,000 yen from my own pocket and gave it all to him.

"Thanks for your business. What do you have in mind for the custom item?"

"I have the [Quick Draw] skill and it seems like it's based on Iaido. A katana that's easy to draw from its sheath might be the best bet…"

"Are you sure you're not just thinking that katanas are cool?"

He got me.

"Alright, I get it. Give me a moment."

He stood up, placed the magazine down on the counter, and headed to the back of the store.

I looked at the magazine.

"..."

It was a porno.

I read it while I waited for him.

Part 7

After spending most of my funds, I didn't even bother going to the magic store.

If ordinary gear was that expensive, I couldn't imagine that magical gear was cheaper.

Besides, if I kept Aqua waiting any longer, she'd nag me for hours.

"Kazuma, you're late! You're so late! How dare you make a goddess wait so long!"

It was around 8 pm when I got back.

"Shut up! You're the one who forced this on me!"

I didn't really feel like going to the dungeon, especially since Aqua was going to try and get revenge on the toads again.

Even so, I found myself going to the train station with Aqua. She was humming a happy tune the whole time, as if she had forgotten all the bad experiences she had in the dungeon.

Taking the train at night was a different feeling. The scenery of the city at night was dark and mysterious. The city lights were also quite inspiring.

As always, Aqua got a lot of stares from people. It was a constant reminder that Aqua was supposedly quite a catch, although I couldn't even see her as a girl anymore.

I once took a picture of Aqua sleeping on the couch, with her clothes in a disarray. I tried to jerk off to it later that night, but I couldn't even get hard.

I thought that it was a common guy problem, the inability to jerk off to girls I knew.

But then I tried jerking off to Darkness, and I managed to do it just fine.

Even doing it for Rin, Megumin and Chris ended up as a successful venture.

The only anomaly was Aqua.

"...Why do I feel like Kazuma is having rude thoughts about me?"

Is she psychic?

…

…

A train ride later, we ended up in the dungeon.

"Fufu… I got quite a useful item this time, Kazuma. I got it from a quest!"

She said, as we walked inside, letting the numerous torches on the wall illuminate our path.

"Oh? With your shitty luck, I didn't think you'd manage to get a good item. What is it?"

"It's a perfume that attracts all kinds of monsters to attack the user! This way, we'll get lots of EXP!"

"...Eh?"

I blinked, Aqua's comments just starting to dawn on me.

There was a rumbling in the ground, followed by ominous noises.

"Kiiii…!"

"Skree…!"

"Hissss…!"

My [Enemy Detection] went haywire as it warned me of a bunch of monsters coming out all at once.

"W-What did you do?! Are you actually insane?!"

I said, starting to back away from the monsters.

"Pfft! Are you this much of a coward, Kazuma? Fine, I figured I'd share some kills with you, but I guess I'll take everything! Take my divine fury, you stupid monsters! [God Blow]!"

She charged, her punch connecting with a big rat monster.

"...! I did it, Kazuma! Now to take out the others… Eh? W-Wait… Isn't there a lot of them?!"

Was she nearsighted, or just plain dumb?

Realizing that she couldn't possibly take out all these monsters by punching them, she turned around and started to run away.

"Kashuma-san! Pwease help…?!"

"Skreee…!"

The monsters chased after the retreating Aqua.

"You idiot! Why are you leading them to me?!"

"Pwease do something, Kashuma-saannn!"

There was still a lot of distance we had to run to reach the entrance.

As much as I wanted to abandon Aqua, my family would probably start asking questions if I didn't come back home with her.

I might even get blamed for her disappearance.

I sighed and turned around to face the monsters, letting Aqua run ahead of me.

"[Wind Breath]!"

I exhaled out a gust of wind, aiming it at the torches all along the walls.

The usually well-lit dungeon became dark.

The [Night Vision] skill I got from Aqua, which I once figured was useless, allowed me to see in the dark.

"Skreee!"

The monsters who had night-vision didn't have any problems and charged forward.

Namely, the Giant Bats all flew towards us. There were three of them who approached.

[Enemy Reading] activated and told me that each of them had 5 HP and an armor score of 0.

"[Snipe]!"

I took down two of them before they could reach us.

"Skreee!"

I dropped the bow and in one motion…

"[Quick-Draw]!"

...I drew out my newly purchased katana and sliced the bat in half.

After sheathing my new katana, I picked up the bow again and ran as fast as I could with Aqua.

I heard my phone ring, indicating that there was a new notification from the app, but I didn't have time to go look at it, spending all my efforts in escaping.

For some reason, I felt like I could run way faster than usual.

Eventually, we outran the monsters and reached the entrance. We came spilling out from the door.

I hurriedly closed the door before any monsters could follow us outside.

"You useless goddess! What were you thinking?! Why didn't you mention anything about that monster attracting perfume?!"

"I didn't say anything because I didn't want you to question it! I know how much of a worrywart you are! Besides, I was on a time limit!"

"...Does the perfume have a short time limit?"

"Nope! It actually lasts for several hours!"

"Then what's with the hurry…?"

"Since I'm a goddess of water, I tend to turn a lot of fluids I touch into water! If that perfume stayed on my skin for long enough, it would lose its properties and become water eventually!"

"Instead of a goddess of water, the higher-ups should change your title to the goddess of disappointment."

"Is that really what you think of me?! Anyway, the perfume should wear out in a few minutes. After that, let's go back! Wait… Why are you walking away, Kazuma?!"

"As if I'd go back inside after all that! I'm going home!"

"Wait, Kazuma! I haven't even had revenge on the toads yet!"

I ignored all her begging and complaining as we headed back.

I checked the notification on the app that I missed earlier.

Your cowardly running has unlocked a new skill!

[Escape] Skill Rank: 1, Active Skill (5 mp cost)

Chance to escape hostile enemies increases by +10%. Ability to escape is determined by 'Speed' stat (43).

…Considering how many close calls I had in the dungeon, this skill might be worth investing points into after I max out [Enemy Detection].

The only good thing that came out of this excursion was that I managed to grab some monster parts to sell.

You sold the monster materials for 500 yen!

...I almost died for 500 yen, huh?

As for Aqua, the reason why I almost died, she complained the whole time as we went back home.

Chapter 6: An Official Match For This Sub!

Part 1

I had a late dinner and was about to take a bath when Aqua started whining.

"If you keep running away all the time, you'll never gain levels, Kazuma!"

"...My 'Bravery' stat is at 24. It's not my fault."

"It's completely your fault if it's that low!"

"Cowardice is what allowed my ancestors to survive. Risk-takers don't get to live another day!"

"No need to be afraid, Kazuma! Since I'm a goddess and all, I already have a bunch of high level healing skills! I can even use the [Resurrection] spell in case you die!"

"...That's not exactly reassuring."

Why would I want to die and leave my fate in this idiot's hands? I said,

"Listen… If you didn't do unnecessary shit, you might actually have some use. All you need to do is heal and buff me. We might see a lot of success if you didn't sabotage everything with your dumbass stunts."

"Why are you always so harsh towards me, Kazuma?! Is that how you talk to girls?! You'll never get laid at this point!"

"What does that have to do with what we're talking about?!"

I closed the bathroom door on her, then proceeded to take a bath.

The whole time, Aqua was banging on the door.

I tried to relax, but that banging was grating on the ears.

"What's your problem?!"

I came out of the bath and opened the door, wearing a short towel around my waist. She said,

"You can't just ignore me! You need to treat me with more respect!"

"I'll respect you once you actually deserve it!"

"You need to work harder, Kazuma! We have to beat the Demon King, or else I can't go back!"

"...You know, I'm starting to think that I don't even have a chance against the Demon King."

"Hah?! How much of a coward are you! You're one of the chosen few who have the potential to defeat the Demon King!"

"You say that, but there are other heroes who have OP cheat weapons and powers. Even if I don't do anything, one of those guys will beat the Demon King."

"...I guess you're right. But if those guys don't succeed, you still need to train so you can take out the Demon King!"

"And I'm telling you I don't think that's possible."

"What do you mean by that?! You have me by your side!"

And that's exactly why I didn't think it was possible.

My stats were mediocre to begin with. Thanks to the Adventurer class, I could learn a variety of skills and manage to survive so far in the dungeon.

But in order to defeat someone with the title of Demon King, I doubted that my loosely connected variety of skills was enough to do even any serious damage to him. I said,

"The only reason why I'm doing all this stuff is because the app seems to make my life better. Even if I don't take the dungeon seriously, I'm making money and even getting closer to girls…"

"Oiii! The app isn't some self-improvement program! It's supposed to make you powerful enough to take down the Demon King and his generals! Why are you treating it as some multi-purpose organizational tool to get your life in order…?!"

"Hah? Look at all the quests it's giving me! 'Joining the soccer team', 'get a girl's number', 'work a part-time job'. How are these quests supposed to help me defeat the Demon King?! There was even a quest that told me to drink a smoothie!"

Aqua glanced away and started backing away from me.

"W-Well… The app is customized to fit whoever is using it. I guess that before you become a hero who can defeat the Demon King, it's trying to make you become a person who can someday become a hero who can defeat the Demon King…"

"It's too slow paced! Where are my bullshit powerups?! I'm supposed to be power creeping everyone by now!"

"L-Like I said before! The app isn't some magical tool that gives you a crazy amount of power instantly! It merely displays your growth as a person! If you want to blame anyone, blame yourself for being untalented!"

While we were yelling, my mother peeked her head in to see why we were yelling.

She looked at me, with only a towel around my waist.

"Lover's spat, huh?"

She returned to her room and closed the door.

She couldn't have been further from the truth.

Aqua crossed her arms and said,

"...In any case, just because your progress has been slow, don't use that as an excuse to slack off on your training, Kazuma! You're only Level 4, of course you're not as powerful as you could be! You're just not taking enough risks in the dungeon! You're also not spending enough time grinding levels!"

"What's even the point of grinding levels? I only get 1 Skill Point every time I level up."

"...J-Just work harder from here on out!"

Aqua couldn't find a proper rebuttal and went back to her room in a huff.

Part 2

I was walking to school when Rin saw me and joined me.

I noticed that Mitsurugi was about to approach me, but when he saw Rin, he gave me a thumb up and walked away.

That guy was unexpectedly cool sometimes.

"Hm? Senpai, you look like you're in a bad mood…"

Rin said, when she noticed the scowl on my face, which remained there after my argument with Aqua.

"It's nothing."

"You can tell me, senpai! Oh, I know! It's girl trouble, isn't it?"

She was somewhat right, but I bet she was imagining something else.

"Just had an argument with someone, I guess."

"I see… And does senpai care about that person?"

"Hah?"

"Why is senpai making that face as if I said something incredibly offensive?"

I couldn't help but make a face as if someone falsely accused me of committing a horrible crime. I said,

"I think it's an exaggeration to say that I care about this person. Something they said just made me really mad."

"Well, if you care that much about what they said, I think that senpai actually does care about this person, at least to a certain extent."

"No, no, that's not true."

She giggled when I denied her speculation. She said,

"You know, I'm actually kind of jealous. I don't really have any friends that I can have arguments with."

"Why would you want to argue with your friends? I think having harmonious friendships is better."

"I figure that the closer you are to someone, the more you can argue with them. It means that you're willing to show your true self to them. I mean, could you imagine spending a lot of time with someone without having any disagreements whatsoever?"

"It's fine to have disagreements, but there is such a thing as incompatibility. If two people just can't get along, why force it?"

"I disagree with that! I think that it's better to surround yourself with people who have opposing viewpoints to your own. It's like solving a puzzle. You can't make a beautiful picture if you only have copies of the same piece!"

"I think life is more peaceful if like minded people stick together."

"Oh, my. Senpai, could it be… Are we having a disagreement?"

"Ah…!"

I didn't even realize it, but she was right.

She giggled and said,

"Does that mean that we're incompatible, senpai?"

"I-I guess not."

"I'm glad I could make you see things my way! Don't worry, I got something out of what you said, too. It's not like arguments are all about who's right or wrong, or who comes out as the victor, you know? It's really all about learning from one another."

Why was this first-year girl so mature?

…

…

It was becoming routine for me to head to the soccer field after classes.

After changing out of my uniform, I joined the others in the field.

There was an official game that day. Not that it mattered to me, since I was just cheering from the bench.

The coach didn't have his usual enthusiasm when we saw him. He said,

"I have bad news, everyone. It seems that a few of our players tried the new 'spicy curry challenge' at a family restaurant. Their digestive systems couldn't handle it and they are now out of commission for the next few days."

Don't tell me…

The coach turned to me and said,

"Since we have a game today, we'll have to rely on substitutes to take their place. Satou-kun, please prepare yourself to play in the game!"

…It was this kind of cliched development.

"Hah? Why can't we just forfeit if we don't have enough players?"

I said, looking for any excuse to not play.

Sure, I'd like to complete that quest, but this was too big of a step for me.

"...B-But we do have enough players. You're a substitute… You're supposed to fill in when the starters can't play."

Damn it.

Since there were lots of players in the club, I didn't think that I'd actually have to play an actual game.

To think that they'd all take on that stupid challenge…

Even though Mitsurugi and I didn't have any problems.

Mitsurugi was pale when he approached me. He leaned in and whispered,

"...I-I think it's our fault, Satou."

"Huh? What do you mean?"

"Think about it… We unlocked the [Heat Resistance] skill as soon as we finished the challenge. That means our digestive systems improved to handle the consequences of the spicy food. The skill saved us before our bodies digested the curry."

"I still don't see how that's a problem…"

"Well… I heard that the restaurant thought the challenge was too easy since we, the first contestants, finished it easily and didn't show any side effects. As a result, they added even more spice to the curry…"

Even though the reward was only a 50% discount and having your photo hung up on the wall.

How cheap was the owner of that restaurant?!

Once he explained it that way, I could understand why he thought it was our fault that our teammates suffered a grim fate.

That curry must have been more painful going out than in.

I made a quick prayer for their holes.

Your earnest prayer has increased your 'Faith' by +1!

After making my prayer, I said,

"...What am I supposed to do now? I'll just make a fool out of myself out there."

"Just try your best. Stick to the fundamentals and pass it to whoever is open."

He gave me as much advice as he could while doing our warmups and drills.

Half an hour later, the opposing school arrived for the match.

The bleachers were also starting to fill with spectators.

"Kyaa! Mitsurugi-kyuun! Do your best~!"

Mitsurugi had a bunch of female fans as usual.

Part 3

Once the officials arrived, the starting 11 from both schools stood in a line to bow.

"Wait… Satou, is that you?"

In front of me, there was a guy I recognized.

He used to go to the same middle school as me.

"Eh…? Satou… I heard you went to this school, but… I didn't know you played soccer?"

He said, confusion all over his face.

"...I didn't feel like the quality of our middle school team was worthy of my skills."

I said, trying to rile him up.

"Hah?! Oi… Just because we went to the same middle school, I won't go easy on you! I don't care how good you are!"

Your 'Cunning' has increased by +1!

He fell for it so easily.

Once we went back to our side, Mitsurugi who witnessed the interaction said,

"Satou… Why are you antagonizing your former schoolmate?"

I looked around before saying,

"They don't know that I actually suck. I figured that we could use that to our advantage."

"...I don't know what you're planning but I guess I'll go along with it."

Since the only thing I could do was pass and dribble a little bit, the coach slotted me in at Midfield.

It was still an important position, but he also couldn't trust me at defense and there was no way I could handle the responsibilities of a Forward.

…Also, most of the guys who got hit by the curry challenge played as Midfielders. It was the position with the biggest gap.

Which also described their holes after eating all that curry.

Our team ran a '4-2-3-1' formation. Since they couldn't trust me as a Defensive Midfielder, they assigned me as an Attacking Midfielder.

"I believe in the potential sleeping within you, Satou-kun…"

The ever optimistic coach, who just gave me a vital position in the attacking patterns of the team, said this.

As the game was about to start, my former schoolmate glared at me, as did a lot of the other members of his team.

He probably told everyone about what I said.

The game started with our possession.

Mitsurugi kicked the ball back to me.

"Get him!"

The agitated frontline of the other team rushed to swarm me.

"Let's see… Place the ball like this… And…"

All the passing practice paid off as I sent a lob pass over the heads of the swarming players.

"...!"

Even the one who received it, Mitsurugi, was surprised.

"Huh?!"

The opposing players turned back to try and block Mitsurugi.

He held the ball, posting up the Midfielder who tried to stop him. The Wingers rushed forward and received a pass from Mitsurugi.

A simple 1-2 pass from the left winger to Mitsurugi and he was off, sprinting towards the goal.

…I have to admit, watching Mitsurugi up close in a real match… He was one hell of a talented player.

He sent a curving shot that the goalkeeper had no chance of saving. Just like that, it was a 1-0 lead for us.

"Kyaa! Mitsurugi-kun! You're so cool!"

"Hey… Who's that Midfielder who made the pass?! How come we've never seen him play before?!"

"It seems our school has been hiding a secret weapon, just for this moment…"

The peanut gallery was getting all kinds of misconceptions about me.

After that goal, the opposing team got even more wary of me.

My former schoolmate walked past me and said,

"...It seems that you really were hiding your skill all this time, Satou. Why didn't you play with us back then?! We could have made the nationals if we had you!"

I chuckled and turned around.

"That kind of 'what-if' mentality is why I didn't consider you worthy… If you want to prove yourself, then show me your strength…"

"...! Fine! I'll show you that I'm not the same weakling I was back then…!"

This dude read way too much sports manga if he thought people actually talked like this.

This time, the opposing team was on offense.

I was able to stand around and preserve my energy while the defense did most of the work.

They kept a Defensive Midfielder to keep an eye on me at all times. That pass really left an impression on them.

It took a while until our team was able to retain possession and work up a series of passes that reached the midfield.

In the meantime… While I didn't have the ball…

"[Lurk]..."

I hid my presence from the Midfielder marking me.

"Oi… Over here…"

I held my hand up to my teammate who had the ball.

He seemed surprised that I was free from my mark, but still sent the ball my way with a long pass.

My first touch was atrocious, but I had a lot of free space, giving me lots of time to control the pass.

I controlled the ball with my inside foot and advanced forward.

"...! Catch him! Don't let Satou get away!"

"[Escape]."

My footspeed increased when I used the newly learned [Escape] skill.

With all this space, the opposing team's defense was forced to pay attention to me.

I moved to the right side of the field, towards my own winger.

At first he was confused why I was running towards him, but I gestured to the left. He nodded and made a horizontal run to the left.

I made a simple pass to the winger who received the ball in free space, the midfield area that I vacated.

"Shit…! Switch to the winger!"

As soon as they glanced away from me…

"[Lurk]."

I made an overlapping run down the right side.

"Oi… Free again…"

"Eh?!"

The winger was surprised once more to see me open again.

I received the ball from him near the last line of defense.

"H-How'd he get there?!"

The defense went forward to try and trap me.

"...How do I cross again? Oh, well, I hope you catch this…"

Since I knew that my crossing was awful, I just kicked up a wild cross towards where I saw Mitsurugi was, hoping that he'd get it.

"...?! What kind of shitty cross is that, Satou?! Hah!"

Mitsurugi rose up… And that bastard actually did a bicycle kick to catch my awful pass.

The ball went in, making the score 2-0.

"Good work."

I said, running up to Mitsurugi and helping him up.

"...We're working on your crosses after this."

He said, standing up and wiping off the grass from his kit.

Then he leaned in and whispered to me,

"Oi… You were using skills, weren't you?"

"...I figured that it counts as a 'talent', so I went ahead and used it."

"That's cheating!"

"I'm a total beginner, so it's fine for me to cheat a little."

"So you admit that it's cheating… Whatever. Aside from the use of skills, everything else was perfectly executed, anyway. You might actually have some talent."

Our teammates caught up and surrounded us, celebrating the goal.

"Who knew that Satou was this good?!"

"If we have Satou and Mitsurugi… We might make it to nationals?!"

"A new deadly combination is born!"

After my team was done celebrating, my former schoolmate walked over to talk to me again.

"...I admit, Satou… You're good. You might have won this time… But next time I'll definitely beat you!"

Did this guy forget that the game wasn't over yet?

Part 4

The game ended with a 2-0 victory for us.

We spent the rest of the game turtling up and focusing on defense to maintain the 2 goal lead.

In the locker room, the coach embraced me and cried tears of happiness.

"...I knew you had it in you, Satou-kun! I knew I saw talent in you!"

They were treating me as if I was the Man of the Match, even though Mitsurugi was the one who scored two goals.

Once I checked my phone, I saw two new notifications.

Quest completed! You played in an official soccer game! You gained +2 on all your 'Physical' stats!

Your superior vision on the field has allowed you to learn the [Farsight] skill!

[Farsight] Skill Rank: 1, Active Skill (5 mp cost)

You can see objects and creatures 60 miles away. If your vision isn't 20/20 already, you will have perfect vision whenever this skill is activated.

Playing in that game gave me quite a big yield…

I changed back into my uniform. Mitsurugi caught up with me as I was about to leave.

"...You're always quick to leave."

"That's because I don't spend all my time socializing in the change room. I just get changed and leave."

"Why are you so antisocial?!"

"I'm only antisocial towards overly social people, though."

"...What does that even mean? Anyway, I just wanted to say thanks for filling up the vacant spots like that. It was unreasonable for the coach to put a complete newbie in, but not only did you go along with it, you even played really well."

I rubbed the back of my head, wondering why I even bothered playing well.

If I played poorly, that would guarantee that the coach would never put me in a game again.

"I guess it was fun beating all those guys. It's like… I'm a total noob when it comes to the sport and I don't even like playing it, but I still managed to beat those guys who have been playing their whole lives. It was incredibly satisfying."

"...There's something seriously wrong with you, Satou."

We talked a bit more. When we parted ways, my phone buzzed in my pocket.

Your bond with Mitsurugi Kyouya has deepened!

Mitsurugi Kyouya (Soccer Club Ace), Bond Rank: 3

At Rank 3, Mitsurugi Kyouya will view you as a teammate who he can rely on in emergencies. He will gladly do favors for you if you help him get closer with Aqua. He will give you tips when it comes to the dungeon if you ask and he has time. Staying on the soccer team and working hard in practice will deepen your bond with him.

Bond Rank-Up Reward: +10 Strength

…Why did this guy's bond rank-ups give out such good rewards?!

I'd never gotten a +10 in anything before…

With 54 'Strength' I was only just a bit above the average person, though.

Why were my stats so bad? That was the real question.

…

…

On the way home, I bought something from the convenience store that I also worked part-time in.

Since it wasn't my shift, there was another new employee working there, one that the manager just hired recently.

I gave him a look of understanding, since I was in the same position.

When I got home, I saw Aqua on the couch, playing with Kazuto's Nintendo Switch while lying prone.

She turned her head when I walked in and made a disgusted face, turning back around.

Seems she was still angry about our fight.

I walked over to her and took out the sparkling juice I bought from the convenience store.

I pressed the bottle against her cheek.

"Wah! So cold! What was that for, jerk?!"

"This is for you. You like fizzy drinks that go 'shuwa shuwa', right?"

"...D-Do you think this is enough to make me forgive you?"

She grabbed the drink anyway.

I sighed and sat beside her on the couch when she made room for me.

"Look… Maybe I shouldn't have said that I was giving up on facing the Demon King. I know that beating him is the only way for you to return home."

If I got dragged off into a world that wasn't my own, and the guy who was tasked to bring me back said that he had given up, I would have gotten mad, too.

"...As long as you understand. I'm sorry for calling Kazuma a pathetic virgin who will never get laid."

"You don't need to repeat it."

She opened the bottle and started drinking straight from it.

"Puwah! I wish it was alcoholic, but that still hits the spot! Oi, get me some snacks to eat with this."

She was back to her bossy self.

I got her some chips from the pantry as my final peace offering, then went upstairs.

Your bond with Aqua has deepened!

Aqua (Water Goddess), Bond Rank: 4

At Rank 4, Aqua will act reasonable if you ask her to. She will listen to your demands if you ask nicely. She sees you as a reliable housemate who will do things for her if she bugs you enough. She sees you as someone she can mooch off, so she won't leave you alone.

Bond Rank-Up Reward: +10 Faith

Another +10 reward…

I didn't really care about this one, though.

What did the 'Faith' stat even do?

…In the end, she gave me another useless reward.

Part 5

"Yes… He will need to take the day off again this week… His sickness is… Eh? He played in a soccer game yesterday?! Kazuma did?! Erm… Y-Yes… That's exactly why he needs a break, because of his frail body…"

I had my father call the school and get them to give me a day off on Saturday again.

With the day off, I wanted to go to the dungeon and grind some levels.

"Oi, Aqua, I'm going to the dungeon. Wanna come with?"

"...Go away. I wanna sleep."

Even though she made such a big deal about wanting to train at the dungeon…

I kept prodding her, but she wouldn't move.

I left her alone and headed to the dungeon by myself.

However, on my way there…

Somewhere outside the city, there was a faint sound of something blowing up.

Everyone in the street turned their eyes to the sound, but when it disappeared, they went back to what they were doing.

…These people sure were carefree.

As for me, I headed to the source instead of going to the dungeon.

"I knew it was you…"

I ended up in some abandoned junkyard.

There, I found a girl who had collapsed on the ground.

"...That was the best explosion yet."

It was the chuunibyou explosion enthusiast, Megumin.

I helped her up, supporting her arm as she dusted off her school uniform.

"Ah, Kazuma… It seems you're also ditching school."

"I'm not ditching. The school allowed me to take the day off."

"...! W-What sorcery did you use?! You must teach me!"

She clutched my shirt and pressed her face way too close to mine.

"Nevermind that. Why are you ditching school, Megumin? Not only are you ditching school, you're even committing domestic terrorism."

"I wish you wouldn't call it that. After all, this junkyard is abandoned, as you can see."

"You're really good at rationalizing your destructive tendencies, huh?"

"Hehe… Is that true?"

"I'm not complimenting you."

I tried helping her walk around, but she couldn't even move her legs. Instead, I settled for giving her a piggyback ride again. I said,

"This is becoming a recurring theme whenever I meet you."

"That must mean that you're destined to walk the path of explosions with me!"

"No, thanks."

"Eh?! Why not?!"

I carried her out of the junkyard before the police or some emergency responder could arrive to assess the cause of the mysterious explosion.

I soon found a small park and sat her down on a bench, getting a juice for the both of us to drink.

"This is the second time you've treated me. I won't forget this…"

"You can pay the 1,650 yen in total you owe me for the last meal and this drink."

"Y-You remember the exact total, huh? Haha…"

She started nervously averting her gaze.

"Alright, mind telling me exactly why you're blowing up a junkyard?"

"...It's an abandoned junkyard."

"Whatever! Just tell me why you're randomly blowing things up!"

"I received a quest telling me to blow up an abandoned junkyard at exactly 10 am."

"...Why are your quests so oddly specific? And why do they always involve destruction of property in the real world?"

I was very worried about this girl. She should be on a watchlist.

"The quests are my only real way to progress, since I can't exactly go into the dungeon by myself…"

"Didn't you mention a friend named Yunyun before?"

"She's not my friend. She's more like my fan."

"...I don't know this Yunyun personally, but I bet she'd object to that."

Megumin sipped the apple juice I gave her and said,

"Yunyun is a sell-out who is learning ordinary magic and has refused to follow the path of explosions with me. As such, she is too powerful for the beginner floors and I forbade her from coming along with me."

"She's someone with common sense, huh? How unusual for someone who is your friend."

"She's not my friend. She's more like a wounded puppy that likes to follow me around."

Why did the description change?

Although the nickname 'Yunyun' would actually fit a dog more than a real person.

"Well, then… I bet you can recover on your own if you just sit here for a few more minutes. I gotta get going now…"

"Hold it."

Megumin grabbed my arm before I could stand up and leave.

"Huh? Do you need to go to the toilet?"

"Not that! You're going to the dungeon, aren't you?"

How perceptive.

"...What makes you say that?"

"Why else would you skip class and head to the city? I can't imagine you going on a date."

"Do I really give that kind of impression?"

I tried to shake off her hand, but she had a surprisingly strong grip.

"Take me to the dungeon."

"Never."

"You didn't even think about it!"

With what happened last time, it wasn't strange for me to turn her down.

Just as I was about to ditch her…

"Please take me with you to the dungeon! I'll do anything if you let me come back!"

Several people turned their heads to look at us when Megumin started screaming.

"What are you talking about?!"

I tried to cover her mouth but she bit it.

"Owww!"

I heard people talking about us.

"...Dungeon? Is she talking about some weird BDSM thing?"

"Poor girl… That scumbag made her addicted to some kind of strange dungeon play, and now he's throwing her away once he's had his fun…"

"I mean… If he doesn't want her anymore, can I have her?"

Megumin gave me a smug smile as a crowd started to form around us.

"Fine! You win!"

"Heh… Next time don't even bother opposing me and just do as you're told!"

I picked her up again and carried her to the dungeon.

Part 6

Megumin was able to walk again once we arrived.

"...Why do you even want to come with me? Not only is your explosion magic useless in a dungeon, you already used it. I doubt you have enough mana to use it again."

"I can still finish off enemies with this…!"

She took out her phone and a staff came out from her inventory.

It had a wooden shaft and a red crystal at the top.

"I got this from a Random Loot Box I got after finishing that quest at the junkyard."

"Oh…! Can it recover mana, or something?"

"Even better! It amplifies my magic power!"

"Why do you need even more power? That's the last thing you need. Go ahead and sell that thing. It must be rare, right?"

"...D-Don't tempt me. I know that I can buy a full month's worth of groceries if I sell this!"

"Then why don't you sell it?"

"Because it's cool."

I was tempted to leave her at the entrance.

However, knowing that she'd find a way to make my life hell if I did that, I let her come along with me.

"Are you telling me that you'll use that staff to fight monsters? I doubt it does a lot of physical damage."

"It's still a blunt object, you know. It can do a fair bit of damage. And for some reason my 'Strength' score is pretty high…"

"What is it?"

"Right now, it's 60."

I stopped walking, causing her to bump against my back.

"Ow! Why'd you suddenly stop…?!"

I turned to her just as she was rubbing her forehead.

"...Why are you looking at me like that? I-It can't be… Now that you have me alone in a place where no one can find us, you're going to do perverted things?!"

"Don't mind me. I'm just thinking to myself that life is unfair and needlessly cruel."

"I understand. My father occasionally has those moments. I believe they're called a 'midlife crisis'..."

"How old do you think I am?! You and I are pretty much about the same age, you know?!"

"Sorry… Those bags under your eyes add a couple years. I recommend sleeping early and washing your face with cold water when you wake up."

Even though I had a proper sleep schedule these days, it was hard to undo all those late gaming sessions I enjoyed as a NEET.

As we were walking, I held a hand out to stop Megumin.

[Enemy Detection] was telling me that there were creatures ahead.

…Although I didn't sense a high threat-level from them.

When we peeked around the corner, we saw some lizards skittering around.

"Huh? What are those? They don't look like monsters…"

Megumin said, as we were huddled together and looking around the corner.

"These are just normal creatures that are there for the monsters to hunt and eat. These monsters still need to eat and drink. They don't just randomly spawn like mobs in games. They also need to breed and procreate, that's why sometimes you don't see a lot of monsters."

"I see. Let's kill them."

She took out her staff and ran forward, using it like a hammer to pummel down the lizards who couldn't run away in time.

"Oiii! Didn't you hear me?! The monsters eat these things! If you kill them, we won't have as many monsters to hunt!"

"Oh, these things give out quite a bit of EXP, and they don't even fight back."

"...Come again?"

Megumin showed me that killing those weak lizards gave her 5 EXP each.

"Are you telling me all this time that I could have hunted those creatures instead of fighting dangerous monsters?"

"Sigh… Don't worry, it's not your fault. Not everyone has the intelligence of a Crimson Demon like me…"

I wanted to chop the back of her head to make those fake eye contacts of hers fall out.

Megumin and I proceeded to fall into a pattern of avoiding monsters and hunting the helpless creatures.

Mostly they were insects like beetles and caterpillars, along with the lizards that we found earlier.

"Kazuma… That sword you have…"

Megumin said, noticing my katana.

I smirked and held it for her to see. I said,

"I got it custom made. Not bad, right?"

"It's quite excellent, for sure. Does it have a name yet?"

"I haven't thought of one yet. I was thinking something manly like Excali…"

"Chunchunmaru."

"Huh?"

I lost my train of thought when Megumin said that.

"That's the name of your sword now. Chunchunmaru."

"No way."

I ignored Megumin's suggestion and kept walking.

Eventually, we came across a small pond in the lake.

I came across this pond before in the past, but aside from killing the monsters who gathered around it to drink water, I didn't really interact with it in any special way. I didn't want to risk drinking from a random pond I found in a dungeon, after all.

Megumin didn't even hesitate. She dipped her head into the water and started gulping down mouthfuls of it.

"...?! Oi! What would you do if that was toxic to humans?!"

I pulled her head out of the pond and started to do the Heimlich maneuver on her to get her to spit the water out.

"Let go of me! I found something really good in that pond!"

She pushed me away and went back to dipping her head into the pond.

A few seconds later, her head reemerged.

She turned around and showed me that she had two crawfish in both hands.

…What kind of savage girl is she?

She had a proud smile on her face and waved the crawfish around.

"There's a bunch of them in that pond, Kazuma! Come on, help me catch them!"

I didn't really feel like it, but I figured that I might get something if I cooked those crawfish.

I helped Megumin gather a bunch of them, although I wasn't as skilled as her when it came to capturing the slippery things.

You learned the [Fishing] skill!

[Fishing] Skill Rank: 1, Passive Skill

You are now proficient in using fishing tools. Your fishing skill depends on your 'Intuition' (60) score. You can fish aquatic creatures that are ranked as 'Common'.

…I didn't think that I'd actually get a skill from that.

Not only that, gathering those crawfish even gave some EXP.

Part 7

On the train, people avoided us again.

That was because the duffel bag I had was stuffed with creature carcasses, including the crawfish.

We couldn't fit everything in our inventories, and Megumin insisted that I bring them home with me.

She also insisted that I let her come over to my place, to cook all the 'food' we captured.

"We're gonna have a feast today! I should bring some home for Komekko…"

"What's a Komekko?"

"My little sister."

"You even give your sister a weird nickname?"

Even though it was embarrassing, I was getting used to having people avoid me on the train after a visit to the dungeon.

Your 'Bravery' has increased by +1!

Even the app recognized that I was getting used to the humiliation.

Once we got home, Megumin took half of the carcasses in my duffel bag, took a grill and headed outside.

She left me with the crawfish.

I simply boiled them and ended up putting them in miso soup.

Once it was done, I scanned it with the app.

Boiled Crawfish Miso Soup - Common

Eating this will give you +2 Health.

After I finished making the dish, Megumin came back with a tray full of fried skewers.

Fried insects, fried lizards and some other things I didn't recognize.

"Throw those away."

"I won't let them go to waste!"

I was worried that the neighbors would complain about the smell of grilled insects in the air.

Aqua came down, smelling the food.

When Megumin saw Aqua, she blinked and said,

"Wait, you two live together? How indecent."

"It's not like that."

Even though I didn't want anything to do with the fried insects and lizards, Megumin and Aqua sat down on the table and started eating them.

Megumin already showed me that she had a wild side to her, but I didn't expect Aqua to start chowing down on the food.

"Aqua, why are you eating that stuff so easily?"

She chuckled, waving a fried lizard skewer around.

"Do you think I'm dumb? Since you two caught these together, I assume you were from the dungeon, yes? Therefore, I can conclude that these are actually some kind of dungeon monster that can be consumed as food, such as Flying Cabbages and Flying Lettuce."

"Actually, they're just random insects and lizards we found roaming around the dungeon."

Aqua immediately spit out the beetle legs and lizard tail in her mouth.

"Why are you two hunting the critters in the dungeon?! Those things are monster feed, you know?!"

Megumin was chewing on a worm-like thing when she said,

"They give out just as much EXP as monsters. Why wouldn't we hunt them?"

"...They give out a lot of EXP because they're supposed to make monsters grow at a faster rate! Why do you think you always see mature monsters around, and not a bunch of younglings!"

"All the more reason to eat them."

"Argh! Do you not understand the consequences of this…?! If the young monsters can't defend themselves, the parents will… Eh? It seems that eating these things raised my Health Points?"

Aqua resumed eating the skewers when she found out that they raised Health Points.

"..."

Knowing this, I ended up eating them, too.

…They actually weren't that bad.

Your 'Health' has increased by +1!

…

…

"Thanks for the meal."

Megumin said, when I saw her out as she was about to leave.

"...You shouldn't use your explosion alone. If you collapse like that, you'll be in trouble if some perverted guy finds you."

"Kazuma found me but you didn't do anything."

She really thought I was a pervert.

Aqua laughed and placed a hand on my shoulder.

"Don't worry about this guy! He's a pervert, but he's also a coward! Even if he has the desire to violate a girl, he'll never act upon it. He's completely harmless!"

"Enough with the slander."

I said, shaking off her hand from my shoulder.

"Seriously, though. Just call me next time if you get a quest like that again."

Megumin seemed surprised by my offer, but she smiled.

"Once you make a promise, I'll hold you to it."

"Yeah, yeah. I'm not as much of a scumbag as everyone seems to think I am."

"Well, then… Farewell."

"Later."

We waved goodbye to Megumin.

Your bond with Megumin has deepened!

Megumin (Explosion Mage), Bond Rank: 2

At Rank 2, Megumin considers you as a slightly reliable guy who seems really perverted. She noticed the way you took the chance to grope her butt while you were carrying her. She thinks that you seem like a nice guy and you have potential as an explosion sommelier. If you offer to help her practice her explosion magic, she will readily agree.

Bond Reward: Magic Power +5

…Why did it seem like her opinion of me got worse after the rank up?

The good news was that I finally managed to raise my Magic Power.

"Megumin has more useful bond rewards than Aqua, huh?"

"...Kazuma, if you want to fight, I'm more than willing to give you a fight!"

"Why don't you wash the dishes, instead? You're the goddess of water, right? You should be good at chores that involve water."

"D-Don't reduce my divinity to that of simple chores! And what's with you going to the dungeon with Megumin and not taking me along, huh?!"

"I tried to wake you up, but you're too damn lazy."

"I don't want to hear that from you!"

Even though we just recently made up, Aqua and I started arguing again.

Chapter 7: A Close Call For These Fools!

Part 1

It was Sunday, the day when I arranged to meet with Chris.

I only just realized that I didn't have enough money, with a meager 1,350 Yen.

"Please, I beg of you!"

I bowed in front of my parents.

They both looked at each other. My father said,

"...Giving Kazuma an advance on his allowance, huh? The last time we did that, you said you were hanging out with friends, but you ended up just buying a new game."

My mother nodded and said,

"Yes… And are we really supposed to believe that Kazuma is going on a date with a girl?"

Was it really that hard to believe? I said,

"Please! I'll send you pictures and everything as proof!"

"But what if you're just taking pictures of some random girl and photoshopping yourself with her?"

"Oh! I could see him doing that, dear!"

They really didn't trust me at all.

I suppose I couldn't blame them, since I did trick them a lot in the past.

"...How about this? If you give me an early allowance now, I'll pay you back next week. You already know I have a part time job, anyway. I'll pay you back, I promise!"

They looked at each other, then turned back to me.

"...If Kazuma is willing to go that far… I suppose we'll have to agree."

My mother nodded and said,

"If Kazuma isn't tricking us and he's actually maturing a little, we shouldn't stop his progress."

My father took out his wallet and gave me 1,000 yen.

"I expect you to pay me back, like you promised."

"Deal!"

I snatched the money from him before he could change his mind.

"...Our little boy is going on a date. He sure is growing up."

My mother said, wiping tears from her eyes. My father held her shoulder and said,

"I know, right? Even though he was a NEET only a few weeks before…"

"I think Aqua-chan really helped him get out of his shell. We owe a lot to her."

"I know! We should raise her allowance!"

How the hell did Aqua end up profiting from this?!

I didn't say anything, since I got what I wanted.

After checking myself in the mirror, I left the house to meet up with Chris.

Before I left the house, my phone buzzed in my pocket.

Your bond with your family has deepened!

Satou (Family), Bond Rank: 4

At Rank 4, your family will give you some leeway as you recover from being a NEET. Your parents will give you an advance on your allowance if you continue to go to school, as promised. Your brother thinks better of you and might say a few nice things to his friends about you. If you mention wanting a non-blood related step sister again, your parents will beat you and leave you with grave injuries.

Bond Reward: Parents will give you an advance on your allowance as long as you pay it back!

Satisfied with this outcome, I headed to the meeting place Chris suggested.

We agreed to meet in a trendy cafe near the train station.

Even though this wasn't a place I'd go to if I was alone, I felt it was fine if Chris was with me.

I arrived first and waited in front of the store for a few minutes.

"Kazuma-kun! Sorry, did I make you wait?"

"Don't worry, I just got here."

I said the famous line.

Even though all I did was pass the ball around and dribble through cones.

The way he was talking…

"This team has reached its limits with me as the playmaker. I acknowledge that you have what it takes to carry this team to its full potential, Satou. I'll leave our dream to reach the nationals in your hands…"

Which 90's soccer manga did he steal that line from?

"No, I don't really want to…"

The coach blew his whistle and drowned out my complaints.

Practicing with the main team took up a lot more energy than practicing alone.

I had to keep running back and forth and doing a bunch of things that I wasn't used to.

There was no doubt that I'd wake up sore in the morning.

Your 'Speed' and 'Stamina' have increased by +1!

After the practice was over, I headed to the locker room with Mitsurugi.

"You did well keeping up in the main team practice, Satou."

He said, while changing out of his kit and putting on his school uniform.

"..."

Since Mitsurugi was a hero candidate like me, of course he'd notice that something happened in the dungeon.

When I didn't respond, he said,

He actually fell for it?

Your 'Cunning' increased by +1!
