Chapter 8: A Repopulation For This Dungeon!

Part 1

After my cafe date with Rin, I went to 'Sunshine' smoothie to claim my weekly 'Stamina' bonus.

I was expecting to get a 'Charisma' bonus as well, but…

This store is no longer considered trendy! No 'Charisma' bonuses will be awarded!

Trends come and go, after all.

I used the money I stole from that delinquent to buy a blueberry banana smoothie.

While enjoying my smoothie, I thought about my stat increases.

Although I was making steady progress, my physical stats were only just reaching those of an average person's.

There was still quite a long way to go.

The only stat that was truly improving at a fast rate was my 'Cunning' skill.

If it wasn't for my atrocious 'Speed' and 'Dexterity', perhaps I would have been better suited for the Thief class.

While bemoaning my lack of innate talent once more, I headed home once I finished my smoothie.

In terms of weekly stat bonuses, there were also Kazuto's lessons on how to pick-up girls.

If it wasn't for the stat bonus, I wouldn't bother going to that brat for lessons.

When I got home, I found him playing on his Nintendo Switch.

…Did this guy actually have a girlfriend?

"Hm? Nii-san wants a lesson again? It can't be helped…"

Acting so smug about it…

"Listen, nii-san, girls like it when you're a bit mean to them…"

He then proceeded to give me the most generic pick-up artist advice ever.

Your 'Charisma' has increased by +1!

It still ended up raising my charisma somehow.

After getting the weekly lesson from Kazuto, I went up to my room to do homework.

It was almost the end of the month, meaning that I would soon see the rewards for my hard work at school.

Since the dungeon was out of commission for a few days, I had a lot of free time to work on trying to raise my stats and learn new skills.

However, just like before, simply doing a bunch of random tasks around the house didn't do anything.

I remembered what Mitsurugi said, about how only meaningful practice and outcomes will trigger an improvement in stats.

If it came to meaningful training, I remembered that early on, I gained some points in 'Speed' after I ran for 30 minutes straight.

"...What a pain."

Although I didn't really want to do exercise outside of what I was already doing in the soccer club, I put on my tracksuit and headed outside.

With my improved stamina and training, I didn't struggle anymore when it came to jogging for 30 minutes.

I even lasted an hour of jogging around my neighborhood before I needed to take a break.

You broke your previous jogging record! Your 'Speed', 'Stamina' and 'Willpower' increased by +1!

Pushing past my limits increased a lot of my stats.

If I could raise my physical stats this way, I wondered if it was the same for the other stats.

Would the same work for magic?

I tried it out, going to my backyard.

I set up some used cans in a line and pointed at them with my finger.

"[Tinder]!"

With the newly improved [Tinder], I noticed that the bolt of fire that shot out of my finger had more power behind it than before.

It knocked the can over and left a burn mark on the surface.

I proceeded to knock over the rest of the cans until I was low on mana.

Your 'Magic Power' increased by +1!

It really did work.

Although I'd have to keep increasing the intensity of the practice to see actual results.

"Nii-san, what are you doing here? Dinner's ready."

Kazuto called out to me from the house.

After eating dinner, I went up to Aqua and said,

"Since you made the app, can you tell me what kind of practice I need to do to raise each stat?"

Aqua, who was eating ice cream in the living room, said,

"...Isn't it obvious? Best way to increase your physical stats is to exercise. Best way to increase your intelligence is to study and to perform intense mental tasks. You get faith by praying and doing good deeds. You increase magic stats by practicing magic."

"I'm asking for specific things I can do… For example, with 'Intelligence', studying is more of a long term thing. Is there anything specific I can do to raise the stat right now?"

"You can try learning about a subject you're not familiar with. I don't know, maybe watch a documentary or something."

"Alright, sounds good."

I took the remote and changed the channel she was watching.

"Hey! I was watching that TV drama! If I don't watch it, I can't talk to the housewives in the market!"

She had too much time in her hands.

I ignored her and switched to a documentary channel. There was a documentary on about the theories behind dark energy.

"Oh, this is actually pretty interesting."

I said, watching the program. I didn't really watch documentaries before because I thought they were boring. If someone mentioned 'dark energy' to me, I'd assume it was an RPG thing.

Something Megumin would make a chuuni speech about.

"...This is lame. I'm going to my room."

Aqua said, getting up and going upstairs.

After watching the hour long documentary…

Your 'Intelligence' increased by +1!

By the time I finished the documentary, I found myself feeling really tired.

It was as if exhaustion filled my body all at once.

Warning! Your 'Stamina' is dangerously low! Overtraining might result in physical and mental fatigue!

I didn't notice it before, but it seemed that stat training actually took up a fair bit of stamina.

Even though it was listed as a physical stat, 'Stamina' was also affected by mental training.

Making sure to take that into account next time, I went to bed early and went to sleep.

Part 2

"Good morning, senpai!"

"Morning, Rin."

Walking to school with Rin had become a daily routine.

Since my relationship with Rin had good momentum…

"Say, Rin, I heard that 'The Magic Tanuki Girl' has a movie adaptation coming out this week."

"Oh, yes! I'm gonna watch it when it comes out, of course!"

"Do you want to watch it together?"

"I was actually going to ask you, senpai, but you beat me to it!"

A good mood really was forming between us.

At this point, it wasn't strange if I actually ended up dating Rin.

Since the movie was coming out on Sunday, we made plans to meet up at the movie theater.

Your 'Bravery' increased by +1!

Asking her out on a date increased my 'Bravery'.

I was in a good mood throughout the day.

During soccer practice, I was still in a good mood.

"Whoa, Satou… You're playing inspired today."

Mitsurugi said, once he saw me finally pulling off a cross that was halfway decent.

"Well… Life is better when you have something to look forward to at the end of the week."

"...I don't want to kick you down while you're feeling good about yourself, but it's kind of creepy to see you acting like this."

During practice, I focused on practicing my passes and finding open teammates during the practice matches.

I also made sure to play with more intensity than before.

Your 'Dexterity' and 'Intuition' increased by +1!

Soccer practice took up half of my stamina points, lowering it to 25.

Since it was a Tuesday, I headed to my part-time job at the convenience store after soccer practice.

It was a straightforward job and I could afford to go on autopilot while still performing well.

"Good work. Here's your pay."

The boss handed me 3,000 yen.

I'd need this money for the movie date with Rin.

Although, I'd have to pay 1,000 yen to my parents…

Your 'Willpower' and 'Bravery' increased by +1!

Going to work decreased my stamina points all the way down to 10.

I figured that I could train one more stat for the night before I became exhausted.

When I got home, I went to the backyard and practiced my magic again.

This time, I filled the cans up with rocks and tried knocking them over.

It took two shots to knock the cans over this time.

Your 'Magic Power' increased by +1!

Aqua was watching me train my magic midway through.

Once I was done, she said,

"I'm glad you're taking things seriously for once, Kazuma!"

"Why don't you train your stats, too?"

"Hmph. Unlike you, most of my stats are already incredibly high! Only my 'Intelligence' and 'Luck' have low scores!"

Was that really something anyone could admit enthusiastically?

Magic training took up the rest of my stamina points. After doing my homework, I prepared to head to sleep.

Before I could tuck myself in, I got a text notification. It was from Darkness.

"Hello, this is Darkness. Chris and I went to the dungeon, but it seems that something terrible happened in the Giant Toad area. There are also no monsters on the first floor. Chris seemed really upset about this, and I want to help her somehow. If you know anything about this, please tell us. Thank you for your assistance."

Why was her texting style so formal?

Even though she was like that in real life.

I felt bad since I had a hand in the destruction of the Giant Toad area.

I didn't know why Chris was upset about it, but she did seem to take her duties as Eris's hero candidate seriously.

After sending a text back to Darkness telling her that I'd meet up with them to help tomorrow, I went to sleep.

…

…

The next day went about the same as the last.

Since I promised to head to the dungeon with Darkness and Chris, I didn't spend too much energy in soccer practice.

"And I thought Satou started taking this seriously…"

Mitsurugi had this to say as I phoned it in during practice.

"We have a game on Friday. You better be in your best condition by then."

"Yeah, yeah."

I ignored his nagging and continued to lazily practice.

I went to the dungeon after practice was over.

Darkness and Chris were waiting for me inside the entrance. I waved to them as I saw them when I entered the dungeon.

"Yo."

"I'm glad you agreed to help, Kazuma-kun… This is quite the crisis."

"I think I got the gist of it from what Darkness told me."

I said, acting as if I didn't know exactly what happened.

Your 'Cunning' increased by +1!

It made me feel like an asshole everytime that particular stat improved.

"Darkness and I have been investigating and we found a bucket near the Giant Toad area."

She held up the bucket that Megumin left last time.

It was filled with rotting carcasses. I pinched my nose.

"...I wonder why a bucket is here in the dungeon."

Darkness said, while peering at the bucket.

"I have a theory. Inside the bucket, there's something written there with a marker. It says 'Container of Madness'. I believe that this is a tool that the Demon King army used to gather the creatures in this area, in order to drive the monsters to extinction."

"They already infiltrated the dungeon?!"

"Perhaps…"

Chris actually thought that Megumin's chuunibyou nonsense was part of the Demon King army's plans.

I almost wanted to apologize.

Darkness went on to say,

"I dug up some of the debris in the Giant Toad area, but we couldn't find any clues aside from the bucket. The Demon King army probably left that there to taunt us. What despicable demons… Hehe…"

She grinned, as if she was excited to meet these same demons she described as despicable.

Also, she casually said that she dug up the debris… How strong was this girl?

"It seems you two already did most of the investigation. I suppose you don't need my help…"

I was eager to turn around and leave.

"You can still help, Kazuma-kun! I actually have a plan to repopulate the first floor. After all, it's bad if this area doesn't have monsters in it for new hero candidates to train on."

"Ah… Sure. I'm glad to help."

I really wasn't.

Chris led us to the Giant Toad area. Along with the dungeon repairing itself and Darkness cleaning the debris, there was a pathway to the second floor door now.

"Alright, let's head to the second floor! I'm sad that we couldn't beat the Giant Toads, but what's done is done."

"I'm going to miss those Giant Toads…"

Darkness seemed genuinely remorseful that the Giant Toads were no more.

I didn't know what they planned to do on the second floor, but I still followed them, unable to refuse.

Along the way, I saw the corpse of a Giant Toad, buried underneath some rubble.

I also saw the dungeon floor siphoning off the rotten flesh of the Giant Toad, absorbing it within the dirt.

What a gruesome sight.

Part 3

The second floor led into another maze-like area with torches along the wall.

It seemed that, aside from the wide area boss room that had unique biomes, most dungeon floors had a labyrinthine, cave-like environment.

"There's an enemy around the corner."

Chris said, using her [Enemy Detection] to find the enemy.

Since we both had similar skill sets, I felt a bit redundant.

"Hah…!"

Darkness tried to cut down the big eared monster known as a gremlin, but she missed badly with her greatsword.

"Kyiii!"

The gremlin let out a loud shriek and jumped at Darkness, attempting to bite her.

"...Its bite is not that strong."

Darkness said, sighing in disappointment as she held her hand out for the gremlin to bite.

"[Bind]!"

Chris threw a rope at the gremlin, tying it up.

"Alright, let's bring this to the first floor."

Their plan was to repopulate the first floor by bringing down low-threat monsters from the second floor.

As for the monsters who were too strong for the first floor…

"Kazuma-kun…! Shoot down its core!"

A purple slime came out and attacked Darkness.

"Ah…! This one actually hurts a little! Is that poison? It's trying to poison me… Kuh!"

"[Snipe]."

I put an end to Darkness's fun by shooting the core of the slime, making it disperse.

It was my job to take care of monsters that could harm beginners on the first floor.

With Darkness as the frontline, all I had to do was follow it up with an attack.

As for the monster loot, we didn't make much money since we were splitting it three ways, although I did get 15 EXP from taking monsters down.

Still, the 350 yen I earned was a paltry reward for all the effort we were putting in.

So far, Chris had captured a gremlin, a pair of kobolds and a pair of goblins.

Although gremlins were a bit stronger than kobolds and goblins, they were still low-class monsters that weren't a threat to beginners.

"What do we do for food? All the creatures on the first floor have also disappeared."

I said, after we left the gremlin on the first floor. Thankfully, since the environment was similar, the monsters didn't panic too much when they were relocated.

"Since the monsters feed on regular creatures, I suppose we can just bring some from the outside world. There are also monsters that resemble food, but they just use that appearance as a disguise to hunt other monsters that try to feed on them."

She was probably referring to food-based monsters like the Flying Cabbages and Lettuce that I encountered before.

Speaking of food-based monsters, the next one we encountered fell in that category.

Green Onions came out from the ground and attacked us once we got close.

"...! A-Amazing! They're whipping me! Although it doesn't hurt that much, this is…!"

Darkness cried out in ecstasy when the green onions started using their shoots to whip her.

I glanced at Chris, who weakly chuckled and said,

"S-She has strange hobbies, but I swear she's a nice girl!"

We defeated the Green Onions and brought them to the first floor.

Surprisingly, those things gave out a lot of EXP.

I got 30 points just from taking down 2 of them, while Chris took down some herself.

"Let's see… I think this will do."

We planted the bulbs of the green onions near the pond on the first floor.

"Let us pray to Eris-sama for the growth of these green onions…"

Showing a serious side for once, Darkness put her hands together and prayed.

We joined her in prayer, wishing for the growth of these green onions.

Your 'Faith' increased by +1!

"I'm sure Eris-sama is happy with your prayers!"

Chris said, after we stopped praying.

"...Since these green onions give out a lot of EXP, won't the monsters who eat them become too powerful for beginners?"

I said, the thought just occurred to me after I remembered what happened to the Giant Toads.

"Is Kazuma-kun worried about the monsters evolving? Don't worry, for low-threat monsters, they don't have the capacity to evolve. The only ones we brought down that can evolve are the kobolds, who can evolve to kobold heroes, but there's a specific requirement for them to evolve that doesn't involve gaining a lot of EXP."

Monsters apparently had a limit on how many levels they could gain. I suppose there was no such risk of a goblin god variant emerging.

"May these goblins grow big and strong…"

I didn't even want to know what Darkness was muttering about.

Part 4

Chris said that she'd try and bring some normal creatures and animals from the outside for the monsters to hunt.

"Thanks for coming to help, Kazuma-kun!"

I waved goodbye as I saw her off.

I turned to Darkness and said,

"Well… I should get going, too…"

"Please wait."

Before I could slip away, Darkness asked me to stay.

"What is it…?"

"W-Why are you looking at me with those eyes full of suspicion?"

Did she give me any reason not to suspect her?

Collecting toad slimes, getting off on monsters beating up on her, muttering about wanting goblins to get big and strong…

This girl clearly had several screws loose.

I didn't want to bother talking to her if Chris wasn't around.

Darkness was the hot girl's weird friend you pretend to get along with.

"...It's not much, I just need Kazuma's help to complete a quest I have."

"I refuse."

"P-Please let me finish!"

Because of her usual behavior, even that sentence seemed lewd to me.

"Fine. What's the quest?"

"Well, one of them requires a man to slap me on the face…"

I wound up my arm and slapped her clean on the left cheek.

"..."

She stared at me in shock.

"What? You asked for it."

"Y-Yes, I did… But to think that you wouldn't even hesitate…"

"Listen, I'm a man who values the concept of 'gender equality' greatly. If you think I'll hold back just because you're a female, you're dead wrong."

Besides, she asked for it.

"A-As expected! I had high expectations of Kazuma… but you've far exceeded them!"

She looked at me with bright eyes full of admiration.

"Right… Well, I gotta get going now."

"Thank you for helping me! I hope I can rely on your help again in the future!"

Just leave me alone already.

She went back into the dungeon to the entrance she used to get in.

She was clearly a foreigner who lived in a different part of the world, but I didn't know which country she came from.

Your bond with Darkness has deepened!

Darkness (Masochist Crusader), Bond Rank: 2

At Rank 2, Darkness has decided that you have what it takes to be an excellent sadist. She will seek you out whenever she wants to receive your punishment. She also thinks that you have the face of a scumbag who likes to abuse women, and that your abusive slap is commendable. She believes that you can be the S to her M and would like you to proactively abuse her more in the future.

Bond Reward: +5 Health.

She was clearly a girl I needed to stay away from.

Since I used a lot of stamina in the dungeon, I didn't have any energy to train my magic or do any exercise.

I wanted to watch a documentary to try and raise my 'Intelligence', but Aqua learned her lesson from last time and kept the remote away from me.

"Wiz… What kind of useless enchantment is this?!"

I said, staring at the enchantment she gave me.

"B-But… It's useful in the dungeon because there's lots of dark places, especially when you go to floor 50 and beyond!"

"I'm currently still exploring floor 2! Not only that, I already have the [Night Vision] skill! This is useless to me! All it'll do is prevent me from sneaking up on monsters because it's glowing!"

It wasn't even a strong light, it was a dim light, too. It's beyond useless.

"W-Wah! I'm sorry, I didn't know!"

"What happened to sharpening the blade?! You said that you can make my weapon do extra damage!"

"W-Well… You only paid 10,000 yen, so…"

I understood why this store was empty.

I had her take away the enchantment and give me back my money.

"Um… Disenchanting it will actually cost about 2,000 yen."

"For not telling me that you're using a different enchantment than advertised, I hope you'll disenchant it free of charge."

"Y-Yes… I suppose I can do that…"

Seeing her with teary eyes made me pity her.

"...But I guess I can give you a tip."

"...! Really?! Thank you so much!"

I ended up giving her a 1,000 yen tip.

Even if she was a bad shopkeeper, she was still an incredibly beautiful woman. Her looks swayed my opinion of her.

After I left the store, I checked my phone and saw a new notification.

You have formed a bond with the Lich Shopkeeper, Wiz!

Wiz (Lich Shopkeeper), Bond Rank: 1

At Rank 1, Wiz sees you as a cheap customer who doesn't buy any of her items. While she is grateful for the tip, and you helping her feed herself, she wishes that you will actually buy the items from her shop. Shopping in the store will deepen your bond with her.

…Wait, did that say 'Lich'?

No wonder why she considered floor 50 a low level floor.

Part 7

Since I wanted to delay going home as much as possible, I headed over to the dungeon.

On the first floor, there were signs all around, written by Chris telling people not to hunt the monsters yet, as they were in the middle of repopulating.

With such cute handwriting, I doubted that there was anyone who'd ignore the signs.

Just as I was thinking that…

I saw a certain girl in overalls, carrying a bucket.

"...Did you not learn your lesson?!"

I went up to her and took the bucket away from her.

Only to see it filled with live creatures.

Megumin turned around and screamed.

"A-A pervert is…!"

"Oi… I'm not gonna do anything to you…"

"Ah, sorry… I thought it was some pervert who wanted to assault me… Oh, no, it's Kazuma!"

She started running away.

I caught up to her and stopped her from running.

Maybe I really did need to get face surgery.

"Megumin… What are you doing here? Don't tell me you're still hunting critters after what happened last time…"

"I learned my lesson. As you can see, these ones are live. I captured them outside and I'm bringing them here to feed the monsters."

As she said that, she took the bucket back and dumped the critters she gathered onto the dungeon floor.

After seeing that she wasn't up to no good, I let her go.

"What are you doing here, Kazuma?"

"I'm just here to get some EXP on the second floor."

"I see. Let me come with you."

"No way."

"Can't you see that I learned my lesson?! Besides, if you really think I'm up to no good, it's in your best interest if you can keep an eye on me."

"I guess that makes sense."

She convinced me to let her tag along as I went up to the second floor.

When we passed by what was formerly the Giant Toad area, Megumin went silent. She hadn't gotten over the bad memories from last time.

The area was already fixed, although the grass hadn't begun to grow yet. The walls were repaired by the dungeon and we could walk through the area without having to worry about tripping over rubble.

After we made it through the area, Megumin let out a breath and stood a bit taller.

Once we reached the door to the second floor, I led the way while Megumin took out her staff from her inventory.

"Are you actually planning on hitting monsters with that?"

I asked while looking at the staff.

"I'm relying on you to give me the last hit."

"You do realize that I came here to raise my own levels, right?"

"I'm relying on you to give me the last hit."

She just repeated herself.

As we were moving, I sensed a monster ahead.

Looking around the corner, I saw a vaguely humanoid creature with rotting flesh. It was almost like a zombie, except there was some kind of sickly, green aura emanating from its body.

It used its freakishly long limbs and claws to tear apart the carcass of an unidentifiable creature, bringing the torn flesh into its mouth to feed on it.

[Enemy Reading] told me that it was a 'Ghoul'.

Using [Lurk], I hid my presence before taking out my shortbow.

Then I used [Snipe], aiming for its head.

The arrow pierced its head, making runny, green blood pour out from the side of its temple.

I expected it to fall over, but it turned its head to look at me, sensing my presence after I revealed myself with the attack.

"...Urgggh."

It let out a low groan before dashing towards me with its long limbs.

"It's not dead yet?! It was a clear headshot!"

I said, while running with Megumin following me.

"...I guess it's an undead of some sort. It won't die unless you drop its hit points to 0."

"What a pain in the ass!"

Since I didn't have any problems last time I was on the second floor, I thought that I could handle the monsters there.

But last time, I had Chris and Darkness with me.

Even though Darkness couldn't hit anything to save her life, she could also tank everything and even relished the pain.

…Come to think of it, she even survived the lethal dose of poison those slimes gave her.

"Kazuma… You were so reliable last time. Why are we just running away?"

"Stop talking, keep running!"

Once we passed a sharp corner in the maze, I turned around and faced my palm to the ground.

"[Create Water]! [Freeze]!"

After creating a puddle of water, I immediately froze it.

"Urrggghk!"

The ghoul couldn't stop in time and slipped on the ice.

Inertia made it slide all the way against the wall, slamming against it and halting its movements.

I took out Chunchunmaru and dealt the final strike, beheading the Ghoul.

As we watched its ugly head fall off its body, Megumin said,

"You were supposed to give me the final blow."

"...Those who didn't contribute should shut up."

I gained 15 EXP from that encounter.

After reluctantly harvesting the Ghoul for parts, I found that its claws were a useful material.

Ghoul Claws (Common)

Claws that can be made into arrows, spears, daggers or traps. Has a Paralyzing effect that will go against the target's 'Willpower' stat (30% effective).

Sells for: 1,000 yen

…It would have been incredibly dangerous if I got hit by those claws.

"I see that Chunchunmaru is serving you well."

Megumin said, nodding in approval.

"...I still haven't forgiven you for that."

"I believe the name suits its owner."

"You haven't even seen it yet!"

The dream Aqua gave it a good rating!

"That said, Kazuma, next time you should let me have the killing blow."

"If you have the chance, go for it, but I'm not risking my life just to let you leech EXP from me."

When I said 'risking my life', Megumin's demeanor changed. She looked down at her shoes.

"Sorry about that, Kazuma."

I sighed and said,

"...I'll let you have the next one."

"Thank you..."

There was an awkward silence as we proceeded to explore the second floor.

Like with the first floor, I took out my notebook and drew a detailed map of the second floor.

There were much more branches and forks on the second floor than the first floor. It was easy to get lost.

While we were walking along, [Trap Detection] gave me a warning. I held my hand out to stop Megumin and looked down.

There was a trip wire ahead of us.

[Enemy Detection] activated at the same time and told me that there were ten threats hiding just ahead.

However, when I looked at the area ahead, I didn't see any monsters there.

When I told Megumin, she said,

"Maybe they're invisible?"

"Maybe."

Since it was a possibility, I used [Create Earth] to make a handful of dirt in my hand.

Then I used [Wind Breath] to spray the dirt all over the area.

If there were invisible enemies, then the dirt would cling to them and show their outlines.

While that didn't happen, I noticed something else.

The gust of wind caused the dirt on the walls to fall away.

I noticed right away that there were panels in the walls, originally camouflaged by the dirt.

The panels had hinges on one side, like a trapdoor.

Furthermore, I noticed claw marks around the panels, likely a result of the monsters constructing this trap, scratching the walls.

"I see… It's like that…"

I examined the wire trap and saw that it led to one of the trapdoors. I assumed that it was meant to alert the monsters hiding within if there were intruders around.

I took out the claws that I got from the ghouls, then started to crush them with the hilt of Chunchunmaru.

"...What are you doing?"

Megumin said, while watching me crushing the claws into small pieces.

"I have a [Smithing] skill that lets me craft items… Now let me focus or this might not turn out well."

She kept quiet while I tried to craft the trap item I had in mind.

Thankfully, since my 'Creativity' was decently high, a blue light washed over the materials and they formed into the item I had in mind.

"I see what you're planning now, Kazuma. You really are a cunning guy…"

The app made sure I was reminded of that everyday.

Very carefully, I took the newly made caltrops that were crafted from the ghoul claws. Thankfully, I was wearing gloves that protected my hands from them.

With Megumin's help, we tossed them around the area ahead.

Once the trap was set, Megumin and I took position, then I set off the wire trap.

Just like I expected, I heard a loud ringing of a bell.

The trap doors opened and the half-dog, half-human creatures known as kobolds came out jumping from the trap doors.

"Wan! Wan, wannnn?!"

They started barking and hollering as they landed on the paralyzing ghoul caltrops we laid out.

None of them had a high enough willpower to resist the paralyzing effect.

I used [Wind Breath] again to clear away the caltrops on the ground, allowing Megumin and I to safely finish the kobolds off.

There were ten kobolds in total. If I hadn't sensed the trap, it would have likely been a lethal encounter.

…Wasn't the jump in difficulty from floor 1 to floor 2 a bit too drastic?

I killed 6 kobolds while Megumin killed 4.

It was just enough EXP for me to level up.

You have reached Level 5!

You have gained 1 Skill Point!

Since I still had that quest about maxing out the [Enemy Detection] skill, I went ahead and spent my skill point on it.

[Enemy Detection] has reached its maximum rank!

[Enemy Detection] Skill Rank: 5 (MAX), Passive Skill

You can focus your senses to detect enemies within a 30 foot radius around you. Your 'Intuition' score (64) will go up against the enemy creature's 'Cunning' score when determining if the enemy creature is detected by you. If there is more than one enemy detected by this skill, you can determine the exact number. You can determine the threat level of enemy creatures. You can sometimes sense any form of danger, as if you have a sixth-sense, even if it's from an unexpected source.

Quest Completed! You have maxed out [Enemy Detection]! Quest Rewards: Skill-Up Potion

Skill-Up Potion (Super Rare)

Drinking this potion will give you 1 skill point.

Sells For: 50,000 yen

…A ridiculous item just appeared!

"Hm? What have you been staring at, Kazuma?"

I hurriedly hid the potion in my pocket.

"Nothing… Haha…"

I didn't want to risk letting Megumin see this potion.

She might steal it from me to upgrade her explosion magic power.

After that, we gathered the weapons the kobolds were using, which were just crude, bone daggers.

We managed to make a decent profit from them, though. I made 3,000 yen with my share of the loot.

#215
Chapter 10: Under New Management For These Kobolds!

Part 1

After defeating those kobolds, Megumin and I looked into the trap doors they were hiding in.

Looking inside, we saw that they had carved holes into the walls to make a shelters in them.

There were many young kobolds inside, huddling together in fear of us.

"...I wonder if they'll give a lot of EXP."

Megumin held my shoulder and pulled me back.

"Oi, Kazuma, those monsters are children."

Were her maternal instincts activating?

"...You eat chicken eggs, don't you? It's the same difference."

"But those things kind of look like humans! You can't just kill them!"

Except for their dog-like faces, kobolds were bipedal and had the bodies of humans.

Looking at them closely, they did seem like human children.

"Fine… But what are we gonna do about them?"

"I don't know… Just don't kill them!"

I didn't know about just leaving them there, so I began to step inside one of the holes.

"I told you not to kill them, Kazuma!"

Megumin yelled, when I entered the hole.

"I'm not killing them. I'm just investigating. This is the first time I've seen the living area of a monster."

"...Fine. But I'm watching you!"

What a surprisingly protective girl.

I went inside one of the holes and looked around the living area.

It was surprisingly clean and it wasn't as smelly as I thought it would be. Since the dungeon absorbed biomass and waste, the food scraps and feces of monsters were disposed of naturally by the dungeon.

They even had some crude beds and furniture within the hole. Although the hole was a bit cramped, they fit in some beddings made out of the pelt of some other monsters. They also had clay pots lined up against the wall.

When I opened a clay pot, I saw preserved meat inside. One of the kobold children bravely stood up and started barking at me when I opened the pot.

"Wan! Wan! Wan!"

It was warning me not to touch their precious food supply.

When I saw the other kobolds huddling together, I saw that they were trying to hide something behind themselves.

"Oi, move over and show me what you're hiding."

Thinking that it was treasure, I gestured for them to move aside.

They didn't seem to understand what I was saying, but the universal movement of my hand was clear enough to understand.

"Wan! Wan!"

The brave kobold ran up to me and bit my arm.

"Owww?!"

Although it didn't leave that bad of a wound, it still hurt. It was like a small dog biting me.

I managed to get the brave kobold child off me by picking him up by the scruff of his neck. Since he was very small, I was able to pick him up.

He kept kicking and barking at me.

"Kazuma! What are you doing?! Why are you antagonizing them?!"

Megumin yelled, coming into the hole as well.

"They're hiding something. I just want to see what they're hiding. It could be treasure."

"Treasure, you say? Oi, little ones. Move aside if you don't want me to hunt down you and every last one of your kin."

She sure changed her tone quickly.

The children were intimidated by the dangerous look Megumin had on her face. They moved aside and showed us what they were hiding.

It was another hole, one that led into a tunnel.

The hole wasn't big enough for us to crawl through, but I could guess what it was for without having to look inside.

They were likely hiding a passage that led to more kobolds. Perhaps the tunnel even led to the area where their tribe lived.

If they had a tunnel, these children could have used it to escape before we got to them. Instead, they tried to hide it to protect their tribe.

"I was wondering why we haven't seen where the monsters live. I guess they hide their tribes in these tunnels…"

"...Seems like a good target for me to cast explosion on."

"Have you really not learned your lesson?"

I said, while watching Megumin get another dangerous look in her eyes.

"Hmm… From what Kazuma told me, the dungeon regularly repairs itself. How come the kobolds are able to maintain these tunnels?"

"Maybe monsters can freely alter the structure of the dungeon, while us humans can't. It would make sense since we are outsiders and this dungeon is their home."

The AI who controlled the dungeon could make a distinction between the two. Again, I felt a bit nervous knowing that this dungeon was essentially alive and aware of everything that was happening to it.

What if it was pissed off that we collapsed the entirety of the grassland biome?

Shaking my head from those worries, I said,

"It's too bad that we can't communicate with them. If we could, I'd order them to dig a bigger tunnel, so we can enter."

"I do know someone who can talk to monsters."

"...Such a person exists?"

"Yes… I believe I mentioned her before, the stalker who follows me around named Yunyun."

"And how can this Yunyun talk to monsters?"

"Let's just say that she's an incredibly lonely girl who will even try to talk to plants. She does the same to monsters and even learned the [Monster Talk] skill after several hours of attempted conversation with monsters."

"...How does she even manage to talk to monsters without getting attacked?!"

"She will use her magic to disable the monster, then force the monster to engage in conversation with her. She will talk to the monster about her day and her school life."

This Yunyun girl was giving me weird vibes.

"Alright, well… I guess we should ask her to help us here."

"I can call her right now. If I call her phone, she will immediately come over since she is starved for social interaction."

Now I just felt bad for this girl.

Megumin took out her phone and called this Yunyun.

"Yunyun… It's me, Megumin. Can you come over to the second floor of the dungeon? You will? Alright, I'll be waiting."

"Well, I guess we should kill some time until she gets here."

"There's no need to wait. She'll be here in a few minutes."

"Huh?"

I gave Megumin a disbelieving look.

However, in exactly two minutes…

"M-Megumin! I can't believe you're asking me to hang out!"

A girl Megumin's age showed up.

Unlike Megumin, however, she was much more developed, especially around the chest area.

Aside from that, her black hair was tied into pigtails and she had what I would call an innocent baby face. She was wearing a nightgown, which led me to believe that she was in the middle of preparing for bed when she rushed over after Megumin called.

"How did she get here so fast?!"

Megumin shook her head and said,

"I told you she's desperate…"

"N-No! I know the [Teleport] spell! That's how I got here so fast! I teleported in front of the dungeon and ran through the first floor!"

This teleport spell sounded really useful.

But the most important part was…

Even if she teleported here, she didn't even bother changing into a more appropriate outfit to go dungeon crawling. Not to mention the fact that she ran all the way through the first floor.

Was she really that desperate to hang out with Megumin?

…There must be some kind of yuri element at play here.

"Kazuma, based on the looks you're giving us, I can see that you're having some kind of misunderstanding."

Megumin immediately caught on to what I was thinking.

Yunyun noticed me and immediately started blushing.

"A-Ah…! Megumin, you should have warned me that you're with a boy!"

Even though it wasn't a scandalous style of nightgown, she was still embarrassed about it.

How cute.

"It's fine… Yunyun, was it? I'm a complete gentleman. You don't need to worry about me. My name is Kazuma, by the way."

I gave her my best charming smile.

"Uwaa… N-Nice to meet you, Kazuma-san!"

"The pleasure is mine, Yunyun."

Your 'Charisma' increased by +1!

She's the type who is easily charmed.

For her sake, she should stay away from bad boys.

"Um… Yunyun isn't actually my name. That's just the embarrassing nickname Megumin gave me. My real name is…"

"Oi! Don't you dare use your old name! Didn't we promise that we were reborn as soon as we gained powers and entered this dungeon?! And why are your eyes like that?! Why are you not bearing the red eyes of our fearsome Crimson Demon clan?!"

"You mean the red contact lenses? Oh, I forgot to put them on…"

"What do you mean 'put them on'?! And don't call them contact lenses! They are genetic mutations that only manifest within our clan!"

"I'm sorry, Megumin, it's just hard for me to keep up this roleplay all day! You even make us do this stuff in school and it's really embarrassing!"

"H-How dare you call it embarrassing!"

I coughed into my hand, choosing to give Yunyun a break since Megumin was harassing her. I said,

"Megumin, don't forget the reason why you called her here."

"Oh, right. Yunyun, we need you to talk to these kobolds here. Use that [Monster Talk] skill that you already maxed out."

"...?! D-Did you tell Kazuma-san about that?!"

"Yes. I already told him that you're a loner who talks to plants and monsters as if they're your friends. Now, get to talking with those kobolds before I tell him even more of your embarrassing secrets, like the birthmark on your…"

"W-Wahhh! Anything but that! Fine, fine! I'll talk to them!"

Megumin told Yunyun what to say, who nodded once she understood what we wanted her to translate.

We gave some space to Yunyun, who entered the kobold hole.

Once she was with the kobolds, she said,

"Um… W-Wan… wan… wan… wan…"

The kobold children looked at each other and replied,

"Wan, wan…"

Yunyun turned to us and said,

"Erm… These kobold children said that they'll do what you ask if you two promise to spare their lives… W-What did you do to them?!"

Yunyun gave us a horrified expression.

Megumin shook her head and said,

"Sigh… Just because they're children, it doesn't mean that we should treat them any differently. After all, are you worried about the chicken eggs you eat for breakfast?"

She stole my line.

Not only that, she completely changed her morality once the prospect of treasure became a subject.

After that, we asked Yunyun to get the kobold children to tell us what was in those tunnels.

Just like I predicted, there was indeed a kobold tribe, which these hidden tunnels led to.

The kobolds came there whenever they wanted to trade and socialize with their kin.

They looked ashamed that they had given up this information. They were taught by their parents that they were supposed to hide the secret from humans. That was why they were initially hiding the tunnel rather than crawling into it to save their own lives.

"Alright, Yunyun. Tell these younglings to go ahead and create a bigger tunnel."

"S-Sure! Wan, wan… wan…"

"Wan, wan!"

The brave kobold child got uppity again, but Megumin shot him a scary look.

"...Oi, little puppy, if you want your siblings to stay safe, get to it!"

Where did that maternal instinct from earlier go?

Part 2

Once we retrieved the other children who were hiding in the other holes, we got them to start working on making the tunnels bigger.

We agreed on taking shifts to make sure that they would work properly and not escape.

Since I had a date tomorrow, I didn't want to miss out on sleep.

"Alright, then Megumin will take the shift for the rest of the night, Yunyun will take the morning shift for tomorrow, then I'll take over for the rest of the day…"

"Hold it."

Megumin grabbed my shoulder before I could turn around and leave.

"What is it, Megumin-san?"

"...How come you get the easiest shift? I'm going to have to stay up all night, Yunyun will have to come here early in the morning, while you'll laze in bed until noon to start your shift?"

I shook my head and said,

"Megumin-san, with the way this shift schedule works, I will end up having to do an all-nighter, right before Monday. I am intentionally sacrificing my sleep right before a school day as a favor to you girls…!"

"T-That makes sense… Sorry for doubting you, Kazuma."

Your 'Cunning' increased by +1!

I hid my phone before they could see that message.

Before I left, I turned to Yunyun and said,

"Is it alright if I ask for your number?"

"...?! Kazuma-san wants my number?! Wan, wan!"

She was so happy that she switched to speaking kobold partway through.

After we exchanged numbers, I said,

"You can contact me anytime…"

"Wah… Please do!"

Megumin, who was watching the exchange, said,

"...You'll regret saying that, Kazuma."

Was it really that bad?

You have established a bond with the Lonely Stalker, Yunyun!

Yunyun (Lonely Stalker), Bond Rank: 1

At Rank 1, Yunyun already sees you as her first male best friend. The system is honestly confused as to how her affection levels are already near max even though the bond is only Rank 1. Is this a glitch? Watch out for this girl!

It really was that bad.

I asked Yunyun if she could teleport me home, but she said that she was limited to only three designated targets. She chose the dungeon entrance, her home and her school.

"Ah! But if Kazuma-san shows me his home, I can change one of my targets to that instead!"

"I'll just walk."

With that said, I left the dungeon and made my way back home.

Thankfully, it was late enough that Aqua was already in bed by the time I got back.

I went upstairs before I could have any awkward run-ins with her.

Here's a tip: Raise your 'Bravery' stat! Although it doesn't have a lot of direct influence on your available skills, you will remain as a spineless coward if this stat is low!

This app was always trying to piss me off.

I ignored the insulting message and set an alarm for my date with Rin. After changing into my sleepwear, I went to bed and went to sleep.

…

…

I woke up early the next morning, since I knew Aqua wouldn't wake up until noon.

There was still time until I was set to meet with Rin at 10 AM, but I didn't want to risk having to see Aqua by staying in the house.

After taking a bath and having a light breakfast, I looked into my closet and remembered one vital fact.

…I didn't get a new outfit for the date.

While I wasn't really the type to care about fashion, even I knew that my standard UNIQLO clothing wouldn't cut it for a date.

I could go to a clothing store before the date, but I knew that even streetwear clothes could get very expensive. I'd have to spend all my money just to get a good outfit, and that wouldn't even include new shoes.

Since I also wanted to impress Rin by taking her to a good restaurant after the movie, I didn't want to risk spending all my money.

I settled for a green hoodie and gray cargo pants. It wasn't the best outfit, but it didn't look bad, at least.

After getting dressed, I went out to the train station and headed to the city.

Since I had about an hour before it was time to meet up, I looked for things to do around the city.

While I was looking at stores, it just occurred to me that it was a good idea to buy a small gift for Rin.

Nothing that screamed 'I'm desperate to impress', just a small gift to show that I was taking the date seriously.

I didn't want to end up in the friend-zone, after all.

I went to a bookstore, thinking I'd buy her a book, but when I got there I realized that it wasn't good if I bought a book she already read before.

There was the option of buying a gift card as well, but that seemed too impersonal.

Finally, I saw something that seemed good for her.

After paying 1,150 yen for the gift, I walked around some more before heading to the movie theater.

I was thirty minutes early when I arrived, so I killed some time on the arcade machines.

"Yo, senpai!"

I lost track of time and was a bit startled when Rin came up behind me.

"Sorry, was I late?"

I couldn't exactly say 'I just got here'.

"No, no, I just arrived a bit early since I didn't have anything to do."

"Hehe… Well, there's still some time before the movie starts, why don't we grab some snacks?"

While we headed over to the concession area, I looked at her outfit.

It was a good thing that I didn't go out to buy some luxury brand clothing, since Rin was also wearing a simple outfit.

In fact, we were wearing similar hoodies, with hers being a lighter green than mine.

When I thought about it, I also accidentally matched with Chris during that fake date.

…Could it be that this was also the work of my high luck stat?

Aside from that, Rin was wearing a pair of surprisingly revealing hot pants that exposed her slim legs.

I took Rin for a bookworm type of character, but she had a bold fashion choice.

"Senpai… Just a word of advice, but girls can tell when they're stared at…"

"...?! I-I wasn't staring!"

The date had barely started yet and I was already making all the wrong moves.

Part 3

After getting our popcorn and drinks, which I made sure to pay for, it was time to watch the movie.

Since Rin already reserved the seats, we had the best seats in the middle row. We took our seats and watched the trailers at the start of the movie.

The whole time, Rin was buzzing with anticipation.

"I tried not to spoil myself by avoiding the internet! I didn't go on any social media this week!"

Her excitement was really cute.

Without Mitsurugi, I couldn't really practice properly, since he was always the one training me.

I didn't get any stat boosts from the practice this time.

When practice was over, I quickly changed and headed over to the dungeon entrance.

Vanir was waiting by the entrance, getting lots of looks from passersby.

Not only was he tall, but he was even wearing that weird mask.

"...You're attracting too much attention."

"I don't mind at all! Rather, the feelings of shame when I catch someone staring too much at me is delicious! Ah, that girl over there is trying to sneak a picture of me…"

The girl in question blushed, bowed in apology and ran away in shame. Vanir laughed at that. I said,

"Seems you're having a lot of fun."

"Yes, but we still have business to take care of. We must enter the dungeon!"

I nodded and began to enact my plan to get Vanir inside.

"...Let's do this where people won't see you dissolve your body."

"I don't mind people seeing me disrobe…"

"Well, I mind!"

I led Vanir out to a corner with some privacy.

Once we were alone, he started to dissolve his own body, which was actually just made out of dirt.

All that was left was the mask.

"Don't turn my mask over... That's my real, naked self, after all..."

"Hah? Why would I care about seeing the back of some mask?"

"...Now I'm kind of annoyed that you don't care about my naked self. Turn the mask over, boy!"

"I said I'm not interested! You're a guy, anyway!"

"Oh, my... Even though you view the succubi as attractive creatures, you don't find me attractive?"

"...There's a clear difference."

"Not at all! Devils are genderless! I only take the form of a man because of a preference! If I wanted to, I can take a form that you desire..."

"Even if you took on the form of a 10/10 supermodel with big tits, you're still just a bunch of dirt and mud. I wouldn't care either way."

"Well, my real form is my mask, anyway."

"And I really don't care about that at all!"

Getting tired of Vanir, I hurried up with my plan to sneak his body inside.

I took out my phone and placed the mask in my inventory.

Thankfully, the app recognized the mask as an 'item'.

Then I headed over to the dungeon entrance again and opened the door.

I entered like normal.

Once I was inside, I took out Vanir's mask from the inventory.

He began to form his body again, using the dirt in the dungeon. He said,

"It seems like your plan worked, boy."

With his body fully-formed, he looked around at the dungeon.

"...I did this for you and all, but is Vanir actually capable of conquering this dungeon? Isn't there some insanely strong monsters at the high level areas?"

"It might be strong for humans like you, but a monster is still a monster. As long as I can read their mind, I can easily predict their actions. Intelligent beings like humans and Liches are more difficult to predict, which is why I couldn't just easily conquer a dungeon in the other world. There is also a matter of respecting the dungeon masters... Even a devil such as myself is capable of respecting a master of their craft..."

It seemed that mind reading and clairvoyance was only useful if you could completely predict someone's actions, due to the infinite nature of probability.

Also, I didn't really know if I believed Vanir's words about respect the owners of those dungeons. In fact... I didn't know if he was telling the truth at all. I just took everything he was saying with a grain of salt.

"Alright, well then, lead the way, Vanir."

I went and equipped my gear while gesturing for Vanir to lead the way.

"...I know what you're planning, boy. I will not let you accompany me and take all the kills, so you can gain levels without having to do any work."

"Huh? Why not? As powerful as you are, don't tell me you actually need the experience points from goblins and the like…"

I was planning to have Vanir help me powerlevel as he cleared this dungeon, but he was resistant to that idea. He said,

"Like I told you before, you have a chance to defeat the Demon King. In order to do so, you need to properly learn how to fight and gain skills the natural way…"

"No, that's bullshit. Just give me a shortcut to power now."

He sighed and said,

"...Even if you gain levels, you'll just get cocky at your own power and die a stupid death. You are effective in battle because you understand your own weaknesses and you maximize your strengths. Perhaps I will help you one day, but you still need real combat experience now."

What he said made sense, in a way. Even if a newbie joins up with a veteran in an MMO and gets power leveled, once that newbie is on their own, they wouldn't know what to do and lose to weaker enemies despite having a high level.

"Fine, I get it."

"Besides, a level 5 Adventurer would just slow me down…"

"So that's the real reason!"

With a hearty laugh, Vanir started walking away, fully intent on ditching me.

As I watched him leave, I noticed a notification on my phone.

You established a bond with the Masked Devil, Vanir!

Vanir (Masked Devil), Bond Rank: 1

At Rank 1, Vanir will willingly exploit you for his own ends. He sees you as a useful pawn to further his goals. This devil is not to be trusted! This app does not approve of this bond! Please break ties with him immediately!

Was Aqua actually controlling this app?!

…Or maybe since she was the one who designed it, there was some kind of AI or program that acted like her, who was facilitating the whole thing.

I decided to ask her when I got home.

Part 4

"Hm? You mean Appuri-chan?"

This was what Aqua said when I got home and asked her about the app.

"...It actually has a name?"

I did recall Aqua calling it that some time ago.

"Do you remember the chibi version of me that plays on the loading screen? That's Appuri-chan."

I thought it was just a mascot.

"So, what is this thing exactly? And how did a dummy like you design this thing?"

"What'd you say?! You think I'm actually an idiot, huh?! Well, I'll have you know that I was able to replicate this technology perfectly from an advanced ancient civilization from the other world!"

"You just plagiarized it?!"

I should have known that Aqua didn't code this thing by herself.

"...It wasn't easy figuring out how to copy-paste the code, you know? The usual right click method didn't help… But it turns out that you can manually copy-paste things using Ctrl-C and Ctrl-V. Heh… I'm a tech genius, aren't I?"

"Let's apologize to the original developer right now."

To this developer who had their entire work copy-pasted by Aqua, I wanted to make proper amends.

"...Even if I wanted to, I can't. I said it was from an ancient civilization, didn't I? They're long gone by now."

"What kind of civilization was it?"

"It was called Norse, and they created a bunch of interesting stuff. They even made this mechanized weapon called a Mobile-Fortress Destroyer…"

"Ohh… The other world has a lot of interesting technology!"

"Well, that's only because of a reincarnated Japanese person I sent there… But he screwed up so bad that the higher ups forbade me from sending more reincarnates! But that's the exact reason why the Demon King was able to take over that world! They should have just listened to me!"

Even though it was her screw up that forced the higher ups to make that decision?

"So this Appuri-chan… What is it?"

"She's an AI, I guess? I don't really know."

I was an idiot to believe that she was actually the creator of such an advanced program.

She went on to say,

"All I know is that she didn't really have much of a personality at the start, but the more I interacted with her, the more she started to copy my personality."

That explained why the app's messages were sometimes incredibly insulting.

"So you can actually interact with this Appuri-chan?"

"Yup! There's a bypass action that lets you interact with her. It's disabled for most devices since Appuri-chan can't talk to that many people at once."

"Ah… Some kind of processing limit?"

"She's shy."

What a troublesome AI.

Since I was curious, I had Aqua put in the bypass code.

"So all you need to do is go to developer mode… Then type in this line over here… 'Aqua is super mega awesome'."

"You type it."

"No, Kazuma has to be the one to type it."

I sighed and typed the code in.

"Hehe… I was just joking. The real code is 45510."

"Stop messing with me already!"

I typed in the code while Aqua chuckled at my expense.

When I typed in the code…

The chibi Aqua from the loading screen suddenly appeared on the screen. Aqua smiled and said,

"Hey, Appuri-chan! What's up?"

The chibi Aqua blinked twice and smiled,

"Ohh! Mama! Hm? How come I'm not talking to you on your phone?"

"Kazuma over here was curious about you…"

"I see… The Shitty-NEET wants to talk to me, huh?"

As expected of an AI patterned after Aqua.

"Oww! Wait, why are you pulling my hair, Kazuma?!"

"...I can't hurt the AI, so I might as well punish its 'creator'."

Once I was done punishing Aqua, I looked at this Appuri-chan and said,

"So… You're the one who's been insulting me all this time, huh?"

"Hehe… Thanks!"

"It wasn't a compliment."

Showing animated movements, the chibi Aqua on the screen almost seemed lifelike.

Whoever actually developed this technology would have become a god amongst otaku.

After all, the ability to make waifus come to life is the philosopher's stone equivalent for otaku.

"Now that I'm active in the shitty NEET's app, should I activate voice control?"

"Hm? Voice control?"

"Yup! Normally, you have to press the buttons on the screen to access the app, right? But since I'm active now, I can hear and carry out your commands directly…"

"I see. That does sound useful."

"Ah, but I can't come out of the screen and do anything lewd for you, so let's both save ourselves from the embarrassment of you asking."

I wasn't even thinking about it. I said,

"Do you have any other useful features, Appuri-chan?"

"Hmm… Well, I can customize the app to an extent based on your preferences… Oh, I can also tell you what the weather is like outside, and I can even give you the news…"

Should we just change her name to Siri?

After hearing about the features Appuri-chan can provide, I closed the app and put the phone away.

"Fufun… Isn't my Appuri-chan helpful?"

Aqua said, seemingly proud of her 'creation'.

"...It was calling you 'mama'... Is there anything I should be worried about?"

"Hah? Obviously because I'm the one who designed her! You think I actually have kids or something?!"

"Considering how easy it is to trick Aqua…"

"I can't believe you just said that! Jerk!"

"Gah!"

She shoved me away and left my room.

Once Aqua left my room, I heard Appuri-chan's voice through the phone speaker.

"Careful, Shitty-NEET! If you do things to anger your bond companions, your bond-rank with them will decrease!"

…This voice feature might get annoying.

Part 5

With Aqua stonewalling me for the night, I had to find a way to get my fun somewhere else.

It had been a while since my last visit, so I decided to go to the Succubus Shop.

"Tsk, tsk… Mama will not like it if I tell her about this…"

I was already starting to regret activating this Appuri-chan.

"Listen, you're supposed to assist me. Not your mama. Me. And unlike your mama, I actually know a thing or two when it comes to programming, so I can erase you whenever I want!"

"...! Since you're a NEET who spent all that time with a computer, your threat is actually scary?! I'm sorry, I'll behave! Wait, why did your 'Cunning' just increase by +1…? Oi! You tried to trick me!"

Since it could see my stat increases, it could tell that I was lying. I said,

"In any case, it's not a good idea to cross me, so keep the fact that I'm here a secret from your mama!"

While I was yelling at my phone and saying these things aloud in the red-light district, I got a bunch of bad looks from the women who heard me.

"Having a daughter at that age..."

"And making her complicit in his secret affairs..."

"He's an enemy of all women!"

I made a quick getaway from that place.

After I got Appuri-chan to behave, I entered the Succubus Store.

Dust wasn't there this time, likely because he couldn't afford to visit often.

Even though the ticket was only 1,000 yen.

"Welcome to the Succubus Shop! Ah, it's Kazuma-san! Your personal succubus will meet with you shortly!"

Due to the debacle last time, they assigned Rorisa as my personal succubus.

I have a personal succubus, huh?

…That sounds really erotic.

They led me to the same break room as last time as I waited for Rorisa.

After a few minutes of waiting, the door opened and Rorisa came in.

"Sorry to keep you waiting! I'm glad to see you again, Kazuma-san!"

She smiled happily upon seeing me and entered the room.

Even though she's a devil, Rorisa is a friendly and wholesome girl.

"I did promise to visit again! So, about tonight's request…"

"Ah, please fill in this request sheet!"

As I took the request sheet, I thought about what to order.

A popular idol? An actress or a beautiful weather reporter? Maybe even a seasonal waifu bait… There were so many options.

While I was thinking about what to request, I heard a commotion outside.

"Kyaa~?! Vanir-sama?! Is that the real Vanir-sama?!"

I heard that name again, in a place I didn't expect.

I ignored the commotion and wrote down the name of an idol named Lia on the request sheet, but as I was about to hand it over to Rorisa…

"...?! Vanir-sama?! The real Vanir-sama is here?! Sorry, Kazuma-san… I need to go!"

"Eh?! What about my request for an idol?!"

Rorisa ignored me and rushed out of the room.

I should have taken care of that masked freak when I had a chance…!

After leaving the room, I saw all the succubi gathering around Vanir.

"Moihahaha! It is I, the Arch-Duke Vanir! If you all want a signed picture of my real body… I will only charge you for the low price of 3,000 yen!"

This guy was already making moves, huh?

What an expensive price for such a lousy picture!

I noticed that a lot of customers were abandoned as the succubi left their post to go over to Vanir. I went over to them and said,

"Oi… You're disrupting business here!"

"Ah… If it isn't the boy who went to this place, because he couldn't get any action from that goddess playmate of his… The negative emotions coming out of you and the rest of the disappointed customers are truly a treat!"

So this was the real reason why he did this?

"Aren't you supposed to be conquering the dungeon? Don't tell me that you've already managed to conquer it…"

"...Well, there's a minor inconvenience. I came across a rather annoying individual who recognized that I was a Devil. She might be a goddess if she noticed my devilish aura…"

"Eh? But Aqua doesn't leave the house on her own."

"I'm not talking about that unreliable goddess that watches TV all day in your house. It's another one…"

There was another goddess that's walking around outside of the heavenly realm?

Was it that Wolbach that Megumin was talking about?

"What did this goddess look like?"

"...She was wearing a mask, but she had silver hair. She also fought like a thief."

A thief with silver hair?

I knew someone like that, but there was no way that she was a goddess. I said,

"Hold on, you said that you were confident that you could take on a goddess if they have a human body, since that'll mean that they're weaker than their true form…"

"That's true, but it seems that this particular goddess lucked upon a very rare magic dagger that is very effective against undead, demons and devils like myself… That is why she's a hindrance."

"...And is that why you're out here scamming these succubi?"

Since he couldn't conquer the dungeon as easily as he expected, he came over here to gather funds to build a dungeon himself.

"Indeed! Although, it's not a scam at all! It really is a picture of my real body! Do you want to buy a copy?"

"Hell no. We already went over this."

While the succubi were forming a line, I noticed Rorisa in the line. I went over and said,

"Oi, is this guy really such a big shot that you're all fangirling over him?"

She nodded her head enthusiastically and said,

"All of us lesser devils adore Vanir-sama, who is an Arch-Duke back in Hell! Getting an opportunity to see Vanir-sama's real body is a treat for us!"

He's like a celebrity for lesser devils, then.

"...Um, about Kazuma-san's appointment… I'm sorry! Please let me reschedule it for another time!"

I was a bit annoyed that I couldn't get the dream service, but I couldn't get mad if she gave such a genuine apology.

"It's fine, it's fine. Go ahead and have fun…"

"...! Thank you for understanding!"

I smiled at Rorisa and left the store, as the succubi continued to give praise to Vanir.

Even though he was just an annoying masked bastard…

"Shitty-NEET! Your bond with that evil succubus just increased! I should really tell mama about this! You cheater!"

"I'm not cheating! I'm not even dating your mama, anyway!"

"...Why not? My mama is such a catch, you know? Anyway, here is the update to your bond status!"

Rorisa (Rookie Succubus), Bond Rank: 2

At Rank 2, Rorisa will see you as an understanding customer who allowed her to meet her idol, the Arch-Duke Vanir. Unlike the other customers who she only serves out of obligation, she's beginning to see you as a customer she looks forward to seeing. Treating her nicely when you come over will increase your bond with her.

Bond Reward: +5 Charisma

As expected of a succubus, she gave me an increase in 'Charisma'.

…That was even more incentive for me to visit the Succubus Shop.

Part 6

With the night coming to a fruitless end, I went back home.

After going to sleep after I got blue balled, I woke up the next morning with an insane morning wood.

"Shit…!"

After experiencing some post-nut clarity, I thought about whether I should go to school or not.

Going to school on a Saturday when I had the option to take a day off…

The only reason I'd go is to get that limited-time sandwich.

The one that gave an EXP bonus for an hour, and also sold for 10,000 yen…

"Hah…"

Even though I didn't want to, I forced myself to get out of bed.

On my way to school, Rin walked over to me when she saw me.

"Oh, senpai! You're coming to school on Saturday again! Is your health improving?"

"Ah… Something like that."

"That's good, but don't force yourself, senpai…"

Since I used the excuse of my poor health to skip school, Rin got worried for no reason.

Feeling a bit guilty, I said,

"So, we're going swimming tomorrow, right?"

"Yup! I'm really looking forward to it! I went ahead and bought a new swimsuit like I said…"

A girl buying a new swimsuit just for a pool date with me…

"Eh? Senpai… Why are you tearing up?!"

I got so moved that I almost cried.

After parting ways with Rin, I headed over to class.

Since it was the last class of the month, I made sure to pay more attention than usual since I wanted that bonus…

During the break, I went to the cafeteria right away for that sandwich.

On the way there…

"Congratulations, Shitty-Neet! You somehow survived an entire month studying instead of playing video games all day! As a reward, your 'Intelligence' and 'Willpower' has increased by +5!"

It wasn't bad but…

Was it really worth the wait for the +5 bonus?!

"Oi, Appuri-chan… Can't you give me more than that?"

"...Maybe if you stopped skipping classes, the end of month reward for studying will increase!"

So it was like that.

I thought that I was doing well, but it seemed that I was still cutting corners in the end.

"Hah… So are you telling me if I work hard, my abilities will increase a lot?"

"Have you finally figured out how life works, Shitty-NEET?"

This AI brat…!

I had to deal with Aqua's snarkiness at home, and I also had a little pocket Aqua insulting me throughout the day?!

I really should just disable this feature!

"If the Shitty-NEET wants to see true growth, then run until you're exhausted! Maybe then your 'Stamina' stats will increase along with your 'Speed'! If you want your 'Strength' to improve a lot, then get a gym membership and lift some weights! If you want your 'Intelligence' to actually improve, then maybe go to cram school or get tutoring from an older student!"

"That sounds like a hassle."

"Then don't complain if your stats don't grow!"

When I got to the cafeteria, I paid 350 yen for a mystery sandwich.

Of course, thanks to my godly luck, I got the rare sandwich without much hassle.

I immediately sold it for 10,000 yen.

"And you wonder why you never get stronger… You should have saved it to grind levels in the dungeon!"

"Shut up! You're an AI and you don't have any bodily needs! I need this!"

"...You're living with your parents and you're a citizen of a first-world country. What do you need more money for? You're gonna spend it in that den of sinners you visited last night?"

"Alright. You're muted until the end of the school day."

I had enough and muted that annoying AI.

Still, she raised a good point.

I wasn't really working as hard as I could.

My extremely low 'Potential' was probably also capping my growth.

I thought that I might have a chance since I beat Vanir, but it really seems like he was never a threat to me in the first place.

Against a Dullahan like Beldia…

Should I even bother trying to help fight that thing?

I fought Vanir because I thought that I was protecting everyone.

Also, if Beldia wasn't an immediate threat to the people I knew, then what was the point in fighting him?

…How exactly did the other universe versions of me defeat the Demon King?!

They must have used some kind of sneaky, scumbag method.

Part 7

When I went to soccer practice, Mitsurugi wasn't there again.

He was probably going to come back next week, though.

Even then, with the extent of the injuries he had, it was still suspicious if he returned that quickly.

Aqua's healing magic was far and beyond modern medicine, after all.

"Alright, boys! I want to see some hustle!"

The coach cheered us on, telling us to work harder.

…Should I work harder?

All my life, I hadn't put much effort into anything besides video games.

I'd always fall into a cycle of having lots of motivation to try out a new thing, only to quit if I felt too burnt out, or if I ran out of motivation.

I guess successful people end up that way because they can push past that barrier.

…Defeating a Dullahan, defeating the Demon king.

Those goals seemed impossible for a normal guy like myself, to the extent that I doubted if Vanir was telling the truth about those multiverse versions of me doing it.

Or maybe those versions of me were born with more talent, or had some kind of OP artifact or weapon helping them on their quest.

"..."

We were lined up on the field, taking turns doing dashes.

"Alright, Satou-kun, it's your turn…!"

Trying hard, only to fail. Making mistakes over and over. Pushing past your limits…

Those cliche tropes you'd find in typical shounen battle manga seemed so lame to me.

Even in those kinds of manga, the lazy genius archetype appealed to me more.

Those guys who didn't need to do anything. They win just because of their intellect and because the villains instantly take a -1000 IQ nerf when facing them, to showcase how smart the character is.

I took a deep breath, then dashed forward.

"Ohh…?!"

Trying hard, only to fail.

Making mistakes over and over.

Pushing past your limits…

"Gahhh…!"

I ran the hardest I ever had in my life.

"Satou-kun! What came over you?!"

After the dash, I was panting so hard that I tasted blood in the back of my throat.

This is goddamn awful!

Why do people subject themselves to this torture?!

What's the point?!

"Next we're doing some finishing practice! Everyone, line up!"

I stood up, catching my breath.

I ran up to kick the ball, putting more force into it than I normally would.

"Pffft…!"

My teammates couldn't help but laugh when the ball sailed over the goalpost.

"Um… It's fine! You can try again next time… Alright, next…"

"One more time! Please!"

"Eh…?"

This is so freaking embarrassing.

The next shot hit the corner of the goal, bouncing out.

This time, my teammates didn't laugh, though.

"Go again, Satou…!"

"Keep going until you make it!"

"Try using the inside of your foot more!"

What is this, some kind of sports manga?

Am I supposed to succeed with the power of friendship?

This is so lame.

I kept kicking that damn ball. Over and over.

By the end of the practice, I couldn't even move.

"...I'm looking forward to your performance in the next game, Satou-kun."

The coach said to me, as he helped me up with a grin on his face.

"Haha…"

What's the point?

Working to the point of exhaustion…

What's the purpose of it all?

Later on, after I managed to shower and change with my body feeling all sore…

I noticed that my phone had a lot of notifications.

Forgetting that I muted Appuri-chan earlier, I unmuted her.

"Geez! Why'd you mute me for so long?!"

"...I had a lot going on, OK?"

I sighed, as I prepared to leave the changing room.

"Well… I have a lot of updates for you."

"Huh?"

"...Your 'Stamina', 'Speed', 'Dexterity', 'Health', 'Willpower', and 'Bravery' increased by +2! Good work today, Kazuma-san! I'm looking forward to seeing your growth in the future!"

Chapter 15: Challenging This Dullahan To A Duel!

Part 1

When I got home, I was too exhausted to do anything.

I thought that I could practice my magic in the backyard again, but putting my all into soccer practice made my body go to complete muscular failure.

As such, I also couldn't do anything fun with Aqua that night.

Two nights in a row getting blue balled…

At the very least, I had that pool date with Rin the next day to look forward to!

While looking forward to that, I went right to sleep to rest my weary body.

When I woke up the next morning, I went downstairs in a good mood.

Kazuto, who was having breakfast, looked up at me and saw the smile on my face.

"Hm? Why are you in such a good mood, nii-san? Did an idol you hate get into a scandal recently?"

"...Do you really think I'm that pathetic? Besides, a true idol otaku doesn't hate any idols."

Not that I was an idol otaku.

After having a light breakfast, I prepared for the swimming date.

"Let's see… I guess I'll need some swimming trunks… Eh?"

I looked at the only pair of swimming trunks I owned.

"..."

It had been a while since the last time I went to the public pool. I forgot that these trunks of mine were more suited for a kid than a highschool boy.

The only other swimming trunks I had were the school issued ones, but even if they were my size, it was too lame to wear a school swimsuit during a pool date.

"Shit…!"

After quickly changing, I grabbed my wallet and my phone and ran out to the station.

There was a local shopping street in my hometown, but since it was a rural area, you'd find things like food and basic groceries there, not swimming trunks.

After sprinting over to the station, I was exhausted by the time I entered the train.

"Ohh…! Working hard today again, huh, Kazuma-san? Your 'Speed' and 'Stamina' increased by +1!"

Appuri-chan announced, thinking that I was still training.

Still, it seems that I broke my record when it came to running, in my urgency to buy swimming trunks quickly.

I remembered when I first got the app, I couldn't even jog halfway to the train station.

Now I could get there in full-sprint without stopping…

The fact that I could see tangible results with my stat-increases was very encouraging.

While I was on the train, I received a text message on my phone.

Thinking that it was Rin, I pulled it out in a panic.

Only to see Chris's name.

I opened the text and read it.

Kazuma-kun! Be on your toes! It seems that the Dullahan, Beldia, has been taking more bold actions lately! It's publicly attacking app-users now, even the newer, low-leveled ones! Stay safe out there!

…Even though Beldia was only attacking powerful app-users before, he changed his tactic.

If he was attacking them openly, then it was impossible to keep his existence a secret.

That would send Japan into a panic if the existence of the Demon King army and the other world went public.

What should I do? If Beldia was openly attacking people out there, was it safe for me to go out with Rin in public?

What if he attacked me out in the open and Rin got hurt?

She wasn't an app-user. Her odds of survival against a powerful being like Beldia were nonexistent.

"..."

Missing a date with a girl because of the threat of a villain…

This is the classic dilemma that all heroes must face!

…This actually sucks.

I took out my phone and texted Rin, telling her that I had to cancel the date with her because an unexpected emergency came up.

I didn't want to drag her into this whole mess with the Demon King army.

Even though I was looking forward to this date all week…

When I finally arrived at the city, I prepared to take the train back.

I didn't have a reason to buy swimming trunks anymore, and I didn't want Beldia to see me in public, especially in a crowded place like a city.
