I added a bit more weights when I felt it was too light and repeated the exercise with breaks in between, for three sets and eight reps.

I spent the next couple hours going through the other exercises, exhausted by the end.

"You gained +2 'Strength', 'Stamina' and 'Willpower'!"

Mitsurugi told me that it was a good idea to take in protein after the workout. I went to the gym's vending machine and bought a protein shake for 300 yen, gulping down the chocolate flavored shake.

I took a shower in the gym changing room and put my school uniform back on, before limping away to the train station and heading back home.

"Geez, Kazuma, what happened to you?"

Aqua said, looking at me as I staggered home.

When she used [Heal] on me, I was back to normal.

Maybe if I could convince Aqua to workout with me, I could ask her to keep healing on me and I could, theoretically, workout without ever needing to rest.

When I asked Aqua, she immediately shook her head.

"No way! That sounds like too much effort! I'd rather watch TV all day!"

That was her answer.

#337
Chapter 17: Cursing This Scumbag with Revenge!

Part 1

After fooling around with Aqua for a bit, I decided to take out my copy of Myriad Swords 2.

This was the game I purchased before I discovered the dungeon. I had been so busy with the dungeon and everything else that I didn't even take the CD out of the box yet.

The reason I was playing this game was to help out my classmates, who were having trouble with a Player Killer.

This PKer was killing low level players for the fun of it.

"Ohh… Playing a game, huh? If Kazuma-san wants, I can search the internet for the most OP build for you to use!"

"No need."

"Ehh… Even though I just wanted to help…"

"Hmm… There is something you can help me with, Appuri-chan."

"Oh? What is it?"

"Find me a site that sells max level accounts."

"Huh?! That's cheating?! Aren't you gonna embrace the grind?!"

"Huh? Do I look like I have the time to do that? I have a bunch of girls who want me, and I'm the badass who defeated a Demon King general. I don't have the time to grind up a new account."

The old me would have sneered at this statement.

I wasn't a NEET anymore. I didn't have time to pour in endless amount of hours, grinding up a level 1 account to max.

Despite Appuri-chan's complaints, she still helped me look for a seller.

The cheapest seller was willing to sell their max level account for 10,000 yen.

"Damn, that's so expensive!"

I knew that max level accounts sold for quite a lot, but I didn't think that the cheapest one would sell for that much.

"Hmm… Is it even worth doing this side quest? I mean, it gives +2 to 'Intelligence' and 'Willpower', but I can just raise those naturally… The money investment isn't worth it."

"Don't you want to help your classmates?! That PKer can't get away with this!"

I remembered the days when I used to be into MMOs. Whenever there was a PKer, I would lead my guild in an effort to bring them to justice.

A part of me that remained from those days wanted to put this PKer in their place.

That said, I really didn't have time to invest in this game.

It felt like the past and present versions of me were clashing with each other. In the past, if I had the money, I wouldn't have hesitated putting this kind of money into the game. It was a worthwhile investment in my eyes, since the only thing I cared about was having fun playing video games.

Now that I had a job and had to earn money, now that I had to risk my life fighting the Demon King army and training in the dungeon, I knew full well the value of money. That 10,000 yen I was paying for the account was the accumulation of my hard work at the grocery store, as well as my reward for beating Beldia in a battle to the death.

Did I really want to use that money that I spilled sweat and blood for, on a max level account for a video game?

In the end, I decided to do it.

It wasn't like I was doing this for fun. I did get stat increases, and I could raise my popularity with my classmates if I finished this quest.

And maybe a part of me also wanted to try playing a video game, after a long break from it.

After all, it's important to move forward from a past you're ashamed of, but nothing good comes from forgetting your roots.

I purchased the account and renamed the character to my old handle 'RNGod'. I wondered if my old guild members transitioned to Myriad Swords 2. We played the original one together for years. It was hard to imagine that they wouldn't play the sequel.

Would they recognize me from my handle? Would they forgive me for not playing, even though I promised to play it all with them when the sequel came out?

I didn't even know if they'd miss me. I mean, I was the top player and the guild leader, but to them, I was just some rando they played with. Even my protege in the guild, Dark+Angel, must have forgotten about me by now. After all, she was a gamer girl who had a bunch of simps everywhere she went.

After purchasing the account, my next objective was to bait the PKer into fighting me.

"Eh… Is it really safe to do that at the moment? You don't even have any powerful gear. You won't survive."

"I don't need powerful gear."

"Y-You sure are confident, huh? But the PKer might not target you if you don't have good loot."

"Didn't you hear what those guys said? The PKer doesn't care about taking loot from players. They're doing this for the fun of it. This PKer will attack me regardless of what gear I have."

I went to a random grinding spot and slayed some monsters for a while. After some time, I saw another player with a red username, indicating that they were a player killer.

Their avatar was geared up like a complete edgelord, all black with a bunch of skulls, with a flaming scythe as their weapon. Their username was 'xXx_VengeanceSoldier666_xXx'.

"Hm? Kazuma-san, you lost -1 HP for some reason…"

I actually took damage from all the edge.

Due to the equipment difference, I was swiftly defeated by the PKer.

"Aww… I told you to get better weapons, Kazuma-san!"

"It's not a big deal. I was just scouting his build. What's the point in investing in a bunch of powerful items if we don't even know what we're dealing with?"

"As expected of a former Shut-in NEET! You really know a bunch of useless information that will not benefit you at all in real society!"

I really needed to ask Aqua to adjust Appuri-chan's smugness settings. Although I doubted Aqua actually knew how to use her stolen tech beyond surface-level adjustments.

Reluctantly, I spent 5,000 yen to buy the necessary equipment. At this point, I was beginning to think this whole thing was a sunk-cost investment, with how I kept pouring money in with the justification that since I already got this far, there was no point in backing down now.

Once I dealt with the equipment, I used the free respec that all accounts get once they hit a certain level, focusing on putting my Skill Points on a build that directly countered the PKer's.

Going back to another grinding spot, I waited for the PKer to come again. This time, I was prepared for him. Not only did I counter his build, I also memorized all his attack patterns. It didn't take long until I killed the PKer.

When you kill a PKer in the Myriad Swords series, you earn a bounty based on how many players they killed. You also don't gain the PKer status for killing them.

There is also a bounty board where the status of PKers are updated. When the board registered my kill, multiple players sent me DMs, asking me how I accomplished the feat. Instead of telling them what I did, I got the idea to sell my account to the highest bidder.

I ended up making a profit from all the money I spent on this account, gaining 20,000 yen from the auction. Selling the bounty money I gained to real-life currency earned me an extra 2,000 yen.

"You defeated the PKer! Quest Rewards: +2 Intelligence, +2 Willpower!"

Part 2

"Whoa, you actually defeated the PKer?!"

"I was wondering who did it!"

"You sold your account for a bunch of money, right?!"

My gamer classmates were overjoyed when I showed them proof that I defeated the infamous PKer.

I grinned and scratched my nose.

"He wasn't such a big deal in the end."

"You earned the respect of your classmates! 'Charisma' increased by +2!"

Meanwhile, Konno-san was watching me from her desk.

"...I thought that you were putting serious efforts into studying, but here you are playing some kind of video game."

I managed to grow a bond with her, but I honestly didn't see it advancing past rank 1. Not only did I keep giving a bad impression on her, but I couldn't get over the fact that she was actually a famous idol in disguise.

"I-I'm studying properly, Konno-san!"

"If you say so."

She didn't believe me at all.

...

...

There wasn't any soccer practice after school, since there was a big game coming up, which would qualify us for the nationals if we won.

The coach declared this once we showed up to the changing room. He was standing outside the building, a wide grin on his face.

"Rest up, everyone! I want you in tip-top shape for the game on Thursday!"

He didn't know that I could just ask Aqua to heal me even if I got exhausted or received an injury. Still, I didn't have a reason to go against the coach's decision.

I was heading out when Mitsurugi caught up to me.

"Hey, Satou. You started going to the gym, right? How about I come with you today to give you some pointers?"

"...I didn't ask for a trainer because I didn't want some guy barking orders at me while I worked out."

"I'm not gonna bark orders at you. Rather, if I was a girl, are you saying you'd be fine with that?"

"Absolutely."

"Wah… You're something else, Satou. So you really don't want my help?"

Without a real good reason to refuse him, I agreed to have him come along with me to the gym.

We walked over to the gym, where I saw the receptionist, Luna, again. I wondered if she worked here all day, since I also saw her taking the evening shift last time.

She smiled, a look of recognition on her face when she saw me.

"Welcome back, Satou-san! Oh, did you bring a friend today?"

She said, glancing over at Mitsurugi.

"He's not really…"

"You get a free day pass for referring a friend!"

"We're practically besties~!"

Mitsurugi made a disgusted face at my behavior.

He had to pay the normal 400 yen entrance fee, while I got in without paying. Mitsurugi showed that he had potential as a teacher, as he taught me well when it came to soccer, a talent that translated over to weightlifting, too.

"Do you have some kind of teaching skill, Mitsurugi?"

I asked, after I finished a bench press session, with him helping me lift the final rep as I reached failure.

"Erm, yeah. I actually learned it through our Bond…"

"O-Oh, I see."

It was awkward as hell talking about our bond, so we quickly moved onto talking more about working out.

"You gained +2 'Strength', 'Stamina' and 'Willpower'!"

We drank some protein shakes, costing me 300 yen. Mitsurugi convinced me to pay for his, since he gave me advice and helped me with my workout. He probably just wanted to go even since I got in for free.

I went home after we separated ways, getting Aqua to heal me up when I arrived. Once I finished dinner, I was about to do some homework when I got a text from Yunyun.

Yunyun was the type who sent a bunch of texts, then even more texts explaining those texts, then another onslaught of texts apologizing for being a bother, until she went completely silent. This cycle repeats itself every few days. Since I had gotten used to this behavior, I was about to ignore her text, but the content of it got my attention.

Yunyun: Kazuma-san! This is an emergency! The kobolds are rebelling against us!

This wasn't the kind of news I expected from her. I texted back,

Kazuma: You're an Arch-Wizard. That's an advanced class, right? Just scare them a bit with your fancy magic, and they should behave.

Yunyun: I already tried, but the kobolds are way stronger now than before!

I stared at the screen incredulously, before sighing once I thought I figured out what she was trying to do.

Kazuma: …You don't need to come up with tall tales just to get me to hang out with you, Yunyun.

Yunyun: I'm not lying! Please look at this!

She sent me a video file. I opened it and played it, seeing that Yunyun had filmed the kobolds.

I expected to see the usual kobolds, but these ones were different from before, like Yunyun claimed. They had a tangible aura around them, and I could tell from their movements that they got faster.

Furthermore, leading them as they marched and raised their weapons was a bigger kobold. It was more muscular and human-like in its facial expression and the way it carried itself. It also looked like it was carrying some kind of magic sword, which made me wonder if that was a dungeon treasure or something it looted from a cheat-user.

Yunyun: The kobolds are more organized now and they're tougher! My magic isn't enough to deal with them! Please help, Kazuma-san!

Kazuma: Have you asked Megumin for help yet?"

Yunyun: No, I haven't!

Kazuma: Please keep it that way.

If Megumin heard that the kobolds gained an unknown power out of nowhere, she'd think that it was a cool development and come to the dungeon, immediately casting explosion magic on the kobolds. She might take them out, but she would also take out everyone in the vicinity, including herself.

"Oi, Aqua, we're heading out!"

I said, grabbing her wrist and pulling her from the sofa, where she was watching some braindead comedy show with Kazuto.

She resisted my pull, showing that absurd strength of hers that went to waste since she never used it.

"Eh? Why? I'm content relaxing here on the sofa all night!"

"This isn't the time to be lazy! There's an emergency!"

Kazuto raised a brow at me, turning from his seat on the sofa to look at me.

"Hah? What emergency? Did nii-san brag to his classmates that he has a girlfriend and now he's being pressured to introduce one? And since nii-san doesn't have any girls he can rely on, he's unashamedly trying to use nee-chan?"

He came out with such a delusional, yet painfully realistic scenario that I might find myself in.

"No, not that! Aqua, you know what I mean when I say 'emergency', right?!"

She blinked, not understanding what I was getting at.

"...I don't really get it, but I have a feeling that whatever this is, Kazuma did this to himself and you need to face the consequences of your actions. You deal with it yourself."

She was really perceptive at the most inconvenient times.

Even though I didn't want to deal with an unknown threat without Aqua, I left her at home and went to the train station on my own. I couldn't just leave Yunyun to fend for herself. And if I did that, the worst case scenario was that she'd call Megumin for backup, and that would just turn a bad situation into the worst case scenario.

Part 3

Yunyun was at the entrance of the dungeon, a worried look on her face. She looked out of sorts, and I could tell that she really did have problems dealing with the kobolds.

"Kazuma-san! There you are!"

"...So are these kobolds really that tough now?"

She quickly nodded her head.

"Yes! Their magic resistance, speed, strength… Everything increased! And that big kobold acting like their leader is really tough!"

"Let's go in. I wanna take a look."

She agreed and followed me inside the dungeon. We walked through the first floor, Yunyun easily clearing the goblins that attacked us with her magic.

In this way, we reached the second floor without any problems. I expected the kobolds to fill the entire second floor in their mutiny, but there were only the standard monsters around, such as imps and ghouls.

"Are the kobolds still in their hidden area?"

I asked, as I watched Yunyun frying some helpless imps with fire magic.

"I went over to hang out with them, but they chased me out all the way to the first floor. They must have gone back to their hidden city…"

The 30-foot radius of my maxed out [Enemy Detection] was a wide range, especially within the confines of the dungeon. Its one weakness was that long-ranged attacks going beyond the detection radius wouldn't register until it was too late, especially against a hidden opponent.

"...! Yunyun, watch out!"

When I saw the arrow flying towards us, I called out a warning to Yunyun. I should have worried about myself, though.

"Gurk!"

The arrow pierced through my shoulder, making me cry out in pain.

"Kazuma-san! You lost 5 Hit Points! Your armor reduced it by +5!"

That meant that these things were doing 10 damage just from one attack.

"Yunyun, we should teleport out of here…!"

"Y-Yes…!"

I was about to reach for Yunyun's hand, but another arrow whizzed past the space between us, making us draw our hand back.

"Wan…! Wan!"

A loud, booming voice emerged from the kobolds. I turned to see the big kobold that Yunyun was talking about.

Looking at the big kobold, I activated my [Lore Reading] skill. Words appeared in front of my eyes, explaining to me what this creature was.

Kobold Hero

An evolved kobold. Arises when a courageous kobold has decided to rebel against their transgressors.

A courageous kobold…

That reminded me of the kobold child who always opposed me, when the others didn't.

I looked into the kobold's eyes and I saw the same impudent look.

This was the same young kobold.

"Yunyun, try again…!"

Before I could even turn my head, I saw a flash of steel.

…Eh? Why is the room upside down?

Wait, is that my body?

"Kazuma-san…!"

The last thing I heard was Yunyun's horrified scream.

Part 4

A familiar space greeted me, a seemingly featureless, white space with a big chair in the middle of it. The room didn't seem to have dimensions, but I could tell that it had a finite quality. Sitting on that chair was a beautiful girl with long, silver hair and kind, blue eyes. She wore a nun-habit and had graceful features.

I knew immediately that she was a goddess like Aqua. No human girl could look as beautiful as this.

"...Did I die?"

That was the only thing I could think of, based on what happened.

My head went rolling off my shoulders after the Kobold Hero decapitated me. Then I ended up in the heavenly realm of this goddess.

She gave me a sympathetic smile.

"Yes. I'm sorry, Satou Kazuma-san. You died in battle against a Kobold Hero."

"I see… Well, I guess I'll wait a few minutes. You got any snacks or something?"

She blinked in surprise.

"Um… Why are you so calm right now?"

"Well, I have this Arch-Priest living with me who has the [Resurrection] spell, so I just need to wait for her to revive me."

She blinked and said,

"That may be true, but… Your body needs to be close to the caster to use that skill."

That made me pause.

I just assumed that Yunyun would have successfully retrieved my body, but…

When I thought about it, she didn't know about Aqua knowing the resurrection spell!

Once she saw me dying, the normal reaction would be to try and fight the ones who killed me, or teleport away, not try to retrieve my corpse.

"Quick! Goddess-sama, can you let me see what's happening down there?!"

I rushed over to the goddess and held her by the shoulders.

"Eep! Um, just call me Eris! And I can't do that for you…"

Eris… That was the goddess who Darkness and Chris worked for. From what I heard, she seemed to disagree with Aqua's methods and was working to retrieve the cheat items from adventurers.

This is bad! I didn't know the relationship between them, but I did hear Aqua always insulting Eris! She was always muttering something about Eris padding her chest!

I didn't mention Aqua, but if she disliked Aqua and found out that I was trying to use Aqua to resurrect me… She might not allow that!

And she just said that she couldn't help me… This is really bad!

"Why can't you help me, Eris-sama?!"

"It's not that I don't want to help you, but you're dead now. The only thing I can really do is help you move onto the afterlife."

The afterlife… That means heaven, right?

That didn't sound so bad. Heaven was always depicted as a paradise, after all.

But when I thought about my life, all the friends I made, even my family, who I started talking to again after all those years of awkwardness.

Something wet and hot gathered around my eyes. Before I realized it, I was crying.

"...! Kazuma-kun! You're…"

"I-It's just allergies!"

I said, giving some lame excuse while I rubbed my eyes.

"There's no allergens in this realm, well… I get it. You were blessed with kind encounters, weren't you?"

I wiped the last of my tears and nodded.

"Yeah. I guess I was."

I didn't want to go. Not yet. Especially since that Kobold Hero was running around because of me. If Mitsurugi or the other girls heard about my death, those idiots would surely come running to the dungeon to avenge me.

Megumin might try to blow up the whole dungeon.

Eris-sama had a conflicted look on her face. She said,

"...I'm sorry, but I have to send you to heaven now."

"...!"

She chuckled and looked to the side.

"Eh? Ah, it looks like I have a meeting with the higher ups today… I completely forgot!"

"Eris-sama...?"

She winked at me and placed a finger over her lips.

"I'm sorry, but I can't send you to heaven just yet, Kazuma-kun. I have to go to a meeting now… Ah, this remote over here will allow you to view the mortal realm, but please don't touch it!"

She was helping me…

Eris-sama… She was a really good girl, wasn't she?!

If I didn't already have a bunch of girls to consider, I would have seriously gunned for her!

"...I'll just wait here for you, then, Eris-sama."

"Please do!"

I watched her go, a door suddenly appearing in the realm and opening for her. She gave me a final smile before leaving.

I took the remote and clicked the 'on' button. Suddenly, a projection appeared in front of me. For some reason, I saw Darkness on the other end. She was in a fancy dress, having dinner with a bunch of other people in formal wear.

"...? Why is Eris-sama watching Darkness? Well, I guess Darkness does work for her."

I changed channels, hoping that I'd see a channel that would show where I died.

"There it is…!"

I saw the dungeon floor where I died. My body was on the ground, still bleeding. Yunyun was kneeling over my headless body and crying.

The Kobold Hero walked up to her. I thought he would try to attack her, but he said,

"...Since you were once kind to us. I will spare you."

My [Monster Talk] skill allowed me to understand him.

The kobolds turned around and left Yunyun with my body.

"What should I do…?! Ah, his head… Maybe… They can heal it? No, there's no way that's possible…!"

It was frustrating, watching all this without the ability to do anything about it.

We should have been more organized. We were fighting in a war, but we never told each other the extent of our abilities. That was so stupid in hindsight.

I already knew how serious this all was, but part of me still treated it like a game.

I looked through the remote, looking for anything that would let me communicate somehow with Yunyun. When I saw a microphone button, I got excited, thinking that it would let me talk to those in the mortal world. But it was just a microphone feature that would let me use the remote with my voice.

One part did catch my attention, though. There was a paired device feature.

I clicked on that and saw that with the remote, I could pair it with other divine devices. In the list of devices, I saw an option for 'Adventurer's Card App'.

It made sense that the app was considered 'divine'. Aqua created the app, and Eris-sama did seem to regularly communicate with Darkness and Chris somehow. She probably used this paired devices feature to do so.

"Satou Kazuma."

I spoke into the microphone, watching the text bar fill up with my name. One device showed up in the results, even displaying what kind of product my phone was.

When I paired up with my phone, a voice came out from the remote speaker.

"...Hah? Someone named Eris has paired to my device… Don't tell me this is that goddess that mama doesn't like?!"

I heard Appuri-chan's voice. Connecting to my phone meant that I could now talk to Appuri-chan.

"Wait, it's me! I'm in Eris-sama's realm right now!"

"Kazuma-san?! You… You're fine…! Thank goodness…!"

It was odd to hear such emotion in Appuri-chan's voice. It made me smile, hearing that she actually cared about me.

"Appuri-chan, quick! Please send a text message to Yunyun! Tell her that Aqua knows the resurrection spell and to bring my head and body to her!"

"Alright, I can do that!"

In a matter of seconds, Yunyun's phone buzzed in her pocket. With tears, she took out her phone and almost dropped it when she saw it was a text from me.

"K-Kazuma-san?! Wait, you're alive?! Huh? I… I don't get what's going on!"

Poor Yunyun not only had to deal with seeing me die in front of her. She now also received a text message from beyond the grave.

"Appuri-chan. Tell her not to panic and to listen to my instructions!"

"Got it!"

It took Yunyun a while, but she eventually managed to take a long, calming breath.

After that, she looked at the body.

"H-How do I bring this out without panicking people…?"

She didn't have a teleportation mark to my place, so she'd have to bring my body out of the dungeon. That was a one way ticket to a jail cell.

I didn't like having to do this to my own body, but I didn't have a choice.

"...Appuri-chan. Can you put a corpse in the inventory?"

"...Yes, it's possible as long as it's not alive. Your body is technically an object right now."

That was a morbid thought.

"Tell her to do that, then."

When Yunyun received the text, her eyes widened and she looked down at her phone.

"...I guess this is better than carrying his corpse."

She took her phone out and held it over my body and head. One by one, they disappeared as if they were never there. Only the blood remained.

"...Eh? Kazuma-san's body is only worth 1,000 Yen?"

I didn't need to hear that. At all.

Part 5

When Eris-sama came back, I had already put the remote away.

"Ah… That sure was a long meeting! Sorry to keep you waiting!"

I didn't know why Eris-sama decided to help me, but all I could do was give her an appreciative smile.

"Well, then… I suppose it's time to send you to heaven…"

All of a sudden, we heard a familiar voice.

"Oi, Kazuma! I've resurrected you now! Good grief… Dying to some lowly kobold. Pufufufu!"

"I-It wasn't some ordinary Kobold! It was an evolved Kobold!"

"Well, you should come back now!"

"Um, well… I'm supposed to go to heaven now."

"Hah? Who's telling you that? I bet it's that no-good, textbook goody-goody Eris, right?! Tell her not to interfere with me! I'm her senpai, her senpai, got it?!"

Eris-sama sighed and rubbed her forehead.

"That Aqua-senpai… Willful as always. She's even causing so many problems by giving all those divine artifacts to the heroes!"

I almost thought that Eris-sama would prevent me from resurrecting once she found out that Aqua was the one helping me. However, she just smiled.

"Kazuma-san, please be careful from now on. You defeated the dullahan, Beldia, and for that, we are expecting a lot out of you."

I was a bit surprised that she'd recognize my achievement. She also implied that her superiors were aware of my victory over Beldia.

Was that the reason why they were making an exception for me?

I gave her a smile.

"Um, I know that it's hard to believe since I died to a Kobold, but I'll do my best to protect this world, and the other world, too."

"I'm looking forward to your future exploits!"

We heard Aqua's voice again below.

"Oiii! What's taking so long, Kazuma?! Tell that hussy Eris to send you down already, or I'll tell everyone about how she pads her chest!"

Eris-sama blushed and waved her hand, making a shining circle appear underneath me.

In the next moment, I felt a surge of motion. Then, I found myself lying on my back, my head on top of Aqua's lap, as she looked down at me.

She sighed in relief.

"Ah, there he is."

Yunyun teared up and leaned down to hug my head.

"I'm so glad!"

I looked up gratefully at Yunyun. She did so much for me and suffered through the horrible sight of seeing me die in such a brutal manner.

"Thanks for saving me, Yunyun."

"Ehehe… You're welcome!"

I looked around and saw that we were in my room. My neck was stiff from where the Kobold Hero decapitated me. Rubbing it made me wince.

"So, what do we do now, Kazuma? We can't just let that Kobold run around in the dungeon."

I sighed when Aqua reminded me that it was my responsibility that the impudent, young Kobold managed to evolve.

"We'll have to gather people with the right skillset to handle these Kobolds."

This was all my fault, but that didn't mean that I wanted to risk my life again. I had enough shows of bravery with Vanir and Beldia. This time, I actually died.

"I'll make some calls and gather everyone later."

I thanked Yunyun again before she teleported home. Once she left, Appuri-chan alerted me,

"Your bond with Yunyun has increased!"

Yunyun (Lonely Stalker), Bond Rank: 4

Whenever you use a spell scroll, you can cast a spell you don't know if you use twice as much mana.

Inside… The Kobold Hero was waiting for us.

Chapter 18: Revenge On This Kobold Hero!

Part 1

"...I don't think that's a good idea."

"Why? I mean, if we're gonna share you, I might as well get to know her."

"You both have very different personalities…"

"I see… So she's the chaotic and impulsive type, huh?"

Aqua…

She was more delusional than I thought.

"Hey, Kazuma, why are you looking at me like that, as if you're pitying me?!"

I placed a hand on her shoulder.

"You are blessed with good looks, Aqua. Truly."

"Oi, I can tell when you're insulting me, and that sure felt like an insult!"

"Just be glad you were born a goddess."

"...I am glad, but again, that really feels like an insult!"

Aqua kept questioning me on what I meant by that, before she got bored and kicked me out of her room.

I went back to my room and took a look at one of the books Rin recommended to me. I didn't have any homework to do, so I spent the rest of the night reading it.

"Your 'Creativity' increased by +1! Also, Kazuma-san, please don't tease mama so much!"

Instead of just giving me a report of my stat increase, Appuri-chan took the opportunity to scold me about my treatment of her mama.

"Don't ignore me! Also, your new quests have been determined!"

"...Why did it take so long after I completed the second floor boss quest?"

"You've improved a lot, so it took some time to come up with quests of an appropriate difficulty! Do you wish to see them now?"

Reading that book made me sleepy, so I decided that it could wait for tomorrow.

Chapter 20: Interrogation For This Demon!

Part 1

I checked the new quests I unlocked when I woke up the next morning.

Repopulate the Giant Toads! Quest Rewards: +2 Intelligence, +2 Willpower

Kill the third floor boss! Quest Rewards: Random loot box

Discover the next trendy place! Quest Rewards: +2 Charisma, +2 Attractiveness

I was already planning on doing the first two.

But the third quest caught me off guard.

"...Where should I even look?"

The smoothie store and the cafe was straightforward enough, but I didn't know what other place would get the attention of normies.

I decided to just keep an eye on the news and the service locator.

I noticed there was a note waiting for me when I went downstairs to eat breakfast. It was the 1,000 Yen weekly allowance, left for me by my dad.

Here's your allowance! I bet you really need it!

Maybe a month ago, but this allowance was pretty much useless to me now.

It was the same thing with my family's bond rank reward of letting me skip classes.

I was actually trying in school now, so I couldn't afford to skip.

Still, I took the allowance since it was free money.

I went off to school. On my way there, I saw Rin.

"Ah! Senpai, good morning! I had fun yesterday!"

A rosy-cheeked Rin greeted me.

She was still embarrassed about the kiss. How cute.

"Yeah, me too. Oh, I read some of the new books you recommended to me."

"Nice! Please tell me your impressions!"

The slight awkwardness disappeared as soon as we started talking about Rin's favorite hobby.

I noticed Mitsurugi by the school gates. When I walked past him without acknowledging him, he grabbed me by the arm.

"Oi… I know you saw me, so why were you walking past me?"

He said, giving me an offended look.

"I thought you said you weren't gonna cockblock me during my morning walks with Rin."

"Then you must have realized that this must be important if I'm 'cockblocking' you, right?!"

He was speaking too loudly and Rin heard him. She looked at us in confusion and said,

"Eh? Um, what is 'cockblocking'?"

I gave a warning look to Mitsurugi not to corrupt the innocent Rin and he rapidly shook his head.

"It's nothing! Um, I need to talk to your boyfriend, so…"

He was calling me her boyfriend. This guy really lacked any tact.

Rin just chuckled and started walking away.

"Alright, I'll see you later, senpai!"

I waved at her and turned to Mitsurugi, not bothering to hide how annoyed I was.

"This better be good."

"I told you, it's important! Listen, one of the app-users I'm friends with said that he saw a portal opening in his neighborhood and a demon scout came out of it! Here he got it on film!"

He was probably talking about one of the app-users I saw him talk to in the swimming pool. I accepted his phone and played the video in question.

Mitsurugi wasn't kidding around. It was in the video, a red, demonic creature stepped out of the portal, into the streets.

"...Aqua told me that the Demon King army can only open a portal to our world every full-moon. Is this one of those accidental portal openings?"

Just like Dust and the succubi who accidentally arrived here from the other world, I thought it was one such scenario.

"I hope that's the case. Because if it wasn't, then that means the Demon King army finally figured out how to create portals whenever they want!"

I watched the rest of the video. The demon looked around, before sprinting away from the portal.

"Did your friend attempt to give chase?"

I asked, to which Mitsurugi shook his head.

"No, he was with a girl, so he didn't want to leave."

"...He risked the safety of our world because he didn't want to leave some girl?"

"C-Come on, go easy on him."

Mitsurugi couldn't even defend his friend, and just pleaded for me not to insult him too much.

"Well, we need to track of where this demon is going."

"Do you have any ideas, Satou?"

"I have a [Tracking] skill, but it only works on tracks that have been there for 30 minutes."

"Oh, that's unfortunate…"

"I guess we'll just have to look around for him."

Mitsurugi sighed and swept his hair back.

"Alright. I'll recruit some people to help. You should also ask the girls we hunted the Kobold Hero with to help."

"I'll ask Chris for help."

"Yes, Chris-san and the other girls as well."

"No, just her."

"Why?! It's more efficient if we have lots of people looking for that thing!"

"Megumin will try to blow the demon up on sight. Aqua will exorcize it right away. Darkness will want to be interrogated, rather than interrogate the thing. Yunyun will try to make friends with it. That's why."

"...You really have no faith in those girls, huh, Satou?"

"Absolutely zero."

"F-Fine. Let's begin our search tonight, then."

Part 2

That night, the app-users spread out through the whole city to look for this demon.

I asked Chris to help as well. Those with the [Enemy Detection] skill were sure to be useful in this case.

We didn't go together, as having more eyes to go around different areas of the city was more efficient.

That said, I also knew that just looking around randomly wasn't going to do much good.

So, I decided to contact an informant.

There were a few people I knew who came from the other world, who might know a thing or two. I sought out Dust for information.

I knew exactly where to find him, the red light district, more specifically, the Succubus Shop.

"I'm sorry dear customer, but if you don't have the money…"

"Oh, come on! I'm a regular customer! Shouldn't you give me some special treatment?!"

"...But you already owe us for your last three unpaid visits."

A pathetic scene was waiting for me in the Succubus Shop.

"...! Kazuma! Dear ol' pal! You don't mind spotting me, do you?"

"Only if you give me some information…"

"That succubus over there has an E cup."

"Not that kind of information."

I told him about the demon I was looking for.

"Hmm… If it's a demon from the other world, then wouldn't they respond to the language of my world?"

"That's a pretty good idea, coming from you."

"What does that mean?"

If I made a fake message for the demon, pretending I was on its side, I might be able to trap it.

"Alright, here's 1,000 Yen."

I gave him the fee for the Succubus Shop.

"Ohh! I knew I could count on you! You're the best, Kazuma!"

Your bond with Dust has increased!

Dust (The Blond Delinquent), Bond Rank: 3

At Rank 3, Dust will give you information about the other world, as long as you cover his Succubus Shop fees! Dust views you as someone with deep pockets who he can follow around and receive money from. Be careful about being seen with him in public, as he owes the yakuza a fair bit of debt.

Bond Reward: [Spear] Rank-up

[Spear] Skill Rank: 2, Passive Skill

You are proficient in using spears. You gain 20% weapon accuracy with attacks using spears and +1 to damage using spears.

He was really just using me for money. What a transactional relationship.

Next, I wanted to ask the succubi for information, just in case they knew something. I booked a session with Rorisa.

The receptionist succubus took me to the private room, where Rorisa soon came to greet me.

"Hello, Kazuma-san! Thank you for being so understanding last time with Vanir-san!"

"It's no problem."

I was actually really annoyed by that, but I couldn't stay annoyed for long if she gave me such a cute smile.

"Actually, Rorisa, I wanted to ask you about this demon…"

"Oh, Kazuma-san wants to request a demon-type character this time?"

She made quite a misunderstanding.

Actually, that gave me an idea.

"Is it possible to request a scenario where I fight a typical Demon King army soldier from another world?"

Rorisa thought about it before nodding.

"Yes, that's possible. Although it will have to be limited to what I know about them."

"Alright, let's go for that, then."

That way, I could prepare myself for when I have to fight a real demon.

"So is Kazuma-san the one who will be conquered, or is Kazuma-san conquering the feisty demon warrior?"

She still misunderstood me.

I explained to her that I didn't want any lewd elements in the dream. I just wanted to see what it was like to fight a demon soldier.

With all the parameters set, I laid in bed and went to sleep.

When I regained my awareness, I was in a battlefield among soldiers facing off against a horde of demons.

The soldiers around me bore flags of a nation I didn't recognize.

"For Belzerg! For Princess Iris!"

There was a short-haired blonde lady with a blue streak in her hair, leading the charge. She raised a sword and the soldiers all cheered.

I looked down at my equipment and saw that I had my regular gear, just like I requested.

I watched as the soldiers and demons charged, using [Lurk] on myself to quietly observe.

While I was watching, I noticed that the demons had all kinds of fighting styles. Those who were frontlining had huge frames and carried heavy weapons that no normal human could carry.

There were medium-sized demons in robes carrying staffs, who unleashed magic on the soldiers. There were also those who used bows to shoot enemies from afar.

Finally, there was a small class of demons who acted more like rogues and skirmishers. I recognized that the demon from the video belonged to this class.

I watched how the smaller demons fought. They were light on their feet and used all sorts of dirty tricks to take down bigger opponents.

"[Steal]!"

"[Bind]!"

In short, their combat style was similar to mine.

I was used to outsmarting opponents and taking them off guard, but these guys also relied on the same kind of trickery.

In fact, when I pulled out my bow and tried to shoot one, it seemed to notice me with a detection skill and took cover before I could even fire. They escaped my awareness, before sneaking up on me with a dagger and striking me in the back.

"[Assassinate]!"

I couldn't even react as I immediately died.

I woke up from the dream, panting from the momentary pain I felt.

"Are you alright, Kazuma-san?"

Rorisa-san asked, placing a hand on my shoulder.

"Yeah, can you give me the same dream?"

"Eh? But this isn't really a dream, it's a nightmare!"

"I'd rather be prepared than die like that in reality."

Rorisa-san sighed and placed me back in the dream again.

I was back in the battlefield again.

This time, I made sure to focus on my surroundings like I did with the Rookie Killer, truly shutting off my senses to everything else and watching out only for the demon.

When I felt [Enemy Detection] signalling me of an attack, I quickly turned with my bow and shot an arrow at the threat.

The demon fell down, killed by the arrow.

I woke up again, with Rorisa smiling at me.

"Good job, Kazuma-san! You did it!"

"Humu, it's only natural."

"Ah, would you like me to give you a lewd dream as well?"

I already went all the way with Aqua, but…

"Well, since I'm here…"

…I couldn't resist, in the end.

Since Rorisa fulfilled my strange request, I also made sure to give her a tip.

Your bond with Rorisa has deepened!

Rorisa (Rookie Succubus), Bond Rank: 3

At Rank 3, Rorisa thinks that you are into some weird play. Regardless, she sees you as more than just a customer, thanks to your kind treatment of her. Treating her nicely when you come over will increase your bond with her.

Bond Reward: You learn the skill [Bedroom Skill]!

[Bedroom Skill], Rank: 1, Passive Skill

You are proficient in pleasing your partner in bed. Success is determined by 'Charisma' (62).

I learned quite a crazy skill…

Rather, I was confused as to why I didn't gain that skill when I first slept with Aqua, since I was also able to gain skills just by performing it.

…Was Appuri-chan trying to say that I didn't do well enough to learn the skill on my own?

"Eh…? Kazuma-san, why are you putting me on sleep mode?!"

I got pissed off and put her to sleep.

Part 3

Since the demon rouge-types in Rorisa's dream service seemed to have a skill that could one-shot me, I decided to get better protection.

I went over to the blacksmith.

Like last time, the storekeeper was reading an erotic magazine. He looked up at me with bare interest.

"What do ya want?"

"...Is that how you treat a returning customer?"

"You want me to give you some complimentary shuwa shuwa or something? Just tell me what you want, then buzz off."

I really hated having to give this guy money.

"I'm going on a hunt tonight…"

"Not interested."

"I don't even know what you think I was trying to ask. But that's not it."

I told him that I needed armor. I also needed some high quality rope for my recently acquired [Bind] skill.

"If you want a direct upgrade for your iron breastplate, I can give you a discount."

"Wait, you can do that?"

"Yup. There's an [Upgrade] skill available to the blacksmith class that can let me upgrade an armor if I have the material available."

"What a useful skill… Say, do you want to set up a bond link, maybe?"

I didn't know how else to say it, so I directly asked him.

After all, if I made a bond with him, it was possible that I could learn that skill through the bond rewards.

"Hah? Not a chance. You're one creepy kid, asking to bond like that…"

"Oi! It's beneficial for the both of us to learn skills from one another, right?! In fact, I have something called a [Bedroom Skill] that might be available if you get close enough with me…"

"I don't need some lame skill to make me better in bed."

Seeing how adamant he was to refuse the offer, I just gave up and gave him the armor to upgrade.

The upgrade cost me 20,000 Yen.

Steel Breastplate - Medium Armor (Rare)

Reduces incoming physical damage by 7. Applies -7 penalty to stealth related stats when sneaking.

Sells for: 14,000 yen

As for the rope, he sold it to me for 1,500 Yen.

"Oh, yeah, you bought a hunting shortbow last time, right? Do you want a better bow?"

He was really intent on making money off of me.

Still, I couldn't deny that I needed more firepower.

"Yeah, what do you have?"

"I have this Elven Shortbow for 15,000 Yen."

I looked at his ears.

"How can you make an elf bow when you're not an elf?"

Better yet, were there any elves in Japan to begin with?

"Idiot. I have this skill called [Cultural Exchange] that lets me create equipment outside of my species. It includes species and races from the other world."

Since elves in stories were known for their archery prowess, I imagined that this bow would be quite powerful.

It was quite an expensive item, but my archery was still my most reliable DPS option. I decided to fork the money over for the upgrade.

I also sold my old bow for 1,500 Yen. Then, I assigned the new bow as one of my two signature weapons.

Elven Shortbow - Signature Weapon (Rare)

Shortbow of elven make. That said, a normal Japanese oji-san made it.

Ammo: 20/20 (Steel-tipped arrows)

Bow Accuracy: Dexterity modifier = 62% chance of hitting

Weapon Damage: 5 piercing damage Dexterity modifier (6) Bonus (2) = 13 damage

Sells for: 10,000 yen

"Did you level up or something, oji-san? I remember you were only an intermediate blacksmith last time."

I said, while looking at the rarity of the weapons and armor he was able to make.

"I guess I leveled up after ripping off… I mean, serving customers like yourself."

This guy wasn't even hiding it anymore.

I left the store once I made my purchases.

From then on, I would enact Dust's plan to capture the demon.

I used the [Smithing] skill to carve out messages all over town.

Dust gave me a message in the other world's language, which translated to an order for the demon to meet with its superiors.

The meeting place I specified was Wiz's store.

I figured that since a Demon King general was staying there, the demon would have an easier time believing the message.

And if something went wrong, perhaps Wiz would take pity on me and defeat the demon for me.

I also recruited the help of the other app-users through Mitsurugi, as well as Chris, to plaster this message all around the city.

I felt a bit bad that there was random graffiti of some unknown language all over the place. Still, being a nuisance to the public was better than letting this demon wander around.

"Yo, Wiz."

I said, as I entered the store.

"Oh, Kazuma-san! Thank you for shopping with us once again!"

She had the wrong idea.

Vanir glanced at me from where he was sitting and scoffed.

"Foolish shopkeeper. This shrewd boy doesn't intend to give us proper business at all. In fact, he is using us to capture one of our comrades…"

"Eh?! Kazuma-san, is that true?!"

I felt a bit bad now, since Wiz was so innocent.

I shook that feeling of guilt off, knowing that Vanir was using that against me.

"Just let me stay here for a bit. You can do that much for me as a regular customer, right?"

"W-Well, I suppose so…"

"What a terrible businesswoman! You, boy, if you don't intend to buy any of the wares, then leave!"

"...If you make me leave, then I'll have Aqua come here and sprinkle holy water all over the place."

Wiz looked horrified when I said that.

"Please don't do that, Kazuma-san!"

"Aren't you a Lich, woman?! Why are you cowering before a mere human and his pet goddess!"

I gave an evil smirk at Vanir and continued,

"Aqua is your direct counter. Think twice before kicking me out…"

"...Among all the humans I've encountered, you're probably the one closest to a devil. Fine, stay if you want, boy! But I won't make this visit a comfortable one for you! I will now proceed to share your romantic escapades to the innocent Wiz!"

Wiz blushed as she heard this and waved her hands around.

"E-Eh?! No, that's rather embarrassing!"

I also didn't want Wiz to hear about my private affairs.

"Oi, Vanir, if you don't want this shop to be flooded with holy water, you better not follow up on that threat!"

"You see, it seems this boy over here who was a virgin not that long ago is getting a big head. He now has two girls that he's fooling around with…"

"Kazuma-san is a playboy?!"

I suffered through this the entire time I waited for the devil to arrive.

Part 4

It took a couple hours until [Enemy Detection] alerted me of a threat.

Vanir was telling Wiz all about my embarrassing secrets until he supposedly got full from all the nourishment. He went to work on items that adventurers might buy once he had his fun.

That meant that it was just me and Wiz in the store front when I felt the demon's presence.

"...Don't tell him I'm here, Wiz."

I instructed her, as I used [Lurk] and hid behind the counter.

She looked down at me as I crouched beside her legs, my face leaning against the side of her thigh.

"Um, Kazuma-san, why is your face pressed up against me…?"

She was blushing not only from the contact, but from the stories Vanir told her.

"I can't help it. I'm hiding, after all."

"...But there's lots of space under there."

"Shhh! The demon is coming in!"

The door opened, making the bell ring.

"Welcome to Wiz's Magic Item Store!"

"...! W-Wiz-sama! Forgive me, I didn't know that I was supposed to rendezvous with you!"

"Eh? You were?"

Wiz blinked in confusion, then looked back down at me.

I made a motion with my hands, telling her to play along.

"O-Oh, right…"

"...? What's the matter, Wiz-sama? You seem unsure."

"U-Um… Please wait a moment…!"

Wiz knelt down to face me eye-level.

"Kazuma-san, what do you want me to say?!"

"Just turn around and pretend you're sorting through your wares. I'm gonna use a skill to imitate your voice."

"A-Alright…"

She didn't seem all that eager to do this, but she still stood up and turned around to the wares on the display shelves behind her. Then, I used [Versatile Entertainer].

"...Tell me the details about your scouting mission."

I said, in Wiz's voice.

"Yes, ma'am! I was sent here with two tasks. The first is to make sure that our new portal system works. The second is to find out what happened to Beldia-sama and Vanir-sama, if they were defeated or if they turned traitor…"

"The portal system… What kind of improvements has the Demon King army made?"

"We can now open small portals that can transfer two people at a time on every change of the moon phase, rather than once per full moon."

This was really bad. Once per month was already bad enough, but if they could send a Beldia and Vanir level threat every week, I wasn't sure if we could deal with that.

"...So, Wiz-sama, did you just want me to report to you? If so, then I will go back to my duties."

"Wait, I have one more task for you…"

"What is it, Wiz-sama?"

"You see, I've been very lonely here in this world… And I'd like some company… Perhaps you could be my partner, hmm~?"

"...?!"

Wiz shot me a panicked look as I used her voice to seduce the demon.

"W-W-Wiz-sama?! Surely a lowly demon like me… With someone like you…!"

Wiz looked at me pleadingly, begging me not to go further, but I wanted to take this chance to make the demon lower his guard.

"Take off your clothes and service your mistress, demon…"

"Y-Yes, Wiz-sama! Gladly!"

As expected, this demon couldn't resist the once in a lifetime chance to sleep with Wiz.

When I heard the demon removing its gear, I leapt out from behind the counter.

"...Eh?! A human?!"

I was about to throw the rope at him to use [Bind], but the demon kicked up the dagger it dropped on the ground and threw it at me.

"[Dagger Throw]!"

The dagger moved in a rapid spin towards me.

"[Steal]!"

I stole the dagger mid-flight, the weapon appearing safely in my hand.

It didn't matter if the weapon was moving in a deadly trajectory or was part of an attack. In fact, the skill was basically guaranteed to work since the weapon was no longer in the user's possession.

The demon was disoriented by having his weapon suddenly appear in my hands. I used that chance to throw the rope at him.

"[Bind]!"

"Ah, crap…!"

It couldn't move out of the way in time, as the rope wrapped around its entire body, making it fall on the ground.

"...Wiz-sama! Please help me!"

I gave it a cruel grin while imitating Wiz's voice once more.

"Nope~! Just give up, you stupid demon~!"

It had red skin, but I saw its face pale when it realized what happened.

"Wiz-sama, have you betrayed us?!"

Wiz shook her head in denial.

"N-No, I didn't! But I can't harm humans, so…"

"But you can't interfere with us demons! That's part of the deal!"

"T-That's true…"

I turned to Wiz and said,

"Oi, you saw what happened. This demon attacked first by throwing that dagger at me. I was just protecting myself."

"T-That's also true…"

"Wiz-sama, please don't listen to this human!"

"U-Um… W-Well, I'm sorry! But you did attack Kazuma-san, so he was only right to defend himself!"

"Gahhh! This can't be!"

I smirked and went over to the demon, rolling him around like a log with my foot.

"Oi, you can't complain since you were stripping and about ready to do all sorts of erotic things with Wiz! Did you really think you'd have a chance with your superior, huh?!"

"Y-You took advantage of my admiration for Wiz-sama! How dare you!"

"Ehhh… You hear that, Wiz? This little demon admires you!"

Both Wiz and the demon blushed in embarrassment as I started laughing at his plight.

"Kuh! J-Just kill me already!"

The demon started saying lines that Darkness would say.

"Nope, you're gonna give me more information. Tell me everything you know, now."

"And why would I do that?!"

"...You're currently buckass naked and tied up. What kind of leverage do you have in this scenario?"

"Y-You make a good point."

I eventually got it to give up.

"...I don't really have any more information I can give you. I'm just a scout after all. Ah, but I do know that the Demon King is planning to send two generals next week, when we can open a portal again."

"Which generals is he sending?"

"Hans-sama, a giant poison slime and Sylvia-sama, a chimera…"

The chimera sounded a bit threatening, but the slime didn't seem all that scary.

After all, I defeated a slime before in the dungeon.

However, Wiz seemed nervous when the demon told us who was coming.

"Oh, no… Hans-san in particular is very scary."

"Hah? Wouldn't the chimera be a bigger threat?"

"Sylvia-san is also powerful, but Hans-sama as a poison slime has powerful regeneration and is almost immune to physical attacks. Not to mention his incredibly potent poison…"

Could it be that slimes were actually pretty dangerous?

Even though they were just cute mascot characters in Dragon Quest.

"I-I gave you information, so please let me go now…"

The demon said, as it squirmed underneath my feet as I kept it in place.

"And why would I do that? It's better to just keep you prisoner here for a while."

I learned my lesson with the Kobolds. When I used [Lore Reading], I found out that this small, red demon didn't have any means to evolve or grow more powerful. That meant that it wouldn't suddenly get a power up like the Kobold Hero did.

That meant that we could keep it in captivity while knowing the full extent of what it was capable of.

"Um, where are you planning to keep him, Kazuma-san?"

Wiz asked, looking at her comrade in the army with pity.

"Just keep him here for now. You need employees anyway, right?"

"W-Well, that's true…"

She couldn't deny that.

"As for you, demon, you get to be with the Wiz-sama you admire so much. It's not a bad deal for you, right?"

"...I suppose there's some positives to this."

Trying to find some good in this bad situation he found himself in, the demon said this.

Part 5

The next day, after school, I asked the same group that took down the Kobold Hero to meet me at a family restaurant.

Mitsurugi was the first to arrive, followed by Megumin. Even though Chris and Darkness weren't from around here, Aqua was actually the last to arrive.

"You're lucky I showed up in the first place!"

Aqua said, when I pointed this out.

I then told them what I learned through that demon.

Mitsurugi sighed in concern.

"It's a good thing my friend managed to film that demon, or we would have never known about this."

"A giant poison slime and a chimera, huh? That sounds cool."

Megumin said, nodding along to whatever image she had in her head of our enemies.

Yunyun rubbed her chin.

"A slime, huh…? I tried to make friends with one in the dungeon, but it tried to melt my clothes instead… I think it was called a cloth eating slime…"

"...Where did you encounter this creature, Yunyun?"

Of course, that got Darkness's interest.

Chris coughed into her hand, trying to get everyone back on track.

"Slimes are pretty powerful, but their abilities are largely known. They are incredibly durable and have high regeneration on top of that. However, a chimera's abilities are much harder to predict…"

That was because chimeras were made out of many different components. Even the demon couldn't tell me much, since he said that Sylvia had a habit of absorbing a bunch of different things into her body.

"The thing I'm most concerned about is how to hide this from the public. If it's a giant slime we're dealing with…"

Mitsurugi said, as he rubbed his temples from the stress of all of this.

"Apparently, chimeras have high magic resistance, right? Then I'm not sure if my explosion magic will be much help."

We all turned in surprise at what Megumin said.

"...Hey, is this the real Megumin, or an imposter?"

Aqua said, pulling Megumin's cheek to see if her body was real and not that of a doll's.

Megumin (Explosion Mage), Bond Rank: 5

At Rank 5, Megumin sees you as a pervert with a heart of gold. You're a reliable friend and party member who will always come through for his friends, even if he doesn't act like it. [Ice Magic Increase] Skill Rank: 2, Passive Skill

"[Overpower]!"

He increased his raw strength and shook off the bodies trying to stop him.

The keeper had no chance to stop his empowered shot.

With Mitsurugi going all out, I didn't even have to do anything.

That guy really made me do so much work up until this point, when he could just take over the match all on his own…

And with that, we moved to the finals.

Part 5

For our last match, I saw some familiar faces waiting for me in the hotel, after I finished a short team practice.

"I can't believe our son is in the national championship! I'm so proud of you!"

My mom said, holding me in her arms.

I couldn't even remember the last time she hugged me, but she was giving me quite the embrace right now.

"...You've really come far from where you were a few months ago, Kazuma. I'm proud of you, really."

My dad patted me on the shoulder.

I didn't expect my parents to show up. Not only did they surprise me by showing up, they even told me they were proud of me.

"Y-You're pretty cool right now, I guess, nii-san…"

Even Kazuto had some nice words for me.

I couldn't help but think about how I was a NEET for all those years, how much trouble I must have given to my family. It wasn't like I improved myself because I wanted to make up for all those years. I just wanted to have fun playing out my fantasy RPG dreams in real life.

But I couldn't deny that my life was getting better, and my relationships were also improving. I also couldn't deny that it felt good to have people, especially my family, recognize my growth.

"T-Thanks… For showing up and all."

I didn't know how to deal with their praise, so I just avoided their gaze and glanced to the side.

Your bond with your family increased!

Satou (Family) Bond Rank: 6

At rank 6, your family respects you for the continuous growth you've shown, ever since you've stopped becoming a NEET. Your brother accepts your relationship with his crush and respects you for managing to woo her. If you mention wanting a non-blood related sister again, your parents might reluctantly consider it.

Bond Reward: Your parents will support you financially as much as they possibly can

I thought that the bond rewards from my parents got power crept by everything else but…

Wasn't this new rank-up reward kind of ridiculous?

Even though they were so stingy before, it was saying that they'd support me unconditionally now?

To test it out, I said,

"Say, dad, can I have some money? My funds are kinda running low right now…"

"Oh? Yeah, sure. No problem. I only have 10,000 Yen in cash right now. Is that enough?"

Was this really that stingy father of mine who couldn't even lend me 2,000 Yen before without asking me to pay it back?

With shaking hands, I accepted the money from him.

"Oh? Kazuma, there you are."

Of course, if my family was here, then Aqua would also be there. She was eating some takoyaki as she approached us. She was dressed in a blue top and a pleated skirt.

"Ah, Aqua-chan! Are you back from your shopping trip? There's lots of good stores in Tokyo! Do you want an extra 20,000 Yen?"

"Yeah, sure!"

Wait, I thought he said he only had 10,000 Yen on him? And why was she getting more than me?!

"...Don't tell me, Aqua, that you also have a bond rank with my family?"

I said, leaning over to whisper to her.

She nodded, while licking the takoyaki sauce off from the stick she just finished.

"Yup. It hit Rank 7 today, actually."

Wasn't that higher than mine?

She reached the max rank with my family before I did.

And here I was getting emotional over my close bonds with my family.

"...Nii-san, do you want to go to the arcade?"

Kazuto asked, giving me a smile.

"No way. Play on your own, brat."

"...?! Why are you so mean to me?!"

Just when I was starting to get along with them.

"Oh? Senpai, is that you?"

I turned around and saw Rin approaching us. She smiled when she saw me and jogged over. She was wearing a green hoodie and a white skirt, as well as a tan purse. My family turned to look at her.

"Who's this, Kazuma-kun? A friend?"

My mom asked. Rin smiled at her.

"Yup! Nice to meet you, I'm Hinamori Rin!"

"Ehh… Is she the girl you were talking about, Kazuma?"

Aqua asked, examining Rin from head to toe.

I started sweating. They knew about each other, in a vague sense, since they knew that I was seeing two girls. But this was the first time they were meeting each other.

"We're gonna check out some shops so you kids have fun!"

My parents chose the worst time to leave.

"Why don't we have some tea, then?"

Rin suggested to Aqua-san, giving her a cheerful smile.

"Yeah, sure. Let me just finish my takoyaki first."

And so, I found myself in quite the hellish situation.

Part 6

"Here's your milk teas!"

The waitress said, placing our cups down on the table.

Rin was still all smiles, while Aqua was giving her a curious look.

I kept expecting them to pounce on each other at any moment.

Then, Rin said,

"So, um, how do I say this? Are you senpai's other lover?"

Rin blushed a little as she couldn't find another way to broach such a touchy subject.

Aqua chuckled and said,

"Wow, you just went ahead and said it, huh? I like her, Kazuma, she's got guts. Yeah, and I guess that means that you're…"

"Yup, I am."

They shared a giggle. I sighed in relief, glad that they were finding humor in this, rather than getting all hostile about it.

"Kazuma, you seem surprised that we're getting along."

Aqua raised a brow as she saw me relaxing.

"Can you blame me? These sorts of situations can go south pretty fast."

Rin shook her head.

"Not necessarily! And you made sure to communicate with us a lot. It's not like this is a surprise to us, right?"

"Yeah. I gave you my permission and everything."

I wondered how much of this was caused by the bond reward I got from Kazuto, the ability to have two girlfriends at once, and how much of it actually had to do with what they were talking about.

I'd really prefer it if the app didn't have anything to do with their acceptance, since I wanted them to be OK with this of their own volition.

"So, I take it you're an app user, Rin?"

I almost spit out my tea when Aqua said that.

"Oi, what are you saying?!"

Thankfully, Rin only tilted her head.

"App-user? What kinda app? Ah, I like to use a grocery shopping app to keep track of discounts!"

"Oh, that's a surprise. I sensed potential in you, so I thought you'd be an app-user, too."

This got my attention. I turned to Aqua and said,

"Eh? Rin has potential?"

"Yup. Well, it's kind of faint right now, so I guess that's why the app didn't sense it."

Come to think of it, I did find it a bit strange that Rin's bond rewards gave me all kinds of dungeon related skills and even increased my mana capacity.

For non app-users like my family, they didn't even get their own personal bond categories, being grouped together as my family instead. And all the bond rewards from the Satou family line were non-dungeon related.

Konno-san had an individual bond-rank, but she didn't give me any skills yet, so I had no way of knowing if hers were also dungeon related.

"Um… Is there something I should know?"

I turned to Aqua, who just shrugged her shoulders.

"It's all up to you, Kazuma."

I considered not telling Rin, since I'd prefer it if she stayed out of danger.

But it would be even more dangerous if demons came over and Rin didn't know what to do. I lied to her about the Vanir pager, but that wasn't really a good countermeasure in case the worst case scenario happened.

I sighed and turned to Rin.

"...Um, how do I get started with this…"

"Why don't you just show her the dungeon, Kazuma? We should be able to keep her safe if we stay on the first floor."

Aqua had a point. I didn't even know where to begin to explain the app, the other world and everything else.

"Um… T-The dungeon? I don't think I'm ready for that kinda play…"

Rin blushed, assuming all kinds of things.

After assuring her that wasn't what we meant, I used the Service Locator function of the app to show me to a dungeon entrance in Tokyo.

Then, after a short train ride…

In the middle of a crossing, there was a floating door.

Aqua and I both clearly saw it, but Rin didn't see it at the start.

"I'm supposed to see a door?"

Rin said, squinting her eyes at the spot we pointed at.

Aqua smiled and went behind Rin, gently guiding her head.

"Yeah, right there. Don't try to imagine it. Your imagination will actually overlap with the reality in front of you. Just clear your mind and you can see it."

From Aqua's words, it made sense to me now why Rin couldn't perceive the dungeon doors.

Rin was an imaginative girl, always reading books, always thinking about all her favorite stories and imagining herself in fantasy worlds.

Since she was always inventing her own realities, she couldn't find the fantastic world that was right in front of her.

Rin took a deep breath, then did as Aqua instructed.

Then, after a moment…

"...! I can see it! Whoa, that door really is just floating there!"

Rin was finally able to see the dungeon.
