#419
Chapter 23: An Evacuation For These Forest Monsters!

Part 1

Before we went down into the dungeon, I wanted to take out my Spell Storage Ring to give it to Rin. She should be safe with us, but she could use it in case of an emergency.

But when I looked down on my phone, I noticed something.

There was a new entry for the Chris Bond Rank.

In fact, the rank actually went up to rank 4.

Chris "Silver-haired Thief", Bond Rank: 4

At Rank 4, Chris views you as a total pervert! She has completely changed her opinion of you from a reliable friend to a sexual harasser! However… She didn't seem to hate it that much? She might welcome more in the future…

Bond Reward: You gain +10 speed!

"...Oi, Appuri-chan, how come you didn't alert me of this…"

"...That's because the way you gained the bond rank is despicable. I should really tell mama on you."

"Well, she's right here, you want to tell her that you're not doing your job?"

"No, I don't wanna get in trouble with mama…"

"Then don't do shit like this again!"

"Hm…? Kazuma, are you saying something to Appuri-chan?"

Aqua curiously peeked over my shoulder.

"No, not really."

"But I heard you saying something."

"Must have been your imagination."

Rin was nervously following us. She looked around at the walls and the darkness beyond.

"Just stay close to us and you'll be safe."

"Alright, I trust you, senpai."

I looked into her eyes and saw that she was completely sincere.

"So, how do you want to start this off, Kazuma?"

Aqua asked, as she took out her staff. Then, she casted a bunch of buffs on us, focusing on protective spells for Rin.

"We're just gonna see if Rin can download the app. If not, then she can't come to the dungeon with us."

"But I can see and enter the dungeon, right?"

"That's true, but the app hasn't appeared on your phone yet."

Rin nodded, taking out her phone to check again, only to not find the app there.

The only way to really see if Rin could become an app-user was to involve her in a fight.

We walked around for a few minutes until we encountered a goblin.

"Eep!"

Rin let out a yelp of surprise as she saw a monster for the first time. I suppose that was a pretty normal reaction.

Standing protectively over Rin, I threw a rope at the goblin.

"[Bind]!"

I also did a pose, trying to look cool for her.

"Wow, senpai! You have powers and stuff! You're like a superhero!"

Every guy wants to hear that exact line from a cute girl.

"...This kind of thing is normal for me."

Aqua snorted at my attempts to show off.

"Even though that's the weakest monster…"

She didn't intend to let me have my moment at all.

Next, I handed over Chunchunmaru to Rin.

"You're going to need to finish it off."

"Wait, what? I can't do that."

"You'll have to do it if you want to unlock the app."

"That can't be…"

She reluctantly raised the sword, facing the tied up goblin. Then while closing her eyes she struck the goblin across the chest, causing a fatal wound.

"See? That wasn't so bad"

"Easy for you to say... You're used to this, senpai."

Aqua smiled and slung an arm around the quivering shoulders of Rin.

"So? Did you unlock the app?"

"Oh, it looks like it's on my phone now!"

Rin smiled and showed me the screen. We all huddled around her to look at the app. We saw the familiar animation of the chibi Appuri-chan dancing around in the intro scene.

"You gained a level, so that means you can choose an available class"

Aqua explained the process of the app. It almost looked like she knew what she was doing.

"Let's see... It says the only classes I qualify for are the mage classes. I guess I'm not built for any frontline class..."

I looked over Rin's petite body, not at all surprised that she didn't qualify as something like a Warrior or knight. Although I was a bit surprised that she also didn't qualify for the Archer or Thief class, considering how slim she was. I guess body types didn't really have anything to do with innate talents.

"Just choose the Mage class. It's a shame that you couldn't unlock the priest class. Although I guess those are for the exclusively talented."

Aqua didn't spare any moment to try and raise her own ego. Thankfully, Rin didn't seem bothered by it. Although she did spare Aqua a side-glance and gave a toneless chuckle.

"Senpai... She has quite a high opinion of herself, doesn't she?"

"Don't worry you'll get used to it."

It turns out that Rin had good intelligence, magic power and magic capacity, all of them ranging at around the 70s. It didn't qualify her for an advanced class, but if we could find her a proper spell book, then she can probably learn intermediate spells without any problems.

"It's kind of hard for spell casters, isn't it? Even if they unlock the class, they still need to find spells to learn"

I said, while looking at Rin's empty skill list.

"Well, it's still worth it because spellcasters eventually outscale the warrior classes."

Aqua explained with a know-it-all expression on her face.

"But if they don't even survive until that point, then it doesn't matter even if they outscale the warrior classes. Especially since it seems like priest classes are actually rare. So most people don't even have healers around them."

"That's why it's important to have a party, right? Of course, someone who prefers to dungeon delve by themselves might disapprove of that tactic."

Aqua gave me quite the smug look. I wanted to slap it out of her face. However, I didn't want to do that in front of Rin. Instead, I just gave an insincere chuckle in response to Aqua's taunts.

"You're always joking around, Aqua. Hahaha..."

Rin looked at me with a surprised but amused twinkle in her eye.

"I've never really seen this side of you before, senpai. You're always so nice to me, but it seems like you have a different side to you, at least, when you're talking to Aqua."

Even though I was trying to hide it, Rin was perceptive enough to see through my guise.

"You should see the way this guy talks to me when you're not here, Rin. He's so rude, so abusive, a true enemy to all women!"

I tried to get aqua shut up, but being rough on her would just reinforce what she was saying about me.

Rin was shocked to hear this, even gasping.

"Wait... I thought senpai was just a bit rougher when interacting with Aqua. But is it really so much different from how he talks to me?"

I should have thought this through. I should have known Aqua would try to expose me.

"No, no. Aqua here is just exaggerating..."

"Rin, if he acts any differently around you, like, more gentlemanly, then just know that it's all fake! In fact, he's probably only just doing that to give a mistaken impression to you, that he is a good guy that can be trusted. That's the furthest from the truth! This guy is a pure scumbag! There are many other girls who can testify to this!"

It's over for me. This is why I hesitated to introduce Rin to anyone else I had bond ranks with. I couldn't exactly deny that I was acting differently around her, but that was because Rin was the only normal girl I knew. There wasn't really any reason to lash out on her.

Well... Chris is also normal but she tempted me too much with that female thief role play she was trying to put on. Yeah sure, let's pin the blame on Chris. I guess I really am a scumbag, huh?

"Listen, Rin, Aqua isn't really lying. But it wasn't like I was trying to trick you or anything. You are nice to me and I wanted to be nice to you."

Instead of looking betrayed, Rin ended up in a chuckling fit.

"Wait, why are you apologizing that you have different interactions with other people? That's normal isn't it? I mean, the way I interact with my classmates, and the way I interact with my teachers and parents, is totally different from the way I treat you. Isn't it natural for it to be that way?"

Aqua also ended up giggling.

"Yeah, you don't need to be that serious..."

Aqua really was just taking advantage of the situation.

"Still, senpai, it's not good if you're mean to everyone else but me. Can't you work on that?"

I knew I still had a lot to work on. Especially after what I did to Chris. They still didn't even know about that. And the fact that I don't even want to tell them means that I really have a lot to work on.

"Yeah I'll try to improve..."

"He's going to say that but I bet he's going to start harassing some other girl we don't even know about. In fact, I wouldn't even be surprised if he was flirting with the female fans he has now."

"There's female fans, huh?"

This was supposed to be a dungeon orientation session for Rin, but it just became an interrogation for me. How did that happen?!

Part 2

"Oh, it looks like I leveled up again!"

Rin pumped her fist excitedly.

"You should also be able to see a quest list. What does that look like?"

We all looked at her quest list.

Defeat five monsters! Quest Rewards: Random loot box

Learn magic! Quest Rewards: +2 magic power, +2 mana capacity

Go on a date with Satou Kazuma! Quest Rewards: +2 charisma, +2 attractiveness

The both of us blushed a little, while Aqua snickered.

"Aww... Isn't that cute..."

"W-We can do that whenever. Let's take care of the monster hunting one, since we're already here."

I said, while coughing into my hand.

We resume the pattern of myself disabling the enemies and Rin finishing them off. Aqua kept a careful watch, ready to heal or defend us in case an enemy slipped past my notice.

With us helping her, it didn't take long until the quest was completed.

The random loot box soon appeared in the inventory. It was the same blue box with the pink ribbons.

"Hey, Aqua, does it matter who opens the box?"

"No, you could even gift it to someone"

Since I had an insanely high luck stat, I took the box and opened it.

Sure enough, the rare magic tome appeared. The last time I got this item, it only gave me elementary magic. But with Rin's higher magic potential, she should be able to at least unlock intermediate magic.

"So, I have to read this? Wait, there's nothing inside the book."

She was a bookworm and was excited to read a story. Instead, a bright light emerged from the book before it disappeared.

"It says here I have intermediate magic now!"

I was a bit jealous since she already had a higher tier of spellcasting than me despite just starting out.

To try it out, she used a spell on a group of skeletons. She swiped her hand in front of her and summoned a blast of razor sharp wind.

"[Wind Blade]!"

The skeletons fell in a heap of bones as the powerful spell cut through them. Small lacerations appeared on the walls as the large-scale blast tore through the narrow corridor. The torches also simultaneously lost their flames.

I used [Tinder] to reignite the torches. Then, I said,

"You'll have to be careful using big spells in the dungeon like that. Especially with fire spells."

"G-Got it, senpai..."

She looked a bit shaken by the destructive spell she conjured. But I could also sense a childlike excitement within her. After all, she was an avid reader of fantasy novels. And now, she discovered this fantastical element in her, what was once, ordinary life. She could summon lightning, fire and wind from her fingertips, explore a mysterious dungeon and battle monsters--it didn't surprise me that she was excited, even with the potential risk to her life. I was also like that when I was starting out, so I knew the feeling well.

We didn't want to overwhelm her too much in her first visit to the dungeon, so we went out into the city again. Rin gave a glance back to the floating door.

"Be careful, you're going to get addicted to the dungeon."

Aqua warned her, when she saw Rin's gaze lingering at the door.

"And make sure you don't go there without us around."

It was one thing if she had any frontline capabilities, but since she had a pure caster build, I didn't want her to take the risk of going in alone. Even I, at the start, had weapon proficiencies. Meanwhile, Rin couldn't even unlock the [Improvised Weapon] skill like I did. Maybe if she had a staff like Megumin, she could defend herself, but even then, Megumin was an exception with that unusual strength of hers.

"Don't worry, I don't think I can go in there by myself willingly, anyway."

I turned to Aqua and said,

"By the way, do you think your replacement in heaven is going to give Rin a cheat item? Or has Eris-sama already taken over your role?"

If that was a case, then there would be no cheat items going out anytime soon.

"Do you really think my authority would be usurped that quickly? If that angel bitch knows what's good for her, then she'd be quietly resume my tasks in my place without seeking credit for it."

I feel sorry for that angel now.

"If you do get a chance to receive a cheat item, then make sure it's magic related."

"I'll keep that in mind, senpai."

Aqua grinned and draped her arms around our shoulders.

"Well, you two do have a quest to do. I mean, you're already in Tokyo and all. Why not make use of it?"

"Doesn't senpai have a game in a couple hours?"

"We can just go to a café for a quick coffee, or something..."

"If you're sure you have time, then why not? Aqua, do you want to come as well?"

"That would make Kazuma way too happy, going on a date with the two of us. So, I'll pass."

And what's wrong with making me happy?

"Besides, you won't be able to meet the quest conditions if I come along."

"I suppose that's true. Then I guess it's just us two, senpai!"

I nodded and took out my phone, checking my Service Locator app.

"Says here that there's a café that provides charisma bonuses. Let's check it out."

Rin looked at me with a look of suspicion.

"... Don't tell me that you always take bonuses and such into consideration when choosing places to hang out with me?"

"N-No not at all..."

It's a lot more scary now that Rin knows about the app. Not only that, thanks to Aqua, she doesn't have an idealized version of me anymore in her head. She was now beginning to doubt the things that I said.

After that, we headed over to the cafe and tried the coffee.

You gained +1 Charisma! Also, I'm glad that mama approves of your mistress, you cheating scum!

Appuri-chan still seems to disapprove of the whole arrangement. Even when the parties involved are fine with it.

"So, you really do get bonuses just from drinking coffee."

Rin said, while sipping the coffee.

"Sorry, this must all be overwhelming and confusing for you."

I had my gamer background to lean on at the start, but Rin was kind of a normie, bookworm qualities aside.

"It is making me think of you in a different light…"

"I'm sorry for not living up to your expectations."

"No, no, it's nothing like that! In fact, I think it's cool that you're risking your life to protect everyone from the demon king army."

"Well, there's others, too"

"Yeah, but that just makes it even more impressive, that you are still fighting even if you can just rely on others to do the job."

That actually meant a lot to me, considering my attitude at the start. I even suggested to Aqua that we should just take the final blow on the Demon King, rather than risking our lives fighting seriously.

"I'm sorry I wasn't completely honest from the start."

"It's not like I'm just accepting everything. A part of me does feel like I shouldn't forgive you for not telling me sooner. I mean, it's kind of weird that you have an app helping you with our relationship."

"It's not really helping me. In fact it's been intentionally sabotaging me."

And that was the truth.

"Well, from now on we're in this together. So, you don't have to worry about hiding the dungeon from me anymore. And I want to protect senpai like you were protecting me all this time."

I gave her a genuine smile. I couldn't help but feel touched by her words. Then, she asked,

"So, how's the coffee from Tokyo?"

I gave it another sip.

"Overrated. Overpriced. But at least I like the company."

"But you can have me anywhere, senpai, not just in Tokyo."

"I can have you anywhere, huh? I'll hold you to that."

"Senpai, you're kind of perverted, aren't you?"

I guess my cool, reliable façade is no more.

Part 3

It was time for the final game of the nationals.

I expected a bunch of app-users on the field for the big finale. Instead, I was surprised to see my middle school classmate, the same one I faced for my first official game.

He walked up to me and said,

"Satou... You weren't kidding when you said you had enough talent to reach the national stage. But I worked my ass off to reach your level, ever since I lost to you. Let's have a good match, alright?"

I looked at his hand. I considered riling him up again to get him emotionally imbalanced, like last time. But instead, I just took his hand and shook it.

"Yeah, may the best man win."

I couldn't even remember his name, but I do have clear memories of sometimes playing soccer with him in the school courtyard. This was before I became a NEET, when I was a relatively normal high school student. This guy would invite me to play with his group, even when we weren't friends or anything. Granted, he was probably just trying to get enough members to play. But still, I always thought he was a cool guy for doing that.

I went up to Mitsurugi and said,

"We probably shouldn't use skills in this one."

He looked at me in surprise.

"I never thought I would hear that from you, ever. And this is the most important match, too."

I pointed at the cameras filming the game.

"This is going to be nationally televised, so it's probably not a good idea to show off a bunch of superhuman abilities."

"Yeah, you're right about that. I always wanted to play normally without cheating, anyway. So I have no complaints."

Thankfully, he accepted my explanation.

It wasn't like I didn't work hard, like I relied on my app skills and nothing else. After school I'd always attend practices. I'd work on my shooting, my passing, my cardio. Hell, I even started going to the gym.

But when the match started, I found out that these guys worked harder, for much longer, and loved this sport more than I ever did.

Even without any special abilities, they ran faster than me, hustled harder than me, and had a better feel for the game.

Mitsurugi did his best, but I was just reduced to a normal guy now. A lot of our offense depended on me using an ability to steal the ball, or imitate voices to cause chaos. Now that I wasn't doing that, I was just below average midfielder, clearly outclassed by actual national level players.

Still, I did my best. I looked for passing lanes, even finding Mitsurugi for a lob pass. It was reminiscent of our first play. And like our first match, he scored.

The game was tied. Both teams, with one goal each.

I was exhausted at this point. I was almost tempted to use [Drain Touch] on someone, but I held back. There were only a few minutes left of regulation. If the game ended in a tie that would mean we'd go into penalty shootout.

"Let's play defensively!!!"

Our coach yelled, his face set in a serious, stony expression. He wasn't crying like before. It was the first time I saw him like this, and I knew that this meant a lot to him and everyone else.

And I found myself feeling the same way. This whole thing started out as just a means for me to raise my stats and finish quests. But now, I wanted to win this with everyone.

Time ticked down as legs became heavy and the sound of everything, the sound of the cheers of the crowd, got drowned out by the heavy thump of my overworked heart trying to beat its way out of my rib cage. My lungs felt like there was hot wax plastered all over it. Debilitating waves of nausea accompanied each muscular function I tried to force my exhausted body through.

"Satou...! Ball is coming your way!"

Mitsurugi warned me. I raised my head and saw the ball, spinning almost languidly over to me. I looked at my mark. It was my former classmate. I could still see him in my mind, wearing our middle school uniform, his dirty shoes kicking up dirt and grass and the ball over to me, smiling without a worry.

I remembered a conversation we had.

"Hey, you're not bad at this, Satou. Ever think about joining our team?"

"Nah. Too much hassle."

"Oh, come on, man. Maybe we'd make nationals someday."

"You wish."

I grabbed his shirt. He tucked his elbow into my rib cage. We fought for position as we bent our knees, preparing to jump.

It's kind of crazy, isn't it? Going from kicking the ball around in the courtyard, to clashing in the biggest stage of our lives. I wondered if our classmates from back then were watching this on TV. I wondered if our teachers were watching. Were they surprised that a guy like me was competing in the finals like this? "Wait a minute… Why didn't you open the box for me like you did with Rin, Kazuma?!"

I gave her a blank stare.

"...In case you forgot, I was opening the boxes for Darkness and Megumin, but you got impatient and opened yours! I hope your goldfish brain remembers that next time you get another loot box!"

She's so unreasonable.

I just reminded myself how good it felt inside her, and how beautiful she looked without clothes on, so I wouldn't lose my temper.

"Hmm… There's a lot of diverging paths here, like last time."

I said, while looking at the diverging paths we encountered before finding the sand-covered third floor boss area.

Megumin squinted her eyes as she looked at the corridors that changed since the last time we went through them.

Mitsurugi drew a map for us, but this particular area of the dungeon had a special property: transforming paths.

The dungeon would regularly change where the paths lead to, in order to catch app-users off guard. This was one of the trials the dungeon gave to app-users, to prepare them from the trickery of the Demon King army.

I held Aqua in place before she could go through a path with no plan.

[Flash Attack] Skill Rank: 1, Active Skill (5 mp cost)

Quickly dash forward along with your attack. Dash effectiveness depends on your 'Speed' (68).

When using attack skills together, decrease the mana consumption of each skill by 1 point.

When we stepped out of the opening, we saw a seemingly endless stretch of sand.

Smooth plains of sand rose into breathtaking dunes. Rippling lines formed by the artificial wind swept through the sand, slow waves that trailed off into the horizon. A large serpent slithered underneath the sand, sending up sparkling grains in its twisting journey, its scales radiating the pervading Coronatite glow in a reflective lattice of oblique diamonds. The faux-sky was a soft, unchanging blue.

Just as I was thinking that, we heard the sound of trampling feet in the distance. But the sound became closer in an instant, showing the incomprehensible speeds of the approaching creatures. A cloud of dust and floating sand particles followed their arrival, as well as a trail of golden streaks of light.

These creatures were called Lizard Runners, and the floor boss was a mutant variant of a female Lizard Runner, which was called a Flashing Princess Runner.

Male Lizard Runners normally competed for the mating rights of the Princess Runner by trying to catch up to the princess in a race. However, with these mutant variants in the dungeon, the poor Male Lizard Runners had no chance of catching up to the Princess Runners that couldn't even be seen by the naked eye while she was sprinting.

Mitsurugi told me that app-users normally give up on this floor, choosing to hunt the other creatures in the desert instead to gain levels, or just straight up skipping the level and advancing to the next floor. That was because most app-users, unless they had a very specific ability that gave them equal, or greater speed to the Flashing Princess Runner, didn't have any hopes of catching up to it.

"What do we do? Should we set up a bunch of TNT to stop it?"

"...I guess Kazuma's right. I can probably kill the males with explosion, but that golden thing is too fast."

Even Megumin wasn't confident that her explosion could finish the job.

I bet Darkness just wanted to be surrounded by a pack of males in heat. She didn't think she actually had any real chance of catching the princess, rather, she wasn't interested in the princess at all.

[Lore Reading] showed me that the males had the potential to evolve through EXP, rather than a special condition like the Kobold Hero. After that, we took our Green Onions and let the tadpoles eat their food.

For example, if I manage to evolve into the very rare Tranquility Queen, I can spread my roots to other areas of the dungeon and gain more information for you… I can even communicate with other Tranquility Girls, who will assist you on your journey as well…"

With that said…

Chapter 25: A Heart-to-Heart With This Tsundere!

Part 1

I looked at the unopened Random Loot Box that we got for beating the third floor boss.

"Alright, Aqua, make sure to give me yours now instead of opening it."

She looked at me reluctantly.

"Hmm… It kind of takes away the thrill of the gamble if I let Kazuma open it for me, though."

"How is there any thrill when you know you'll get something crappy again?"

She ended up giving me her box, Megumin and Darkness giving me theirs as well.

I opened them one by one. When I opened Megumin's box, we saw a ring inside.

"Here, Megumin."

I said, holding out the ring to her.

Darkness gasped and squealed.

"W-Wow… It almost seems like you're proposing to Megumin, Kazuma!"

"Do you see me on one knee? Ah…"

While I was distracted talking to Darkness, the ring slipped out of my hand and fell on the ground.

"..." x 4.

Megumin smirked and pointed at it.

"Well, Kazuma? Are you gonna get the ring for me? You dropped it after all."

Aqua smirked as well, relishing in my embarrassment.

"Are you gonna go down on one knee, Kazuma?"

"[Steal]."

"Tch. You're no fun."

Demon Eye Ring (Very Rare)

Gives the user shining, red eyes. Also increases magic power.

Even though she gave Yunyun such a hard time before for saying they were contact lenses.

Your bond with Megumin has deepened!

Megumin (Explosion Mage), Bond Rank: 6

At Rank 6, Megumin sees you as a pervert with a heart of gold. You are truly kind and caring deep down, even if you pretend like you aren't. Chapter 26: A Relocation For This Tranquility Girl!

Part 1

With my mind preoccupied with the impending demon king army invasion, I didn't even think about midterm exams.

I was sure that I could get a decent grade even if I didn't study too hard, but I didn't want to miss out on potential rewards from doing well on the exam.

At the same time, I had all the dungeon stuff to worry about. I couldn't just dedicate hours of my time to studying. I needed to be efficient about this.

I looked at the class rep and secret idol, Konno Lia.

I had good results while studying with her last time, although she did brush me off before.

Still, I took the chance and went to her desk, putting on my friendliest smile.

Why did she assume I had ulterior motives in the first place?

I dragged my chair and placed it beside hers and sat down. She glanced at me from the side.

I suppose it did seem rather intimate, sitting so closely together.

Your bond with Konno Lia has increased!

Konno Lia (Idol-In-Disguise), Bond Rank: 2

Bond Reward: +5 Intuition

Was Aqua some kind of tracking dog?

Aside from the accessory being cute, the main benefit of the cheat item was to provide the user with a new set of spells.

We went into the first floor and soon we encountered a group of goblins…

We tried out the other spells she had, including [Light Beam] and [Bright Spark].

[Light Beam] was a concentrated blast of light that was good at piercing through armor, while [Bright Spark] was an AoE attack that also illuminated groups of enemies, making it easier for allies to hit them.

While we were there, we went to the Giant Toad area to check up on the tadpoles.

Only to see that they had grown quite large compared to last time.

They weren't the size of the Giant Toads of old yet, but they were still relatively big.

It wouldn't take too long until the app-users could hunt them again.

Quest Completed! You gain +2 Intelligence and +2 Willpower!

Megumin: Humu… My little one is growing up well.

[Shield] Skill Rank: 1, Passive Skill

You are proficient in using shields. You won't suffer a stealth penalty when equipped with a shield. You also won't suffer a spell failure chance when using shields.

[Double Attack] Skill Rank: 1, Active Skill (5 mp)

"I'm not gonna let you take this keepsake from my beloved!"

"It's not a keepsake, more like a murder weapon, right?! Besides, if you truly loved him, then you wouldn't have killed him!"

"I loved him so much that I killed him before he could move on to some bimbo!"

She was a true yandere.

Before I could retrieve the dagger, she withdrew her vine and pressed the dagger against her skin. Then, she somehow absorbed it within her.

"The only place my beloved's dagger should be in is inside me!"

She said another misleading statement.

I tried to use [Steal], but somehow, it didn't work while it was inside her. Maybe it was some kind of ability of hers.

"...So, what should we do, Kazuma? Do we trust this thing or not?"

Aqua said, as she kept a cautious eye on the monster.

"I don't want any other app-users getting harmed because of her…"

Darkness said, showing a surprising amount of concern over the other app-users.

"I say we should just kill her and sell that cheat-item."

Of course, Megumin was only thinking about money.

"Hah… Let's just go with the original plan and move her to the fourth floor."

The other girls ended up nodding, since that was what we decided on, anyway.

"I'm not gonna let you separate me from my beloved!"

"You can bring that skeleton with you, how about that?"

"...I guess that can work."

Mary said, as if she had any leverage in this. What a prideful monster.

And so, we planted her roots in a pot with soil in it and gave Darkness the cumbersome task of carrying her. Rather than go through the diverging paths and the desert area again, we just retraced our steps to the first floor.

I had the others go on ahead, since I wanted to make use of my [Solo Leveling] skill and get as much EXP as possible, grinding monsters by myself.

When I reunited with the others, I was only 40 EXP away from leveling up.

Then, we used the teleportation circle and went to the unexplored fourth floor.

"This seems like a good spot."

Mary said, pointing to a wall.

"There isn't a hidden treasure room behind this wall again, right?"

"Not this time. There's just a good pathway to the mana source on this wall."

We let her step out from the pot and make a new home on the wall. We also dug up a new burial ground for her 'lover'.

Without her noticing, I grabbed the guy's wallet before Mary could bury him. She did say that he had a girl he was seeing. The least I could do was let her know that he didn't just abandon her.

I also pocketed the 7,000 Yen that was inside.

I mean… It's not like he'd have a use for it anymore.

"Ahh… The mana on this floor is quite tasty…"

Mary let out a satisfied sigh as she leaned against the wall, resting the back of her head against the surface.

"How long is it gonna take for you to scout out the floor?"

I said, while watching her roots digging through the stone walls.

"Hmm… I'm gonna need about a day. But if you just want info on the nearby surroundings, I can give you that now."

"Sure, go for it."

"Up ahead there seems to be a flock of Magic Cabbage…"

I fought some Flying Cabbage before and made a stirfry out of them with my [Cooking] skill. Was this Magic Cabbage a similar breed to that?"

Mary explained further.

"Magic Cabbages are similar to Flying Cabbages, however, they don't use their leafy wings to fly. They are capable of using wind magic, which they can use to hover. They can also use those winds to attack from a distance."

Whereas Flying Cabbages could naturally fly and use their flight to gather momentum and slam themselves into foes, these Magic Cabbages were more like long-ranged mages.

Knowing this, I set up an Ice Shield beforehand and we advanced to the area where the Magic Cabbages were.

It didn't take too long to find them. It was quite a surreal sight, seeing cabbages float on something like miniature tornados. The cabbages also had small, beady eyes, although it was impossible to ascertain how their anatomy even functioned to allow for such a trait. I couldn't even find a brain or an optic nerve when I was cooking them.

Above the eyes, there was a small, green crystal. Mary explained that these were the source of the Magic Cabbage's wind magic.

"Alright… Darkness and I will tank the first wave of wind magic. Then Megumin will attack and I will follow after. Aqua, make sure to support us."

"Can't I join Megumin for the follow up attack as well?"

Aqua said, clearly bored with just supporting us all the time.

I was about to deny her, but I remembered something from my MMO days, when I was a guild leader.

The healer and support roles had a high-turnover rate because it was a thankless job. Nobody praised you if you played perfectly, but everyone shits on you if you make one mistake.

Then, my protege at the time, Dark+Angel, proposed an idea.

"Why not let the supporters take on a DPS role on non-boss fights as well?"

I learned that even if it would mess up with their class builds to take damaging spells, sometimes keeping up the morale of the guild was better than min-maxing stats and raid roles.

And so, after Dark+Angel's advice, the healer role became more popular in our guild.

After that it was the tanks who kept bitching, but those guys whine no matter what, anyway.

Case in point, Darkness.

"Sure, go ahead, Aqua."

"Eh? Really?"

She said, not expecting me to agree.

"Yeah, but I trust you to heal and support us anytime we need it."

"You got it!"

Once everyone agreed to their roles, we attacked the Magic Cabbages.

They all turned to us simultaneously once they sensed us, beady eyes watching us alertly.

The green crystals above their eyes glowed as the tornados helping them hover intensified in its spinning motion. The tips of the tornadoes pointed to us and expanded to release a spinning drill of wind. It was a large-scale attack as they all focused their power to try and wipe us out at once. I wouldn't have been able to dodge it, and if I didn't have my ice shield, I would have been torn to shreds.

Darkness was able to tank the damage with her armor, although she suffered some cuts on her face. Aqua quickly healed her, before following Megumin on the follow up attack.

I trailed behind them as the tertiary attacker. Megumin and Aqua already took out a lot of the cabbages, with Megumin blowing them up with her staff and Aqua punching them to smithereens.

There were four more cabbages remaining.

I took this time to make use of my new skill.

"[Quick Draw], [Double Attack]!"

Within half a second of me drawing the blade, the two cabbages in front of me were already sliced in half, as the skill allowed me to release two attacks, whereas an ordinary human would only have time to do one.

The last cabbages were some distance away. They could fire their attacks before I could get within range.

I sheathed Chunchunmaru and created an ice spear.

"[Flash Attack]! [Side Slash]!"

With a high-speed movement, I just barely managed to reach the cabbages with the spear and cut them down in a wide-arcing slash that destroyed the remaining cabbages. The wind they were charging up was released into a harmless gust.

"Don't wreck them up too much! We can cook them up later!"

Megumin said, even though the ones she blew up were scorched black.

Part 4

"Kazuma-san, you gained a level! You also have two Skill Points to use!"

I didn't spend the last skill point from my last level-up yet, primarily because I didn't know what to spend it on, and I wanted to see if the Warrior exclusive skills were worth leveling up.

In the end, I decided to just max out [Signature Weapon], since I had enough to put it to max rank, anyway.

[Signature Weapon] Skill Rank: 5, Passive Skill (MAX)

Assign two of the weapons in your inventory as your 'Signature Weapon'. These weapons gain +15 durability and +4 weapon damage. These weapons won't be destroyed even if they fall below 0 'Durability', but you can't use them again until you fix it.

Aside from that, I could also now switch to the Wizard class after leveling up.

"You have switched to the Wizard class!"

"I don't feel any different."

"...Are we really gonna do this bit again?"

Appuri-chan wasn't playing along this time.

I already got what I came for, and we didn't want to explore the rest of the floor without waiting for the results of Mary's scouting assignment. We could just rely on Mitsurugi's intel again, but like with the diverging paths, there were certain obstacles in the dungeon that even he couldn't inform us about.

And so we used the teleportation circle to the first floor.

"Hehe… Kazuma, cook those cabbages for us!"

Aqua said, since I had the [Cooking] skill. She also didn't want to do any work.

"Sure. Everyone's invited."

Darkness seemed surprised by my invitation.

"...Is it just me, or is Kazuma a lot nicer now?"

I shared a glance with Megumin, who gave me a small smile.

"You must be imagining it, filthy whore."

"Even that lacked the usual vitriol! You said it like you didn't mean it!"

I sighed and rubbed the back of my head awkwardly.

"...I mean, I don't think I ever really meant any of those mean things I said to you before."

"Really?"

"Yeah, I mean, I know for a fact Darkness isn't a whore. I mean, you're a total virgin, right?"

By that definition, she can't be considered a 'whore'.

"That's somehow even more cruel than just outright calling me a whore!"

I wasn't even trying to be mean, though. Am I just naturally an asshole?

I'm sure a lot of people would say, 'Yes, you are'.

We took the train to my place, with Megumin and Aqua consoling the depressed Darkness.

I looked around at all the people on the train. There were teens our age, families with young children, elderly folk, office workers and college students. The demon king army could make their move any day now. I imagined what would happen if the Giant Poison Slime appeared near this train, crushing it and all the people within.

I didn't think I could live with myself if I allowed that to happen.

"...Do you girls think we should really keep the public in the dark about the demon king army?"

My abrupt topic change surprised the others, who all turned to me.

"Well… It'll cause a big panic if they find out, right?"

Megumin said, tilting her head as she pondered the outcome.

"They're gonna panic anyway once they see a big poison slime coming to attack the city."

Beldia and Vanir were one thing, since they were within the range of human size proportions. Their appearances were also grounded enough in reality that one could be convinced that it was cosplay.

But a slime that is the size of a building? There was no explanation around that.

"Certainly… It would be better if at least the authorities are prepared to handle the threat of the invasion. Right now, they have no clue that there's even danger."

Darkness said, starting to see it from my perspective.

I didn't want to tell the government or any authorities involved about the app, because I was frightened about what they'd do to me. I was worried they'd treat me like a test subject once I showed them my powers, or that they would mishandle the situation once they were informed about the other world.

But the alternative of having people die needlessly was worse than those fears. The closer the danger approached, the more I realized that now.

"So, what are you gonna do, Kazuma? Hold a press conference and announce that we're super heroes who fight the demon king army?"

Megumin was excited about that prospect, but I just shook my head.

"...Nothing public like that. We'll have to take a discrete approach."

"Hm… Well, I trust Kazuma. And you were the first hero to defeat a demon king general, after all. They couldn't even do that in the other world."

If Aqua herself approved of my plan, then I pretty much had the goddess's approval. Although her word might not hold much sway in heaven anymore after I took her with me.

"I'm sorry for taking away the only good thing about you, Aqua."

"...What does that mean?"

She stared at me in suspicion when I didn't elaborate.

When we got to my place, the others went to the living room to relax, while I got left with all the work. Well, it was probably better that way, considering I was the one with the [Cooking] skill.

As much as I would have liked to use this skill more, there was no way I was eating most of the monsters I had encountered so far. Anything with intelligence was a no-go for me. Even the Giant Toad meat was pushing it, but at least it was animal-like, and they caused me so much trouble that I didn't even care about harvesting their meat and cooking them.

I made cabbage rolls this time, stuffing the cabbage with ground meat.

You gained +30 exp! Your Stamina improved by +1!

Just like last time, there were some bonuses gained from cooking the monster parts.

"Fufu… Time for your meal!"

Aqua took out the egg and placed her hands over it, casting a blue light over the egg.

"...Hopefully the baby doesn't inherit your intelligence."

"Even if you think I'm dumb, a monster having an intelligence score equal to mine will be potent regardless!"

That was doubtful, since even the Rookie Killers could probably outsmart Aqua. That wasn't really a fair comparison, though, since they also outsmarted me a few times.

Part 5

Although Darkness went home after the meal, I asked Megumin to stay behind.

That was because I wanted to invite her family for dinner, like we discussed.

"I want to do this before the Demon King army starts attacking."

It wouldn't be good if her family was starving or still in need during a crisis scenario. It was better to make contact and build trust between our two families now.

"...Thanks for doing this, Kazuma."

The grateful and gentle look she was giving me made my heart start beating faster.

"Y-Yeah, it's no problem."

My parents didn't have time to cook a proper dinner for everyone since they were busy with work, so the plan was to order takeout. The food was still hot when Megumin's family arrived.

Since Megumin said that her dad was a wannabe military contractor of sorts, I expected a burly, tough-looking man. However, perhaps owing to their poor background, instead I saw a scrawny middle aged man. Although he did have a gruff appearance, he had a very humble air about him now, probably because he was a visitor in our home at the moment.

"Thank you for inviting us…"

He said, bowing as he entered our home.

My mom tactfully took over.

"It's no problem at all! It seems that our children get along, after all!"

Megumin's mother spoke next, giving my mom an elegant smile.

…And let me just say that Megumin wasn't exaggerating about her mother's beauty. She looked like she could have been a famous actress in another life.

"It's nice to meet you. I'm Megumi's mother, Yui."

"...! Mother! I told you to call me Megumin from now on! And you're Yuiyui, dad is Hyoizaburo and this little one is Komekko!"

The aforementioned 'Komekko' was like an exact clone of Megumin if she was younger. She looked up at me with a curious look.

"...Mama, is this nee-chan's sugar daddy who gave her 60,000 Yen last time?"

We all went quiet at that, unable to process what she said.

Yui-san… Or, I guess, Yuiyui-san, just chuckled as if she didn't hear what her youngest daughter just said.

"The food smells delicious. Is that curry I smell?"

My mom blinked, before shakily smiling.

"Oh, um, yeah… Let's head into the dining room."

How else was she supposed to respond to that?

Aqua was already there, along with Kazuto. I understood Kazuto's impatience to eat, since he was a growing pre-teen boy, but what the hell was Aqua's excuse?

"Took you guys long enough!"

"And who's this?"

Yuiyui-san asked, as Aqua was clearly not related to us.

"This is Aqua-chan! She's Kazuma's friend from abroad who needed a place to stay, so we're letting her stay here!"

She was a freeloader, in other words.

Yuiyui-san stared at Aqua, before turning to her husband.

"...Our daughter has some competition, I see…"

"This is gonna be tough…"

They were whispering something suspicious to each other.

Thankfully, we moved on to eating the food before a dangerous topic could be brought up.

"Oh, mama! They gave me a full bowl of rice!"

Komekko said, thoroughly impressed by the moderate amount of rice in her bowl.

"And there's three side dishes and a main dish on top of that?!"

Hyoizaburo-san was equally ecstatic, trying to refrain himself from eating too much.

"Please help yourself and don't hold back!"

My mom said, as Megumin's family was treating this normal dinner like it was a feast.

"And now, here's dessert!"

Komekko blinked and turned to her mom, looking confused.

"Mom, what's a 'dessert'?"

I almost felt like crying when I heard that.

My mom brought out some cheesecake and Megumin's family looked like they were in near-tears, too.

"Is this what heaven tastes like?"

Hyoizaburo-san said, as he held his cheek and chewed slowly, his mannerisms were like that of a highschool girl enjoying some after school treats.

"You sure eat good every night, Kazuma."

Megumin noted, as she enjoyed her cheesecake as well.

Aqua shrugged and said,

"Well, it's not always like this…"

I closed her mouth before she could answer and whispered into her ear.

"Oi… Did you forget that this was supposed to be a ploy to feed Megumin's family? Of course we don't eat like this every night…"

"Why are you getting mad at me? Megumin was the one who asked the question, and she's in on the plan, too."

"How would she know? She doesn't live here, like you do. You have no excuse…"

Yuiyui-san noticed Aqua and I huddling together to talk and sighed.

"Hah… This is really going to be tough, after all… In any case, Megumin, you should still stay the night with Kazuma-san."

Yuiyui-san said something that made all of us look at her.

Megumin was in the middle of chewing on a cheesecake, when she replied.

"...You mean, like a sleepover?"

"Oh, you silly daughter of mine! You should know that nothing's free in this world. For blessing us with this meal, you should treat Kazuma-san well tonight, isn't that right?"

What kinda messed up logic is that?! Should I call child-protective services after all?!

Thankfully, my dad took charge and defused the situation with a chuckle.

"Ah, you shouldn't joke around too much, Yui-san! And to clarify, my wife and I just wanted to befriend your family, since our children are friends. Please come over for dinner as many times as you like, no strings attached!"

"Well! If it's like that, then I can't turn down your offer!"

…That night, I learned that this Yuiyui-san was quite the scary woman.

Meanwhile, her husband was clearly not in charge of the family at all, as Hyoizaburo-san was just meekly chewing on his cheesecake when his wife tried to sell his daughter off.

Part 6

The next day, I took Mitsurugi aside after school, taking him to the station for the weekly smoothie bonus.

You gained +1 'Stamina' from drinking the smoothie!

Then, I told him what I decided with the group yesterday, about informing the government about the demon king army and the app.

"Satou… Is that really such a good idea? There's a reason why none of the app-users have done that."

"Because they wanna keep playing the heroes and don't want the government to interfere with their immature, egotistic power fantasies?"

"That's not the case…Well, there are probably some who are like that…"

He couldn't deny it after what we saw during the soccer nationals tournament.

"I thought about it while looking at the people around me. Can you, in good conscience, risk the safety of the people, just because we're not sure how the government would react? It's not even a given that the demon king army will open a portal around here. What if they attack a place where there's not many app users to defend it?"

Mitsurugi sighed, slowly sipping his strawberry smoothie.

"Fine, you make a good point. How are we gonna contact the government, though? It's not like we can just walk into the diet building."

"Why not?"

"Because we'd surely get arrested?! Why would they believe what we're saying, anyway?!"

"We can just show them our powers."

Besides, Aqua told me that the app-users and the other-worlders were treated as super dimensional beings. Weapons from this world can't hurt us, even if it's a gun or a warhead. We were like Saiyans coming to Earth for the first time, the power levels were just too far apart.

That meant that even if the police started firing on us, the bullets would just bounce off us. That could even be a good way to convince them.

"Fine… And I assume you asked me because you don't want to risk the girls being harmed?"

"Sure, let's go with that."

It was more like I didn't trust them with diplomacy at all, and Mitsurugi was way better at that kinda thing.

That was also why I didn't want to go alone. I didn't have the kind of people skills Mitsurugi had.

"Alright, well… When should we go?"

"Considering the demon king army can attack at any moment, as soon as possible. Ah, but first we should look into getting some suits."

They wouldn't take us seriously if we went in with just school uniforms on or street wear, after all.

"Yeah, that's a good idea."

"And of course, you're paying."

"Why me?!"

"...I'm just a low level adventurer, and you're really gonna make me pay for an expensive suit? What happened to that dragon loot you got?"

"Fine, it's on me… You sure are convincing, Kazuma. Are you sure you really need me to come with you?"

"Of course. You'll be the Nappa to my Vegeta."

"...You know, I actually started reading the Dragonball manga and I'm up to the saiyan arc, so I know you just insulted me there."

Busted.

"Humu. It's a good thing you're heeding my advice, Mitsurugi."

"You sure are patronizing…"

We went into a formal clothing store and had suits fitted for us. I ended up with a dark gray suit and a green tie, while Mitsurugi opted for a navy blue suit with a red tie.

We looked at our appearances in the mirror, before heading out of the store, side-by-side.

I adjusted my tie as I glanced at Mitsurugi beside me.

"Ready to raid the diet building?"

"...You make it sound like we're terrorists… But yeah, I'm ready."

And so, we headed to the National Diet Building in Chiyoda.

#543
Chapter 27: A New Base For This Group!

Part 1

"I can't believe I let you rope me into doing this."

Mitsurugi said, as we stood in front of the National Diet Building.

There were public tours available in the Diet Building, so it wasn't like we'd be swarmed by police just by entering, at least not right away. That only applied to days when there weren't any hearings or representatives present, though. Right now, there was security that went to stop us as soon as we entered.

"Excuse me, can we see your press IDs?"

The guards said, assuming we were members of the press when we entered with our fancy suits.

"Ah, we don't have any IDs or anything."

"Then we'd like to ask you to leave. There will be a televised meeting starting in an hour. For security reasons, the public isn't allowed into the building."

Mitsurugi leaned down and whispered.

"Oi… That means the Prime Minister and stuff is here, right?! This is a terrible idea!"

"This is even better for us. Come on, let's enter before the press starts filming."

It was better if we didn't make the public aware of things related to the app, until the government was aware of it, at least.

I started walking towards the guards and they moved to block me.

"Hey… Didn't you hear us? If you're here to sightsee, just wait later!"

I didn't want to harm these guys who were just doing their jobs, but I also wanted to prove a point.

In order for the government to start believing us, we needed to show our powers.

"[Drain Touch]!"

I touched the guards on their shoulders. They screamed then fell down once all their energy was drained.

"...Now you've done it, Satou."

Mitsurugi said, as more guards came out to handle us.

"Stop what you're doing and…! Argh!"

I dealt with them with [Drain Touch] once more.

By this point, the police came, pointing their tasers at us.

"...What? They're just kids?"

They hesitated, seeing how young we were.

But in order to demonstrate our supernatural abilities, we couldn't have them not seeing us as a threat.

"[Tinder]!"

I fired off a bolt from my finger in front of them, making the welcoming rug catch on fire.

"W-What was that?! Someone, deal with the arsonists!"

A brave officer finally put aside his hesitation and went up to fire his taser at me.

I just held up my arm and let the taser try and shock me, but like Aqua said, it didn't hurt me at all.

"...I really do feel like the Saiyans invading Earth right now. Earthlings, lead me to Kakarot!!"

Mitsurugi sighed as more police officers came to try and tase him as well. One even came up to try and grapple him, but Mitsurugi didn't budge.

"You're enjoying this too much, Satou…"

"S-Something's wrong with these kids! The tasers aren't working on them!"

"Try to subdue them!"

In order to really prove our point, we needed to have them use guns. However, I knew that these upstanding police officers wouldn't shoot a kid for no reason. So, it was our mission to push them to the edge.

When they attempted to tackle me, I knew that they'd actually succeed unlike with Mitsurugi. His 'Strength' stats were probably above 100 at this point.

Even if I was invulnerable, my stats were still within the realms of human potential.

So, I used my tried and true tactic of filling the ground with water and freezing it.

But this time, I tried to delay the spell as much as possible, waiting for all of the police to get within range, before creating the frozen hazard.

"Gahh!"

The police slipped and fell on the ice.

Then, with the remaining police…

I took out Chunchunmaru from the inventory, but I didn't draw it out of its sheath.

"[Quick Attack]! [Double Attack]!"

I dashed in a blur of speed and whacked the police on the back of the head, knocking them out with the sheathed sword.

Mitsurugi also knocked out a police officer, attacking him with a chop on the back of the head. With that, we advanced forward, letting one police officer retreat to get backup.

"...This feels awful."

"Don't worry, they'll get a big insurance payout from this, even though we didn't really injure them."

"Well, that makes me feel a bit better, I guess."

At this point, reinforcements came and they weren't holding back like the last wave.

"Do not move, or we will be forced to fire!"

They gave their warnings as they took out their handguns, ten of them aimed at us.

That did make me pause for a bit, the instinctive fear of having several guns pointed at me.

I took a deep breath and stepped forward.

"F-Fire!"

The first bullet was fired.

I felt a faint, stinging sensation.

Then, I saw smoke coming out of the gun.

They all watched me in shock and sheer terror.

A bent bullet fell near my shoes. I bent over to pick it up, turning it over to examine it.

"W-What kind of monsters are you?!"

The police said, this time not even hesitating to fire bullets at us.

Mitsurugi and I stood there, letting them pelt us with bullets. Once they ran out, I held up my hands in a sign of peace.

"Hey, we're not here to harm anyone. We just want an audience with the PM and the diet members."

"We can't let you do that!"

I turned my head to the sound of a sharp, feminine voice. I saw a beautiful, longhaired police officer wearing red-framed glasses. She held out her badge while glaring at us.

"I am Superintendent Ise Sena! Stand down or we will be forced to take drastic measures!"

I sighed and narrowed my eyes at her.

"Lady, you just saw us tanking a bunch of bullets. What are you gonna do next? Just warning you now, tear gas won't work on us either."

She bit her lip, knowing we were right. She couldn't deny what she saw, no matter how ridiculous it was.

"...State your purpose for raiding the National Diet Building."

"I just told you. We just want an audience. Also, no cameras, so kick the press out."

They probably heard the gunshots by now, but as long as they didn't know about our powers, the public wouldn't totally panic yet. Terrorist attacks were still concerning, but something like interdimensional beings and such were outside of the realm of comprehension.

"...I'm sure you understand that we can't put you in the same room as our nation's lawmakers and the Prime Minister himself."

"Then just set up a laptop and webcam for us to talk remotely with them."

Sena nodded, seeing the logic in that. She commanded one of the other officers and soon enough, they had a laptop ready for us.

After a few minutes, we had a live feed of the most important people in Japan. The Prime Minister himself was sitting in front of the camera, looking stern and dignified. He gave a basic introduction before saying,

"...What is the reason for your assault?"

He thought we were terrorists.

"We only came here to give a demonstration. Did you already receive a report of our powers?"

"Yes, but I'm finding it hard to believe what I'm hearing."

That wasn't too surprising.

I held my hand out to one of the guns pointed at me.

"[Steal]!"

The gun appeared in my hand. Then, in order to further demonstrate, I held the gun against my temple.

There were screams from the video feed when I pulled the trigger, and a gasp of disbelief when they saw that I was still alive.

"That is… Outstanding…"

I nodded and slid the gun back on the floor to the officer I stole it from.

"There are many others like me out there. As for why we were given these powers…"

I explained the app-system to them. Everyone in the audience listened attentively at first, until chaos ensued once they heard about the Demon King army.

"This is not only a matter of national security, but a global one!"

"We must alert the other world leaders!"

"No… We should keep this to ourselves for now!"

Mitsurugi sighed when he saw the chaos.

"Of course it'd be like this…"

When faced with the unknown, people were bound to panic no matter what.

I clapped my hands to get everyone's attention.

"Um… Only softball in PE… Eiii~!"

She swung her bat and managed to make contact, but it wasn't enough for a base hit.

I also only had practice doing this at PE, and I certainly hadn't faced a pitching machine before.

Thankfully, it was only fastballs this time and I managed to make contact.

However, it ended up being a foul ball.

"...Ah… This is pretty tough, isn't it?"

"It's kinda addicting, too… Eiii~! Oh, I hit it really far!"

"That's a pop out to the infield."

"Ah…"

Eventually, we soon got into a rhythm.

"Hmph!"

I grunted as I sent a hit into the outfield that would have earned me a double.

"Eiii~!"

Yunyun managed to get a good hit as well, earning a single.

Once we were getting a good string of hits, I said,

"You wanna start adding breaking balls now?"

I said, as our eyes had become adjusted to the fastballs.

"Sure thing!"

With the varied pitches, it became much harder to get hits. And we had yet to hit a single homerun.

"Hah… That was fun but it gets tiring after a while."

I said, cooling down in the lobby as we finished up.

"Yup… Oh, it seems that my dexterity increased, Kazuma-san!"

Just like I suspected.

Your 'Dexterity' and 'Stamina' have increased by +2!

Hopefully the Demon King army doesn't come soon, because I'd like to spend a couple days at least in the batting cages. I should also introduce this place to the others, so they can raise their dexterity as well.

Especially Darkness.

Before we headed back to the mansion, I said to Yunyun,

"Hm… Why don't we have something to eat? We used up a lot of energy, after all."

"G-Going out to eat with Kazuma-san… Of course I'm happy to do it!"

Her enthusiasm never fades.

We ended up going to a family restaurant, similar to the one we had been to before. When we were about to order, the waitress said,

"Would you like to try out our ice cream challenge after? The goal is to eat a giant bowl of ice cream within thirty minutes! You get your picture hung up on the wall and you get a 10% discount on your next visit!"

It was just like the spicy curry challenge.

Right down to the cheap reward.

Side quest unlocked! Complete the ice cream challenge! Quest Reward: Learn the skill [Cold Resistance]

Here it goes again…

But that skill was too good to pass up, if it was anything like [Heat Resistance].

"...I guess we'll do it."

Yunyun and I were soon staring at the biggest bows of ice cream we had ever seen in our whole lives.

"Kazuma-san… I don't think I can do this."

"Do it for the skill, Yunyun."

I said the words Mitsurugi said to me back then.

And so, we picked up our spoons and tackled the challenge.

"Ah… My head…"
Yunyun held her head as the brain freeze assaulted her.

Did they make this thing extra frozen, so they wouldn't have to give a discount?!

How cheap were they?!

I gave a side glance to the waitress, who avoided making eye-contact with me.

Ah, so she knew how unfair this thing was, huh?

Still, I persevered and shoveled ice cream into my mouth.

You completed the side quest 'Finish the ice cream challenge'!

You learned the skill, [Cold Resistance]!

[Cold Resistance] Skill Rank: 1, Passive Skill

You can endure the cold more than the average person can. When up against magical cold, the success rate of this skill is determined by your 'Willpower' (53).

"I got the skill, Kazuma-san…"

"Good work, Yunyun!"

I placed my hand on her and casted [Heal].

She gave me a grateful look as she blushed from the contact.

When I paid the bill and we left the store, Yunyun turned to me and said,

"U-Um, this was really fun! Hanging out like this… Um, were we hanging out?"

She wanted a clarification on what this really was. How cute.

Knowing that she was developing feelings for me, I didn't want to keep her in suspense.

I knew what it was like, having feelings for someone and not knowing if it will be fulfilled or not.

That kinda one-sided affection is the worst.

"It was really more of a date, wasn't it? I mean, we went clothes shopping, played around and even went to a restaurant."

I knew a lot of girls considered family restaurant dates cheap and lazy, but it still counted, right?

"A d-d-date?! U-Um… thank you very much!"

Still, keeping her in suspense is one thing, but keeping her in the dark about Rin and Aqua, and even Megumin, was even worse.

I had her come with me to a nearby bench and sit down.

"So Yunyun, I know you have a crush on me…"

"Ehhh?! D-Did Megumin tell you?!"

So Megumin knew, huh?

Yet she made no mention of it.

Well, I guess it was obvious enough to anyone who saw. She probably assumed I already knew.

The app also kind of kills the suspense.

"Well, the app told me. What does the app say about our relationship, actually?"

"Um… It only told me that Kazuma-san is mildly wary about me because I come on too strong sometimes… But that you still care for me!"

That seems pretty accurate.

I guess that also explains why I hadn't gotten many invitations from Yunyun lately.

Even though she was so eager to hang out before.

"Well, anyway, um, I know that Yunyun has feelings for me…"

"I-Is this Kazuma-san's way of letting me down gently…?!"

She already thought I was gonna reject her.

"...Just listen for a second. You see, I'm already seeing someone… Well, two girls. And also, I have something going on with Megumin as well… Actually, let me be honest, it's probably gonna keep expanding some more."

"K-Kazuma-san is a polygamist, huh? Well, I guess it's more like polygynism in this regard…"

"I haven't married anyone yet, though… Anyway, you have the right idea. Um, I just wanted to say that I already have that going on… I don't want to lead you on and spring that up on you later."

Yunyun nodded and lowered her chin in thought.

I didn't want to disturb her thought process, so I patiently waited until she spoke up again.

"U-Um, it's true that I do like Kazuma-san… I-I don't know about sharing you with other girls but… I'm inexperienced with romance anyway, so I'd at least like to try it…"

"Are you sure? You don't have to force yourself."

She shook her head and gave me a wan smile.

"...I know firsthand that life is short. Especially in this war against the demon king army… Anything can happen."

"Ah…"

Yunyun had to witness the horrible sight of me dying. Not only that, she had to absorb my body into her inventory.

I suppose in that moment, the frailty of life was instilled in her, more than ever.

"So, with that in mind… I don't want to regret anything! The regret that comes with making a mistake feels better than the regret that comes with inaction…I thoroughly believe that!"

Yunyun may have trouble making friends, but she sure was a brave one.

She never stopped trying, even when she made a bunch of cringy mistakes.

I really admire that about her.

"In that case… Do you want to follow what Megumin is doing? We can take it slow and see where this goes from now on."

Megumin would probably complain about how Yunyun was copying her, but I didn't think she'd mind.

Especially after she promised to be more honest with Yunyun.

"I-I think we can do that! I'm glad we had this talk, Kazuma-san…"

"Yeah, same here."

"Um, can I ask to do something naughty…?'

Didn't she say she wanted to go slow?!

"Can I get a hug from Kazuma-san?!"

…She was way too innocent.

I smiled and leaned in to gently hug her. She hooked her arms around me and we let the hug linger for a while.

Yunyun (Lonely Stalker), Bond Rank: 5

At Rank 5, you and Yunyun have agreed on a tentative romance! Yunyun is still discovering a lot about herself and her relationships with people, and she gets overly excited. You will have to reign her in, or she might go too far in trying to prove herself to you. She's a good girl at the end of the day!

Bond Reward: You learn the Intermediate Magic, [Flash]!

[Flash] Skill Rank: 1, Active Skill (15 mp cost)

Blind the opponent with a flash of light. Success depends on your Magic Power (72) against the opponent's Willpower.
