#584
Chapter 28: Training These Newbie Soldiers!

Part 1

Yunyun went ahead to catch up with Mitsurugi for their usual training session. I went to the dungeon as well, but rather than meet up with the others…

I went to the train station to meet with the JSDF soldiers.

"...I believe I asked them not to dress too conspicuously."

I said, looking at the men and women before me dressed in Hawaiian shirts and khaki shorts.

Sena, who was tasked to organize the soldiers I was supposed to train, rubbed her temples as she sighed.

"I'm sorry, but they came here looking like this."

Other people were already steering away from them, thinking they were undercover cops or a group of weirdos.

I examined the soldiers. There were only about six of them, which was surprising. Aqua did thoroughly sniff through a bunch of soldiers, but there was only a handful of those who had potential. There were 5 men and 1 woman, all of them standing perfectly in a row. All the men had shaved heads, and the woman had hers cut in a bob.

"...Let's just head into the dungeon before we attract more attention."

I said, as people steered a wide path around this suspicious gathering.

Sena had to stay behind, as she couldn't enter the dungeon. Then, leading the soldiers, I stepped inside the dungeon entrance.

The soldiers gasped in shock once we transitioned from the real world to the dungeon.

"...The reports were real…"

One of them muttered. I suppose that even if they received a classified report about the dungeon and the demon king army, some of them would be skeptical until they saw it with their own eyes.

"I thought that this was some kind of test to see how well we can follow orders, no matter how ridiculous they were."

I raised my hand and they all stood to attention, saluting me. Their efficient movements caught me off guard.

''...Alright, I'm going to be your instructor, Satou Kazuma. I realize that it's weird to have an underaged teen as your instructor, but these are crazy circumstances we're faced with. I ask you all to obey my instructions, because the wrong move can mean life or death in this dungeon."

"Sir, yes, sir!"

"Alright, then first of all, here's your gear."

I took out my phone and using the Storage Box, I brought out their uniform and arms, as well as their tactical belts filled with the Hyoizaburo-san style ghoul grenades and Howa Type 20 ARs loaded with the composite ammunition I designed.

"Our unit has two objectives. First is to raise your levels and second, to field test these prototypes. Once you're ready, please follow me."

"Sir, yes, sir!"

I led them inside the first floor. I could tell from their body language that they were quite nervous. Their eyes glanced back and forth, watching for any threats. When I sensed the first pack of monsters, I held up my hand, having them stop in place.

There was a group of five goblins equipped with stone spears. I memorized some standard military hand signals from a handbook I was given earlier. I gestured for a soldier to throw a grenade, and for the others to finish off the goblins once they were paralyzed.

Unlike the usual party I explored the dungeon with, these soldiers followed all my instructions perfectly.

"Gaaa?!"

The goblins were paralyzed as ghoul claw shrapnel dug into their skin.

And then, they were decimated by the spray of bullets that tore into them.

"Good work, team. Now, check your phones and see if you have the app now."

"...We see it, sir!"

They each showed me the Adventurer Apps that were now installed on their phones.

"Alright, let's hunt a few more monsters, then you should be able to choose a class. Tell me when you're ready."

Once they reloaded and did a quick equipment check, we moved forward until we saw a group of skeletons, which were swiftly taken care of by gunfire.

By the way, they didn't gain any gun-related skills, so I suppose there wasn't a Gunslinger class or any skills associated with guns.

When they leveled up, they showed me the classes they had available to them.

All of them qualified for Warrior, Rogue, Archer and the Knight class, as well as the Adventurer class that everyone unlocks.

"Alright, all of you, choose the Adventurer class."

This was the idea that I came up with.

I bemoaned having to choose the 'weakest' class at the start, but in terms of skill diversity and acquisition, Adventurer was the right class to choose for beginners.

Besides, they could always branch out into more specialized classes later on without missing much.

I could also teach them easier if they all fought like me.

"Ditch the guns and grenades for now and equip yourself with the loot you got from the goblins and skeletons."

They obeyed my instructions and put their guns away into their inventory. It was quite a sight, seeing JSDF soldiers in leather armor, using spears, bows and shortswords rather than guns.

"Fight the next group with the weapons you have now. Then, once you acquire the associated skills, switch weapons with the next person and unlock even more skills."
I already have a cheat code on what to do to unlock certain skills, so they wouldn't have to go through the trial and error process I went through.

Aside from learning weapon skills, I also had them track enemies and become aware of their presence, letting them gain [Enemy Detection], [Farsight] and [Tracking].

I also had them run away from a group of slimes just for the sake of getting [Escape].

Even if they were trained soldiers, this was their first time in the dungeon and they were already pretty stressed out about it. They were exhausted before we even reached the Giant Toad area.

They weren't ready for that yet, anyway.

"Alright, let's call it a day. Good work. When the demon king army comes to invade, you will still primarily use your guns, but you should use all your other skills in tandem with it, especially [Farsight] and [Escape]."

"Yes, sir!"

"Alright, you're all dismissed!"

They saluted me once more, before putting their gear away into their inventories.

When we got out of the dungeon, Sena came up to me, as she was patiently waiting outside.

"How did it go, Kazuma-san?"

"...They're already better than my party."

"...! They leveled up that fast!"

No, they were much weaker.

But they followed my orders so precisely that it almost made me cry tears of joy.

While also dreading having to party with the likes of Aqua again.

You established a new bond!

Satou Kazuma Squad (JSDF Forces), Bond Rank: 1
At Rank 1, this squad will already obey all your orders and your command. However, this doesn't mean that you have earned their loyalty and respect yet. They are merely following your orders out of professional obligation.

…Well, I suppose there's still work to do to earn their respect.

Part 2

The others were already tired from their training, but I haven't trained by myself yet, since I was busy with the soldiers.

And so, I decided to do some solo grinding, since it had been a while.

I went back to the dungeon after splitting off from Sena, and used the teleporter to go to the fourth floor.

On the way there, I stopped to talk to Mary.

"Ah, Kazuma-san… I finished scanning the fourth floor."

"Good job."

"Do I get a reward?"

Considering that I needed to establish a bond with her somehow, I didn't dismiss her request right away.

"What kinda reward do you want?"

"Humu. Of course, I'd want some human nutrients."

I gave her a wary look.

"...I'm not gonna let you sap my life force away."

"I won't sap everything. Just a little bit."

I suppose it was similar to how the succubus fed themselves.

Just to make sure she didn't try anything, I placed my hand on the wall behind her and used [Drain Touch] to replenish my energy as she absorbed nutrients from me. What was scary was that this method to absorb nutrients was a passive effect that I didn't even feel or notice. That was how her kind lulled humans into a false sense of security.

"Alright, that should be good enough~!"

Mary let out a satisfied sigh as she stretched her arms, looking happy with the nutrients she absorbed. It had been a while since we forced her to abstain, after all.

"Remember what will happen to you if you do that to anyone else…"

Mary smirked when I said that.

"Wow, possessive much? Don't want me to do that to any human but you?"

"Way to twist my words!"

That was her specialty, so I tried not to let her provoke me.

"You know, you kinda remind me of my beloved…"

"Wasn't he a loser NEET who was desperate enough to mate with a plant?"

"Yeah, you really do remind me of him!"

"In what way?!"

I reminded her again to behave, before taking the new map and going on my way.

You established a new bond!

Mary (Tranquility Girl), Bond Rank: 1

At Rank 1, Mary will reluctantly go along with your commands, as her survival depends on it. She also seems to tolerate you because you remind her of her beloved. Giving your nutrients to Mary will deepen your bond.

Quest completed! Establish a bond with Mary the Tranquility Girl! Quest Rewards: Gain the title [Monster Tamer]
[Monster Tamer]

When this title is equipped, you are capable of calming and taming monsters around your level.

I got a title…

I equipped it right away, looking to try it out on some of the monsters in the lower floors.

If Darkness could tame that Giant Toad, I imagined that I could achieve the same results.

I mean, if Darkness of all people could do it…

Once that was taken care of, I set about exploring more of the fourth floor.

It didn't take long until I sensed quite a powerful monster. The fact that it wasn't in a group and still gave me a sense of foreboding meant that its threat level was pretty high.

When I turned the corner, I was surprised to see that it was a Female Orc.

However, unlike the other Female Orcs, it seemed to have hair that was intentionally dyed black. It also seemed to wear something like black eyeliner and even had a nose-piercing. As for its weapon, it had a big cleaver.

I observed this Female Orc before engaging it in combat.

"Heh… Life really is better by myself. Who needs other orcs? They're so noisy and obsessed with men… Ugh. Damn sluts… Always partying all night and capturing men to mate with… There's more to life than that, you know? And what about the emotional connection? I can't just sleep with some random guy the tribe captured and let him impregnate me, while also sharing him with everyone else. If I was to mate with a man, I'd want it to be a special relationship, you know? Yeah, a relationship like that is ideal."

…It seems like this particular Female Orc is having some kind of identity crisis.

I tried to sneak up on the Female Orc, but she was high-leveled enough that she sensed my presence, even with [Lurk].

"...! Sniff, sniff… Oh? That's a man, I smell, isn't it? Hey, you can come out! We don't have to fight. I'm not like the other orcs! I'm not just looking to hook up! I want to connect on an emotional level!"

That might have been convincing if she wasn't drooling and blushing while saying that.

I decided to try out the [Delay Spell] skill.

I drew my shortbow and created an ice arrow, and while I was notching it, I used [Delay Spell]. Even as I was firing the arrow, three magical orbs made out of ice, water and fire floated above my head, orbiting it.

"Owww! W-Why'd you hurt me?! I just wanted to talk! Here I was being nice to you, and you're gonna treat me like that?! Fine, I guess I'll force myself on you after all!"

The orc's real intentions came out.

Even with the ice arrow piercing her arm that she used to protect herself, she charged at me with tremendous speed. She really was quite a high level monster…

I wouldn't have been able to react in time if I didn't delay those spells.

The orb of ice and water reacted with a mere mental command, forming a slippery trap on the ground.

"Eeek!"

The orc didn't expect it and slipped down.

Then, I shot the orb of fire, aiming it at her face. She predictably moved her cleaver to block it.

I used the opportunity to attack her exposed torso, driving the blade of Chunchumaru clean through her stomach. She twitched for a while, before she eventually lost her life.

You unlocked a new skill!

[Control Spell] Skill Rank: 1, Active Skill (5 mp)

You can control the direction and speed of the spell. Advanced Magic is the most difficult to control, while Elementary Magic is very easy to control.

I suppose I got this while intentionally aiming the [Tinder] at her face.

I took her equipment into the storage box. I didn't really need the money from it anymore, so I intended to donate it to the soldiers later.

Part 3

"Appuri-chan, what other exclusive skills are available for the wizard class?"

I asked, as I replenished my mana with [Drain Touch], taking the opportunity to take a break as well.

"There's [High-speed Incantation], although that skill only applies to intermediate and advanced magic."

Since elementary magic didn't require a specific chant, there was no way to unlock that skill.

[Flash] was also a type of spell that didn't require much chanting to cast it. I'd have to wait until I unlocked spells that required chanting.

"Aside from that, there's also [Charge Spell], [Staff] and [Mage Armor]."

"[Charge Spell] is pretty self-explanatory, but what about the last two?"

"[Staff] gives one weapon proficiency using staffs in combat. This is the skill Megumin-san has. [Mage Armor] gives one damage reduction that scales with their magic power, although this is capped at +5. The user also can't wear any armor aside from robes and magical clothing."

I didn't really have a use for [Staff] and [Mage Armor], so I opted to just try and learn [Charge Spell] instead.

The female orc from last time was incredibly powerful on her own, but there was only so much one monster could do. The next encounter was a group of monsters that gave off an aura of collective strength.

They were a group of lizardmen equipped in leather armor. They also carried a variety of short bows and scimitars. There were eight of them in total, a rather large group.

Unlike the female orc, they didn't sense me when I used [Lurk], so I was able to take my time preparing. I used [Delay Spell] to make water and ice orbs float around my head.

Then, I decided to debut the [Flash] spell.

I focused on trying to charge up as much mana into the spell as I could before releasing it.

Of course, I made sure to do the iconic Solar Flare pose.

"[Flash]!!!"

"Kraaa!"

The lizardmen were blinded by the flash of light that filled the tunnel.

I didn't waste any time and created an ice arrow.

"[Snipe]! [Snipe]!"

I managed to take out two of them before the other 6 regained their senses.

I didn't give them any time to attack.

The delayed [Create Water] and [Freeze] transformed from floating orbs to two more ice arrows. I was able to instantly fire and take out two more, leaving only four left.

I used [Bind] to deter the lizardman charging at me. He fell on the ground. Then, I dealt with the archers by using [Wind Breath] to blow their arrows away.

There was one more lizardman with a scimitar who used tricky movements, dashing side-to-side to avoid my attacks as he advanced forward.

"[Tinder]! [Control Spell]!"

I shot a bolt of fire, which I controlled to curve sharply.

The lizardman didn't expect the change in direction and couldn't dodge in time.

"Argh!"

Along with its burnt shoulder, it was also too distracted to protect itself.

"[Drain Touch]!"

I absorbed its mana and its life, before finishing it off with Chunchunmaru.

By this time, the archers reloaded another arrow and fired it. I used their dead comrade as a shield.

Then, I used [Delay Spell] to make three spheres of clumped up dirt float above me.

Right when the archers were prepared to fire again, I charged up my mana again.

"[Wind Breath]!"

I released a strong exhale of wind just as I released the delayed [Create Earth].

"Gackkk!"

The archers hacked and coughed as an onslaught of dirt was blown their way.

That bought me enough time to finish them off.

"[Quick Draw], [Power Slash]!"

Their heads rolled off their shoulders.

It was the first time I was able to take out such a large group of powerful enemies that easily.

My new skills were giving me even more options than I had before.

It was a bit tricky having a bunch of different options, though. Especially since I was pretty much just experimenting at this point.

You learned the skill, [Charge Spell]!

[Charge Spell] Skill Rank: 1, Passive Skill

Empower the effects and damage of a spell, depending by time you spend charging the spell, and the amount of mana you spend. For every 5 seconds that passes (maximum 10 seconds), you can increase the potency of the spell by +1. You spend the total mp amount the spell requires for every 5 seconds that passes. If you are interrupted while charging, the spell effect disappears and you lose all the mana you've spent charging up.

Since I pretty much learned every useful skill from the wizard class, aside from [High-speed Incantation] that meant I could switch back to adventurer on the next level up, or change to another class that I unlock in the future.

I didn't have to worry about school or other responsibilities for this week, at least, while we were preparing for the war. The government gave our schools a suitable excuse. I also didn't have to worry about my parents wondering why I was out so late. With that in mind, I decided to explore some more in the dungeon.

Before I could move forward, I saw something like a puddle right before a fork that led to two paths. It was more like a pond when I looked closer, and I saw fish swimming inside. It was like the pond Megumin and I fished in, back on the first floor.

Since food from the dungeon gave benefits and exp, I decided to use my [Fishing] skill.

But first, I needed a fishing rod.

I took the longbows the lizardmen dropped and used [Smithing].

I was somehow able to restructure the bowstrings into a fishing line, and the bow itself into a rod. It was a simple matter to make a hook from the steel in the scimitars.

As for the bait, I carefully took one of the worms scurrying around on the dungeon floor, careful not to take too much of the monster's food.

I created an earthen bench with [Smithing] as well and took a seat. The goal was to clear my mind with a peaceful activity, as well as catch some fish to raise my stats.

Perhaps it was due to my luck, but it didn't take too long until I got a bite.

I managed to catch a sturgeon.

[Sturgeon] Common

A rather common fish found in the dungeon's ponds. When cooked this will give +15 EXP and +1 Stamina.

I stuck a stick through it and used [Tinder] to cook the fish.

I didn't have any seasonings with me, and I kept a mental note to do that last time, in case I wanted a snack in the dungeon.

You gained +15 EXP and +1 stamina!

Part 4

I stayed a bit longer in the dungeon, but I didn't want to risk advancing too far without the others.

The enemies were getting more powerful and plentiful. Even if I beat those lizardmen easily, it was only because they had conventional means to fight. If I fought a powerful monster with some strange magic I couldn't counter, then I'd be dead without anyone to rescue me.

And so, I took the teleportation circle back to the entrance and left the dungeon.

Besides, there was another chore on my list. I headed over to the pawn shop.

The blacksmith was there as usual, looking bored. He glanced at me with barely any interest in his eyes.

"It's you again. What do you want?"

Such poor customer service!

"Did your smithing skill rank up at all?"

"Yeah, I can craft 'Very Rare' items now. Not like you can afford those."

"I got some money now. Show them to me."

He gave me a doubtful stare, but he took out his best wares to display to me anyway.

"If you're still using medium armor, then I have this mithril half-plate set."

"Mithril… Isn't that legendary material?"

"It's a grade below adamantine ore according to the app system. But since it's lighter than adamantite ore, it makes for good light and medium armor."

"Alright, I'll buy it."

He gave me a tired glare.

"You can't afford it. It's 500,000 Yen."

That amount would have made me wet myself before.

I took out a wad of cash and dropped it on the counter.

He silently looked through the cash, making sure to really inspect each bill. Was I really that untrustworthy?

Finally, he said.

"Alright, I'm not gonna ask where you got this. Take the armor and go."

"Hold on, that's not the only thing I'm gonna buy. Show me your longbows."

I had a goblin longbow, but that was just some random loot I got from a goblin.

"Hmm… Well, I got this treant wood longbow. The wood is super flexible but tough at the same time. It costs 50,000 Yen."

He showed me a longbow made out of a polished, dark wood. I felt the smooth surface of it and tried the bowstring.

"Alright, I'll buy it."

"Where are you getting this money from?"

"I promise it's from a legit source."

"That's what they all say… Do you want a new sword, too?"

I was rather attached to Chunchunmaru at this point, considering it something like my partner.

"Nah, but is it possible to upgrade it?"

"Yeah, I can do that. That'll be an extra 100,000 Yen."

"Done."

He seemed happy for once, getting this much money in one night.

Mithril Half-Plate - Medium Armor (Very Rare)

A set that includes a breast plate, pauldrons and chausses. The mithril has a light blue sheen. Reduces incoming damage by +8. Applies -8 penalty to stealth related stats when sneaking.

Sells for: 400,000 Yen

Treantwood Longbow (Very Rare)

A longbow made out of flexible treantwood. Increased damage when fired at long distance (+3)

Ammo: 20/20 (treantwood arrows)

And it was up to me to finish it…!

"Impossible…!"

A wave of blue energy emerged from the blade of Gram as I slashed cleanly across Sylvia's back.

"Gahhh!"

Since I wasn't the owner of Gram, the attack, powerful as it was, wasn't enough to completely finish her off.

"I should kill you once and for all, Satou Kazuma…!"

Sylvia wasn't playing around anymore. A sword emerged out of her chest and she launched it at me like a projectile.

"Kazuma! [Protect]!"

Darkness bumped me aside and used a skill to switch places with me, taking the attack. She screamed in pain as the sword hit her directly, causing a large gash to appear on her armor.

"[Heal]!"

Aqua reacted just in time, healing Darkness.

"Thanks, Aqua! You'll pay for that, foul fiend! [Side Slash]!"

Darkness attacked Sylvia with a wide swing of her sword, but Sylvia dodged it. Perhaps it would have just been better if she stayed still, since the attack had no chance of landing.

While we were in the dungeon, Megumin, Aqua and I noticed something about Darkness's attacks.

Sure, they never land. At all. But most opponents don't expect that. They will instinctively move out of the way of such a powerful-looking attack.

Especially since Darkness hadn't attacked once this whole fight, keeping her terrible accuracy a secret.

That was on purpose, just for this moment.

"You're a proper tank after all, you space creating meathead! [Snipe]!"

"Good job, Darkness! All that time spent watching you miss finally paid off! Hahhh!"

Megumin smashed her staff against the back of Sylvia's skull. It was followed by an explosion that rocked Sylvia forward.

"Your attacks are never gonna hit, but you sure are good at moving that big body of yours, Darkness! [God Blow]!!!"

We saw the whites of Sylvia's eyes as Aqua stepped through just as Sylvia stumbled forward from Megumin's attack, an uppercut of the gods connecting to Sylvia's chin.

I thought about capturing Sylvia, but considering all her troublesome abilities, I didn't want to risk having her escape.

Letting the enemy live only to have them come back again is the worst cliche of them all.

I raised my hand to the sky, then brought it down, palm open to Sylvia.

"[Lightning]!"

A lightning bolt crashed down from the heavens to strike Sylvia down.

"This can't be…!"

Those were her last words as she perished, burn marks all over her body.

An Explosion on this IRL Dungeon!

Part 1

Hm. That's a bit peculiar, isn't it?

I had these thoughts as I observed that my schoolmates were ignoring the door hovering in front of them. One even went through the door as if it were a mere projection.

Just to make sure, I went over to the door and touched it.

…I'm the only one who can see this.

It wouldn't be strange to call this a supernatural event.

"...Is this related to the dungeon somehow?"

I lavishly chuckled to myself while reaching for the door knob.

When I went inside, I saw a purple room with a woman sitting on an ornate chair inside.

She was a woman with red hair and pointed ears. What's more, she had horns sticking out of her head.

Was she a demon?

Either way, I thought that she looked cool.

Then, my eyes went down and I saw her chest.

"..."

What big breasts.

The woman looked at me up and down before speaking in a voice that resonated within the walls of the room.

"Welcome to my realm. I am the dark goddess of sloth and destruction… Wolbach."

I said, my eyes never leaving those cow-like breasts.

I changed the subject.

"Indeed… As soon as you discovered the dungeon, you've awakened a special power."

"[Dark Specter]! [Evil Eye Beam]! [Banishment This World]!"

I started yelling out attack names while posing.

Something like 'download the app now and give all your credit card information!'.

"It's not a scam! Just hurry up and download the app."

"If you meant the app that shows my stats, I already downloaded it before."

"Good. Now, drink this potion."

She handed me a vial with a glowing liquid inside.

"I realize that you're wary about drinking something from a stranger, but…"

"Thanks for the meal."

"You drank it…"

She stared at me as I chugged down the vial without hesitation.

"Even though you were suspicious about the app, you drank it right away?"

"I have a good constitution, so I can survive drinking suspicious liquids, but there's no way I'm gonna risk my phone getting some virus."

"Your priorities are messed up! Anyway… I had you drink a potion that gives experience points. It's a rare item and I only have one of them, so be grateful."

"Thank you very much, Wolbach-sama."

"You should have enough experience points to level up now. You should also be able to unlock a class."

"Ah… I already unlocked a class before…"

"Wait, so I just gave you a rare item for no reason?"

"Thank you very much."

Her eyebrow twitched. Was she getting annoyed at me?

"Here. This is a list of abilities and spells that I can transfer to you. Just keep in mind that it's limited to my own abilities. You can only choose one."

[Explosion] Skill Rank: 1, Active skill (90 mp)

Unleash a powerful explosion. At rank 1, has a 20 ft. radius of attack and deals 50 fire damage plus your magic power modifier (+8). The attack can't miss as long as enemies are within the area of effect, however, magical defense still applies.

This is probably better than sex.

You established a bond with Wolbach!

Wolbach (Goddess of Destruction and Sloth), Rank: 1

At rank 1, Wolbach sees you as an underling with high potential… but questionable common sense. Still, she thinks you might be useful for her nefarious mission. Keep doing her bidding to deepen your bond with her.

That gave me a good idea.

Yunyun managed to put the lenses on… I mean, undergo a full transformation. She looked up when I invited Arue.

"D-Does that mean we're gonna hang out with Arina-san after school?! Wahh… It's always been my dream to hangout with friends after school!"

Instead of Arue, two more of our classmates came by with smug smirks on their faces to explain what these rumors were.

I smirked and wagged a finger at her.

"Figures. A commoner like you can't perceive the dungeon. I bet someone with more imagination like Arue can…"

"I also can't see it."

"Oh."

An awkward silence fell on us, as we realized that the others couldn't see the dungeon.

I turned to Yunyun.

"Oi, can you transfer your abilities to Arue?"

You have leveled up! You gained 8 skill points!

Chapter 31: The Betrayal of this Bro code!

Last time, I taught Darkness about getting enemies to use their stamina and ability cooldowns on her, so the DPS members of the group could come in and safely deal their damage.

"So… I guess you want me to tire out the monsters first before I attack?"

I nodded.

"Pretty much. Once they run out of stamina, their mobility will be severely limited and you'll have a higher chance of hitting them."

More than anything, I just wanted to give Darkness some confidence. Once she got used to the feeling of her attacks landing, she'd see massive improvements.

"And what will you do, Kazuma?"

"I gotta talk to Mary."

I separated from Darkness and used the teleporter to go to the fourth floor. After a short walk, I found Mary.

"If it isn't my least despised human. Aside from my beloved, of course!"

Was that her idea of a compliment?

"Speaking of your beloved, Mary, I got some news about him."

Sena gave me some information after I told her about Mary's 'beloved'.

He claimed that he got a girlfriend, but when the police found that woman, they discovered that she was just a hostess.

She told him that this guy was a frequent customer, but that she wasn't involved in any relationships with him. Once the police questioned her more, she confessed that she slept with him a couple times, since he was one of her top spenders.

Hostesses and hosts weren't technically allowed to sell their bodies, but it was a legal gray area if they slept with clients when they weren't working. I guess he thought that they were together, since they went on a date when she was off the clock and slept with him. He didn't realize that this was a pretty common practice for people of that profession, sleeping with their top customers to keep them loyal.

"...So I killed him because he made a misunderstanding?"

She said, once I told her about what happened.

"Well… I guess that's what happened. I mean, he still broke up with you, but…"

I didn't know if I should have shared this with her at all, but I had a goal in mind.

She seemed intent on keeping his corpse, but I wanted to give the guy a proper burial. According to Sena, he had parents who didn't know where he disappeared to. I wanted to give them some peace and allow them to hold a funeral.

"So, knowing that, do you wanna give up the corpse now?"

I said, to which she looked at me distrustfully.

"...Why? I get that my beloved is handsome, but what do you wanna do with his corpse?!"

What was she implying about me?

I guess she wasn't willing to part with that skeleton yet.

"Fine, you can keep it for now."

"Still… I appreciate you for telling me that."

She seemed genuinely grateful, so I didn't pursue the matter of the corpse for now.

Mary (Tranquility Girl), Bond Rank: 2

At Rank 2, Mary will reluctantly go along with your commands, as her survival depends on it. She also seems to tolerate you because you remind her of her beloved, and gave her some information about her beloved's so-called girlfriend. She won't give up her beloved's corpse to you, even if you command her. Giving your nutrients to Mary will deepen your bond.

Bond Reward: You learn the skill [Gardening]!

[Gardening] Skill Rank: 1, Passive Skill

When you plant produce and harvest it, consuming the produce will give you certain benefits depending on your Intuition (72). Produce will also grow 1.5x faster than usual.

After talking to Mary, I decided to do some grinding of my own on the fourth floor. I still had the rest of the archer skill list to unlock.

"Appuri-chan, what are the other archer skills I haven't unlocked yet?"

"Hmm… There's [Create Trap], [Trick Shot] and [Orb Walk]."

"...Orb walk, as in kiting?"

That was interesting, to say the least.

"Something like that!"

"Oi… Can't you be a bit more specific?"

"It's not fair because the other app-users don't get to have me helping them!"

"Who cares about those incompetent background characters?! You saw what they were like in the previous battle! They all have OP weapons, but no brain cells! They're actual NPCs!"

"...I guess you make a fair point."

She had no choice but to agree.

"Alright, for [Create Trap], you just have to make a simple trap, nothing fancy, just tie a trip rope and bait some monsters to trip on it."

"Easy enough…"

I took the rope I used for [Bind] and attached it to the wall with some ice shards I made.

Then, I used [Enemy Detection] to look for some monsters to bait.

Soon, I found some lizardmen.

"Oi… You scaled freaks, want a piece of this?"

I said, giving them the middle finger.

They looked like they were about to attack me, but when they saw my middle finger, they gave me a solemn nod, lowered their weapons and walked away.

"...Hah?"

I said, in utter confusion.

"Hmm… It seems like your Monster Tamer title activated. Also, the middle finger apparently is a peace gesture in some lizardmen tribes."

"What the hell is that?!"

I didn't expect the Monster Tamer title to backfire on me.

Also, I suppose I shouldn't be surprised that there were culture differences, even with monsters.

"It seems that the middle finger represents solidarity between tribes."

"...That's cool lore and all, but I just want my freaking skill."

"Kazuma-san, are you the type to skip cutscenes and such in games, just so you can head straight to the action?"

"This isn't a game now is it?! Besides, I don't have time to be stuck in a dungeon all day! I got other things to do!"

"What, like flirt with girls?"

"...Do you really think I'm some unrepentant playboy?"

"Do I really need to answer that? You were fine before when you were sleeping with girls you were close with, but now you even slept with some skank I don't even know!"

"Well, I am close with her, you just haven't met her before."

I probably knew Kuroko longer than the other girls, but all that history was lost on Appuri-chan.

"I still have lots of other things to do. I need to pay Dust his bonus for fighting in the war. I also need to start looking for the other generals that have already snuck in here."

I didn't forget that there were already other generals here, aside from Wiz and Vanir. They would never tell me about them, though.

Aside from that, there was also the matter of defeating the fourth floor boss.

This time, I switched out my monster tamer title temporarily to the general slayer one, just so I wouldn't make a mistake of pacifying those lizardmen.

Then, I went to the same group of lizardmen and shot one of them in the head with an ice arrow.

This time, they didn't bother with the peaceful approach and all came after me.

I ran to the rope, which I hid with a misty cloud I created using [Create Water] and [Tinder]. They followed me inside and tripped from the rope trap.

"[Rapid Shot]!"

While running away, I shot multiple arrows into the lizardmen that emerged from the mist after they avoided the trap.

As for the trick shot, I didn't really know how to do it at all.

I wasn't an archery expert, by any means.

I got the idea to close my eyes.

"[Snipe]!"

Since snipe guarantees my shot will hit, I closed my eyes while releasing the arrow.

That qualified as a trick shot, right?

After I defeated all the lizardmen…

You learned three archery skills!

[Create Trap] Skill Rank: 1, Passive Skill

You can now make traps of 'Basic' make! The enemy's intuition determines the success rate of them discovering your trap.
[Orb Walk] Skill Rank: 1, Passive Skill

You can now make evasive moments while shooting arrows! Increase your speed when retreating away from an enemy while shooting an arrow by 1.5x. You will no longer suffer an accuracy penalty while shooting with a shortbow while moving.

[Trick Shot] Skill Rank: 1, Active Skill (5 mp)

You are now proficient in archery trick shots! You can curve an arrow, making it change direction in midair, although the arrow will take a 40% decrease in accuracy when doing so.

Once I unlocked all the archer exclusive skills, I decided to switch back to the 'Adventurer' class.

It has been a while since I started dipping into all these other classes. Somehow, it felt good to have this familiar class back, even if I hated it at the beginning.

There was also the temptation of switching to a class like 'Merchant', but I also wanted to see what other skills I could unlock with adventurer that I haven't yet.

There was also the chance I could create my own skills again, like I did with [Magic Archery] and [Combo].

Besides, it wasn't like I needed more money now, so switching to Merchant could wait.

There was also the matter of my 10 unspent skill points.

I looked at the archer skills I unlocked, but there wasn't really anything that I needed to immediately upgrade. Most of them functioned well enough at the base level.

For example, the accuracy decrease in [Trick Shot] didn't really affect me since I had [Snipe].

So, I just looked at the other skills I learned.

"...I guess [Intermediate Magic] will be one of them."

It was the same logic I used when I maxed out [Elementary Magic]. Magic was way too useful.

A lot of my other skills also ended up making use of magic, anyway, so this was the most efficient upgrade.

What improved was that the damage of all the spells increased from 15 + magic power modifier to 20 + mods. That gave me a total of 27 damage with each spell.

Aside from that, the mana cost went down from 15 to 10, and the ranges and AoE of the spells increased. Freeze Gust's slowed and frozen durations also increased.

Overall, it was a big power spike for me, probably the biggest I've had when it comes to upgrading a skill.

Mages always grow exponentially, after all.

As for the remaining 5 skill points, I put 3 of them into [Medium Armor], since Darkness's bond reward already put it at rank 2. Doing so gave me an additional +4 to my armor score, giving me +16 physical reduction in total.

At this point, I could just let enemies hit me in the lower floors without even suffering a single hit point of damage.

For my last 2 skill points, I decided to upgrade [Ice Magic Increase] to rank 4, since it was already at rank 2 thanks to Wiz's bond reward.

The rank up gave me +2 damage to ice magic, and increased crowd control duration of ice spells like [Freeze Gust] by an extra 2 seconds.

With that, I got all that I came for in the dungeon and teleported back to the first floor to check up on Darkness.

I found her walking to the entrance as well. She had a conflicted look on her face.

"So? How'd it go?"

I asked, to which she sighed.

"...I'd say my success rate was about 20%."

"Oh! That's much higher than I thought it'd be!"

"How bad is your impression of me!"

I wasn't really meaning to insult her, but I guess it did seem condescending.
I blushed and gave her a kiss, which made her blush as well.

"Uh… Good job, Darkness."

"T-Thanks…"

Damn it! This whole opening yourself up to others is never gonna get easier, is it?!

Part 5

Darkness and I were on our way home from the dungeon, when we saw Mitsurugi talking to someone.

This person he was talking to was a blonde foreigner wearing a nun habit.

"...So you're a follower of Aqua-sama!"

He said, smiling delightfully at this foreigner.

"Yes, yes! To think that the all-powerful, majestic, ultra lovely Aqua-sama also has followers in this world! Or rather, I should say, as expected of Aqua-sama!"

With the way this nun was talking… She was from the other world, right?

Certainly, you wouldn't see a blonde nun walking around in Tokyo, at least, it wasn't a common sight.

She was also talking about Aqua.

The nun went on to say,

"By the way, Kyouya-kun, are you also like me?"

"Like you…? Ah, well, I guess I'm a fan of Aqua-sama as well."

That was an understatement.

"I knew it… And you also like the same thing as me, huh?"

"Well… I guess I do… But it's kind of impossible to pursue it."

I felt kinda bad, since he was most certainly talking about his lingering feelings for Aqua, which he had to give up on.

"I knew it! So, you're a lolicon as well, huh?"

"...Eh?"

"I know how society looks down on us, and how it feels impossible to express your love for lolis these days, but stay strong, my comrade!"

"What are you saying?!"

Just as Mitsurugi was about to cover this woman's mouth, he saw us watching him.

"...We'll be on our way now, Mitsurugi-san."

Darkness said, ducking her head and walking past him.

I followed after her.

"...Take your time, Mitsurugi."

"Hold on! I don't know what this woman is going on about!"

"Oi… That's rather cold, isn't it? I told you my name is Cecily."

The blonde nun who was a self-declared lolicon said, pouting at Mitsurugi.

Cecily followed Mitsurugi's gaze and turned to me. I felt a shiver down my spine and kept walking away from them.

But she was unexpectedly fast and caught up to me, gripping my shoulder.

"Oh! I sense a fellow lolicon in you as well!"

What metric was she going with to decide that?

Rather, I was called a lolicon and such before, with that horrible name 'Lolima', but how in the world was Mitsurugi a lolicon?

Or maybe she was the kind of crazy woman who just imposes her twisted views on others.

"...I don't know what you're talking about, miss. Oi, Darkness, where are you going?"

I noticed that Darkness was walking away from me without looking back.

This traitor ditched me!

I turned to Cecily, trying to escape her grasp.

"Um… I'm not a lolicon or whatever, so please let me go."

"Nonsense! There's no need to hide it! Declare your love for lolis with all your might! Excuse me, everybody! These two men are here to meet a 13 year old girl!"

This crazy bitch!

Mitsurugi and I immediately grabbed her and pulled her to the next alleyway we could find.

"Oi, Mitsurugi! Who the hell is this woman?!"

"I don't know! She said she was from the other world and a follower of Aqua-sama, so I thought she was a sane, rational person!"

"...The fact that she introduced herself like that should have already clued you in!"

I had never met an Aqua follower before, but I couldn't imagine that there was anyone sane among the followers of Aqua, of all people.

"Oh, my… Two handsome young men took me to a dark alleyway… Are we gonna have some fun now?"

"...I thought you said you're a lolicon?"

"Just because you like sweets, it doesn't mean you can eat parfaits all day, right? Sometimes… You need some meat…"

She said, licking her lips as she looked at Mitsurugi in particular.

"...Mitsurugi. You found her. You deal with her."

"Now, just hold on a minute!"

Mitsurugi pulled me back before I could escape.

"Hold on, as the one who won over Aqua-sama's heart, you should be the one to deal with her follower, right?"

"...What kind of stupid logic is that? It's like saying that if you date an idol, you have to deal with their stupid fans."

"Well, you do, that comes with the territory!"

I just realized that I used a terrible analogy.

"...Fine. Cecily-san, you said you came from the other world… How did you get here? Through a portal?"

She smiled and placed a hand on her waist.

"Heh… I was harassing an Eris-cult member as usual. Just as I was pelting them with tokoroten slime, this portal appeared in front of me and I accidentally ran inside."

Dust and the succubi all ended up in this world after the demon king army started messing around with portals. The fact that the demon king army managed to open a bunch of portals at once probably caused more random tears within the boundary of the other world.

As for what to do with Cecily…

"It'll be a disaster if we bring her home, so for now I'll just book a hotel for her to stay in."

I said, making Mitsurugi sigh in relief that I actually had a plan.

"Oh? Going to a hotel already? You sure move fast! But I'm more interested in Kyouya-kun, though~! Is he gonna join us?"

Yeah, this girl was way too crazy.
