Chapter 40: Blessing Humanity With Its Ultimate Guardian!

Part 1

Once Regina disappeared, I was about to prepare myself for bed, but then I heard a knock.

"Hm? Come in."

Megumin walked in, wearing her pajamas.

"Hey… Can we talk for a bit? It won't be long."

"...Can't it wait? I'm about to pass out."

"U-Unbelievable! Can't you see that I really wanna talk to you?!"

I sighed and got up, patting the bed. She muttered to herself before accepting the invitation and sitting down next to me.

"So? What's up?"

"...I just checked my app. I gained a bunch of EXP… I think my explosion actually managed to kill Arnes and the others."

I nodded, knowing that already after what Regina said to me.

"Yeah… You were pretty close with them at one point, right?"

"...Well, it was all a lie."

She brought her knees up, resting her chin on them.

I lifted my hand, hesitating a bit, before I eventually wrapped my arm around her shoulder.

"I didn't think it was all a lie."

"Now you're the one lying."

Was she starting to get trust issues?

"...I'm telling the truth. I spent a whole week with them, right? Arnes and Wolbach, it seemed like they regretted lying to you. And they wanted you to join their side."

"As if I'd join them."

"Well, I just wanted you to know that there was some truth mixed in with the lies. They really did like you. It was just unfortunate that our two sides are at war."

She buried her face against her knees.

"That just makes things worse. I killed Arnes."

My breath got caught in my throat.

She felt anger from being betrayed.

And now regret from killing her friend.

There was never a good outcome to all of this.

"...You did what you had to do."

"No, I could have just let them go. I even risked my life just to get back at them."

"Either way, it's not your fault. And besides, maybe she's like Vanir. She's like, a demon or something, right? Maybe she reincarnates."

Megumin nodded softly at that.

"I heard from her once that she was summoned by Wolbach-sama. So she might be able to come back again."

"Well, there you go."

"But even if she comes back, she'll just try to harm everyone. She might try to capture you again, or worse."
I waited for her to say more, but she didn't expand on that, and I didn't want to break the silence.

After a few moments, she said,

"Hey, Kazuma. Can you just… help me forget?"

She looked up at me. She still had her contacts on, her eyes glowing a beautiful crimson as they shimmered with apprehension.

"...How do you want me to do that?"

"Do whatever you want with my body. Like you do with Aqua."

"...I thought we agreed that it's better not to rush."

"I need you right now."

When a beautiful girl says that, it's hard to refuse.

But I still managed to keep my composure, somehow.

All it took was seeing her pained face.

"...I don't want to take advantage of you. Ask me again when your thoughts are in order."

"You must think I'm some kind of kid, huh…?"

I sighed and rubbed the back of my head.

"It's not like that. I just don't want your first time to happen because of something sad like this. I want it to be a happy moment."
"...But how can I get over how I'm feeling right now? I want to forget everything."

I wasn't going to say something cliche like 'tragedy happens for a reason' or 'pain helps us grow'.

It always pissed me off, whether it's in real life or fiction, when people say the most generic things to those seeking comfort.

More than the lack of originality, I felt like what a grieving person really needs to hear is logic. They want an answer, something of substance they can latch onto.

"You know, Wolbach told me that there are other worlds out there, probably an infinite amount of worlds."

"...I'm having a depressive moment here, and you're just gonna confirm the multiple worlds theory to me? Are you trying to break my mind or what?!"

She gripped my collar and shook me around.

I couldn't really fault her, since I had the same reaction when Vanir first told me about this.

"Oi, just listen!"

"Fine, go ahead."

She managed to calm down and removed her hands from my collar.

"...With the portal technology of the Demon King army, I don't think it's impossible to say that we can someday take that technology for ourselves or reverse-engineer it. Then we can refine it and potentially hop to any world we want."

She rubbed her chin in thought, before eventually nodding.

"Yeah, if the demons can come to our world, I think it's fair to say that we can do that."

"Hm? What were you guys talking about?"

Kazuto was the type who completely changed around girls.

Sena began to drive and the bus was filled with separate conversations about the trip we had.

It was only two days and one night, but it was still a welcome reprieve from everything we had to deal with.

After all, the future was uncertain, so we should treasure the times we can just have fun and relax.

…

…

The next day, I was refreshed from the trip and went to class in a good mood.

To add to my good mood, I had some fun in the morning with Rin in bed, before we took the dungeon door to school.

I really hope that it becomes a daily routine…

When I arrived in class, Konno-san gave me an intense look.

"Hm? What's up, Konno-san? Is there something on my face?"

I pretended to be a dense MC and felt around my face.

"..."

Crap.

I forgot that Konno-san's intuition was very high.

She was almost like Aqua in that regard, a person with unexpectedly high intuition.

Although, since Konno-san's bond rewards actually raises my intuition, I'd say that hers are higher than Aqua's.

"...Say, Satou-san, what did you do this weekend?"

She really was starting to suspect me.

The best option here is to just tell the truth.

"Actually, I had a chance to go to this hotel in Kyoto with my family."

"Ah, I see. That sounds like fun!"

"How about you, Konno-san?"

"Hm… I didn't do much. Just stayed at home."

…What a good liar.

As expected of someone who led a double life.

Although her home was filled with Axel Hearts memorabilia, so maybe I should take that back.

She asked me, reminding me about that tournament.

To be honest, I wasn't planning on staying in the naginata club after the tournament, but there wasn't a reason for me to leave before then.

Soccer club activities were starting up again, though, but that will happen after the tournament.

Both clubs gave me chances to raise my stats, but I had more of an obligation with the soccer club.

Plus, I wanted to actually win nationals next year.

"Alright, class, settle down."

The homeroom sensei came in.

"Sensei, are our exam results out yet?"

"Hah? We only had one weekend to grade those! Do you think us sensei don't have lives of our own?!"

I suppose I still had to wait some more to see if I completed that quest.

However, there were other people present, wearing another school's uniform.

"Hmph… So this is the quality of this year's recruits, huh? Your club is in trouble, isn't it, Terada-san?"

I leaned over to Konno-san and whispered.

"Who are these guys? And who's Terada-san?"

"...Are you telling me you didn't know the president's name until now?"

"Oh. So the president has a name, huh?"

"Of course he does!"

Terada-senpai went over to the visitors wearing other school uniforms and said,

"We're just doing this for fun, so no need to try and intimidate us."

I see. So it was this kind of event.

Before every school tournament arc, the rival club always comes to instigate things.

Normally, what would happen is that the protagonist will then have to face someone in the rival club in a practice match.

Of course, the protagonist will lose at first, but the rival club will see the protagonist's potential. The rival will then lose to the protagonist in the tournament and have a change of heart…

And so on.

"Snap!"

I took a picture.

"..."

Silence spread through the room.

I held up the picture for them to see.

"Oh, look. Delinquents from another school not only trespassed into our school, but they even assaulted one of our club members… Not to mention she's a foreign exchange student. Ah, this could end up being an international incident, you know?"

The rival club members went pale at that.

"...Oi, Kazuma…"

Darkness started to speak, but I interrupted her.

"You punks think you can come here and start cliched encounters like this?! At least be a little original! Get out of here before I report you to the school security!"

"W-We're sorry!"

They hurriedly ran away.

While I was satisfied with my work, the others stared at me in disbelief.

"...What? Those guys would have become annoying later on, so it's better to get rid of them now."

"Kazuma… You're really something else. I like it."

Of course Darkness said something like that.

Chapter 43: Blessing This Dungeon With A Brothel!

Part 1

Your Stamina, Dexterity and Strength has increased by +2!

After I got rid of those nuisances, club activities resumed and I got some decent stat raises as a result.

It was thanks to Mitsurugi that I learned how to push past my limits, so I was getting consistent stat raises, whereas I was hitting a wall earlier on.

Rather than head straight home through the dungeon, I decided to head to the station first.

"Welcome to Sunshine Smoothie! Can I offer you our limited time protein shake?"

I wanted to take advantage of this limited time offer, first.

Maybe I should make a dungeon door in the station?

But energy was still limited in my dungeon, so I couldn't just make doors everywhere.

That said, I knew I had to make doors for app-users to enter eventually, in order to honor the deal with Vanir.

Wiz already showed me that no alliance was permanent, and Vanir was way more disloyal than her.

But if I needed to make a dungeon for Vanir to troll app-users with, I also needed to have actual monsters in my dungeon.

There also needed to be a reason for app-users to want to go to my dungeon instead of just going to the original dungeon all the time.

I thought about these things while sipping my smoothie.

Your Stamina went up by +2!

"Hey, you girls are kinda cute. Wanna hang out with this nee-san?"

A shiver went up my spine as I heard a voice I recognized.

Slowly turning around, I saw the Axis-cult fanatic, Cecily.

I grabbed her away from the middle school girls she was hitting on.

"Oi, what's the matter with you?! You wanna end up in jail?!"

"Hm? Why? I didn't do anything wrong?"

The clueless look she put on almost looked convincing.

"...What are you doing out of your hotel room, anyway?"

The government took over in sheltering the other-world refugee, so I wouldn't have to worry about her expenses. Still, having taxpayer money go to housing a lolicon like her kind of left a bad taste in my mouth.

Not that I'd spend my own money on her.

"Hah? Am I a prisoner, or what? It's not like I have to stay there! They let me out, as long as I wear this weird thing around my ankle!"

She pulled her long skirt, revealing an ankle monitor.

"...Oi, you're gonna get in serious trouble if you keep doing what you're doing."

I said, gesturing for her to hide her ankles again, while nervously looking around to see if anyone saw her.

Also, she was indeed being treated like a criminal.

She sighed and placed her hands behind her head.

"Hah… So, you don't want me to play around? What am I supposed to do for fun?"

"The problem is that what you consider fun is wrong on so many levels…"

"Well, if I can't nip the bud of a young, blossoming flower…"

"Never say that again."

"If I can't sleep with a young…"

"Stop saying stuff like that!"

I hurriedly covered her mouth.

After making sure she'd stop saying these creepy things, I pulled my hands away.

"...Oi, at least hook me up with that stud from before."

"Oh… You mean Mitsurugi?"

I hated having to admit that I knew exactly who she was talking about.

I still didn't really get how she could go from trying to seduce young girls to having a normal taste in men.

…Well, I guess that the unlimited moral freedom Aqua provided to her followers meant that they had a variety of tastes.

"Yes, yes, him! If you hook me up with him, I promise I won't pursue those delicious, young flowering buds anymore!"

"...Stop saying all that flowering buds crap, then we can negotiate."

I said, as if I had any right to determine Mitsurugi's love life.

Still, I couldn't just leave this menace to society running around freely.

I took Cecily to the cafe I used to frequent, not only to take her away from the public, but also to take that Charisma bonus.

This place is trending again, so you get +2 Charisma!

After taking a few sips of our coffee, we began our negotiation.

"...You can say that you want a shot at Mitsurugi, but you won't have a chance with him at your current state."

"Eh, what do you mean? I'm already quite beautiful, aren't I?"

She said, while flipping her long, blonde hair to the side.

"Yes, which is quite a shame…"

"It's rather rude of you to say that."

Wasn't I just telling the truth?

Her good looks were wasted on her.

"Anyway, the point is that your current personality is not something Mitsurugi would go for."

Or any guy, really.

"Hmm… I guess I can't expect the men of this world to accept my values from the other world…"

She was acting as if everyone from the other world behaved like her.

If that was the case, then Iris would be as crazy as her.

"Alright, I suppose I can make some changes, if it will improve my chances with that stud, hehe…"

If she was willing to make changes, then I was willing to support her.

I couldn't exactly call her out for wanting to change her personality just to get with some guy.

After all, I also went through a lot of changes since my NEET days.

So I didn't call her dishonest or flimsy.

Besides, I felt it was somewhat my responsibility to have her behave, since I was the one who took her in.

"Oh, by the way, are you paying for this?"

She said, pointing at the coffee.

"Yeah, it's my treat."

"Nice! Oh, if you're paying for me anyway, can we go on a shopping trip?"

"No."

She really tried to take advantage of that, huh?

You have established a bond with Cecily!

Cecily (Cultist Freak), Bond Rank: 1

Through your efforts, Cecily has been convinced to try changing her ways, in an attempt to woo her target, Mitsurugi Kyouya. Whether this determination to change her behavior is permanent or simply a passing whim remains to be seen. Helping her in her goal will deepen your bond with Cecily.

…I ended up developing a bond with Cecily.

Well, I suppose that if I was helping her out, I might as well gain something from it.

Part 2

When I got back home, I went to my dungeon and turned on the golem farm.

Then, there was another task that I had been delaying.

And that was to unlock the last three exclusive skills of the thief class.

I didn't get a chance to do that yet, after I unlocked the thief class while I was a puppet of Serena.

Using the laptop, I had the dungeon produce a treasure chest.

Although since the dungeon lacked the material to do so, it didn't have any treasure inside.

But for the sake of unlocking these skills, I could use a workaround.

I put some Yen inside the treasure box.

Then after locking it, I immediately opened the treasure box with a pick.

You learned the [Lockpick] skill!

It's really that easy.

[Lockpick] Skill Rank: 1, Passive Skill

You are proficient in picking locks, the success of which is determined by your Dexterity (81).

Then, I commanded a golem to 'hide' the treasure box from me.

Although there weren't really many places to hide it in this small dungeon.

I ended up finding the treasure box under the bed in the break room.

You learned the [Treasure Detection] skill!

[Treasure Detection] Skill Rank: 1, Passive Skill

You will be alerted whenever treasure is within a 15-foot radius around you. The success of the detection is determined by your Intuition (83). You can detect treasures of 'Common' rarity.

…This skill would have been a lot more useful earlier on.

But all of my equipment was too high level to care about common rarity treasures.

I could put some skill points to level it up, but there were already so many other skills I wanted to put skill points into.

Granted, I gained 2 skill points with every level up thanks to Iris's bond rewards increasing my potential, but I still couldn't spend skill points carelessly.

The last skill to learn was [Disarm Trap].

I simply made my own wire trap and cut it.

You learned the [Disarm Trap] skill!

[Disarm Trap] Skill Rank: 1, Passive Skill

You are proficient in disarming traps of a 'common' make. Success of disarming depends on your Dexterity (81).

So now, all of the thief exclusive skills were unlocked.

The next time I level up, if there were no new classes, I would have to switch back to adventurer again.

…Unless I wanted to unlock the other classes like NEET, Pervert and Merchant.

Although Merchant might be good to unlock.

Still, did I really want to dedicate an entire level up class change to the Merchant class, even though I already had so much money…?

"Appuri-chan, what are the Merchant class exclusive skills?"

"The exclusive skills are [Haggling], [Storage Increase], [Rest], [Upgrade] and [Profit Increase]."

[Haggling] allowed one to get a better deal on items when buying or selling. It might be useful against that stingy blacksmith.

[Storage Increase] raises the amount of items one can put in their inventory, which would have been more useful if I didn't already have the storage box. [Profit Increase] simply increases the amount of money one gets from loot or other means of raising money.

The interesting skills were [Upgrade] and [Rest].

[Upgrade] allows one to boost the rarity and power of any item for a limited time.

[Rest] fully restores the user's mana, stamina and hp when they rest out of combat for one hour or more.

While [Rest] was pretty situational, [Upgrade] might be a pretty powerful skill.

I decided to keep that in mind.

"...Alright, I guess I should know what skills the other classes have."

"...Kazuma-san, are you sure you're not just interested in the Pervert class?"

Well, I was a tiny bit curious.

"...The Pervert class gives the [X-Ray] skill, the [Invisibility] skill and the [Seduction] skill. It also gives the [Bedroom Skill], which you already have."

"Wait, don't some of those skills actually seem pretty useful?"

Assuming that [Invisibility] worked the same as Yunyun's [Light of Refraction]... That could be a powerful skill!

Also, the [X-Ray] skill also seemed very useful…

In lots of ways.

"Don't tell me you're actually considering this, Kazuma-san…"

Well, why not?

I didn't care if the class was called 'Pervert'. If it has useful skills, then why not take it?

In fact, I was pretty stupid for not even trying to figure out what skills the class offered. Maybe I wouldn't have taken the Adventurer class at the start and went for Pervert instead.

…It was hard to deny the Adventurer class's versatility, though.

"As for the NEET class, the exclusive skills it has are [Idle Leveling], [Petty Curse], [Leech] and [Miasma]."

I hated to admit it, but the NEET class had some interesting skills, too.

[Idle Leveling] lets one steadily gain EXP as long as they weren't doing anything.

It was the perfect skill for a NEET who doesn't want to go outside.

[Petty Curse] let's one afflict debuffs on the enemy, as long as that enemy is higher levelled than the user.

[Leech] was like [Drain Touch], but it only worked on draining the target's health. It also doesn't require touch and affects targets within a 15-feet radius from the user.

[Miasma] keeps monsters and other people away by producing a bad stench from around the user.

"Hm… If I picked the NEET class, then I probably would have never left my room. I also wouldn't have bothered with the dungeon, since I could have leveled up without even doing anything."

"...What's the point of gaining levels if you're not even going to go outside?"

Even with Appuri-chan's synthetic voice, I could sense her disappointment that I was even considering taking these classes.

The next thing I wanted to do was to work on increasing my Mana Capacity again.

I did some training before in my backyard, but I couldn't really do much out in the open.

Now that I had a dungeon all to myself, I didn't need to worry about being seen or causing collateral damage.

I looked at the golems emerging from the dirt of the dungeon wall.

They were slowly marching over to the pitfall.

"[Fireball]!"

I launched a fireball at the golems before they could reach the pitfall.

I watched as the golems burnt to a crisp and changed back into dirt for the dungeon to reuse.

In this way, I kept destroying the golems with magic.

Then when my mana ran out, I placed my hand on the wall and recharged my supply with [Drain Touch].

Your Mana Capacity and Magic Power has increased by +2!

Furthermore, it seems that all of your creative training methods have been recognized by the system!

Your creativity has been raised by +5!

…It seems the app also recognized my creative genius.

As expected of me.

Part 3

Later on that night, after training in the dungeon, I decided to head over to the Succubus Shop.

It had been a while since I visited, and I wanted to see if there was anything they knew about the Demon King army's movements.

After all, I did get some information from there in the past.

I also wanted to check up on Dust, since I hadn't talked to him since he was mind controlled by Serena.

…That was also when he proceeded to kick my ass.

Not only me, but even Chris.

Taking the both of us on meant that Dust wasn't just some ordinary adventurer from the other world.

There was probably more to him, and I wanted to find out what he was hiding.

While I was at it, I made a dungeon door in the red light district.

So, I might as well set up an easy way to get there.

After stepping out of the dungeon door, I headed over to the succubus shop.

"Ah, Kazuma-san! It's been a while!"

Rorisa smiled as soon as she saw me and flew over with her tiny wings.

How adorable.

That was a shocker.

But when I looked around, I saw that there weren't a lot of guys around.

I did end up seeing Dust, though.

Instead of approaching Dust right away, I was curious about why business was going down.

"Why? This place has always been popular…"

"...Well, there seems to be a decrease of app-users lately…"

"Eh? How can that be?"

"We're not sure… But we heard some of them saying that there's something more interesting than the succubus shop going on in the dungeon…"

What were those guys up to now?

"Ah, by the way, Kazuma-san, would you like a session tonight…?"

She said, giving me quite the cute face while saying that.

"Humu. I always like to support local businesses, so of course."

"Yay~! Thank you!"

She seemed very grateful. I guess business was really that bad, huh?

When I went over to him, he immediately stood up and threw a dream service form he was writing on.

"Whatever! You know what I mean! Why is it so high?!"

"W-Well, we don't have as many customers, so as you can imagine, dear customer…"

"Sir, you say that, but you still have quite a lot on your tab you haven't paid off yet…"

That look on his face… I could practically see money signs in his eyes.

The succubus he was yelling at gave a sigh of relief as she picked up the form Dust threw away.

"So, Kazuma… Wait, are you mad about what happened last time? Listen, I couldn't help it, yeah? That Serena bitch took control over me…"

Not just the yakuza from this world.

Of course he would ask that.

I still paid for him, though.

At Rank 6, Dust has given you some clues about his past. He will not reveal this information, but it seems there is an individual the system recognizes that fits with Dust's data. Dust (Blond Delinquent), Bond Rank: 4 (Decreased)

"Ah, there you are, Kazuma-san! So, what kind of dream would you like to have today?"

Rorisa greeted me in the room with a sweet smile.

"Hm… Before that, did you hear anything about the Demon King army or the other world lately, Rorisa?"

Something about what Dust's other identity might be.

Request: I want to play the role of the rumored Dragon Knight

Roleplay Scenario:

There was once a Dragon Knight from a foreign country. He was an exemplary knight who was blessed with the ability to tame dragons. However, everything changed once he met a willful princess who encouraged him to follow his own desires more.

One day, the Dragon Knight took this princess out of the castle to show her the outside world. When his actions were discovered, he was punished for his insubordination and was exiled from his country.

Since then, there are reports that the Dragon Knight might have moved to the Kingdom of Belzerg…

Character Description:

The Dragon Knight has been rumored to have blond hair and blue eyes, although he might have changed his appearance to avoid being found. It is said that he is skilled with the spear. Rumors also say that the individual has a mole under his eye.

Roleplay script:

The Dragon Knight is found again by the princess. When they reunite, the princess decides to reward him by…

"Ah, Satou-kun, our star midfielder! Are you ready to get back to work?!"

He was as enthusiastic as ever.

We started the practice off with running laps.

Mitsurugi usually led the pace by a considerable amount, but now I wasn't lagging behind him as much as before.

"Ehh?! Satou, you must have been training hard, huh?!"

"As expected of our co-captain!"

Since when did I become co-captain?

"Yosh! Since our leaders are trying their best, let's pick up the pace, too!"

My teammates started running faster.

When we took a break, Mitsurugi tossed a bottle of water at me.

"Good work. Seems you're not holding back this time, huh?"

"I do want to win this time, after all."

"You sure are a sore loser. Well, I'm also on the same boat. Just remember… I don't want you using your skills this time if we're up against regular people."

I nodded at him. That was the plan, anyway.

At first I didn't really care, but now I didn't want to disrespect the hard work of the other players.

It was the same sentiment I had heading into the naginata tournament.

With that said, we went to drills now.

Since I wasn't planning on relying on short cuts anymore, I worked as hard as I possibly could, dribbling through cones and working on my passing and finishing.

However, there was something on my mind.

"Maybe I should work on my defense, too."

I said to Mitsurugi, which made him raise a brow.

"Eh? But you're the attacking midfielder."

"Positions and stuff don't really matter as much in big moments."

In the final game, when I lost that header to my classmate from middle school, I learned that lesson the hard way.

If I really wanted to commit to this and win it all, I needed to learn every facet of the game.

"Hm… I'm not sure how I can help you there. I've been a striker all my life."

Does this guy think he's in Blue Lock?

"What an arrogant person."

"I wasn't trying to show off!"

Mitsurugi led me to the defensive midfielder instead.

"Hm? Are you trying to take my job now?"

He said, when I asked him for help.

"...I just want to learn. No need to get defensive."

"That's my job, though."

My joke went over his head.

Eventually, he agreed and I started my defense training.

"OK, the first thing you need to learn is that aside from marking your man, you also need to play defense as a team. You're gonna have to learn how we move with us, and how we talk to each other. When you're the attacking midfielder, you spend most of your time worrying about what Mitsurugi does, right?"

It was true that most of my efforts went to tracking Mitsurugi's movements, as well as the opposing defense.

"Yeah, I guess."

"On defense, you have way more people you need to communicate with. You're also going to need to know how to 'tether'."

"Hah? What's that? Oi, are you just coming up with stuff to say to look smart?"

"I'm teaching you here! Listen, what I meant was that if you're playing defense, you need to move as if you are tethered to your other teammates. You can't leave gaps of space on the field. If I move, you need to adjust your movements to ensure that you occupy my previous space, while also making sure someone else covers your spot. Do you understand?"

I nodded, appreciating the simple explanation.

And so, we practiced with me playing defense this time.

"Oi, Satou! Don't just blindly follow me! You left your spot open!"

Before I could react, a through pass was sent to Mitsurugi, who instantly capitalized in the gap I left.

…That guy was too fast.

Was this what our opponents had to deal with?

Sucks for them, I guess.

Next, we did some aerial drills.

To be honest, I was a bit nervous about this drill.

We lost the final game because I couldn't contest a header, after all.

Still…

"Ohh! How are you jumping so high, Satou?!"

Because my physical stats went up since last time, my jumping power was pretty high now.

However, when it came to Mitsurugi…

"Ack!"

I grunted as I fell down.

I couldn't stop him at all.

Rather than complain, I just got up and wiped the grass off my uniform.

There was no point in whining, since there were bound to be other app-users in our games again.

If a higher-leveled app-user were to go up against me, I needed to hold my ground physically.

Maybe I was more determined this time, too, since my Willpower skill was much higher now, at an 89.

At the end of practice, I checked my phone to see if there were any stat gains.

Your Strength, Speed, Stamina, Dexterity and Bravery went up by +2!

Even Bravery went up?

Maybe it was because I tried a new way of playing and even practiced defending headers, even though I had bad memories of that.

"Satou, you gonna head home now? Don't tell me you're just gonna teleport back…"

It seemed like Mitsurugi disapproved of me just teleporting and using dungeon doors everywhere.

Is this a case of a martial class resenting the spellcasting classes?

"Actually, Mitsurugi, I wanted to talk to you about something…"

"...What are you up to now?"

Why was he immediately suspicious of me?

Still, we ended up going to the family restaurant we sometimes went to.

The place had several students, although most of them were just there for the cheap fries and the endless drink fountain. I could tell that some of the wait staff were annoyed with how the students stayed there for hours, even though they only ordered some fries to share.

As we took our seats, I saw our pictures on the wall from when we did the spicy curry challenge.

My asshole still remembers the pain.

"So, what's this about?"

Mitsurugi said, as he took a bite out of the curry katsudon he ordered. We were quite hungry after the practice, so we got some real meals. I got an udon. The waitress seemed happy that we actually ordered something above 1,000 Yen.

"Are you still seeing those girls from the trip?"

As soon as I mentioned them, he gave me a goofy grin.

"Hehe… Yeah, they're still here for the rest of the month, so I'm planning to see them on our day off!"

"Things are going well, huh?"

"Yup, yup! Those two are just so lovely!"

"Got room for one more?"

His mood dropped all the way down.

"...Eh? Satou, I like you and all, but… No way."

Why did he assume I meant myself?

"You really must think you're some kind of god of charisma if I would even suggest such a thing, Mitsurugi. No, I'm talking about someone else…"

"Did Aqua-sama change her mind?!"

"Are you trying to piss me off? Besides, you said you were over her."

"...Everyone says that until a chance comes by."

Is this guy really my best friend?

I was tempted to fight him again, but I had a mission in mind.

"Ahem. So, what's your relationship like with those girls? Are you exclusive, or is it open?"

"Well… It's kind of like your relationship with your girls…"

So those girls were quite open-minded, huh?

I thought that would be the case, since they decided to share Mitsurugi, after all.

"Good, good… You see, there's a girl I know who is quite interested in you."

Yes, I was talking about Cecily.

I wanted that girl to calm down and stop being a crazed lolicon, and giving her a stud to play with should do the trick.

She said so herself.

The problem was how to get Mitsurugi to agree with this.

"Oh? What's she like?"

"Hm… She's an older girl. Maybe college age?"

"That's cool! I don't mind a bit of an age gap!"

"She's an otherworldly blonde beauty with an excellent figure…"

"Ohh… Kind of like Darkness-san, huh? Not that I'm looking at her in that way."

If he really wasn't looking at Darkness like that, he wouldn't need to clarify.

"And you've also met her before."

"Eh? I'm pretty sure I'd remember a beauty like that… Oi."

I glanced away as he remembered meeting someone who fit that exact definition.

"...Tell me more about her, Satou."

He was trying to fish me for more details to confirm his suspicion.

"She really likes ankle accessories."

A government mandated ankle monitor, to be exact.

"If this is that otherworlder, Cecily-san, I swear, Satou…"

Even if their interaction was brief, Cecily had left enough of an impression on Mitsurugi that he clearly remembered what she was like.

And he doesn't seem happy about my offer.

"...She's willing to change for you."

"There's too much to change!"

I couldn't disagree with that.

"Oi, don't you consider yourself a man of character?! You're the only one who can fix that mess! If she's left alone, she might do something unforgivable!"

"Why is it my responsibility?! Why don't you do it?!"

"She specifically requested you!"

He sighed and slumped back in his seat.

"I mean, she's beautiful…"

"Very."

"But she's crazy as hell!"

"Very."

"Then, what gives?!"

"You fell for Aqua, so what's the problem with a bit of craziness?"

"Don't you dare compare Aqua-sama to that freak!"

I suppose that comparison was rather insulting to Aqua.

"In any case, here's her number. Call her if you change your mind."

He sighed and accepted the number, being the good guy he was.

Part 6

After that, Mitsurugi said that he wanted to hit the gym.

I suppose he wanted to clear his head after the discussion with Cecily.

I teleported home, opting for the shortcut.

It was hard not to abuse this teleportation spell.

"Onii-sama! Please tell Aqua-san that she needs to apologize! Right here, right now…!"

When I got home, I was immediately met with an irate Iris, who also had tears around her eyes.

"...Aqua, what did you do?"

Aqua, who was holding Zell in her hands, stomped over to us petulantly.

"Hah?! Why are you just assuming that I'm the one in the wrong?!"

"Of course it's your fault! Why else would the well-behaved Iris be crying like this if that wasn't the case?! Now, tell me what you did wrong in this instance, or there will be hell to pay!"

"I-I didn't do anything wrong!"

Iris rubbed her eyes on her sleeve and said,

"...That supposed 'dragon' of Aqua-san's assaulted my grape friend!"

Iris took out a hair piece and showed it to me.

Here's some clarification.

For some reason, Iris always wore a large hair-piece in the shape of a cluster of grapes.

I assumed that it was just a matter of different fashion styles from our world compared to the other world, so I never bothered to pay much attention to it, or ask her about it.

For one thing, I didn't even know if it was just a piece of jewelry or if they were real grapes.

But now, I could clearly see that a piece of grape had been torn from the stalk.

"See?! That fake dragon ate a part of my friend off!"

"Who are you calling a fake dragon?!"

"...Now, now, Iris, I get that you're young, but you're old enough to know that a fruit can't be your friend. You're not Yunyun."

I said, speaking in a soothing way to try and calm her down.

Instead, she just gave me a betrayed look and pointed to the grape accessory again.

"Wait, you're mistaken, onii-sama! This grape is a living creature! Rather, it was a monster that attacked me when I was a child! After I defeated it, this grape has sworn loyalty to me ever since, and has been my faithful companion!"

Is this chunnibyou?

I guess she was at that age.

I was thinking that way until the grape started to move.

"..."

[Enemy Detection] didn't warn me at all, since it didn't prove itself as a threat, but now that I pay attention to it…

After using [Lore Reading], I learned that this grape was actually a monster, like Iris said.

Just like the Green Onions and Flying Cabbages, Grapes were a type of animate food.

And since it was food, Zell decided to treat himself to a little snack.

"Aqua, since this thing actually seems to be alive, why don't you just apologize and heal the grape for Iris?"

"Hah?! But that would be admitting that my child is in the wrong! That can't be! My Zell-kun is a benevolent and pure dragon of light that cannot harm an innocent creature!"

She sounded like the mother of a criminal who was being interviewed by the news.

"Well, then, this is yet more evidence that this walking nugget isn't actually a dragon."

"Kazuma, I get that you're not ready to be a father to Zell yet, but this dragon is your child!"

"I thought that we agreed Mitsurugi was the father?! Besides, I have no problem with Appuri-chan being our 'child', because she's an intelligent AI! That thing is a snack for a lowly grape monster! It's not a dragon!"

"...Zell, daddy over here is just having a bad day. Don't listen to him. I know, let's have a walk in the garden, OK?"

Aqua placed her hands around Zell's ears and took him away, but not before giving me a glare.

I turned to Iris.

"Sorry about that, Iris. Here let me heal your grape."

She gave a thankful smile as I used [Heal] on her injured friend. The missing piece promptly grew back.

"Thanks onii-sama…"

She placed the grape back in its rightful place on her head, but not before giving it a fond, nostalgic look.

"That grape must mean a lot to you, huh?"

"Yes… It also reminds me a lot of home."

So that was what the nostalgic look was for."

"I'll find a way to get you back, Iris."

I said, patting her head affectionately.

Aside from me wanting to fulfill Iris's wish, there was also my obligation to Regina.

I made a pact to restore her kingdom of Norse, after all. In order to do that, I needed to find a way to go to the other world.

"By the way, onii-sama, Sena-san told me that my school uniform has arrived!"

"Oh… I'm proud of you, Iris!"

She has been preparing for this for a while now.

Learning Japanese, as well as basic education that a middle schooler would be familiar with.

Even if she received the best tutoring that Sena could provide, Iris's talent was also simply astounding.

"Be careful about boys, Iris…"

"This again…"

The cheerful look on her face dwindled into a slightly bored one.

"Speaking of boys… You haven't been contacting Kazuto lately, have you?"

"...Ah, I should go back to my studies."

She totally avoided the question and made a quick escape.

Iris (Sword Princess), Bond Rank: 4

At Rank 4, Iris is grateful that you saved her grape companion. You have also learned a bit about her past, and how nostalgic and homesick she really is. She has become more secretive, especially about matters with your brother, Kazuto. She didn't tell you this, but Sena gave her a cell phone, which she has been using to text and call Kazuto every night. Ah, but you didn't hear this from me, Kazuma-san. In fact, if she reads this message, your bond rank with Iris will decrease.

Bond Reward: [Signature Move]

[Signature Move] Skill Rank: 1, Passive Skill

Designate one of your attack skills as your signature move. The attack will deal +1 extra damage of its type and you will gain +10% weapon accuracy. If the attack requires mana, decrease mana consumption by 1. Yelling the name of the attack will add no bonuses to its effect.

I quickly hid the phone after reading that bond description.

"...Oi, Appuri-chan… You shouldn't write those bond descriptions as if you're directly talking to me. Have some professionalism as an app."

"Eh… Who cares about that? More importantly, it's good that you're consistently acknowledging that I'm your child now! I love you, papa!"

Appuri-chan had strangely grown on me ever since she was first installed on my phone.

I was about to head up to my room to do some training in my dungeon, when I saw Yunyun entering the room. She had a dark aura of depression around her.

"...Iris-chan shouldn't be talking to fruits, or she'll end up like Yunyun… Huh?"

Ah.

She heard that.

Chapter 46: One-Shotting These One-Shot Bears!

Part 1

I looked at Yunyun, who overheard that quip I made of her.

"Ah, Yunyun, it was just a joke. You know, the kind friends tell each other?"

"Oh! So that's what it was!"

I almost felt bad because of how easy it was to cheer her up.

If you put 'friends' in there, Yunyun will easily accept it.

"Actually, Yunyun, I'm going to head to the fifth floor boss room soon, but how are you faring with Mitsurugi on the higher level floors?"

I said, since Yunyun was on the fast track program compared to us.

"Oh… It's going well. Mitsurugi-san is very kind and reliable."

"I'm happy that you're making lots of friends."

"Ah, I don't think I can hang out with him outside the dungeon, though."

She said, raising her hand.

Was this some kind of drama I was witnessing between Mitsurugi and Yunyun?

No, Yunyun wasn't that kind of girl.

"You see, Kazuma-san, it's about that troublesome [Lady Killer] skill!"

So she was still struggling with that.

"Whenever I go out in public with Mitsurugi-san, we are swarmed by women who flirt with the both of us!"

"I don't see a problem with that, if Yunyun wants to make friends."

"...I don't think those women are satisfied with just being friends."

"Is Megumin still giving you weird looks from time to time?"

Yunyun slowly nodded.

"Yes, but when I ask her about it, she says I'm just imagining things."

I felt like there was a lot to unpack here.

"I'll be on the lookout for something that will suppress that skill of yours, Yunyun."

I said that, but if she hadn't found any clues regarding that on the higher floors, I doubted there was anything on the lower floors.

After reassuring Yunyun that I didn't intend to offend her, I went about with my plans to conquer the fifth floor boss.

I wanted to refresh my quest list right away, since it has been a while since I received new quests.

Here is an update on where everyone's progress was in regards to the dungeon.

Rin had mostly caught up to our levels due to her steady practice in the lower floors, so I planned on bringing her along.

Darkness vastly improved her accuracy from what it once before, thanks to her naginata training.

As for Megumin and Aqua, I heard that they regularly went to the dungeon together, with Aqua supporting Megumin with buffs and Megumin pummeling her opponents with her staff.

Aqua was likely still mad at me in the meantime for the whole Zell situation, so I sought out Megumin instead.

I found her in the kitchen, preparing dinner. She was wearing an apron over her home clothes, while stirring a pot with pork broth in it.

"Honey, I'm home."

I said, playing up to the housewife look she had going on.

"If it isn't my husband with multiple other women."

She said, while sipping the broth with a ladle.

"...You're normally so into roleplaying, but you're not gonna do this scenario, huh?"

"Hm? What do you mean I normally roleplay?"

She didn't even understand that I was talking about her chunnibyou, huh?

This is a sign of a rampant delusion gone unchecked.

"How are your dungeon raids with Aqua going?"

"Pretty good, although I'd prefer to be able to use my explosion…"

"Well, I have good news for you. I'm ready to tackle the fifth floor boss now, so it's time for you to go wild with your explosion."

"Ohhh! It's finally time, huh? I must say, having to hold back before letting it blow is satisfying in a way, too…"

Why did that have to sound so dirty?

"On another note, I want to talk to you about multiclassing."

"No way."

She turned back to the pot, stirring the broth around and avoiding my gaze.

"Oi… You can't use your explosion most of the time, so it's better to increase your close-combat effectiveness, right?"

"But if I level up, I want to use all my skill points on magic power and explosion damage!"

"That's the one thing you don't need more of!"

I collected myself before I got angry at her. I was trying to convince her, after all.

Rubbing my hands together in an obsequious manner, I smiled and said,

"Oh, great Megumin-san? Can I ask you to reconsider?"

"No means no."

"...How about this? You don't need to spend skill points on any new skill you gain. Just switch your class for one level, so you can at least learn some new, useful skills."
She paused for a moment, actually seeming to consider my words.

"Hmm… That might actually not be a bad idea."

Since skill points could be saved, she could always just spend those new skill points on her usual explosion related skills on the next level up.

"I mean, I do qualify for the knight class already."

This time, I was the one who went silent.

"What?! How do you already qualify for the knight class?! I already have 91 strength, so what gives?!"

"...You don't even need that high of a strength requirement. You just need 70 strength and 70 bravery. Wait, Kazuma, don't tell me that you have less than 70 bravery…"

She gave me a disappointed look.

"T-This system is rigged! No matter how you look at it, I've been put in more dangerous situations than anyone else, so how am I not brave?!"

"...Being forced into those situations doesn't really entail bravery, especially if you're cowering and shaking the whole time."

I couldn't really argue against that.

"Anyway, if you're done backseating my build, can you let me go back to cooking now?"

Upon her request, I left Megumin to finish preparing dinner.

As I was about to head upstairs, Sena found me and asked to speak with me.

"Um… About Kazuma-san's ridiculous request…"

"Which one?"

"The fact that you need me to clarify says a lot. This is about your 'nuclear program' request…"

Ah, I was waiting for news on this.

There were only a limited number of nuclear reactors in Japan due to rules and regulations.

However, due to these very special circumstances, the government decided to intervene and allowed this exception.

They also received generous donations from the international committee for this project.

As for how the materials would be transferred, I proposed that the soldiers under my command, led by Marika-san, were the ones who should bring the material to my dungeon, since they were able to enter dungeon doors.

Then, it was a simple matter to give me the coordinates to where the materials were held and create a dungeon door there. I didn't even need to be physically present.

On my end, the only thing I needed to do was study more about nuclear reactors, then apply that knowledge with [Smithing] to assemble the reactors.

"Alright, Sena, tell them to start working on that immediately!"

"...You make it sound like it's a process that can be rushed."

She sighed, although she didn't make any further objections.

Part 2

After Megumin served dinner, I gathered Darkness, Aqua, Megumin and Rin to the dungeon.

The goal was to take on the fifth floor dungeon boss.

However, along the way…

"Why are there so many people here?"

Aqua said, when she saw a line of young men waiting to enter the female orc brothel.

…I didn't think there would be this many people here when I brought the girls to the dungeon.

"I don't know, maybe they're just bored. Let's go through."

The girls ignored me and went to check what the commotion was about.

"Gah! There's girls here! Scatter!"

A bunch of them tried to run away when they saw the girls approaching them.

I guess there were those who still had some shame left.

However, there were still a few who remained in the line.

"Hmph… Why should I care what girls, who I will never have a chance to befriend or hook up with, think about me? Let them make their superficial judgments like they always do!"

"That's right. We wouldn't be here if we had a shot with those kinds of girls."

"Hold down the fort, boys. We're not budging!"

Why the hell were they so prideful about this?

"Now I'm really curious. What's going on here?"

Rin said, tilting her head in confusion.

One of the guys in the line explained.

"Heh… This is a female orc brothel, if you must know."

"I see. Have a good day."

With empty eyes, the girls started to walk away.

"Oi, wait! Don't get the wrong idea! They aren't just ordinary female orcs!"

As if to prove the guy's point, one of the female orcs stepped out.

"Alright, next group, please! Hm? Why are there less of you now?"

The girls stared in shock, as they saw a famous actress wearing a bunny girl outfit stepping out of the brothel.

"I-Isn't this that the one lady in all those movies?! She's an app-user?!"

Aqua said, making a big misunderstanding.

I couldn't really say it was a dumb statement, though, since there was no way anyone could guess that this was actually a female orc. It looked way too much like the real thing.

"...Wouldn't such an actress be super rich? Why is she servicing all these men? And I thought this was a female orc brothel… Wait…"

Darkness managed to piece it together.

The guy gave a smug smirk and said,

"That's right! This one here is a female orc who learned the [Change Shape] spell! As you can see, they can take on any form they want!"

He wrapped his arm around the female orc while proudly making that statement.

"...It doesn't matter what form they take, that's still a female orc, right?"

Megumin said, not looking impressed by that explanation.

"Of course it matters! If it really doesn't matter, then how about this…"

The guy leaned into the female orc's ear and whispered to her. She nodded and started chanting.

"[Change Shape]!"

The female orc changed her form right in front of us, getting smaller.

The end result was that she took on the form of Megumin, copying her even down to the mage hat and robes Megumin was wearing.

"...?! W-What the hell are you doing?!"

Megumin blushed as the guy pulled the Megumin look-alike closer, rubbing his hand on her waist.

"What's the matter?! You said that it doesn't matter what form they take, right?! It's just a female orc in the end, right?! Then why are you blushing so hard right now?!"

"B-But… I-It's the inside that matters!"

"Heh. Even the inside is going to feel exactly like yours! As a matter of fact, why don't I see what that's like right now!"

"Like hell you are!"

Megumin took out her staff and tried hitting the guy with it.

"Golden Barrier!"

But he just summoned a golden field of energy that floated in front of him, completely blocking the attack.

That was probably a cheat ability of his.

…In the end, these guys were still app-users.

They were usually in the high level floors, and they were only here just to have fun with the female orcs.

That meant that we couldn't really do anything against them.

"Bwahaha! You sure are feisty! I'm gonna have fun with you! Well, your clone, that is."

I didn't really know how to feel about this.

Was this NTR?

…Well, not really. I mean, it was just a female orc, at the end of the day.

The female orc didn't even act like Megumin, and I doubted that they even knew her name.

"My name is Megumin! The greatest Arch-Wizard ever! One who is obsessed with the most powerful magic known to man… Explosion! I swear by the name of the Crimson Demon clan that I won't let you get away with this…!"

…Megumin just had to provide the perfect character profile.

"Humu. A loli Arch-Wizard afflicted with chuunibyou, and your name is Megumin-chan, huh? I like it. Let's go with that scenario, then."

The female orc nodded and did a pose, imitating Megumin.

"...As the one who wields the destructive power of explosion, this Megumin will make sure that you properly 'explode', master!"

Megumin gawked as the clone perfectly copied her voice and mannerisms.

OK, now I was actually getting pissed off.

I was about to step in, but Aqua already grabbed the guy by the scruff of his collar, pulling him away from the clone Megumin.

"Oi, I didn't give you those cheats just to have you act like this!"

The guy's eyes widened in recognition.

"Wait… Aqua-sama…?"

I then remembered that all of these app-users received their cheats from Aqua.

Megumin, Darkness and Rin didn't get a cheat item from Aqua. Megumin became an app-user through Wolbach, Darkness through Eris-sama and Rin became one after Aqua was kicked out of her realm. That was why they didn't see Aqua as a goddess.

But this guy should see reason if the goddess who gave him his cheat power was reprimanding him.

Right?

"...Wait, you must be a female orc, too. There's no way Aqua-sama would be in a place like this."

"What did you say?! OK, I've had it! [Sacred Break Spell]!"

"...!!!"

After a flash of bright, blue light that filled the hall, we saw that clone Megumin was gone.

She was instead replaced by a female orc.

"Eeek?!"

The app-user, who was happily holding the clone Megumin before, recoiled from the sight of the female orc.

"Hm, what's the matter, master? Megumin is ready to play with you now~!"

"F-Forget it! I'm never coming here again!"

"Ah, wait, dear customer…!"

Unable to deal with the real appearance of the female orc, the app-user quickly made his escape.

"As a matter of fact, I'm shutting this whole place down! [Sacred Break Spell]! [Sacred Break Spell]! [Sacred Break Spell]!"

Aqua went inside the brothel and started undoing the transformations of the orcs.

"Ahhh! What are you doing?!"

I said, before Aqua could open hers again.

"Pfft… The last time I opened my box, I got Zell as a result! My luck isn't as bad as you think!"

That was the perfect example of her bad luck, though.

Still, I let her do whatever she wanted, instead of wasting time and energy arguing.

Megumin couldn't harvest the bears for materials yet, since she was unable to move, so I was about to open my loot box.

However, I noticed something ahead of us.

"Hm? What are those things?"

I noticed what appeared to be floating snow balls, but there was an immaterial, ghostly quality to them.

They also had cute, black eyes in the form of vertical lines.

[Enemy Detection] wasn't saying they were a threat, so I just watched them instead of reacting.

"Oh! Those are Snow Sprites!"

Aqua said, looking excited as she saw them.

"Hm? What are they?"

"They're considered spirits that embody the concept of winter itself! If you capture them, you can make wonderful ice packs during the summer! I also heard that capturing them will even hurry along the coming of spring!"
I used [Lore Reading] to see if I could learn more about these Snow Sprites.

Aqua was hardly reliable, after all.

Snow Sprites

Ice spirits that are avatars of winter. They are very weak and are prone to capture. They give a lot of EXP when slain. However, they are very rare and only those who are lucky will encounter them.

There are rumors that capturing and defeating them will trigger a secret event, however, since Snow Sprites are quite rare, there doesn't seem to be much information regarding this.

I was about to warn them about this supposed secret event, until I saw Aqua already trying to capture one.

"Come on! These things give a lot of EXP if they're killed! I also wanna capture one to make perfectly chilled beer with!"

Well, they did seem pretty harmless.

And I needed 100 EXP to level up.

I took out Chunchunmaru and started slaying these Snow Sprites.

"You have leveled up! Um… But Kazuma-san, I should really warn you…"

"Hm? What's up?"

"Well…"

Before Aika-chan could finish her sentence…

We felt the ground rumbling again.

I thought it would be more One-Shot Bears, but when I looked at the source of the tremors, I saw snow and ice swirling around in one area.

The miniature storm formed into the shape of a large, humanoid figure.

The figure wore samurai armor that looked like it was made from ice and snow. It also carried a large katana that would have been considered a nodachi for a regular sized person.

And then, I remembered the 'optional quest'.

To defeat the Winter Shogun.

The summoning method was unknown so far, and Mitsurugi said that no one was able to figure it out.

Either that, or no one lived to tell the tale.

"Quick! Kazuma-san! You have to prostrate yourselves to the Winter Shogun!"

I quickly did as Appuri-chan said.

"Oi, Kazuma, why are you making me bow, too?!"

Megumin said, as she couldn't move and was forced to bow along with me.

"Just shut up and behave!"

Darkness stared at the Winter Shogun with a lewd smile on her face.

"This thing is looking down at me as if I'm a slave… Ah, it's a shogun that's used to conquering women, after all…"

"Keep your head down, or you're not getting any from me anymore!"

That managed to reign her in.

Just when I thought my troubles were over…

"Ahh! My Snow Sprite is escaping!"

This dumbass Aqua stood up to try and capture the Snow Sprite that slipped away from her hands.

I went over to her and brought her face down to the snow.

"Oi! Don't you already have too many pets?! Just let that one go!"

"Are you implying Zell is a pet?! He's a mighty dragon, not a pet!"

"Actually, rather than a pet, isn't he a snack?!"

"Kazuma, take that back and apologize to your child right now!"

"How many children do I have with you?!"

While I was arguing with Aqua, I failed to notice that I still had Chunchunmaru in my hands.

"Kazuma-san, let go of your–!"

That was the last thing I heard before I saw a flash of cold steel.

Ah… This again.

My whole world spun around before going completely black.
