#1,185
Chapter 49: A Reconciliation With This Deadbeat!

Part 1

Darkness wanted to check up on Pocky-chan aka Bei-chan, although Darkness didn't like the latter name since I used it to tease her. The others went home, while I went with her to the goblin forest, where Pocky-chan was being taken care of.

The goblins respectfully, and somewhat fearfully, bowed to us as we entered the forest. Seeing the goblin abode, I really started to see how advanced the Bark People's community was. Even compared to the Kobolds who had a hidden community in the tunnels, the Bark People seemed a lot more civilized than other intelligent monsters.

Although, Mitsurugi did say that it was a natural progression the higher you go up. There were even lizardmen who have created an entire kingdom, apparently.

"Ahh… It's been a while, Pocky-chan!"

Darkness said, while holding her beloved toad, who reciprocated the gesture by snuggling Darkness.

Since Darkness also had the [Monster Tamer] title, Pocky-chan was behaving herself among the goblins. And thus, she was freely allowed to hop around. She had become a bit of an oddity for app-users. Thankfully, the collar around Pocky-chan's neck warned them that terrible things would happen to them if they slayed the Giant Toad.

"Kazuma… Why don't you bond with Pocky-chan as well? She is your daughter, after all."

"..."

What is this feeling of deja vu?

"Excuse me?"

I asked, slightly bewildered.

"...I-If you can have two children with Aqua, and another child from who knows where else, why can't you have one with me?!"

What a nonsensical thing to get jealous of.

"Um, Darkness-san? You do know that… Ah, nevermind."

I felt a dangerous aura coming from my phone and stopped talking.

I was about to say 'Aika-chan isn't actually my daughter, you know?'

But I had a feeling Aika-chan, who was always listening, would make my life hell if I said that.

Instead, I just amused Darkness and went to Pocky-chan, patting her head. She did respond cutely, which made my heart waver.

Even if she's just a giant toad…

If the others get jealous of these 'children', I wonder if they'd start bringing pets home and claim that I'm the father.

I could imagine Megumin, who was way too competitive, picking up some stray cat and doing just that.

I'd like to think that Rin was more mature than that, but you never know.

The rivalry between women can get pretty nasty…

Or was that just a generalization? I hope so.

After we finished our business, we were about to leave, but the goblin chief wanted a word with me.

Using [Monster Talk] I heard what he wanted to say.

"Um… Forgive me, but I have a request I'd like to ask of you…"

Since I had the [Monster Ally] title active right now, perhaps that made me seem more approachable to monsters.

As I got EXP from completing such requests, anyway, I was at least willing to hear him out.

"What is it, oh great chieftain?"

"...You do not need to regard me as such. In any case, our request is to deal with some rather troublesome visitors… That is, um…"

For some reason, he was embarrassed to say it.

"...That is… A very attractive human female once came down here, asking us to impregnate her…"

I immediately turned to Darkness.

"No, it's not her… Although the looks that one gives us are scary sometimes…"

It wasn't Darkness?!

What a plot twist.

He then proceeded to describe what this human woman looked like.

"...She had long black hair held by a yellow hairband… As well as a dress that doesn't look like it'd be practical in normal wear and combat… And like I said, she's extraordinarily beautiful."

Didn't that description kind of sound familiar?

I looked through my phone and brought out a picture I had saved in my phone from long ago.

"Is this her?"

"...! Indeed! Yes, it is!"

It was a picture of Lia, performing on stage with Axel Hearts.

"Darkness! How dare you corrupt my friend!"

"Eh?! What are you blaming me for?!"

I unintentionally lashed out at Darkness.

When I calmed down, I pieced together that this was likely a female orc who was a former worker at that brothel.

I suppose, as a popular idol, Lia was requested enough in the brothel for her to take that form.

Perhaps this orc got desperate enough to breed with goblins, and thought that coming to this forest in that form would make them go into heat and breed with her.

"Of course, we didn't do it because Kazuma-sama told us not to breed with humans…"

They were willing to carry out such an order, huh?

These goblins were a lot more loyal than I thought.

Still, it wasn't like she was a human.

"Actually, that was a female orc."

"Eh?! Wow… The female orcs are more beautiful than I remember…"

"That's only because of the [Change Shape] spell."

I rubbed my chin in thought, then said,

"...Would you goblins want to breed with this female orc?"

It was a rather crude question to ask, but these were monsters, anyway.

They didn't have the same sense of morality as humans.

"Well… The unsightly features of the female orcs made us avoid them in the past, but if they look that way now… I wouldn't be opposed to it."

He was talking about the unsightly features of other monsters, despite being a goblin.

Although, there are people like that among humans, as well. Those who insult the appearances of others even though they aren't attractive themselves.

There was a way here to quell the thirst of the female orcs, as well as satisfy the infamous libido of the goblins.

After all, even though this particular tribe of goblins was under my control, there were others in the dungeon who would still try and assault female app-users, in the same way female orcs assault the men.

…Won't having the main offenders breed with each other solve these issues?

That's a crazy thing to say, but from a purely utilitarian perspective, it was a sound idea.

Decreasing the pain and raising the pleasure of everyone involved…

Quite literally, if I may add.

Although I doubt Mills or Bentham imagined that female orcs and goblins would see the application of their ideas.

In any case, this was all for the better good of this dungeon society.

"If you are willing, the next time that female orc comes in here, you may copulate with her as you wish."

"...! W-Well, if you say so…"

"Oh, but please ask her to take a different form."

I said, even though Konno-san would have no idea her appearance was being used. I still wanted to respect her.

"Kazuma… You really are something…"

Darkness said, while salivating at the thought of goblin breeding.

"If you want to stay here overnight and watch the festivities, go ahead and do that, you freak."

"...?! I-I wasn't planning on doing that at all?!"

"I'll leave you some sleeping bags. Just make sure Pocky-chan doesn't watch."

"I-I told you I won't…!"

She didn't sound that convincing.

Part 2

We left the dungeon after Darkness had ample time playing with Pocky-chan.

I was also hoping that the female orcs would be appeased by the goblins, but I knew better than to be optimistic.

After all, they clearly had a preference for strong males, and goblins were hardly strong.

Still, if it decreased the amount of assaults for both genders, then I was happy with the result.

You gained 2,000 EXP for helping the goblins!

It seems that the [Monster Ally] title gives a lot of EXP, regardless of the power of the monsters involved.

We teleported back to the mansion just in time for dinner.

It was my turn to cook, and there was a lot of Lake Dragon meat to cook.

Not only the normal variation, but the mutant one as well.

I cooked the fish-like meat with some soy sauce and sake, making sure to add plenty of ginger as well to hide the fishy taste.

The mutant meat was already steamed, so I didn't want to overcook it.

But a lot of the normal meat was still pretty raw, so I made sure to deep-fry it with some batter, making a kind of tempura.

Actually, it was closer to a Chinese deep fried fish, with plenty of spices, than a classic tempura.

"Oh! This tastes better than when we were just eating it as is!"

Aqua exclaimed, while guzzling down the food.

Aika-chan was also back in her golem body, eating the food as well.

"Hmm… Impressive… I like the fried version more!"

You gained +5 Magic Power, Mana Capacity, Strength and Stamina!

You also gained 1,000 EXP!

As expected, the cooking skill gave quite a few benefits.

…Although, it would probably be more effective at higher ranks, the cooking skill, I mean.

But should I really use precious Skill Points on something like the cooking skill?

From there, I worked on other items, such as clothes and PET bottles.

As I was digging through the clutter, I happened to pull out a bra from the pile.

"Erk…"

Konno-san made a strange sound.

"Sorry about that…"

She gave a bit of an awkward chuckle, before taking the bra away from me.

Only for me to pull a pair of panties out next.

"...Sorry again."

"No matter how many times you say sorry, I'm still being forced to touch your used underwear, you know?"

"Y-Yeah… Do you want some gloves, or something?"

Hygiene wasn't really the problem here.

"...You're pretty fast, Satou-san."

Konno-san said, as she watched me move around the room to tidy it up.

It was all thanks to my upgraded speed and dexterity.

Although, using such abilities on cleaning was probably a bit of a waste.

"I'm a soccer player, after all."

"I see. But are high school athletes normally this physically impressive…?"

She really did have high intuition.

"...Found another pair of panties."

"I'm truly sorry about that, Satou-san."

In order to distract her, I lifted a pair of panties.

The fact that they were rather bold lingerie types made it all the more awkward.

About an hour later, we finally finished cleaning up the room.

"Ah… I can breathe again…"
Konno-san said, as she spun around the room as if she were dancing in a field of flowers.

She looked like she was in a commercial for an air freshener.

"I'll be back next week to clean it."

Rather than denying it, or claiming that she wouldn't get it dirty in such a short time, she only bowed deeply.

"Thank you so much for your continued assistance."

I poked her on the head.

"What's with all the formality?"

She raised her head again, then said,

"So, what do you wanna do? We can hang out for the next few hours."

"Oh? Not gonna kick me out as soon as my task is done?"

She sighed and placed a hand on her waist.

"You think I kick my friends out as soon as they're done doing me a favor? Actually, you don't have a choice. Come hang out with me."

After a pause, she said,

"Well, unless you already made plans, of course."

I ended up coming down with her to her living room. She poured some more drinks and took out some rice crackers, then put Netflix on.

"...You were watching a Sumo documentary? Are you interested in Sumo, or something?"

"I was just bored, I guess. What do you normally watch? Anime?"

"Oi, Konno-san? Why do you just assume that I watch anime…"

"The fact that you're getting so defensive is pretty telling, you know?"

I suppose only an otaku would act like that.

A normie will respond with, 'Anime? Yeah, I watch One Piece and JJK'.

We ended up watching some random interior decorating show.

Midway through the episode, her phone started to ring.

She placed her phone on the drawer table beside me. I was about to reach for it.

Only to see that it was a timer.

That wouldn't have been an issue, but her lock screen changed to a picture of her in an Axel Hearts costume, along with the other members.

Ah, I shouldn't have let my guard down.

Konno-san lunged towards the phone, almost knocking me over.

"..."

We stared at each other, as our faces were only a few inches apart.

Well, if my strength stat was lower, I would have ended up being pinned down on the couch.

That would have been a worse outcome.

"Um… Ah…"

As expected, she couldn't really make an excuse about this.

I mean, why would she be so panicked about a mere timer?

Another guy would have expected that she was trying to make a move right now.

I mean, she was all alone with a guy, invited him to watch Netflix, and now she was throwing herself on the guy.

Even in a court of law, the court would side with the man if something were to happen.

Thankfully for her, I knew better.

"Um… I… I wasn't…"

I chuckled as the timer went into snooze mode.

"You got an embarrassing background pic you don't want me to see, or something?"

"...Something like that. Uh… Sorry for jumping on you like that."

"It's fine. I don't mind. I know you didn't mean anything by it."

"Still…"

She still looked embarrassed, so I put my arm around her and went back to watching TV.

As if to say, we're friends. I don't mind a bit of physical contact.

She chuckled as well, and even leaned her head into my shoulder as we continued watching. She sighed as she was finally able to relax.

"...You're a good friend… Satou… Erm… Kazuma."

"Oh? We're on a first name basis now?"

"We're cuddling on a couch watching Netflix, I think it's more than appropriate."

"Right… Lia-chan~!"

"Oi…"

We ended up watching a couple episodes of that interior decorating show.

Your bond with Lia has deepened!

Konno Lia (Idol-In-Disguise), Bond Rank: 6

At Rank 6, you are more comfortable with Lia than ever, going on a first name basis, and even getting to a point where you're comfortable with some friendly cuddling. Lia seems unaffected by your high Charisma stat, but respects you and loves hanging out with you. She seems to be debating whether she should keep her secret from you, but doesn't want to do anything to ruin your friendship right now.

Bond Reward: +20 Intuition

…Also, keeping your knowledge that she's an idol to yourself has increased your Cunning by +5!

Part 7

I left Lia's house a couple hours later. It wasn't quite evening yet, but the beginning of a sunset was starting to stretch shadows in the streets. These were prime hours for people to enjoy the vestiges of their free time, so the streets were packed with people of all demographics.

Since I rarely had free time to myself, I bought some bubble tea as a treat. I noticed more girls looking at me, even older women.

Humu… Yeah, this never really gets tiring.

After I finished my bubble tea, I received a call from Sena.

"...We are ready for the transfer now. Please wait at the dungeon to receive the materials."

It was finally time.

I teleported to the dungeon, then opened the door that I created for the soldiers.

Once the door opened, I saw Marika-san and the other troop members walking in, wearing hazmat suits.

"...Please wear these as well, Satou-san."

I nodded and placed the hazmat suit in my inventory, then equipped it, so they wouldn't have to wait for me to put the whole thing on manually.

After that, they brought in the materials, stored away in heavy containers.

"So, how have you guys been?"

I said, as I led them to the dungeon floor where they would store the materials.

"...We're trying to focus on this delicate task here, so please save the small talk for later."

I suppose I was taking it too easy.

After they set everything down, they waited to see what I would do.

Then, without even taking the materials out of the containers, I held my hand out.

"[Smithing]!"

The parts moved out of the containers, and just like puzzle pieces connecting, they flew into place and constructed themselves to the design I had in mind.

I did some research on reactors and read the manuals they sent me. The maxed out smithing skill took care of the rest.

And just like that, my reactor was ready.

"...Eh? It's already done?"

They said, blinking after they watched the quick process.

Getting the paperwork and approval for this was more difficult than actually constructing the thing.

"Yup. We don't need to worry about radioactive waste, either, because the dungeon will just absorb it."

Just like it absorbed everything else.

"...Satou-san… Isn't this kind of a ridiculous invention? Scientists have been finding ways to reduce radioactive waste… And you're telling me that the dungeon can just eat it up?"

I chuckled and said to Marika-san.

"Ah, today's technology sure is wonderful, isn't it?"

"This has nothing to do with today's technology!"

"Anyway, why don't we try it out? You guys still have the adventurer class, right?"

The only thing they could do was nod. I guess they were still too shocked about that reactor business.

With nuclear power hooked on, I didn't have to worry as much about conserving energy from the manatite core.

I went to the laptop and cloned the golem EXP farm, creating several rooms for each of the soldiers.

"Alright, use the [Create Trap] skill I taught you guys, then place traps on each of the pitfall here… Then all we need to do is have the golems fall down, and…"

"...?!!"

They stared in shock as they gained EXP just from setting down traps.

"A-Are you telling me we can gain EXP without even doing anything?"

I nodded at the soldier's shocked question.

"Yup. And with the nuclear plant active, I can keep this farm going all day."

"...This is kind of ridiculous."

"Oh, yeah, I've made a dungeon door in the military base, now, so you can come here anytime. I can also make personal rooms and stuff. You can kill the golems faster on your own, so come here when you're free to power level."

Not only that, but them being in the dungeon will give me the Dungeon Points I need. All this energy only allowed me to create the basic stuff, but I wanted to get into the advanced features as soon as possible.

Of course, I also needed to make this publicly accessible to the app-users, too. Not only to appease Vanir, but to farm them for DP.

"...You always surprise us, Captain…"

I chuckled and said,

"If you have any requests for your personal rooms, make sure to tell me."

"...This place is already more accommodating than the base."

Was a dungeon really that much more comfortable than a military base?

Your bond with the Satou Kazuma Squad has deepened!

Satou Kazuma Squad (JSDF Forces), Bond Rank: 4

At Rank 4, your squad has a deeper respect for your ingenuity. They are much more optimistic about the war now, even if their morale was low after the frequent explosion attacks to the military bases from Wolbach. They also appreciate how you took their comfort into consideration when offering to make personal rooms for them in the dungeon.

Bond Reward: Weapon skill Rank-Up

Installing a nuclear reactor to your dungeon has also increased your Creativity and Bravery by +10!

While I was in the dungeon anyway, I went about learning the new Sniper class skills.

Thankfully, it seemed like it was much easier to unlock them than the esoteric Necromancy skills.

For [Headshot], all I needed to do was shoot a golem on the head. [Trap Shot] only entailed shooting a golem while it was stuck in the trap. [Power Shot] is also pretty self-explanatory, I just had to pull the bowstring at its max power before shooting it. [Stealth Archer] only needed me to hide before shooting an arrow.

[Critical Boost] was easily unlocked just by raising my crit chance with [Merciless Strike]. Maybe I would have had a bit more trouble if I didn't already have a similar skill. [Relocation] just needed me to change my spot after firing an arrow. And [Archery Rank-Up] actually came with the class, it increased the max skill rank of archery related skills to Rank 6.

The only somewhat tricky one was [Deadeye], which was a skill that slowed down one's perception of time when focusing on a shot. It took an hour to actually get this skill, but I eventually got it in the end.

You unlocked all the exclusive Sniper class skills!

[Dead Eye] Skill Rank: 1, Active Skill (5 mp)

When you're focusing on a shot, you can choose to slow down your own perception of time to align the perfect shot. This effect lasts for 1 second.

[Headshot] Skill Rank: 1, Passive Skill

When you deal a headshot, increase the damage dealt by +2.

[Trap Shot] Skill Rank: 1, Passive Skill

When a target has the 'trapped' condition, whether by a traditional trap or magical means, they will take +1 extra damage from your ranged attacks.

[Power Shot] Skill Rank: 1, Active Skill (5 mp)

Increase the time spent drawing the bowstring. Increases damage dealt by +1 for each second the bowstring is drawn (max 3 seconds), however, each second that passes decreases your accuracy by 20%.

[Stealth Archer] Skill Rank: 1, Passive Skill

When you shoot from a hidden position, your location will not be revealed unless creatures who are actively looking for you pass an Intuition check against your Cunning (94) with disadvantage.

[Critical Boost] Skill Rank: 1, Passive Skill

Your Critical Hit chance permanently increases by 10%.

[Relocation] Skill Rank: 1, Passive Skill

After a ranged attack, your movement speed is doubled if you are moving to another location.

[Retrieve Ammo] Skill Rank: 1, Active Skill (5 mp)

You can have up to three fired ammunition teleport back to your hands or quiver, as long as it was used in a ranged attack in the past 5 seconds. Ammunition will no longer break or become lost during a battle.

[Archery Rank-Up] Skill Rank: 1, Passive Skill

All archery related skills have their max Skill Rank increase to Rank 6. However, the skill points required to level those skills increases by 2 skill points.

…As expected of an advanced class.

Not only were there a lot of skills, but most of them were already useful enough to become bread and butter skills.

Not only that, but not one skill went above 5 mp cost. I suppose that reflects the Sniper's need to be efficient.

…The Rank 6 upgrade option was tempting, but that 2 skill point requirement was pretty expensive.

Which made me even more annoyed at Aqua and Megumin, who had their party tricks and explosion magic beyond rank 5 by now.

Well, I suppose there was no need to get jealous.

After unlocking the skills, I made the rooms for the soldiers as I promised, then I went out of the dungeon to join the others for dinner.

"Allow me to show this party trick I upgraded to Rank 10! …Kazuma, why are you glaring at me right now?"

"How dare you give that kind of nasty look to mama!"

I couldn't help but give Aqua a death glare across the table.

Which, of course, made Aika-chan pout disapprovingly at me.

Chapter 50: Blessing This Minotaur With a Labyrinth!

Part 1

After dinner, Iris asked me to come to her room.

The reason being, she was set to go to school tomorrow, and she wanted to practice her introductions.

"I am Iris Belzerg! The number one sword princess in the world!"

"...Don't ever ask Megumin for advice ever again."

I said, once Iris showed me her introduction.

"Eh? But Megumin nee-sama said that I will make an impression if I do that…"

She wasn't lying about that part, but I bet it wasn't the kind of impression Iris wanted to make.

"What kind of impression should I make, then?"
"First of all, why don't you introduce yourself as Satou Iris? Then, tell everyone about your awesome onii-chan…"

"...That's not gonna happen, onii-sama. Please be serious about this!"

I was serious, though.

"Don't worry too much about it. If anyone bullies Iris, I will just use my government contacts to have their parents get a new job at a different prefecture, so they will be forced to leave your life forever."

"Onii-sama! Stop saying such scary things!"

"...In any case, don't worry so much about your school life and relax. I know, how about we play some games tonight?"

"...! I'd love that! Maybe have some treats, too?"

"You might not be able to sleep, and you'll have trouble waking up before your first day of school."

"That's not a problem! Out on the battlefield, I was able to stay up for four days in a row with no sleep whatsoever!"

"Let's have some treats."

I really wanted to spoil this poor girl rotten.

Someone like Aika-chan always demanded to be spoiled, but Iris here asked for very little.

Even though I knew it wasn't good for her health, I gave her a bunch of sweets while we played games all night.

Now, I know that I told Iris not to worry about her first day of school.

But when we said goodnight and I went into my own room to sleep, I was suddenly filled with worries.

…What if something goes wrong?!

Iris is so cute, plus, she's a foreigner.

It's unlikely, but what if she becomes a target of bullying from other girls?

"Tch… Who does that girl think she is?"

"Just because she's a little cute, all the boys are paying attention to her…"

"Let's teach her a lesson, shall we? Ohohoho!"

And then those bitches will steal Iris's shoes, or put flowers on her desk, along with a framed picture of her.

…I'll kill those little monsters!

I accidentally tore my pillow in half while thinking about Iris getting bullied.

…

…

The next morning, I did something I hadn't done in a while.

I called my dad and asked him to call in sick for me.

"Eh? Kazuma… Don't tell me you're back to your old self…"

My dad asked worriedly, after I called him.

He was worried that I was returning to my lazy days of skipping school.

I used [Versatile Entertainer] to make my voice sound sick.

"Cough… cough… No, I really am sick… Cough…"

"Yikes. Alright, make sure you rest up, OK?"

I thanked him and hung up.

Now, as for the reason why I was doing this…

I decided to follow Iris to her school.

Using the [Disguise] skill, I took on the appearance of a janitor.

Please don't judge me for doing this.

I was just worried sick about my little sister.

If some middle-school brat dares to bully Iris, I will make sure that they regret it.

My appearance was that of a nondescript middle aged janitor.

With my stealth skills and disguise, I was able to easily infiltrate the school.

I then pretended to mop outside of Iris's classroom.

Meanwhile, I used [Espionage] to listen in on her introduction.

"...I'm Iris! I'm pleased to meet all of you! I come from England and my Japanese is not great yet… But I hope we all get along…!"

Her introduction was met with applause.

…They should be clapping more!

Those ungrateful brats are not clapping enough even though my brave imouto gave such an outstanding introduction?!

"Hm? Why do I hear clapping outside?"

Ah, I unintentionally started clapping as well.

I left just as the sensei checked outside the door to see what was happening.

When it was time for lunch break, I discreetly went into the cafeteria to follow Iris.

"Iris, over here!"

Kazuto waved Iris over when she arrived.

"Oh? You already know Satou-kun, Iris-san?"

The girls who were following Iris said.

"Yeah! He's a family friend!"

So that was their cover story.

"Fufu… Satou-kun sure is cute, isn't he?"

"Ah, you two would make a good couple…"

Iris blushed at the girls' words.

"Y-You think so?"

"Yeah, you two should date~!"

"Excuse me."

I interrupted by going through the group, pretending like I was going to take out the garbage.

"Ah, sorry, we should move out of the way."

The girls bowed to me, then went over to Kazuto's table.

Young girls talking about cute guys and dating…

How shameless!

Iris shouldn't date until she's 30 years old!

No, actually, she shouldn't date ever!

…OK, maybe I was going too far now.

Once classes ended, I waited for Iris and Kazuto outside the school gate.

"Ah, onii-sama! What are you doing here?"

Iris said, when she saw me waiting outside, after I changed out of my disguise.

"It's your first day of school, so I wanted to pick you up! Ah, how about we go get something tasty? My treat!"

"Oh, thanks, nii-san. Can we go to a family restaurant?"

For some reason, Kazuto was talking as if he was invited.

"Yay! Thanks so much for treating us, onii-sama! You're so generous!"

"Of course!"

I couldn't tell Kazuto to buzz off after that.

I took them to the family restaurant and let them order whatever they wanted.

While they were eating, I saw them having fun talking to each other.

…I'm kinda intruding, aren't I?

Not only that, I was being an overbearing brother by following her everywhere on her first day of school.

"Ah… I'll leave you two alone. Here's some money."

I left them some bills then stood up.

"Eh? Onii-sama, where are you going?"

"Oh, I got some stuff to do. You kids enjoy yourselves."

Yeah, I should just let her enjoy her new life.

"Heh, finally the third wheel has left. Ah, how about we go to karaoke after this, Iris…"

"On second thought, I'm not so busy after all."

"Eh?!"

I sat back down once I heard what Kazuto said.

"...Nii-san… What happened to that cool speech from earlier?"

Kazuto said, gritting his teeth as he tried to keep up a smile.

"Hm? It's better if there's an adult supervising you two, right?"

"Where's the adult?! You're a teenager yourself! Trying to act like you're our uncle is just cringey!"

I was aware that I was being a total clockblock right now.

If I was Kazuto, and my nii-san was constantly trying to get between me and my crush, I would be quite angry, too.

"...Nii-san, come with me for a moment."

I stood up and followed Kazuto to the drink bar.

"Oi… I thought you said you wouldn't interfere from now on."

He said, reminding me of my promise during the trip.

"...It's not like I promised anything. I just left you alone because you guilt-tripped me about Aqua."

"Well, are you telling me you're not feeling guilty now?! You're just being an asshole!"

"Oi, why would I let you take Iris to some shady karaoke, slip something into her drink, and do something despicable to her, while filming the whole thing to blackmail her later!"

"Do you really think I'm capable of doing something like that?!"

"Of course I would with that creepy face of yours!"

"We have the same face, dumbass!"

We quieted down when a waitress stared suspiciously at us.

"...Oi, just believe me when I say that I'm not gonna do anything weird."

I gave him a flat look.

"I wasn't born yesterday! You told me during those 'lessons' that karaoke is the best place to do lewd things with a girl!"

He averted his eyes when I caught him in his lie.

"F-Fine! I promise that I won't get past first base with her!"

"Forget first base, I'm not even gonna let you onto the field!"

"You're too damn strict!"

We both stared intensely at each other.

"...Iris is gonna hate you if you're too protective."

"Urk."

I let out a pained groan, knowing he was right.

Still, I refused to give up. I said,

"...You can go on dates with her, but you have to be in a public space! No karaoke, no abandoned buildings, no sneaking off at night to meet up in the park!"

He rolled his eyes and said,

"Tch… Fine…"

"...And no kissing. No hand holding, or hugging. And don't even breathe the same air as her. In fact, you shouldn't even exist in the same country. Pack your bags, you're going to Greenland."

"What the hell's wrong with you?!"

Well, I said what I had to say.

…I really couldn't interfere past this point.

If I kept watching them like a hawk, both of them would end up hating me at this rate.

Well, I was pretty sure Kazuto already hated me.

And so, after we finished our meal, we went outside and I said,

"Alright, you two kids have fun now."

"Ah, before you go, onii-sama…"

Iris went up to me with a smile.

"I was really nervous for my first day, but you helped me so much with practice last night. It would have been a disaster if I listened to Megumin nee-san and didn't consult you…"

"As long as you know that asking Megumin for school advice is tantamount to social suicide."

"I-I wouldn't go that far."

That was the truth, though.

Iris (Sword Princess), Bond Rank: 5

At Rank 5, although Iris didn't know about your creepy stalker behavior, she felt safe throughout the day, as if a guardian angel was watching over her. She is thankful that you gave her good advice regarding her introduction, and even more grateful that you aren't as strict with her as her guardians back home, especially regarding her friendship with boys her own age. Continuing to care for her as your little sister, while also giving her an appropriate amount of freedom, will deepen your relationship with Iris.

Bond Reward: +20 Potential

Part 2

My Potential doubled all of a sudden.

…Did I just drink the ultra divine water?

No, that sounds wrong, considering this upgrade came from Iris.

Not only that, but my golem farm has been running nonstop since I got the reactors.

I received 600 EXP throughout the day.

I wanted to go back to the dungeon with the others that night, but I was also looking to upgrade my armor.

My weapons received an upgrade, and now I even had a Magician's Cape that raised my mana capacity and regeneration.

My armor was due to an upgrade as well.

Of course, I had the max [Smithing] skill, but I still needed the materials for an upgrade. I couldn't just make epic-tier armor out of thin air.

And so, I had to go back to that stingy old man of a blacksmith.

When I went there, I was planning on showing off my maxed out [Smithing] skill, but…

"What do you mean you're Rank 6?!"

I said, unable to believe what the oji-san blacksmith was saying to me.

He shrugged and said,

"I used the money I made from that government contract and hired some app-users. They take me down to the dungeon and help me level up and gather rare materials."

"...What's with the sudden increase in motivation?"

From what I remembered from last time, the blacksmith only went to the dungeon to trade with app-users or retrieve materials.

He rubbed the back of his head.

"Well… You see, my daughter's birthday is coming up. I think I mentioned this before, but she's the one who got me this phone."

He briefly lifted his phone, before placing it back down on the counter.

"If I didn't have this phone, I would have never discovered the app. I admit, all this app stuff has made my life a bit less boring. So I wanna make it up to her with a big birthday gift… Oi, what's with that face?!"

I was trying not to chuckle.

That was because seeing this hardass of a blacksmith talking about his daughter so fondly was hilarious.

"Ah, well… I also get it, oji-san."

"...Eh? Why do I feel a sense of camaraderie with you? Do you have kids? At that age?"

Did I really give off that much of a fatherly energy, that other fathers could sense it?

Like how Stand users attract other Stand users?

Actually, this could be a good chance to build a bond with this guy!

Even though he has the potential to enter the dungeon, I haven't had any bonds with this guy yet.

I even had a bond with Vanir.

…Although that bond never increased.

In any case, I should shoot my shot.

…That sounds like I was trying to seduce this oji-san.

"Ah… Well… Yeah, I do have a daughter."

The oji-san gave me a look of sympathy.

"A single father, huh? Trust me, I know how that is."

…Why did he assume I'm a single father?

Still, there was a good connection happening here, so I didn't correct him.

"So, what'd you come here for, pal?"

He said, giving me a smile for the first time.

And also… calling me pal…

W-What is this pleasantness I'm feeling?

I finally managed to conquer the hard-to-get oji-san?!

"I-I made this sword for you… B-But it's not like I like you or anything, baka!"

…Actually, let's not imagine that, unless I wanna throw up the meal I just ate.

"Ah… I came here for an upgrade to my mithril armor. It's been a while."

"Hm… Well, with the materials I have right now, I can give you a Super Rare armor as an upgrade. You wanna upgrade your sword, too? I'll give you a discount if you do both."

"Ah, sure, why not."

"Great. Both upgrades will cost you 10 million Yen."

"What happened to the discount?!"

Does this guy like me or not?

"Hah? I'm giving you a total of 4 million Yen of discount! You gonna be an ungrateful little bitch or what?!"

Ah, crap, his affection points were going down.

In the end, I ended up paying him.

…Also, with how much money he was making, what kind of insane gift was he gonna give his daughter? A lamborghini?

He took out a block of red-ish ore. I recognized it as adamantite.

"Hm? Isn't that used in heavy armor?"

"Yeah, but it can be used to line your Mithril armor. And it's done."

"...I paid 5 million Yen just for you to line my armor with another metal? And it only took you a second to do! Oi, I could have done that myself if I had the materials…!!!"

"Obviously there are boosts that come with the Blacksmith class, so stop whining already!"

"...How do you unlock the Blacksmith class, anyway?"

I already had the [Smithing] skill maxed out, plus my creativity was very high. What else did I need?

"Well, you need to own a smithy and sell your goods to customers, of course."

I looked around at his pawn shop.

"...This is considered a smithy?"

"Got a problem with that?"

In order not to piss him off even more, I didn't comment.

Mithril-Adamantite Half-Plate - Medium Armor (Super Rare)

A set that includes a breast plate, pauldrons and chausses. The mithril has a light blue sheen, while the Adamantite lining provides a red lustre. Reduces incoming damage by +14. Applies -11 penalty to stealth related stats when sneaking.

Sells for: 4,200,000 Yen

I checked my armor out, then I had a thought.

"...My friend is a Crusader who uses Adamantine armor, but how come her armor doesn't look red?"

Her armor was white with a golden trim, providing the image of a real Crusader.

Even though the reality was far from it.

"No, I probably just caught it from someone on the train."

"I see… Well, next time you're sick, I'll come over and make you some porridge. Actually, can you give me your address?"

…I was thankful that she was being such a good friend, but…

I can't really explain the big mansion I live in right now.

Instead, I gave her my family address, hoping that she wouldn't come over one day unannounced, only for my parents to awkwardly explain that I live somewhere else.

In short, I kept piling up one lie after another.

During a break, I went to the bathroom to wash my face.

"...You gained +4 'Cunning' for all your lies yesterday to your parents, and your lies today. Do you feel good about yourself, papa?"

Aika-chan said, making me take out my phone and open the app. I watched her animated chibi model glaring at me.

"All superheroes need to lie about their secret identities, and their activities as a hero. That's standard, isn't it?"

"I suppose so… Oh, your 'Cunning' didn't increase this time. I guess you were telling the truth."

She was expecting me to lie to her, huh?

Well, that did happen before.

After school, there was going to be our first game tomorrow, so the coach told us to get some rest before our first game.

He was really trying to focus on resting us this time. I guess now that he saw what we were capable of in the last nationals, he focused on trying to get our bodies to last through the season, rather than pushing for skill development.

I used this extra time to go to Wiz's shop.

"Ah, boy. I suppose you're done with the preparations?"

Vanir said, when he saw me come in.

He was wearing an apron and was idly dusting a table, even though it was already clean.

I also noticed that there was a bottle of sugar water on the table.

"...You don't seem that excited, even though your dungeon is about done."

"Who said I'm not excited? Let's check it out, then…"

He said that, even though he wasn't smiling or celebrating as much as I thought he'd be.

We went through the dungeon door in his shop and I showed him his dungeon room.

"I see. You followed my plans exactly, huh?"

He looked around, eyeing his dungeon room. There was even a throne for him to sit on, right in front of the fake treasure chest.

"Yup. I followed your blueprint exactly… Did I miss something?"

"No… It's perfect, but…"

He sighed, while scratching his head.

"...Let me guess, you wish Wiz was here to see it too, huh?"

"...?! What kind of deluded ideas are going through your head, boy?!"

He turned to me and started yelling.

"You think I care about what that financially cursed shopkeeper does?! I finally achieved our dream… I mean, my dream without her always getting in the way! I should be happy!"

"Keyword is 'should be'."

"..."

He crossed his arms and said,

"Bah! This dungeon room design is all wrong! Boy, you did such a bad job designing it!"

"...You're the one who designed it, though."

"Terrible! It's simply terrible! …You know, that shopkeeper may have zero talent in business, but she did have an eye for design! Ahhh… I guess I have no choice but to have her return…"

What kind of one-man tsundere show is this?

It was as if he was trying to convince himself instead of me.

"Well, you're the all-seeing devil. Why don't you just look for her?"

"...There are such things as anti-scrying spells. Of course, that decrepit shopkeeper isn't dumb enough to not regularly cast those."

"Oh? Teach me those spells."

"Why would I?"

He sighed again and sat on his throne.

"...We have no choice. You will just have to get stronger, boy. Then, defeat the Demon King army and drag that foolish shopkeeper back to me! I mean, back to the shop!"

I chuckled, amused by all his justifications and excuses.

He could just say that he misses her.

"I do not!"

He read my mind and denied it.

"Well, that was always the plan, anyway. But in order to do that, we need to get this dungeon up and running."

Vanir grinned and rested his chin on his hand, crossing his legs.

"Then… I declare that Vanir's Dungeon is now officially open! Let all the misguided fools wander into this dungeon of deception! Then, I will taste their bitter tears! Moihahahaha!"

And so, the insanely difficult 'Vanir's Dungeon' was officially open to the public.

Let the tears and salt flow.

Chapter 51: Climbing This Hellish Mountain!

Part 1

Vanir started cackling in glee once I showed him the final design of our dungeon.

"Bwahaha! This is tremendous! You've outdone yourself, boy!"

If Vanir himself was laughing this much, you know that this dungeon design was just absolutely scummy.

Now, it was just time to set the bait.

We placed the new dungeon door right beside all the entrances to the original dungeon.

Except for these doors, we put Vanir's face on them.

People referred to me as the hero who beat all the Demon King generals so far, including Vanir.

So, they thought that Vanir has been 'tamed' after that, and left him alone.

But I was willing to bet there were those who still had a grudge against him.

They left him alone for now, but if given the chance, I was sure they would want to take revenge on him.

Vanir's Dungeon!

If you think you can take down the great Arch-Duke of Hell himself, come and enter!

Vanir happily went into his boss room, eager to absorb the bitter feelings of those who fell for this bait.

As for me, I observed everything from my personal room, watching the surveillance feed from the divine laptop.

Since the doors were set right beside the entrances, it didn't take long until curious app-users came in.

"Heh… So that masked guy finally showed his true colors!"
"I'll pay him back for ripping me off with that pager that was only useful once!"

"I'll make him give me a refund!"

Oh?

I thought they would be more mad about Vanir and Beldia assaulting them.

If Aqua didn't go around healing people and resurrecting them, they would have died.

But it seems more people are mad that Vanir's pagers were very expensive, yet didn't really see much use after the Shibuya conflict.

…Well, I also profited from that, but that was something they didn't need to know.

And so, I watched the app-users observe the first floor.

"Hm… It looks like a normal labyrinth."

"So it's just like the normal dungeon, huh?"

"Be careful. There might be strong monsters here."

There weren't any such monsters.

Well, I said that, but I saw Vanir in his room, fiddling around and creating something.

After a few minutes, what looked like a chibi Vanir hopped out and started walking out of the boss room.

I pressed the microphone toggle to speak to him through the dungeon speakers.

"Oi, Vanir, what are those? We agreed that no one will be harmed."

"Have faith, boy! These are Vanir dolls! They are puppets of mine that do my bidding. They will not harm those humans, and will only seek to play amusing pranks on them!"

"Do those things give EXP when they're killed?"

"Of course!"

…Hm, this might work out, actually.

Some app-users might not be interested in Vanir at all. But if there were Vanir dolls running around, they might be interested in earning EXP in a safe manner.

I watched as the Vanir dolls filled the floors I prepared.

"...Hm? Wait, isn't this the entrance again?"

"That's weird. Did we get lost?"

"Let's just try to pay more attention next time."

I chuckled as the app-users were already getting lost.

This dungeon functioned exactly like the minotaur's labyrinth.

But this dungeon didn't seek to teach some kind of lesson.

It was only meant to cause pure mental anguish.

Already, Vanir was laughing his ass off as he sat on his throne.

"Moihahaha! They're starting to get frustrated! This is a wonderful appetizer!"

I also chuckled, as I saw my Dungeon Points going up.

Having high-level app-users here was a good source of DP.

Especially with them uselessly going through the labyrinth.

"What?! We're back in the entrance again?!"

"This is stupid… Let's just break these walls down! Ara…?"

An app-user already got impatient and tried to destroy the wall with a magic sword.

"What the hell?! Are the walls made of Amantite, or something?! They're so hard!"

"Inferno…! Yeah… Even magic isn't working…"

Heh… Using all my points to unlock and buy adamantite walls was worth it.

However, the only problem was that I didn't have enough points to make more than one floor.

But here's the catch…

"Oh! I think that's the exit…!"

"Finally… We reached the second floor…"

The app-users said this after they saw a rather conspicuous sign that said 'Floor 2'.

However, what they didn't know was that they were still on the first floor.

You see, I was moving the construction of the dungeon around silently.

I changed the labyrinth walls to ensure that the app-users got lost. Then, I made a fake door that led them to the 'second floor'.

But that only led them to another area on the first floor.

Even that sign was fake.

They were just going around the first floor, while believing that they were steadily advancing in the dungeon.

Since I could watch them and see their behavior, I can see when they were just about to give up.

At the moment where it felt like they wanted to leave the dungeon, I would arrange the floor so that the door to the next level would soon appear in front of them.

Like a video game strategically switching from frustrating elements to dopamine-raising rewards, I played with their mental states in such a manner.

"Hmm… We're making good progress, but isn't it weird how there's no monsters?"

"Yeah… I was thinking that, too…"

Vanir knew what I was doing and chose that moment to make the Vanir dolls appear.

"...! It's that guy! There's small versions of that guy!"

"After them…!"

The app-users chased after the Vanir dolls.

Vanir led them around on a useless chase for thirty minutes, giving me even more DP.

"Oi, Vanir, you should let them kill it now. They might give up if they can't kill it."

"...Why are you so good at this? You're almost like a devil with how you can manipulate these humans…"

For some reason, Vanir was impressed with me.

He made the Vanir dolls slow down, allowing the app-users to get a killing blow.

"Whoa…! They give a lot of EXP!"

"Let's keep going! I might be able to level up if we kill a couple more!"

These guys were easily falling for our gameplay loop.

Soon, more app-users came in.

I had enough DP now to create a new floor.

It would be bad if the app-users encountered one another and shared information. They might find out that they're all still on the first floor.

And so, I created a new floor to make sure they won't run into each other.

"...Papa… You somehow get more villainous by the day. How do you manage to do it?"

Aika-chan said, watching the feed over my shoulder.

She was wearing my tracksuit, which was too big for her, so it looked like a dress. The sleeves also went down over her hands.
…I should probably buy more clothes for her.

"It's not like I'm harming them. I'm just selectively controlling their behaviors through technically-benign psychological tactics, which artificially modulates their dopamine-levels, so that they are heavily inclined to only take actions that lead to my personal benefit."

"...You sure went through a lot of rambling hoops, there."

She said, not sounding impressed at all.

"Ah, that's enough training data, I think."

I let the dungeon's general AI take over the rest of the dungeon's operations. It wasn't like I could spend all day monitoring it.

Although Vanir didn't seem to have that problem.

"By the way, is this dungeon's AI as intelligent as you?"

I asked Aika-chan, knowing that she mentioned the existence of 'other AI' before.

Of course, I knew that the other dungeon had an AI as well.

Aika-chan shook her head.

"Nope. They're quite limited AI. Unlike me, dungeons are capable of a lot of things, so they aren't given the ability to think outside of running the dungeon. Oh, but I can communicate with them, but it's just like talking to a child. They don't have the capacity to grow outside of that, nor do they have free will."

I sighed in relief when I heard that.

"...! This is so much fun! I'll let them explore this dungeon for days… Then finally, when they arrive at the boss room, I will allow them to slay me! Then when they open the treasure chest that is surely filled with unimaginable riches… Behold! I have returned! Moihahaha!"

Meanwhile, Vanir was having the time of his life.

"...Papa… Your bond with that devil has deepened."

Aika-chan said, with a heavy sigh.

I stared at her, after watching Vanir laughing to himself.

"Eh? Seriously?"

I thought my bond with him would never go up.

"Yup… I can't believe you're actually getting friendly with that devil!"

She still disapproved of Vanir, huh?

Well, she is her mother's daughter.

"Nevermind that and just show me the bond rank-up."

"...Don't wanna."

This girl…

However, rather than getting mad, I scooped her up into a hug.

"Aw… Pwease tell papa?"

"I-I won't give up! Even if papa is so sweet to me…! I don't care even if you kiss me on the cheek!"

She said, even though she lifted her cheek towards me.

I sighed and leaned down to give this spoiled child a little kiss.

"Ehe… Fine, if you insist!"

She sent the notification to my phone.

Your bond with Vanir has increased!

Vanir (Masked Devil), Bond Rank: 2

At Rank 2, you have done the impossible. No human has ever bonded with a devil before. Not even the devil himself is aware that a bond has formed. However, you have helped achieve Vanir's dreams, and you two are determined to get Wiz back. This has formed a bond between you two that has never been seen before.

Bond Reward: You learn the skill [Divination]!

[Divination] Skill Rank: 1, Active Skill (50 mp)

Obtain a crystal ball and offer 10,000 Yen or an item that is of the same or more value. After that, you may ask the crystal ball a question. It will then answer with either a simple sentence or a blurry picture, whichever you prefer. The money or item will disappear after the answer is given.

…This skill was pretty powerful, wasn't it?
It was expensive, both in terms of the 10,000 Yen sacrifice and the mana cost, but I'd say it's worth it.

I doubted that this would work on those who could protect against scrying and divination, though.

Such as Wiz or maybe even the Demon King.

Still, I was excited about this skill.

I thought that Vanir's bond reward would have some kind of curse or bad effect, but I was pleasantly surprised.

Part 2

Next, there was the matter of my 5 unspent skill points.

I laid in bed while assigning 1 of them to teleport, to max it out.

[Teleport] Skill Rank: 5 (MAX), Active Skill (20 mp)

Instantly teleports up to 4 targets to a marked location (3 marks total). You can teleport a target to an unmarked, random location if it is an inanimate object. If the target is a creature, they must be willing to teleport, otherwise, they will need to pass a 'Willpower' or 'Magic Power' check with advantage. If their 'Willpower' or 'Magic Power' surpasses yours by 20 points or more, the effects of the forced teleport will bounce back to you.

All of those skill points, and the skill effect never changed…

Well, it was already an incredibly powerful skill on its own.

And going from its initial 30 mp to 20 mp cost was honestly worth the investment.

There were 4 Skill Points left.

I was tempted to just spend it all on the new [Divination] skill.

But first, I wanted to see if it was worth it.

…How do I get a crystal ball, though?

"[Create Earth]! [Fireball]!"

First, I tried to make some glass.

…It was a rather crude attempt, but it was enough for my Rank 5 [Smithing].

The bits of crudely formed glass formed into a glass ball.

Then, I placed 10,000 Yen in front of it.

I activated the spell, and the ball started glowing.

"...Crystal ball, show me the Demon King."

I waited for it to reply.

The light started to shift into an image.

I then saw a muscular, blond man with his back turned to me. He also had a purple star on his shoulder, and he seems to be looking intently into his hand.

…Wait, isn't this just DIO?

"...Aika-chan, I'm not fighting the Demon King anymore."

"Hah?!"

I stood up and prepared to run away.

"Papa, what are you doing?!"

"I'm not fighting DIO, OK?! I'm sorry, I can't!"

"...Look at the crystal ball again!"

I looked back and saw that the image went away and words appeared.

The Demon King is protected with anti-scrying and divination wards, so I just showed you a picture of DIO instead.

Is this thing messing with me…?!

I was about to smash the ball.

…Well, I already knew it wouldn't work on the Demon King, but it was worth a shot.

I absorbed mana from the dungeon walls then tried again.

"...Can I defeat the Demon King?"

I waited for another few seconds after I paid another 10,000 Yen.

Bro just ran away after seeing a png of a gay vampire and thinks he can beat the Demon King. RIPBOZO.

"...Why is it talking like that?"

My brain hurt just from reading that sentence.

"This thing is useless."

Also, it was responding with more than one sentence.

Not like it was saying anything useful.

Aika-chan rubbed her chin thoughtfully.

"Well… The way it speaks is really rude, but it's answering you, isn't it?"

I suppose that it was giving a proper response.

It was basically saying that I can't beat the Demon King right now.

Well, I knew that already.

If I didn't have so much money, I would never ask this thing another question.

But I paid another 10,000 Yen.

"How can I defeat the Demon King?"

Aika-chan smiled and said,

"Oh, good thinking, papa!"

The light in the ball shifted.

…The best way is to gain the 'Hero' class.

Finally, it was saying something useful.

The light went dim. I guess I needed to pay again.

"Ah, I'll just max this skill out!"

Maybe I'll get better answers from it, too.

[Divination] Skill Rank: 5 (MAX), Active Skill (70 mp)

You no longer need to pay an offering when using the crystal ball to use its basic divination ability. You may ask the crystal ball a question. It will then answer the question with the information available to it, either verbally or with a vivid picture, according to your choice.

You can also offer 10,000 Yen, or an item with the same value, in order to ask a question to the crystal ball about other worlds. Doing so will cost 100 mp.

…The mana cost actually increased.

It was just like Megumin's explosion magic… The more powerful it gets, the more the mana cost increases.

Well, it was something like divination, so I suppose that shouldn't be a surprise.

At least now, I didn't have to deal with the money cost, unless I wanted to ask a question about the other worlds.

Not like I even had enough mana for that yet.

With that taken care of, I asked my next question,

"...How do I gain the 'Hero' class?"

The hero class is a class that can only be created by the one who is most likely to defeat the Demon King, or one who has already defeated the Demon King.

"...It hasn't been created yet?"

I looked at Aika-chan and she said,

"...There have been some heroes in the other world in the past… But I didn't think that this class would manifest in the system, as well."

So she didn't even know it was possible with the app-system.

Maybe it was like how I invented skills that Aika-chan didn't even know about.

"Who can create this class?"

You are the one who is most likely to become a hero.

So I really was a candidate to be a hero…

"How can I create the hero class?"

"...You only need to defeat one more Demon King general to create this class."

Just one more…

The thought that it would have to be Wiz made me feel sick.

Then again, there was still Wolbach around, as well as others we hadn't met yet.

That made me feel a bit better.

Part 3

I put the crystal ball away for now and moved on to my next chore.

The knight skills were straightforward enough to learn, since Megumin already showed me how to learn them.

After fifteen minutes, I unlocked all of them.

[Charge] Skill Rank: 1, Active Skill (5 mp)

When you have a running start, accumulate momentum. After the charge, if you hit a target, or several, they receive half of your Strength modifier (+10) as damage of the same type as your weapon. They are also knocked back 5-feet away from you. Both the damage and knockback ability is doubled when you are riding a mount.

[Challenge] Skill Rank: 1, Active Skill (5 mp)

Target 1 enemy to a duel. Your Bravery (65) will go against the target's Intuition when determining the success of this skill. The opponent will make this check at a disadvantage. They cannot break out of the challenge unless they successfully take away 20% of your current health bar.

[Inspire] Skill Rank: 1, Active Skill (10 mp)

Raise the morale of your teammates and increase Bravery among 5 people by +10 points, for 1 hour. Stamina regeneration is doubled while under the effects of this skill.

As for pledge, I already pledged myself to the Kingdom of Norse.

Aside from the exclusive skills, there were non-exclusive skills that the Knight class could learn that I was interested in.

Using DP, I summoned an adamantite wall in front of me.

Then using [Smithing], I created armor out of it.

Adamantite Plate Armor (Super Rare)

Full armor made of adamantite steel that covers every part of the body. Complete with a closed helmet. The parts that aren't covered by armor are still covered by adamantite chainmail. The armor has a red sheen and evokes the image of a gallant knight. Reduces incoming damage by +20. Applies a -20 penalty when sneaking and a 20% spell failure chance.

Sells for: 1,200,000 Yen

…What an upgrade from the half-plate.

Although those penalties to sneaking and spell chance conflicted with my build a lot.

I probably wasn't going to use this armor unless I needed to.

Still…

I looked at myself in the armor. It was perfectly fitted for my body and reflected the light with a red gleam.

…This thing is so badass!

I created a full-body mirror and did some poses.

"OK, I get it, papa, you're cool."

Aika-chan said, as she sat on my computer chair, narrowing her eyes at me.

You learned the [Heavy Armor] skill!

[Heavy Armor] Skill Rank: 1, Passive Skill

You are proficient in wearing heavy armor. Reduce sneaking penalty when wearing heavy armor by -5 and reduce spell chance failure by 5%.

…The heavy armor skill didn't eliminate the penalties altogether.

Well, that's the cost of heavy armor, I guess.

Then, I took out Beldia's sword and swung it around.

You learned the skill [Two-Handed Sword]!

[Two-Handed Sword] Skill Rank: 1, Passive Skill

You are proficient in using swords that require two hands to wield. You gain +10% weapon accuracy with attacks using two-handed swords.

I looked at the mirror again, this time posing with Beldia's sword.

"...So cool!"

Aika rolled her eyes and said,

"This is lame. I'm gonna play with Iris-chan now."
She left the dungeon room.

While looking at myself in the armor, I got a sudden desire to go to the original dungeon.

I mentioned this a while ago.

…The best part of becoming powerful was trying out that power on a bunch of weaklings.

And so, I went to the original dungeon.

I went to the first floor, equipped in my new armor and Beldia's sword.

"[Charge]! [Flash Attack]! [Wide Slash]!"

I blitzed towards a crowd of skeletons then swept Beldia's sword at them with a mighty swing. They crumbled to pieces.

Even though frontlining wasn't my main style, I wanted to enjoy the fantasy of being a heavily armored knight.

Shooting enemies from afar and with magic was probably more efficient.

But there was something cathartic about being in full-plate armor and swinging a big weapon around.

Still, I knew better than to kill too many monsters here on the first floor.

So I travelled up the floors, killing things along the way.

I didn't even need to worry about avoiding attacks, since nothing could damage me.

I stopped when I reached the desert biome boss room.

"...Time to head back."

My little power fantasy died as soon as I felt the heat.

…

…

When I returned home, I went to check up on my dungeon.

"Oh? 100 points already?"
More app-users came into the dungeon.

The AI was making floors as necessary and keeping app-users from getting lost, further increasing the DP yield.

Still, I made sure that the dungeon didn't spend too much DP, so I could actually spend some.

Now, as for what I wanted to spend it on…

I unlocked the most powerful golem the dungeon can buy.

The reason for this was to upgrade my golem EXP farm.

Simply put, those basic golems didn't provide enough EXP, even though they used up so much energy to make.

I also upgraded my pitfall trap. High level golems were much more durable, so I needed to make them drop from a higher place. I also created large spikes at the bottom, to ensure my traps were causing the final blow.

Unlocking the golems is one thing, but the problem was the energy source.

It might be hard to believe, but the reactors weren't enough.

It was just enough to get the Vanir Dungeon running, but adding that along with the new golem EXP farm was unsustainable.

So, I spent the rest of the DP on Coronatite.

Since I bought pure Coronatite, it wasn't as expensive as a Coronatite core.

But that wasn't a problem.

"[Smithing]!"

My maxed out [Smithing] allowed me to create a Coronatite Core using the raw Coronatite.

I also applied my new knowledge on Nuclear reactors when designing the core.

And so, I was able to produce a new energy source, along with the Nuclear reactors.

I created a new floor just for the golem EXP farm alone.

Watching from the observation deck, I watched as the giant golems fell to their death.

"Gack…!"

I tried not to choke as I saw that I gained 500 EXP just from one golem dying.

"..."

Eh? Isn't that around the same amount of EXP I got from killing a Goblin King?

I silently watched as the golems kept dropping.

Aika-chan returned, running all the way to the dungeon.

"Papa, I think I'm sick! My system is telling me you just leveled up?!"

…The change was so sudden that Aika-chan thought she was ill.

I leveled up, just like that.

OK, I'm not gonna lie.

This wasn't part of the plan.

Part 4

"Eh?! What is this ridiculous thing you made, papa?!"

Aika-chan said, as she watched the new golem trap.

To reduce the amount of time to the drop, I designed it so that there was no hallway.

Instead, I designed a dodecagonal pitfall trap.

On each side of the pit, there were runes set on that portion of the wall.

The golems will form out of those runes and immediately drop down into the trap.

In this way, 12 golems could drop down at once.

"Papa, no matter how you look at it, you went too far this time…!!! I was willing to overlook the nuclear reactors, and the human misery farm of a dungeon you just created with that devil, but this is too much! Who the heck gains 6,000 EXP every minute just from doing nothing!"

Since these golems were the highest level, it takes the runes about 1 minute to create them.

So 12 golems every minute produces 6,000 EXP.

"No… I didn't expect this to happen, either."

"At this rate, you'll…!"

All of a sudden, the golems stopped being produced.

"...Hm?"

"Oi! Boy! Put the power back on! Why are the lights off?!"

Vanir said, as if he was a tenant complaining to his landlord.

…I ran out of energy that quickly?

I rubbed my chin in thought.

"Are you telling me that having 12 max level golems being produced at the same time takes up so much energy?"

"You don't say?!"

Aika-chan said, waving her arms around in exasperation.

Once the golem farm stopped, the power in the dungeon went back on. I said,

"...I guess we need more energy."

"And how can we possibly produce more energy at this point! You've got a nuclear reactor and a legendary material that is pretty much a miniature sun! Where else can we get this energy that you want for your crazy schemes, papa?!"

I did some tests and I figured out that the limit was 2 minutes max for the golem farm.

Beyond that, the whole dungeon will shut down.

After those tests, I smiled and said,

"Well, I'll think about that tomorrow. We got a lot done today, so let's get some sleep."

"...I think that would be for the best."

We left the dungeon together.

…

…

In the morning, during breakfast, I said to Sena.

"Um… Does Japan happen to have more nuclear reactors to spare?"

She stared at me for a moment and said,

"You're asking that as if you were asking your neighbor if they have extra butter on hand. Of course not!"

I guess that was to be expected.

"…I don't suppose we can't make a Dyson Swarm anytime soon, huh?"

"OK, it's too early in the morning for this."

Sena proceeded to ignore me.

Mitsurugi raised his brow.

"What are you on about now, Satou? Also, it's unusual to see you at breakfast."

Well, I only came down here to ask Sena that question.

But since I was here anyway, I went to grab something to eat.

"We have that game after school. You ready, Satou?"

…To be honest, my mind was still on that farm.

"Oh, yeah. Sure."

"...You don't seem ready at all."

He sensed my inattention.

When I went to school, I asked Lia, who got better grades than me,

"How do you think one can produce a lot of energy, more specifically, infinite energy?"

"...What kind of anime did you watch last night?"

She said, surprised by my strange question.

My head was filled with thoughts about the golem farm all throughout the school day.

…She couldn't use that armor all that often thanks to its mana drain, but…

Mitsurugi finished off the rest of the Manticores with Gram.

Meanwhile, Iris, Yunyun and Rin all nodded together.

They pointed their hands to the skies and unleashed a torrent of lightning magic.

Many Manticores were slain, but many still remained. Some of them dove down, while others stayed to attack from afar.

I controlled the golem, which used Beldia's sword to slash down a manticore, but the others got through.

"[Flash]!"

I blinded the Manticores that got close.

Then the golem finished them off with [Triple Attack], the sword disappearing in a series of rapid strikes, which left the manticores beheaded.

As for the remaining manticores…

Megumin twirled her staff and pointed it at the sky.

"...Explosion!"

They were decimated in black smoke and brilliant flames that filled the sky.
