Chapter 52: A Park Trip For This Feuding Family!

Part 1

We retrieved the manticores that weren't blown up by Megumin's explosion.

After Megumin finished skinning them, we got some hide as well as wings and teeth from the manticores.

The teeth didn't really have much purpose aside from selling, so we just distributed those among the party.

I made these materials into items with my [Smithing].

Manticore Hide Bracers (Super Rare)

When equipped, the user gets the [Bow] skill if they don't have it already. Ranged weapon attacks deal an additional +1 damage if this is equipped.

Sells for: 320,000 Yen

I didn't really need this item, so I asked the others if they were interested in it.
"...I don't really have a use for that."

Darkness said, stating the obvious.

As for the others, there weren't any bow users as well.

Then, I looked at the golem.

…Can golems even use bows?

Well, if they get the [Bow] skill with this item… It should be fine, right?

With the wyvern materials from before, I made a new weapon.

Green Wyvern Crossbow (Super Rare)

A crossbow made from the bones and scales of a Green Wyvern. Enchanted with wind magic, the range of ammunition fired from this crossbow is extended by +20 feet. Ammunition fired from this bow also ignores the effects of wind spells that deter the flight of bolts.

Ammo: 30/30 (Wyvern Claw-tipped bolts)

We watched as the golem carried the crossbow.

"Ohhh…!"

With the bracers on, it naturally fired the crossbow.

Well, crossbows are easier to use than normal bows, but it was still impressive that the bracers gave the ability to allow even a mindless golem to fire crossbows with decent accuracy.

After that…

Not wanting to linger in this place any longer, we made it to the exit door, happily leaving this treacherous place behind.

"Ahh… I'm glad we made it out alive…"

Rin said, as we piled out of the door.

"That was rather fun, wasn't it!"

Iris said, clapping her hands together.

…Is this girl serious?

How bad were things back in her world that she thought any of that was fun?!

We set a mark on the 53rd floor before teleporting out of the dungeon. Only Iris had enough energy to keep going, but we were all dead tired.

I dissolved the golem, knowing that it would just disintegrate if I put it in my inventory, anyway, just like with the Vibrato Sword (temp name).

"Good job, everyone."

I said, as we split up when we got back to the mansion.

…That was way too difficult.

And I didn't even get that much EXP because I was splitting the kills with everyone.

You got 6,000 EXP from the golem farm! You have leveled up!

"..."

Meanwhile, I was getting the same amount of EXP from my golem farm, without risking my life.

"...That's it. I'm not going back to the dungeon again."

Any wide-eyed enthusiasm I had for exploring the dungeon was immediately extinguished.

Aika-chan, who came into the dungeon just as I went in, rolled her eyes at me. She was eating a popsicle as she sat on the bed, kicking her feet around.

"Eh, you always say things like that, papa. I learned not to take you seriously everytime."

"I'm serious this time! Why would I risk my life in that stupid dungeon, with boulders that try to flatten you as you climb up a mountain, and manticores that shoot spikes at you while flying around! Then if you retreat and make it back to the foot of the mountain, monsters from the forest will come out to finish you off!"

"...Hm… Well, that floor is rather challenging, but I'm sure it will get better!"

I wasn't convinced at all.

"If you need more firepower, how about I help you, papa?"

I stared at this small child.

"Haha, that's cute."

I said, pulling her cheeks.

"Hey! I know I look like a cutie patootie, but you should be reminded that I'm actually a super advanced AI with a golem body!"

"You just wanted to call yourself cute and super advanced, didn't you?"

Although, she did bring up a good point.

Now that I had create golem at rank 5, I could give her a more powerful body.

Actually, I could create a super rare golem and use [Golem Manipulation] to reduce its size. It wasn't like I could make any of the big golems in the dungeon, with its limited space.

Well, that was only possible if I maxed out [Golem Manipulation] first.

Good thing I had 4 skill points right now from leveling up.

I went ahead and spent those points on [Golem Manipulation].

[Golem Manipulation] Skill Rank: 5 (MAX), Active Skill (10 mp)

Manipulate the shape and form of a golem under your control. At rank 5, Super Rare golems and below can be affected.

Then, I made a Super Rare golem, but manipulated its shape to be about the same size as Aika-chan's current form.

Then I used smithing to create the synthetic material that made Aika-chan's body feel real.

"Ohh! Good job, papa! You have recreated my cute and wonderful self!"

"...You really inherited your mama's narcissism, huh?"

"Alright, I'm ready, so transfer me over, papa!"

I nodded and touched Aika-chan's current body. Using [Soul Transfer], I moved her over to the new one.

The new body started to move, with Aika-chan jumping around to test it out.

"Whoa, this body feels more powerful!"

She dashed around from side to side.

"Hmm… Since we made the form more compact, I guess the speed will also increase."

I said, while watching the agility Aika-chan was displaying.

"I can go zoom zoom now!"

I also gave Aika-chan the manticore bracers to put on, as well as the wyvern crossbow I made.

I made some targets for her to practice on, and just like with the golem from earlier, Aika was able to use the crossbow properly.

"Hmm… I wonder, can you unlock a class and stuff?"

I asked Aika-chan, while watching her practice.

"No, at least, not that I know of. I'm not a living thing, after all."

I guess that should have been obvious, but I wanted to make sure.

I had her use Beldia's Greatsword next.

"[Triple Attack]!"

"...?!!"

I washed as she diced the target in three pieces, with fast attacks that almost seemed to blend together in blurs of motion.

She was able to carry Beldia's Greatsword just fine, but it looked ridiculous having such a small body carry a sword like that.

Then again, such occurrences were normal in anime.

Part 2

I checked on Vanir's dungeon next.

It earned another 1,000 DP during the prime hours that Vanir was speaking about.

Perhaps it would have earned even more, as it seemed that the traffic increased, but I also set the dungeon AI to start producing loot and treasures.

This was all to maintain a steady inflow of visitors, so I was willing to spend those DP.

I was about to spend all of that DP on more coronatite ore.

"...?!"

Only to see the cost go up to 10,000 DP after I bought one for 1,000.

"What is with this inflation?!"

It would be a while until I could get another core, huh?

For now, I built a new coronatite core to power the golem farm.

…What should I do? It's not like I can get 10,000 DP anytime soon.

As more app-users come to Vanir's dungeon, the more floors will be needed, and the more energy the whole thing will require.

Not to mention replenishing loot and treasure.

I guess I have to think of other ways to create energy.

Also… Maybe I was a bit too ambitious with having 12 Super Rare golems drop at the same time.

For example, even just reducing the rarity to the Very Rare grade might save a lot of energy, and it will still give 100 EXP per drop.

It didn't matter how I got the EXP, as long as I was getting a lot of it.

It's not like I'm doing EV training here.

Now, as for the energy sources, I could think of a few ideas.

…But the problem is that the issue here isn't necessarily total power output, but the amount that could be generated all at once.

So even if I created a bunch of energy sources, I would still be limited in how many golems I could generate in one burst, otherwise I'd cause another shutdown in the dungeon.

I needed to keep that in mind.

As for the ideas I came up with…

I went back to the ever reliable basic earth golems.

Since they were at a common rarity, they were extremely energy efficient.

After all, even the manatite core I started out with was enough to reliably produce them for extended periods of time.

Then, I created many treadmills for them to run on, which were designed to generate electricity.

I created an entire floor which would eventually be filled with golems running endlessly on treadmills.

The energy would then be saved up and used exclusively for the golem EXP farm.

Next, I created a floor that was to be filled with wind turbines.

The dungeon can create artificial biomes using runes and magical items.

The original dungeon was even able to create an arctic environment.

And so, I waited for Vanir's dungeon to get some more DP, about a hundred or so, then spent that to unlock the wind runes.

I wasn't planning on creating too many, since I didn't have the DP for that.

I just wanted to try it first.

But then I thought of something while looking at the rune symbol etched on the wall.

"...Can't I just make a rune if I copy that exact design?"

I asked Aika-chan, who was jumping around the new floor, still enamored with the improved physical specs of her body.

She did an unnecessary frontflip before coming to my side and looking at the rune.

"You can try, but it needs to be a perfect copy. You also need to apply mana while making the rune."

So it was like high-level calligraphy with magic on top of it.

I looked at Aika-chan and said,

"Wait… Can't you just do it? You have perfect AI precision, as well as a golem body that will help with such tasks."

"Hm… I guess I can try…"

She pressed her finger into the dirt wall and traced the rune symbol at dazzling speed. Blue streaks of light followed the movement, as she embedded mana into the engraving.

When it was done, she created a perfect replica of the wind rune.

"My girl is a genius! A genius, I tell you!"

"Ehe! Aww… Papa keep praising me!"

I hugged Aika-chan and spun her around after she actually managed to create a rune symbol on her own.

"This is gonna save papa a lot of DP!"

"...You're talking like a father who is using his daughters' talents for profit now. Please stop."

Her joy disappeared in an instant. Then, she said,

"Hm… For some reason, papa learned a new skill… Eh?! Why is it papa when I'm the one who did all the work?!"

I looked at my phone to see what she was talking about.

[Create Elemental Rune] Skill Rank: 1, Passive Skill

At rank 1, you can create persistent elemental conditions related to fire, wind, earth and water. You do not need to spend mana when using this skill, however, one needs to be able to control and use mana as a prerequisite. After the rune symbol is engraved, it must spend at least ten minutes in its new location in order for the rune to be used.

…I guess since Aika-chan's body is technically a result of my skill, I was the one who unlocked this.

It was a good thing I had the Adventurer class equipped this time, or we would have never noticed this.

"This is unfair! So unfair!"

I rubbed the pouting Aika-chan's head.

"Don't you know, Aika-chan… That a child's accomplishments are their parents' accomplishments, too?"

"So mean! I'm not gonna talk to papa for the rest of the night!"

"Eh, wait, you gotta make these runes! Do your chores young lady, or I'm telling mama!"

"...?! Anything but that?! I'll behave!"

Along with the wind turbines, of course, I was also planning water turbines.

Things were looking good for the Vanir dungeon's energy sector.

Part 3

When I woke up the next morning…

You have gained 2 levels since last night!

…I guess the adjustments were effective.

With that, I'm now level 40.

If I didn't upgrade Aika-chan's golem body last night, I would have decided then and there to stop going to the original dungeon.

After all, there really wasn't much point in doing that anymore, with how efficient my golem farm is now.

Actually, even going to school seemed like a chore.

I forced myself to get out of bed.

As for my skill points, I thought it was a good idea to spend 4 of them on [Create Elemental Rune].

But before doing so, I consulted with the crystal ball.

That seems to be a good choice, I guess? You also get access to ice, electricity and light magic.

…! Wait, this is big!

I don't even need any gimmicks if I straight up have electricity and light!

I didn't hesitate in maxing out the skill.

[Create Elemental Rune] Skill Rank: 5, Passive Skill

At rank 5, you can create persistent elemental conditions related to fire, wind, earth, water, ice, electricity and light. You do not need to spend mana when using this skill, however, one needs to be able to control and use mana as a prerequisite. After the rune symbol is engraved, it must spend at least ten minutes in its new location in order for the rune to be used.

This will be very useful, for sure.

Since I was also getting a lot of usage on the golem skills, I went ahead and put the rest of the points on [Golem Scrying], after consulting with the crystal ball.

[Golem Scrying] Skill Rank: 5 (MAX), Active Skill (15 mp)

Share senses with one golem that you have created. At Rank 5, you can see and hear, as well as smell, feel and taste. You can also speak through the golem.

…Actually, can't I use this skill on Aika-chan?

I went ahead and tried it.

"Mnn! This omelet is good, Kyouya-san!"

Looking through her perspective, I saw Mitsurugi cooking breakfast for Aqua and Aika-chan.

"Yeah, I have to say you're a good cook!"

Aqua and Aika-chan were happily chowing down the food Mitsurugi was cooking.

He smiled and said,

"Hehe… If you have any requests, I'll cook it for you!"

"Ohh! I want pancakes, then!"

"Coming right up!"

…Doesn't this wholesome scene make them look like some kind of happy family?

Using this skill, I spoke through Aika-chan.

"...Ah, this omelet is too dry. Papa makes better omelets… W-Wait, I think papa is hacking me right now!"

I immediately got caught.

I broke the connection and took the dungeon door to school before they could confront me.

…

…

Later, after school.

During soccer practice, Mitsurugi said to me while we were doing passing drills,

"You really screwed up, Satou… Aika-chan is quite cross with you."

He was of course talking about the incident this morning.

"It was just a little prank. Why is she so mad?"

"...Well, how would you feel if someone took control of your body without your permission… Ah, wait."

He shut up once he realized that I was the victim of Serena's puppet spell.

"S-Still, you should know how awful it is for that to happen!"

"Yeah, you're right."

I decided to apologize when I got home.

You received +2 in Strength, Stamina, Speed and Dexterity!

After practice, I went straight home to apologize to Aika-chan.

"Hmph… If it isn't the cruel papa."

As if she was waiting for me to arrive, Aika-chan was in the living room, crossing her arms and pouting.

Not only that, she was completely dressed up in Aqua's hand-me-downs, and was even wearing a backpack.

…Was she planning on running away, or something?

Although, the whole point of running away is to leave before your parents can stop you.

I turned to Aqua, who was sitting on the couch and watching TV.

"Don't look at me, pal. You're the one who screwed up."

I guess that's true.

"He really did screw up! So much! Ahhh… The only way to fix this is if papa takes me to the amusement park right now!"

So that was why she was all dressed up and ready to go.

"And of course, mama will come along!"

She gestured to Aqua, who was wearing loungewear and was laying on her side on the couch.

…Is this one really in a state to go out?

"I got it, I got it. Is Disneyland fine?"

"...! Hm… I suppose Disneyland is fine…"

She seemed like she was making a compromise, even though she clearly looked excited as soon as I said the words 'Disneyland'.

"And of course, Mary-nee will join us!"

OK, that's a bit too much to ask for.

"...Aika-chan, please remember that your Mary-nee is actually a Tranquility Girl… I can't just bring her out to the general public."

"And why not!"

"'Coz she's a monster."

I said, as if this wasn't an obvious fact.

"Oh, well, my body is that of a golem, am I a monster too?! Huh, papa?!"

Geez, is this really what it's like to have a daughter?!

I have a feeling like I can't win at all!

I turned to Aqua, but I already knew she wasn't gonna take my side in all this.

"Kazuma, just give her what she wants."

I knew it.

And so, I summoned Mary.

"Ah, finally. Where's the computer?"

She became a complete internet addict.

"...Listen, your dear imouto has invited you to come with us to Disneyland."

"Ohh! That's where my favorite streamer went to last time! Sure, I'll come."

So she'd do anything as long as her favorite streamer did it?

It's good that she agreed, but...

There was a problem of how we could have Mary move around.

She was a plant, after all.

And then I realized that I could just create another golem body for her.

When I proposed this plan, she looked hesitant.

"Eh… A golem body? That sounds too weird… Can't you make a plant or wooden body?"

I guess that preferences and suitability might also be a challenge when it comes to putting souls in bodies.

Thankfully, I still had some leftover Bark People materials.

I combined the Bark People material along with the golem to produce a body that suited Mary more.

Then, I made the golem appear human with the [Smithing] skill, so that she'd blend in along with the populace.

"Oh…! Wait, this is easier to move around in! I also don't feel the need to consume the nutrients of humans anymore!"

Mary said, while she looked in wonder at her new body.

I suppose now that she was in a new body, her old instincts no longer applied to her.

"That's great, maybe we can… Gah, what are you doing?!"

I watched in horror as Mary went up to her old body and ripped its arm off.

"Hm? Well, I like my new body better, so I'll just recycle my old one."

"But…!"

Before I could stop her, opened her mouth and started eating her own arm.

"..."

Even though I was horrified, Aqua said,

"Don't worry! Tranquility Girls can reconvert the nutrients of their old body and reform it by growing fruits to create another one."

Mary nodded at that.

"Yes, that's how we reproduce, after all."

She really is still a plant monster, at the end of the day, so her biology and sense of ethics was completely different from mine.

That didn't make it any less unsettling, though.

After she consumed her old body, she said,

"Alright, so, are we ready to go?"

"Yeah, let's go! Let's take lots of pictures!"

…Such a wholesome scene ensued.

Even though I just witnessed that horrific scene earlier.

Part 4

"Here are your tickets, sir!"

A cheerful staff member handed me the admission tickets I paid for.

Overall, I ended up paying 33,000 Yen for admission.

"Ohhh! This place is so cool!"

Aika-chan said, running inside as soon as she was let in.

She saw a girl walking by who was wearing a Minnie Mouse ears headband.

"I want that! I totally want that!"

She said, pulling my sleeve excitedly.

"Right, right… Let's go to the gift store first, then."

"No… I want to try eating human food first!"

Mary said, as she looked at a churro stand while salivating.

These kids sure were demanding.

"Wait…! I wanna take a picture with the mascot first!"

I almost forgot about the third child, as Aqua pulled me towards a Mickey Mouse mascot.

Soon, all three girls were pulling on me.

"Oi! Calm down, will ya?! We'll go to the gift shop first, food second, then mascot last!"

"Why am I going last! This is so not fair!"

Aqua said, stomping her foot down.

"...Oi, you're the 'mama', right? So why don't you do the motherly thing and let your daughters go first!"

"Oh, that's right."

She actually forgot, huh?

Like I promised, we went to the gift store first. Even though this wasn't Mary or Aqua's first choice, and they were complaining about it earlier, they didn't hesitate to run over to the merchandise, snatching things up from the shelves.

"I want this one!"

"And this one!"

"This is soooo cute!"

…If I didn't have so much money, blood would be pouring out of my eyes right now.

In the end, they bought a Mickey Mouse headband for all four of us, plus a sweater for each of them, as well as plushies.

"Hah?!"

I yelled out when I saw the bill.

42,000 Yen just for this?!

What a total ripoff!

The merch is more expensive than the actual admission!

With shaking hands, I placed my phone on the reader and paid for the merch.

"Hehe, papa, you look cute like that!"

Aika-chan said, as I put on the Mickey Mouse headband they got for me.

They also had their headbands on and already put on the sweaters.

"OK, food next!"

Mary said, dragging us to the food court.

…I had a feeling I'd be spending a whole bunch of money today.

Once we were there, Mary ordered a veritable feast.

"I'll have pizza, fries, watermelon lemonade and a corndog!"

How much is she planning to eat?!

"Oh, that sounds good! I want the same thing!"

"Me too!"

These girls…!

"Ahem… Excuse me for a moment."

I smiled at the cashier, before taking the girls aside.

"...Are you all out of your mind?! Do you think I'm made out of money?! What makes you think you can just buy whatever you want, huh?!"

And I already knew that they'd make me buy more things for them later.

"Papa… Please stop pretending like you don't have 1.9 billion Yen in your bank account right now! You lousy cheapskate!"

The whole food court went silent at that, as heads turned towards us.

"Y-You really are an imaginative little girl, huh?! Why would I have that much money in my bank account?! I know, you're probably just hungry, right?! Order whatever you want!"

And so, they managed to get me to spend another 10,000 Yen on food.

I ate a fry as I watched them all gorging themselves on pizza, fries and corndogs.

"...Don't eat too much, or you'll throw up when we go on the rides later."

"About the rides, can't you just teleport us to the front of the line, papa?"

Aika-chan said, coming up with quite a despicable plan.

Aqua looked at Aika-chan with a frown and wagged her finger.

"Now, now, Aika-chan, that's not nice."

Oh, thank god the mother is finally putting her foot down.

"Your papa will instead spend money on exclusive passes that will let us skip the lines. Then all the poor people will have to watch as you cut the line ahead of them."

"Yay~! Thanks, papa!"

"Oi, what are you teaching our child?!"

Aqua shook her head and shrugged.

"I'm just teaching her how the world works, darling. Those with money can do whatever they want, while the brokies have no choice but to watch with envy. Ohohoho!"

I should have known she would say something like that.

And also, we were getting a lot of glares from the people around us.

"...Hurry up and eat. I don't wanna stay here any longer."

Even though they were oblivious to all the glares, I wasn't immune to those judgemental gazes at all.

Mary held up her hand as she bit into a pizza.

"Hold on a second. I want to savor this."

She said, even though she practically inhaled that slice of pizza.

Once they were done eating, we went outside to look for a mascot.

"Oh, Goofy is right there! Quick, get him!"

Aqua said, leading the charge as the girls followed after her.

The poor person in the Goofy costume was startled as three girls suddenly swarmed him out of nowhere.

I brought out my phone and took pictures, but while I was doing so, the camera app zoomed in and changed angles.

"...Your camera work is bad, papa, let me take over."

Aika-chan said, controlling my phone while posing for her own picture.

Seeing her posing while she bossed me around through the phone… My daughter sure is a troublesome one.

After taking the pictures, we headed to the actual rides next.

"Hurry up and pay for those things that will let us skip the lines, papa! I don't want to breathe the same air as the poor people!"

I covered Aika-chan's mouth.

"...Oi, if you don't want to embarrass papa anymore, then stop saying that stuff about poor people!"

"Eh? What's papa gonna do about it?"

I narrowed my eyes at her and said,

"I'll give you a good spanking later if you don't behave, how about that?!"

"B-But I was just copying what mama said earlier!"

"Then I'll give her a spanking, too!"

Aqua went to me this time, both of them teary eyed.

"I'm sorry, Kazuma! I just got carried away by the atmosphere!"

After some threats, they both promised to behave.

Part 5

We went on several rides. I had them promise to behave. In exchange, I'd buy those lightning passes that let us skip the lines.

To their credit, they started behaving and didn't act out, like they promised.

After a couple hours, we took a break from the rides, with Aqua and Aika wanting to get some drinks.

I sat on a bench with Mary. I asked,

"So, how's your new body?"

She looked at her hand, turning it over.

"...It's different. I don't need to absorb nutrients now… And I'm no longer looking at humans as walking food sources."

That was the main positive take away from all of this.

"And well… It's fun… All of this."

She gestured around at the park.

"...I spent my whole life in the dungeon. Meeting my beloved was fun and all, but then he betrayed me. I do have to admit that life has been more fun now after I met you."

I didn't expect to hear this from Mary, of all people.

Our relationship at the start was purely one of self-interest. Mary wanted to survive, and I wanted to make use of her nature as a monster.

But now… Well, here we are, in Disneyland, enjoying each other's company, as a family.

I slowly placed my hand on her head, rubbing it.

After a while, she smiled and leaned her head against my hand.

"So… Do I really have to call you 'papa' now and stuff?"

She said, once I stopped rubbing her head.

"Well… Not if you think it's weird."

"It's not that weird… But I totally thought that we'd end up mating at one point, so it's weird in that respect."

"Hah?! What gave you that idea?!"

"Well, you were awfully kind to me even if I'm just a monster… And with my beloved gone… I totally thought that you were looking to mate with me."

"I'm pretty sure I told you early on that I wasn't!"

"I thought that was just you hesitating as a human who sees an issue with cross-breeding."

"...For the sake of our relationship moving forward, I'm gonna pretend you didn't say that."

She raised her brow at me.

"Ehh… Is this really that awkward to talk about? Mating is natural, isn't it?"

"For humans, we have such things as modesty."

"Yeah, I always found that weird. To monsters, all we think about is eating, survival and reproduction."

They were like intelligent animals, in that sense.

"Well, now that you have a new body, you should think more about having modesty, like a normal human…"

"So you mean I can't pick up random guys and ask them to mate with me?"

"...No daughter of mine is gonna sleep around like that!"

"You mean like you?"

"Urk…"

She brought up the perfect counter.

"Do as I say, not as I do."

"That sounds like the perfect cop-out."

"...Do whatever you want."

In the end, I acquiesced to her.

Your bond with Mary has deepened!

Mary (Tranquility Girl), Bond Rank: 6

At Rank 6, you have given Mary a new body, as well as new perspectives and instincts that come along with it. You are both progressing in your relationship as father and daughter, although Mary still has a lot to learn about what that truly means. You have also given her permission to mate with other humans, although you will need to teach her about restraint and social norms. So I didn't really need this item.

There was a dumbass in this house who put all her skill points on party skills.

I found Aqua downstairs, clinking a sake bottle with Sena.

"We don't need men, Aqua-san! You and I… Us women are all we need!"

"You got that right! I have a man, though."

"Die!"

"Ack?!"

Sena started shaking Aqua.

How drunk were they to get to this point?

"Oi, Aqua. I found the perfect item for you…"

"Oh? Wanna try that vibrator thing Darkness mentioned the other day?"

What the hell was she on about?!

Sena had a dark look on her face.

"Talking about such things to a virgin… You two are despicable! Normies should die! Die! Blow up and die!"

She was talking exactly like me before I got laid.

"Sena… You don't have the right to talk like that when I already told you I'm always available…"

She blushed and looked down.

"A-Ah, right. Um, I'll consider it… So please continue to keep an open mind!"

She immediately sobered up.

Sena was the worst kind of Christmas cake.

She was the type of woman who had the kind of body all men would find attractive, yet she complains about not finding a man.

Then when a man shows interest, she acts like some shy schoolgirl, despite being in her 20s.

"Anyway, Aqua, there's this item that respecs your skills…"

"Oh, good idea! Now I can keep increasing my party skills!"

"Wrong! You got the completely wrong idea!"

I was, of course, talking about her luck.

Since we were aiming to take the gambler skill, I wanted Aqua to allocate those skill points to increase her luck.

Even if her intelligence couldn't be increased unless she had the Arch-Wizard class, just improving her abysmal luck should surely improve our battle encounters from here on.

"You know, I was thinking about something, Kazuma… Isn't my low luck a part of my personality? It's a part of my charm, right? If we were to get rid of that, then who would I really be?"

"...A girl who won't get us killed?! A girl who doesn't pull out a chicken egg from a loot box?!"

"Chicken egg?! What chicken egg are you referring to?! I hope you're not talking about Zell!"

"That's exactly right! I'm talking about Emperor Yakitori! Where is that delicious nugget, anyway?! I wanna dip him in some barbeque sauce!"

"Child abuse! This is child abuse! Fine, I'll do whatever you want, just don't even think about harming my poor baby!"

Sena stared at us as she sipped her sake.

"...Out of context, this conversation sounds really bad."

I bet it did.

Part 5

Aqua asked me to hold off on re-specing her party skill points until we got the Gambler class.

She said that she wanted to say goodbye to her darlings.

Whatever that meant.

Then I went back to my room to do my next task, which was to allocate my skill points.

I had 36 skill points to spend.

"Oh, mighty crystal ball…!"

Hey, can you stop using me as a min-max tool already?

It started to complain.

As if this inanimate object had the right to complain.

It was just lucky that I hadn't smashed it by now for its constant rude remarks.

For now, I upgraded [Trap Detection] and [Disarm Trap].

I couldn't just rely on the rank 1 versions anymore with how far we were advancing in the dungeon.

[Trap Detection] Skill Rank: 5 (MAX), Passive Skill

You can now sense traps within a 35-foot radius around you. Your 'Intuition' (106) score determines the success rate of discovering traps. You can detect traps of 'Master' grade.

[Disarm Trap] Skill Rank: 5 (MAX), Passive Skill

You are proficient in disarming traps of a 'Master' grade. Success of disarming depends on your Dexterity (115).

The upgraded versions didn't seem like huge upgrades, but it was the safety factor that mattered.

After all, it didn't matter how much damage I could put out if we all died in a trap I couldn't detect or disarm.

And since we were on to traps…

"Hey, mighty crystal ball, does [Create Trap] work like [Smithing]?"

In the sense that I can create powerful traps right away at max level…

Yeah, it does, but the enemy can just avoid the trap if they see it being made in front of them.

"...How do you avoid a pitfall that just suddenly appears beneath them, though?"

Were they going to start running in the air like in Looney Tunes?

You make a good point. Yeah, that can work. Especially since you can make 'Master' grade traps at rank 5.

I went ahead and spent skill points on that, then.

[Create Trap] Skill Rank: 5 (MAX), Active Skill (X mp)

You can now make traps of 'Master' grade! The enemy's 'Intuition' determines the success rate of them discovering your trap. Creating a master grade trap costs 10 mp for each minute you spend preparing it. For each minute that passes, the 'Intuition' check required increases in difficulty by +10.

These crafting skills were so OP. No one probably bothered to level them up aside from those with skills like Blacksmith. But those guys don't even fight, so they have no use for the combat application of their skills.

And there was the new crafting skill that I got, [Tailor].

"What kind of bonuses would clothes from the maxed out [Tailor] skill give?"

Clothes of a 'Legendary' variety would of course give powerful effects, from increased mana regeneration, magic power or strength boosts. It depends on the material that is used.

"Material, like silk and such?"

No, more like silk produced from colossal earthworms.

"What the hell is a colossal earthworm?!"

It is a boss monster that appears in level 88.

So something that I wouldn't want to deal with.

"Um… Are there weaker monsters that I can make clothes out of?"

Yes, you can make above average clothing from the silk of the sandworms you encountered on the 3rd boss floor.

Those giant things only produced an above average grade?

I checked the divine laptop and saw that the dungeon could teleport in these worms at a fairly low price.

Even if I was on a DP budget thanks to the construction of Norse, Vanir's dungeon was steadily increasing its victims, I mean, visitors.

That meant that I still had a fairly decent supply of DP.

I went ahead and put skill points into the [Tailor] skill, anyway. Since clothes could be worn under armor, it was a good way to raise our battle potential at little cost.

[Tailor] Skill Rank: 5 (MAX), Active Skill (X mp)

You can create, combine and repair clothing of a 'Legendary' grade. The success of this skill is determined by your Creativity (114), although doing so will cost 20 mp. Combining compatible clothing of the 'Legendary' grade might yield a clothing of 'Artifact' grade, although the chances of success are very low (1%). If you fail to create clothing in this way, you will lose 80 mana points, even if this skill requires none. Attempting to do so, regardless of success, will cost you 30 mp.

Since I wanted to start my silk production right away, I teleported some of those sandworms to a separate floor.

I then used my new [Create Trap] skill to have the worms bound by huge steel cuffs that went around their body, using the material of the floor.

I also used [Smithing] skill to have tubes supplying the worms with food and water, as well as a mechanism that collects the silk.

…Looking at them like this, it seemed like a cruel operation was taking place.

Despite leveling four skills already, I still had 20 points left over.

Since I went ahead and raised my [Cooking] skills to gain more stat bonuses, I decided that I might as well raise the [Gardening] skill.

It could even produce medicinal plants, which ties in with my maxed out [Medicine] skill.

[Gardening] Skill Rank: 5 (MAX), Passive Skill

When you plant produce and harvest it, consuming the produce will give you a range of stat benefits, the final yield of which depends on your Intuition (106). Produce will also grow 4x faster than usual.

Common seeds: +1-5 stat yield depending on produce

Very Rare seeds: +5-10 stat yield depending on produce

Legendary seeds: +10-15 stat yield depending on produce

I see… So since my intuition is high, I will probably get the max yield out of those ranges.

The rarity of the seeds also seems fixed at certain tiers.

To start with, I produced some more seeds with the divine laptop, starting at common seeds, since Very Rare seeds were extremely expensive.

Not to mention legendary seeds.

I then asked the ball if it was fine to just let the golems sow the seeds, if it'll count as me doing it.

There are limits to the amount of bullshit you can pull, you know that?

This guy was way too annoying.

I set the gardening aside for now as I continued with the Skill Points allocation.

Since the golem skills have produced fantastic results so far, I asked the crystal ball about [Golem Transmutation].

At rank 5, the damage of transmuted golems increases by +4.

…It wasn't really as big of an upgrade as I thought.

Well, the damage was good, but there wasn't any lack of damage to go around, especially with Aika-chan and Mary were now in parties that had OP members like Iris and Mitsurugi in it.

I withheld upgrading that for now.

Looking at the rest of my skills, well, I couldn't find much else to invest in, even after I asked the crystal ball.

And so, I just started to complete maxing out the skills that already had some points into them.

[One-handed Sword] Skill Rank: 5 (MAX), Passive Skill

You are proficient in using swords that require one hand to wield. You gain +50% weapon accuracy with attacks using one-handed swords and +4 damage.

[Spear] Skill Rank: 5 (MAX), Passive Skill

You are proficient in using spears. You gain +50% weapon accuracy with attacks using spears and +4 to damage using spears.

When I was done upgrading…

You have unlocked the Swordmaster advanced class and the Lancer specialized class!

…Eh?

The requirements to unlock the Swordmaster class are 90 Strength, 95 Stamina, 90 Health and a Rank 5 [Sword] skill!

The requirements to unlock the Lancer class are 80 Strength, 80 Stamina, 80 Health, and a Rank 5 [Spear] skill!

Unlocking the Lancer class has also made you available for a promotion to Cavalier!

Requirements for Cavalier: 90 Strength, 95 Stamina, 90 Dexterity, Rank 5 [Spear] and Rank 5 [Riding].

I didn't even intend to, but I ended up locking an advanced class and a specialized class.

…I don't really rely on those two weapons that much these days, though.

Especially since I'm on the higher floors now.

Still, I looked at the skills I could get with each class.

With the Swordmaster class, I could raise Strength, Stamina and Health using skill points.

There was also a feature similar to [Archery Rank-Up] called [Sword Rank-Up] that lets me raise sword related skills above Rank 5.

Aside from that, there were new attack skills like [Rune of Saber], [Triple Attack], [Sonic Strike] and [Mighty Slash].

There was one other skill that intrigued me, though. It was called [Surpass Limits].

This skill increases one's physical abilities for a short period of time, at the cost of heavy stamina drain, and requires one to sacrifice their health as well.

Basically, it was an all-or-nothing skill that was meant to sacrifice oneself for the sake of a power-up.

I could imagine the protagonist of an anime using this skill in the final boss fight.

Mitsurugi had this skill, too, but rarely felt the need to use it for its heavy downsides.

But unlike Mitsurugi, I had the Drain Touch skill, so it wasn't such a big sacrifice for me.

Also, isn't this skill just kaioken?

"Oi, why didn't you sell me to unlock Swordmaster?"

I said to the crystal ball.

…That class doesn't really suit your build. Well, I'm sure you'll find some way to abuse it.

This thing was already getting familiar with me.

I ended up switching to Swordmaster. It was an advanced class, anyway, so there was no sense in not taking a dip.

And levels come so easily nowadays that I could just switch in and out of these classes.

As for the rest of the skill points, I saved them for now, just in case I needed to level up any of the new class skills.

Part 6

The next day, I went to school in person.

I left the three clones to study at home.

"Morning, Kazuma-kun…"

When Lia saw me come in, she looked at me closely.

Could it be that she noticed something?

"...Hm… I'm glad you're feeling better today."

She really did sense something was off!

I felt a bit touched, knowing that my friends were familiar with me to sense if I was replaced by a clone.

"Thank you, Lia. You're such a good friend."

She looked at me strangely.

"I mean, I know I am, but what's this about?"

I simply patted her shoulder.

Since it was Saturday, it was only a half-day.

I finished lunch with Darkness and Rin, before heading to soccer practice. .

I needed to make up for my clone's mistakes and put in much harder effort than before, not only on the skill development side, but also during the runs.

Although I didn't even get tired after running several laps around the pitch.

Compared to the beginning, when I couldn't even complete that quest to run for 30 minutes…

I smiled fondly at those memories.

Only to realize that my stats weren't going up at all.

"..."

I really hit a big wall now, huh?

Well, I wasn't even getting tired from running anymore.

I guess a superhuman body needs superhuman level training in order to improve it.

…My work ethic had increased a lot recently, but I wasn't sure if I could handle the typical shounen protagonist's training regimen.

When practice was over, I approached Mitsurugi. Since he was a swordmaster, I wanted to ask him for advice.

"Eh? You're a swordmaster now, Kazuma? You wanna join the club?"

I couldn't tell if he was serious or not, until he pulled out a business card.

It was an actual club.

"...What do you even do in this club?"

"Exchange information, socialize, things like that."

"No, I'm fine. Do all advanced classes have these kinds of clubs?"

"Yeah, I've seen them around in app-user forums."

This seemed like a huge waste of time.

"In terms of advice I can give you… Well, I'd say that it's best to just invest all your skill points in increasing your sword and armor skill, as well as stat gains. After that, you can also increase the rank of Rune of Saber. The other skill points you can add to the other skills only when those are prioritized."

"I see. So that's why you just keep spamming the same move over and over."

"...You make it seem like I'm a one-dimensional type of character! I use [Overwhelm] and [Rune Thief] sometimes, too!"

Still, Mitsurugi's skill point spread was normally the best route to go.

Investing your skill points in a bunch of random skills is usually inefficient. I was the anomaly here.

And as such, this advice was pretty useless to me.

There's no point in dedicating myself to the Swordmaster build, anyway, since both Iris and Mitsurugi had it.

Also, he didn't even mention [Surpass Limits] at all.

I guess that really was seen as an inefficient skill by the other Swordmasters.

I still had the rest of the afternoon available, so I went to the naginata club room to see if Darkness and Lia were still there.

As expected, they were also finishing up as well.

"Oh, Kazuma-kun. Sorry, we already finished. I can go for a spar right now if you want, though!"

Terada-senpai said, when he saw me.

"I'm fine. Call me up if you need me in any tournaments, though."

"Will do!"

Darkness smiled at me and said,

"Kazuma! I managed to win a match against Lia today!"

Lia chuckled and gave a thumb up to Darkness.

"It's because you've been working hard, Darkness."

They shared a small chuckle.

I bet Lia won 10 times to Darkness's one victory, though.

"By the way, Kazuma…"

Lia said, giving me a weak smile as she pressed her fingers together.

I already knew this was gonna be about her room again.

"I got it."

"...The fact you already know what I'm talking about… Well, it's cool that you know me so well now, but it also makes me feel a bit guilty."

At least she was aware of it.

…

…

After I arrived at Lia's place, I stared at all the trash in her room.

"..."

How did it get this bad already?!

I turned to Lia and said,

"We're really good friends now, right?"

She gave me a small smile.

"Yup."

"You don't need to invent reasons for me to come over, you know?"

"I'm not doing this on purpose! It just happened!"

"I don't buy that one bit! You're way too smart and responsible to be this sloppy! It's not even possible!"

And so, I set about the task of cleaning her room.

Once I finally finished, Lia put her hands together.

"Sorry! I'll make it up to you! Here's the premium Hokkaido pudding I was saving to reward myself!"

She presented the pudding to me as if it was a precious artifact.

As if I could accept it after she said all that.

"Nah, you can have it."

"Kazuma, you're the best!"

She said, giving me a hug, before pulling away while giving a weak chuckle and averting her eyes.

"Sorry, I got too excited there."

I smiled and said,

"I said before that I won't get weird ideas, right?"

The old me would be trying to hook up with a girl like Lia by any means possible.

Not only was she my favorite idol even before I discovered her secret, she was also an incredibly beautiful girl.

But right now, I've mellowed down.

I mean, I'm even a father now.

So I didn't get any weird thoughts as I pulled her in for a friendly hug.

She eventually hugged me again, smiling as she rested her chin against my shoulder.

"Kazuma, you're the best, you know that?"

"I know!"

"You're so sure of yourself."

The hug lingered, perhaps a beat longer than a friendly hug, before Lia separated.

"Hey, Kazuma…"

She looked up at me nervously.

…Eh? Was this gonna be a confession?

Even though I already resolved to stay friends with her?!

…I guess my high charisma really had an effect on her after all!

No, there really was a serious mood forming.

The tension kept building.

"Kazuma… Actually, I…"

She took a deep breath, then stared me in the eyes.

"...I'm part of an idol group."

Chapter 55: A Revelation From This Idol!

Part 1

"...I'm part of an idol group."

Lia said, repeating herself.

"Yeah, I heard you."

Why did she repeat herself?

She was like an anime character summarizing what happened in the last episode.

"Well… You weren't responding, so… I guess it's a shock, huh?"

No, I wasn't responding because I knew all along.

I was just trying to decide whether I should keep playing like an oblivious dumbass or tell her the truth.

…Of course I had to tell her the truth, right?

It wasn't like I wanted to lie to her all this time, there just wasn't a good opportunity to actually say it.

But what if she hates me for keeping it to myself?

If that's really the case, then I should just man up and accept what's coming to me.

"Lia… Um… I'll just say it… I knew the whole time."
"Eh?! H-How did you know?!"

She exclaimed in schock.

Oi… Did she really think I was stupid?!

Even without the app, there were so many instances where a normal person would have picked up on it, right?!

Still, I kept going with my confession.

I rubbed the back of my head and said,

"...Actually, I've been a fan of you and Axel Hearts this whole time. Sorry, I didn't tell you the truth."

I bowed to her in apology.

She didn't respond, so I looked up and saw that she had her hand over her mouth.

"I-I see…"

Crap… I blew it.

From her early bond descriptions, I knew that Lia was interested in me as a friend, because I had nothing to do with her idol activities.

She saw me as a reprieve from her secret identity.

But now, she just found out that I was a fan who pretended not to know about her idol life.

That was… kinda creepy, wasn't it?

For all she knew, I could have been a stalker. This could have all been an elaborate plan to get closer to my favorite idol, to be invited to her house…

"Hah… So it's like that, huh…? Sorry, I put you in a tough position, didn't I?"

To my surprise, she bowed to me.

She was the one apologizing.

"No… It was my fault for telling you."

"And what were you gonna say? You'd tell your classmate that you know they're an idol?"

…I guess that was kind of an impossible topic to bring up.

"No… But I could have said something as we got closer."

She chuckled and said,

"Yeah, you could have. But I could have been honest way earlier, too. So… I guess we're both to blame? Or maybe it's better to say that no one is to blame."

She rubbed her chin in contemplation.

…She really was so mature.

It was hard to think that we were the same age.

I got that feeling from Rin, too.

Although Rin is a younger girl.

Maybe I'm just the immature one.

"So, uh… What now?"

I asked, tentatively, not sure how to proceed from this friendship onwards.

She gave me an uneasy smile.

"I don't know… I mean, there aren't a lot of people who face this kinda situation, huh?"

I chuckled, seeing her having such a hard time finding her words.

Not like I wasn't on the same boat.

"...Isn't it weird to know that I'm your fan?"

She narrowed her eyes at me.

"That depends… How much of a fan are you?"

She was trying to gauge my power level.

"...I know all your solo verses by heart. I have a picture of all of your different outfit combos on my phone. I'm also RNGod in the Lia Fan Club forum."

She blinked her eyes and said,

"Eh? Wait… That's a bit more than I expected."

I didn't expect to feel this embarrassed. I looked down at my feet while blushing.

Gahh! I shouldn't have said all that!

If I was just a casual fan, this wouldn't be such a big deal.

But I pretty much just outed myself as the biggest Lia fanboy ever!

OK, fine, I'll admit it.

I'm an idol otaku, OK?!

And Lia is my oshi!

I mean, what do you expect from a former NEET like me?

You think I wouldn't have an oshi or two?!

I was even into Vtubers during that time!

"W-Wait, Kazuma! This is starting to feel like a love confession, isn't it?!"

She blushed and covered her chest, backing away.

"...Since when?! Don't worry, a true idol otaku always keeps their distance away from their oshi!"

"Distance, huh?! Even though you've been to my house three times now… And we even hugged and cuddled and held hands!"

OK, now I was really looking like a stalker otaku.

"Wait, Lia, you said that I'm not at fault, right? So why are you backing away from me like that!"

"That was before I found out you were that infamous RNGod in the forums! I remember you! You're that guy who started so many thirst threads about me on the forum! You were always on the verge of being banned! But you had so many connections among the other fans, and were one of the original fans of Axel Hearts. The mods could never bring themselves to ban you! New members would complain because others kept getting banned for the same things you were doing, but you were untouchable because of the favoritism of the mods!"

…I didn't know that Lia was that involved in the fan forum.

Good for her. Not all idols care about what their fans are doing to this extent.

Or maybe she was just a chronic egosurfer.

"T-That was my dark past, OK?! I'm sorry for that, but I'm a changed man!"

I almost blurted out, 'I'm a father now!', but that would just make things more complicated.

"...Your dark past… Ah, that was probably during the time when you were hospitalized, right? Sorry… I guess you did have a good reason… Maybe you felt lonely?"

Lia remembered my lie about being sick during my NEET period.

And she was looking at me with pity now, even holding my hand.

Another one of my lies was coming back to bite me.

No wonder why my Cunning stat is so high, I'm just a filthy liar!

I averted my eyes and said,

"Um… I wasn't really sick…"

"Hah?"

She gave me a stony expression while letting go of my hand.

"...I just had the teacher give that excuse for me. In truth, I was just a NEET that whole time because of a childhood trauma…"

"Well… Childhood trauma is no joke… What happened?"

I turned away and said,

"I saw my childhood friend who I promised to marry going home one day in the back of a senpai's bike."

Lia had a sympathetic look and said,

"I'm sorry that happened to you…"

"Buuuut…"

"..."

Another stony expression came over her face as I added more to the story.

"...It turns out that childhood trauma was based on a misunderstanding by me, and I reconciled with my childhood friend who wasn't even to blame for it… Haha…"

"W-Well, misunderstandings happen."

"That senpai of hers was actually her cousin… And he wasn't even a senpai. He was younger than me. He just had a growth spurt."

Lia grit her teeth, obviously becoming annoyed, but keeping her emotions in check.

"Y-You couldn't have known…"

"...Also, I was the one who taught that cousin of hers how to ride a bike… Haha. Ironic, right?"

"..."

Ah, she was looking at me like I was garbage.

"O-Oi! Even if the misunderstanding is my fault, I was seriously heartbroken during that time! Axel Hearts was one of the things that kept me afloat, so…"

"...I can understand that, but what was with all the lewd threads about me?"

My face went completely red.

"Well, I was horny, and I had a lot of time, so…"

"D-Don't tell me you've… You know… To me before…"

I stared her right in the eyes.

"That's a given, isn't it?"

If she was asking 'have you jerked off to me before?'.

I mean, the answer was obvious.

I was even about to request Lia in the succubus shop before.

But Vanir showed up to sign autographs for the succubi and interrupted me.

"Kazuma! Even if this is all true, you should have just kept this to yourself!"

She covered her face as an insane blush came on.

"Hah?! We both agreed to tell each other the truth, right?! You can't blame me if you don't like the truth! And besides, even if I wasn't a fan of you, I was gonna do that eventually! You think that guys don't use their attractive female friends as material?!"

"No way! There's no way guys are horny enough to do that!"

"Of course we are! Don't be so naive! Also, you should know that all your fans use you as material, too!"

"OK, stop talking about that! If you want to preserve what little is left of my respect for you, stop it!"

We were both out of breath at the end of my tirade.

…Ah, another girl who was disillusioned about me.

Just like with Rin, who viewed me as a cool, reliable senpai at the start, but now she was aware of all my flaws.

And now Lia was the same.

But to my surprise, Lia chuckled and said,

"Geez… How can we be 'just friends' now, huh?"

She said, while taking my hand again.

I was surprised by the gesture, but I was also relieved that she did it.

We eventually found ourselves sitting on her bed while holding hands.

…I honestly couldn't tell what the mood was.

Lia was just staring in contemplation with a faraway look.

After a while, she said,

"To be honest, I'm really confused about us right now, Kazuma."

"Well… That's understandable."

Are we an idol and fan, or are we friends?

The lines were all blurring.

Most of my relationships so far have been pretty straightforward.

With Lia, I didn't even know what I wanted with her.

She was so fun to be with, and I really did want to be friends with her.

But at the same time, how can I be 'just friends' with someone I was clearly attracted to, whose idol persona I was a huge fan of?

She was right, how can we stay as 'just friends' at this rate?

"How about this? What if Kazuma becomes 'More than a fan, less than a friend'?"

"...Why am I getting a demotion?"

Also, that phrase gave me a kind of nostalgic feeling, for some reason.

"Well, then… What do you think we should do?"

I rubbed the back of my head, then said,

"How about we just see where this goes?"

It was a generic and borderline irresponsible response, but…

The fact that I could even talk to her like this, and how we could share secrets like this, it already showed me that Lia and I had something special.

How special was it? Was it a romantic kind of special, or something completely platonic?

I had no idea.

But that didn't mean that I'd stop seeing her just because of some confusion.

She ended up smiling as she leaned her head on my shoulder.

"Yeah… You're right."

And so, it felt like things went back to normal again.

"...So, uh… Can you change into your idol outfit right now…?"

"Oi."

I ended up pushing my luck at the end.

Part 2

Although Lia never did put on that idol outfit…

"Here you go."

She said, as she placed tea down on the living room table.

I looked at Lia.

Her class rep look was gone.

Instead, she was in idol mode, or I guess, this was her real appearance.

Her long, silky black hair was let down and her circular, class-rep glasses were gone, showing her expressive, beautiful eyes.

She sat down next to me.

"Gulp…"

"...Kazuma, did I just hear you 'gulp'?"

I got nervous and did such a thing.

It was a bit harder to keep my composure once the real Lia was beside me.

Chapter 56: Complaints From These Clones!

Part 1

It was time for the new groups to head to the dungeon.

While I was preparing, I decided to use my unspent skill points.

I decided to put it all on Luck.

Not only would it boost my skills and critical hit damage with [High Roller], but it will also affect every aspect of my life.

And so, for the first time, I spent my skill points in raising a Stat.

Not to mention there was that quest where I had to raise my luck to 150.

Right now, that was my current goal.

I also switched away from the Gambler class back to Adventurer.

I need to be in the Gambler class to raise my luck, but I could always just switch back.

But I didn't want to miss out on new potential skills.

Before leaving, I also made clothes from the worm silk for everyone.

With the [Tailor] skill, I can make clothing that suits everyone's needs.

For example, Darkness will get increased Dexterity.

"Oi, Kazuma… Why am I getting increased Strength? Give me extra magic power."

Megumin said, when she saw what I made for her.

"...Also, why did you make underwear?!"

She held up the black lingerie I made for her.

I coughed into my hand.
"Isn't it obvious? Bigger clothing will just get in the way of your other gear… For example, Megumin has those mage robes, right? Meanwhile, underwear can be worn under anything…"

"Well, that's true… But I feel like you had some kind of other intention when making this… Also, you put so much detail into it…"

…Of course, I also intended to use those underwear for nightly activities later on.

Aqua held her blue shimapan bra and panties up.

"Kazuma, why does Megumin have mature ones while I have childish ones?"

This foolish girl.

Doesn't she understand the concept of gap moe?

The one with the immature body should obviously have sexier underwear, while the one with the body of a supermodel should wear immature undies!

Although with that said, Darkness had proper yellow lingerie to wear.

Rather than gap moe, I just wanted to accentuate Darkness's sexy body.

"Also, this clothing improves my Intelligence, huh?"

Aqua said, glaring at me.

"Oi, what are you trying to imply?"

"That you're dumb as hell, so every little improvement helps?"

"Y-You just went ahead and said it!"

I held up my own green boxers.

"Mine raises my potential, so what's your problem?! Obviously I will put in upgrades that will benefit us the most! What's the point of giving this explosion addict even more magic power?! What's the point of giving this meathead more strength?! What's the point of giving your dumb ass anything that won't increase your intelligence?! Just be grateful for your gifts!"

"Why you…"

"Kazuma, you've gone too far…"

"Sniff… Let's put holes in his underwear!"

"W-Wait, I just made this! Oiiii!"

Soon, I was surrounded by them as I was made to put on the boxers with a big hole right on my left ass cheek.

"..."

A-Anyway.

My new boxers give me +10 potential.

This puts my potential at the same as an average app-user's.

I also gain 5 skill points per level up now.

Once we were all set to go, I teleported everyone to floor 56.

I was a bit nervous, since this was the first time this group was facing the high level floors on our own.

I had Aqua cast buffs on everyone, before heading in.

"...! Wait! I think I see movement!"

I held a hand out to everyone.

Only to see that it was just a torchlight making the shadows flicker.

"Kazuma, you're too paranoid."

Aqua said, as we started moving forward again.

A few minutes later, I actually sensed an enemy.

A group of humanoid monsters with green skin, except it was much larger than a goblin.

Some of them carried battle axes, while others had crossbows. There was even one with a staff and mage robes.

[Lore Reading] told me that they were ogres.

I used [Monster Talk] to attempt to communicate with them.

"Um, hello, everyone! We mean no trouble…"

"Attack them!"

…I guess diplomacy wasn't an option.

Darkness immediately went forward.

"[Taunt]!"

She attracted the ogres to her and kept them at bay with the improvised spear I made.

"Hehe… Although not as iconic as goblins, ogres also have their charm… After all, I imagine that they'd be quite big!"

Oi, what is this pervert talking about?"

Before I could stop her, she moved forward and lifted one of the ogre's loin cloths with her spear.

…So she had enough skill to lift a monster's loincloth up, but she couldn't land most of her attacks?

This girl…

For some reason, Darkness went still.

"...W-Why isn't it big?!"

As if confused themselves, the ogres also stopped attacking.

Darkness pointed an accusatory finger at the ogre whose loin cloth she flipped.

"Even though you're an ogre, why is your size so disappointing?! Are all ogres like this, or are you just impotent?! Shame! You're a shame to ogres everywhere!"

This was probably Darkness's most disgusting display ever.

She was in near tears from the disappointment of seeing an ogre's package.

"...What is this human woman talking about?"

In order to spare the ogres' feelings, I didn't translate.

Instead, I just drew my bow.

"[Rapid Shot]!"

I fired an onslaught of arrows at them.

This is what makes critical hit builds truly OP.

When it's paired with attack speed.

They immediately started falling as I rained critical hits down on them.

The ogre spellcaster raised his staff.

But before he could even cast a spell…

"[Skill Bind]!"

The mana he was gathering with his staff got dispersed, as I held my hand out to him.

Then Megumin swooped in to deliver a crushing blow powered by the ignition of her staff.

"Inferior mages should just die!"

…She always took it personally whenever she saw another spell caster.

Part 2

Arrogant Water Dragon King (Super Rare)

Sells for: 850,000 Yen

I was just making a dirty joke!

This…!

This mentally deficient girl is actually defeating me in an argument?!
And I couldn't really say anything back!

"Hah… Why am I the only one in the group who doesn't have flaws…"

"Oi, you of all people don't get to say that! If I never partied up with you, you'd probably be committing domestic terrorism to this day!"

She surprised me by turning around with a wholesome smile.

This girl…!

I can never predict what she's gonna do next!

Aqua chuckled to herself.

"Oh, look… This Kazuma is blushing all over… He really is a glass cannon, huh?"

"Indeed. The man who will call you a whore in one moment, then profess his undying love to you the next…"

"Who are you trying to appeal to, Tsunzuma? There's no market for male tsundere, you know?"

"Gahhh! Steal! Steal! Steal!"

"...?! What are you doing?!"

I stole the panties I made for them.

"I'll be taking these back…"

"Y-You… What about the stat bonuses?!"

The one who was in the most danger, Aqua and Megumin, clutched their skirts as they glared at me.

"...? As long as you have the bras on, it's fine, right? For spreading such malicious lies about me, go the rest of the dungeon without panties on! How about that?!"

"Damnit! I wouldn't have worn a bodysuit if I knew Kazuma would do this! I should have been sluttier like Aqua and Megumin, who always go around wearing such tiny skirts!"

We got caught up in another pointless argument.

…Maybe I made a mistake with this party composition.

You gained two levels!

Meanwhile, it seemed that the EXP I got from killing those ogres, as well as the EXP Mary and Aika-chan were getting, let me reach level 60.

Ten points right away…

While Megumin and Aqua were both teaming up against Darkness, I decided to put skill points into [Rapid Shot].

That's because I saw just how effective it was when combined with my high critical hit chance.

[Rapid Shot] Skill Rank: 5 (MAX), Active Skill (5 mp)

Attack speed when shooting with shortbows increased by x 3.5. This skill does not apply to longbows or crossbows.

Then to further augment that speed…

I also maxed out [Delay Spell].

[Delay Spell] Skill Rank: 5 (MAX), Passive Skill

You can delay up to 7 spells, which will form as magical energies that will float around you. For every 5 minutes that passes until you use the spell, you will lose equal to the amount of mana points you used to cast the spell.

A trident with a Kraken Eye at its core. Can be thrown and returned to the user's hand at will, regardless of the distance. The trident will manually fly to the user's hand. The success of this ranged attack depends on whether the target can pass a 'Dexterity' skill check of 90. If the target passes the skill check, they will still take 5 Lightning damage from a bolt of lightning striking from above. If the target hits, along with the weapon damage, they will take 10 lightning damage.

This item really suited Darkness well.

Not only would it give her a long ranged attack option, it even had a feature that relied on the enemy having to pass an incredibly high-skill check, instead of Darkness's own weapon accuracy.

"Ah… What a splendid weapon!

I noticed something.

…Wasn't Darkness getting all the best loot recently?

She even got the Winter Shogun armor and Sword.

"Darkness, you're becoming quite a loot goblin, huh?"

"Goblin? Where?"

She randomly got excited when I said the word goblin.
