Summary: The Silver-Haired Thieves Group strikes again! Except they fail in stealing a noble's artifact and end up being arrested by the police. Kazuma gets Darkness to bail them out, but it seems that Darkness wants something in exchange...


Chapter 58: A Favor To This Lizardman King!

Part 1

Quest Completed! You have defeated the 60th floor boss!

You have gained 5 levels!

I put all 50 skill points on Luck again.

Now, [High Roller] gave me +23 bonus damage with each critical hit.

That's insane no matter how you think about it.

I then checked the Random Loot Box I got for defeating the kraken.

You received a spellbook for the Advanced Magic spell, [Bottomless Swamp]!

A spell book appeared in front of me.

Finally, I could learn my first Advanced spell.

According to Yunyun, it might take me a couple days to read.

I put it away in my inventory for now.

The others were still energetic and we had good momentum, so we kept exploring the dungeon.

Mitsurugi told me that although the 60th floor range was much more difficult than the previous floors, this is usually when app-users achieve a large power-spike, making it easy for them to take on even difficult enemies.

I understood what he meant, as we continued to clear floor after floor, at such speed that we didn't even think about resting even after we defeated the boss of each floor.

"Explooosiooon!"

Megumin let out the biggest explosion I had seen from her yet, as she blew up the 64th floor boss, a Mutant Umber Hulk, which had an adamantium shell around it. It looked like a large, bipedal beetle and would dig around the soft soil of this biome.
But I used [Bind] to restrict its movements and Megumin finished it off with an explosion.

"Ugh… This bug stinks when it's all fried up like that."

Aqua said, covering her nose.

I created a golem car and we vacated the area, before the awful smell could stick to our clothes.

[Lore Reading] told me that the mutant Umber Hulk's armor could be made into light armor, but I used medium armor, so that wasn't really all that useful to me.

We moved on to the 65th floor.

This was the floor with that special boss area Mitsurugi told us about.

A lizardman kingdom that was led by a wise king.

The optional challenge for the area was to earn the king's favor.

There have been a few app-users who tried to cause trouble on this floor, refusing to abide by the king's rules, and they were swiftly dealt with.

Individually, the lizardmen were quite weak, but with a well-equipped army of 5,000, no amount of cheat-items can help a single egoistic app-user from surviving that.

Stealing was also a grave crime on this floor, Mitsurugi warned us. Even if you only steal a wooden plate, the guards will immediately surround you, giving you an ultimatum to turn yourself in, or risk execution.

Getting caught and put into jail was pretty bad.

Although they don't keep you in there for a long time, the jail cells have a functionality of decreasing one's skill ranks and stat points for each day spent in prison.

Even spending only a week in that prison will destroy any app-user's progress. One of the strongest app-users apparently retired, because he tried to steal a high-level weapon from a blacksmith, and was put in jail for a week. All of his skill points were reverted to Rank 1, and he lost 70 points in each stat.

He went back to his convenience store job after that.

With those kinds of horror stories, some app-users skipped this floor altogether, using an 'express lane' to the exit that lizardmen have built themselves, in order to quickly get rid of app-users who were intending on skipping the floor.

Otherwise, the lizardmen were friendly to app-users, willing to trade with them, exchange information and socialize. I heard that there were even app-users with peculiar tastes who have decided to 'build a life' in the lizardman kingdom. Several infant hybrids could already be seen in the kingdom, as it only takes 30 days for a female to hatch an egg.

Darkness, when she heard this, let out a creepy chuckle.

"I wonder what it's like to lay an egg…"

We all pretended we didn't hear her say that

I was curious about this fascinating kingdom and opened the door with a lot of anticipation.

"Identification, please."

Only to be greeted by a stern-looking lizardman, wearing formal clothing.

Right behind the door, there was an additional barricade that was guarded by lizardmen wearing steel armor and carrying crossbows.

We all took out our phones and showed them to the lizardman, who read our names and wrote them down. He then took out some paper and rapidly drew a perfect sketch of me. He must have used some kind of artistic skill.

"Satou Kazuma… Here is your temporary ID. Please don't lose it."

"Wait, you can read and write in Japanese?"

I said, looking at the ID he gave me.

The fast drawing was already enough for me to marvel at, but this lizardman just wrote my name and info in perfect Japanese.

"Yes, sir. All border officials are required to learn Japanese."
I knew that Mitsurugi said that this kingdom had the most advanced monster society in the dungeon, but I didn't think it would be to this extent.

"Wait a second."

We were all let through, but he stopped Megumin.

He looked at her app and said,

"...You have explosion magic. This will be a problem."

"Hah? What's wrong with explosion magic?"

"There has been a domestic terrorist in the kingdom who has been causing problems using detonation magic. The terrorist is a former mine worker who started rebelling against her quartermaster. She has even recruited other miners, who all know detonation magic as well. They have been doing hit-and-run attacks as of late. As such, users of detonation magic are being closely supervised."

There were stars in Megumin's eyes.

"That sounds amazing! How can I join these guys?"

That was the worst possible thing she could have said at this time.

It was like going to an airport and yelling 'I have a bomb!'.

The guards all immediately turned to Megumin, eyeing her warily.

I rushed to intervene.

I switched to the [Monster Ally] title and used [Monster Talk] to directly speak in their language.

Just to be safe, I also used [Bluff].

"Forgive me, this one over here… Well, let's just say that she's a bit special, if you know what I mean."

The guards relaxed when they heard me speak with their native tongue. The border official also gave Megumin a look of empathy.

"I see. Please do not worry, the kingdom of Lizardia does not discriminate against those with mental disabilities. In fact, they are highly-regarded."

He took out an armband and presented it to Megumin.

Along with the lizardman language, there was a Japanese-translation on the bottom.

It read: 'Highly Regarded Individual'.

"Please wear this at all times, so that people are aware of your condition."

The official handed it to Megumin, who eagerly accepted the armband, wearing it proudly.

"Fufu… This place must be very advanced if they were able to recognize my true nature…"

The lizardman solemnly nodded.

"Yes, I had an inkling as soon as you arrived."

"I do apologize. I'll try to hide my power level better next time."

Thankfully, I had the [Bluff] skill active and was able to keep a poker face.

Otherwise, I would have laughed and hollered the whole time.

Aqua pouted and said,

"Hold on, how come I don't have that armband! I'm also highly regarded!"

Maybe I should have put points into the [Bluff] skill.

My poker face broke and I started laughing my ass off.

Darkness also started laughing as soon as I did.

"O-Oi, Kazuma… Hold it in, hold it in!"

"I can't! This is impossible!"

Aqua stared at us obliviously, but Megumin was smart enough to piece together what was going on, when she saw us laughing.

She furiously ripped the armband off and pointed at the border official.

"W-What are you making me wear?! What kind of insult is this?!"

The border official gave her a kind, understanding smile.

"Shh… It's OK. I understand that you are prone to tempers at random times. Don't worry, individuals such as yourself are given a lot of social leeway. That's what the armband is for."

He handed her another armband to wear.

Megumin was about to lunge at the guy, but I stopped her and whispered.

"Oi, Megumin. We can use this to our advantage, so just keep the armband. It's our get out of jail free card."

"..."

She slowly nodded, understanding the strategic importance of this armband.

The official also gave Aqua an armband, who proudly wore it, still not catching on.

Your 'Cunning' went up by +5!

Part 2

The guards opened the gate for us to walk through.

We followed the path out of the border office and found ourselves in front of the vast castle walls.

We stared in awe at the size of the walls, as well as the line of people waiting to get in.

I was surprised to see that there was a mix of intelligent monsters lined in here. Goblins, kobolds and ogres.

And to my surprise, there was even a female orc in line.

She glanced at me and a look of lust filled her eyes, and she licked her lips.

However, she noticed a guard passing by and she took her eyes away disappointedly.

I see.

The monsters that were coming to this floor were on their best behavior.

That was because if they spent even a day in prison, their stats would decrease.

That was pretty much a death sentence for a monster, who can't raise their levels as much as an app-user.

I also noticed that there were app-users lined up. I talked to one of them.

"Hey, are you here for the optional quest?"

I asked a male app-user, only to see that it was Kikuchi.

The guy who operated the now defunct female orc brothel.

"..."

I went silent when I saw him.

He glared at me when he recognized me.

"Ah, if it isn't the saboteur…"

It seems he still held a grudge about that.

"...Why are you mad at me? I fixed the problem. I had the female orcs copulate with the goblins. They are also now being watched by a faithful Giant Toad."

I said, referring to Pocky-chan, who became the guardian of the goblins.

"Well, I suppose you're right about that. But there's also the problem of my business being shut down. I spent a lot of money on those [Change Shape] spell tomes, you know?"

He looked at me expectantly.

Was he expecting me to compensate him?

"So, what are you doing here?"

I said, changing the topic before he could get any weird ideas like me owing him money.

Even though I saved his life.

"Hmph. I heard rumors that some of the female orcs moved to this floor and opened a Shapeshifting Brothel of their own, without my permission! Even though it was my idea… I'm planning to sue them in this kingdom's court."

This place even had a legal system?

"Ah, I know! Satou, you can be my star witness!"

"No way."

I said, immediately shutting down that idea.

"...But you know that I'm the one who made that brothel! You can help me win this case in only a day!"

"A day? Is that really how long the legal process takes here?"

He nodded and said,

"Yeah. They don't have a judge. Instead, they use divination magic to determine which side is telling the truth, and what's the best verdict or resolution."

I couldn't really criticize them, since I also used divination magic a lot.

Still, I suppose it was a good way to solve criminal and litigation cases. It removes the possibility of error and bias.

He glanced at the girls behind me and said,

"Besides, don't you want to shut down this brothel, too? Last time, you were concerned that those girls' likeness will be used for the brothel, right? Look at all the app-users in here, checking those girls out. I bet they are here for the brothel and plan to use those girls later…!"

He raised a good argument there.

Since these three were beauties, there were many male app-users looking at them lustfully.

"...When's the trial?"

"In a few hours. I'll split the winnings with you, so please come!"

He was talking about this court case like a day out at the casino.

…

…

"ID, please."

The guard at the gate said, when it was our turn.

We handed them the IDs that were given to us. They nodded and stepped aside.

He smiled at Megumin and said,

"The market ahead of here is rather noisy. Please wear these so you don't get overstimulated."

"..."

Megumin accepted the ear muffs given to her by the guard. He gave one to Aqua as well.

I was pretty impressed by the consideration of these guards.

"Mitsurugi described it as a medieval society, but they're quite advanced in certain societal aspects, aren't they?"

"Indeed. To think that monsters could create such a well-functioning society."

Megumin didn't seem impressed.

"You see progress, I see patronization."

Just like the guard advised, we went through a busy market after we were allowed in.

Darkness smelled the air and smiled.

"Perhaps we can stop for a snack?"

"I suppose those big muscles of Darkness need a lot of maintenance, huh?"

"M-My muscles aren't that big!"

Since the app could convert currencies, I converted some of my money to the currency of Lizardia.

The Kingdom of Lizardia traded Adamantite, Mithril, Gold, Silver and Copper coins.

I bought 1 silver coin worth of Giant Toad skewers.

Your health has increased by +1!

It seems that I can increase my stats by eating all kinds of food here.

I could also buy ingredients for my own [Cooking] skill, instead of hunting dangerous monsters or using DP to create them.

Perhaps I should leave a teleportation mark here, as this place seemed to be incredibly useful.

As we continued to explore the place, I noticed that there were a lot of people gathering in front of a building. More specifically, they were crowding around a bulletin board.

"Ahhh! I can't believe Blacktail Company stock dropped a whole 40%! I spent all my life savings on that!"

"Oi, buy the dip on Blacktail!"

"Hmm… Do you think Manatite prices will go up soon?"

It seems that this was a Merchant's Guild.

Also, based on what they were saying…

It seems that stocks were traded in this kingdom.

"...? If divination magic is used in this kingdom, wouldn't it ensure that everyone will make money from trading?"

"Fufu, not necessarily."

A stranger answered me, a female lizardman who was wearing a navy-blue coat and a skirt.

"Hello, I'm a representative of the Merchant's Guild. Are you interested in trading?"

"I don't think I'm old enough."

"What's your age?"

"I'm 16."

"Oh, that should be fine, then!"

Since I wasn't allowed to directly buy stocks in Japan, I was surprised that I was allowed here.

"And to answer your question, divination magic is incredibly rare. It is also only used in the court, and to prevent the abuse of its power, it cannot be used for any other purpose, other than divining the truth in the court of law."

"...Wouldn't nobles just circumvent the law?"

"The court diviner will know if there are nobles who are breaking the law. That diviner is then tested with a lie-detecting magic item to ensure they are telling the truth."

There were many ways to elude Divination magic, such as what Wiz was doing to hide from Vanir.

I also imagined that the detonation terrorists were doing the same thing, otherwise the guards would have already captured them.

But if the nobles were regularly tested with a lie-detection magic item that was separate from divination magic, that would ensure that they were always honest.

This kingdom seemed to have it all figured out.

As for the stock market, I was indeed curious.

I would be found out right away if I used the crystal ball for this, but I did have extraordinarily high luck, so I didn't need to cheat.

"Can you show me a list of stocks?"

"Sure! Here are the public companies… Would you like me to give you an overview of the top industries? There are mining industries, magical research industries, agricultural industries…"

I closed my eyes and randomly pointed to a company.

"I'll buy 20,000 Adamantite coins worth of this stock."

"...Eh?"

The representative gave me a vacant look.

That was because I just picked a random stock and put 200 million Yen on it.

She started weakly laughing.

"Ahaha… That's funny…"

"No, I'm serious."

"..."

In a gentle voice, she said,

"Sir, you're still so young. You have so much to live for."

She thought that I was trying to throw my life away.

"Oh, yeah, what does this company do, anyway?"

"...I don't even know myself, sir. It's an unknown company that was only recently added to the market."

"Whoever they are, I want to put my money on this stock."

"Sir! Please reconsider!"

"Oi, you get a commission fee, right? Just take the money and buy yourself something nice."

"..."

Seeing that I wasn't going to change my mind, she just silently accepted the money.

She led us to the Merchant's guild and I dropped all the converted Yen into a vault.

Then, I was given some documents, stating that I was now the owner of this unknown company's stock.

Part 3

We headed to the king's castle after the visit to the Merchant's Guild.

There was a line to have an appointment with the king in his court.

The line was occupied with both Lizardmen nobles wearing fine clothing, as well as other app-users who were here for the quest.

"Everyone is here to get a quest from the NPC, huh?

Megumin said, as she stood on her tiptoes to look above the crowd.

"...Did you just call his majesty an NPC?"

Ah, crap.

It seems that the lizardmen were not only knowledgeable in Japanese, they were also aware of our lingo.

It was understandable, since app-users had commingled with their society to the extent there were now hybrids, and Japanese had become a second language.

Megumin… She just had to say that!

However, the Lizardman looked at the armband Megumin was wearing.

He looked at Megumin with a look of pity and patted her on the head.

"Would you like candy?"

I knew that Megumin was going to blow up right then and there.

I intervened by grabbing her neck and casting [Freeze].

"Gyahh!"

"...I'm sorry, she gets hyperactive if you feed her too much sugar. Thank you for the offer."

Megumin glared at me as the guard left.

"Kazuma… I won't forgive you for that."

I pointed my finger directly at her face.

"Listen here! You're way too smart to be acting like Aqua right now! What are you doing?! Surely, you know that causing a commotion here will have us thrown in prison! Maybe we'll even be executed!"

And I knew that Eris-sama probably didn't like me very much right now for what I did to Chris. Plus, her superiors didn't like how I reincarnated myself last time.

I couldn't afford to die right now!

"...You're right. I shouldn't act like Aqua. I'm smarter than that."

"I'm right here, you know?"

Aqua said, pulling Megumin's cheek. She went on to say,

"You keep implying that I'm some kind of benchmark for stupidity, but what was the last really stupid thing I did?! I bet you can't even recall, right?! If anything, Kazuma has been the one screwing up, haven't you?"

"...Hah? When did I screw up?"

Darkness coughed into her hand, but I looked at her, begging her not to mention the Chris thing.

"Come to think of it… Hasn't Kazuma been the main source of problems?"

Megumin said, proposing such a ridiculous idea.

"No way. Clearly the biggest liabilities here are the explosion freak and the magnet of misfortune!"

"When was the last time my explosion magic got us in trouble? That was way before, during floor 1 with the Giant Toads, right? My trigger discipline has been very good since then! Also, Aqua improved her luck, so you can't even use that against her!"

"Megumin's right! Compared to what we've done, Kazuma was the one who did things like enslaving Kobolds! And we don't even know what you're doing in your dungeon half the time… I bet there's lots of shady things we don't know!"

I avoided Darkness's judgemental look.

"No way! I refuse to believe that I'm the cause of the most problems! I bet if someone tallies up all our screwups, Aqua or Megumin will be the leader of that list, not me! Besides, Megumin was involved in the Kobold thing, too!"

Darkness rubbed her chin thoughtfully.

"Then that means that I'm the least problematic one, aren't I?"

"..." x 3.

We all paused and looked at Darkness.

Wait.

She had a point?!

"C-Come to think of it, hasn't Darkness been pretty well-behaved?"

"I mean, she still says weird stuff sometimes… But that's kind of just an idiosyncrasy more than an actual cause of problems."

Aqua and Megumin said, their faces paling as they realized that Darkness was actually the sound one in the group.

"W-Wait, there has to be some crazy and stupid thing Darkness has done!"

I said, thinking back to everything she did.

…Actually, Darkness has probably been the most clutch member in fights, especially when she increased her accuracy.

In fact, Darkness was the hardest worker among us, raising her pitiful Dexterity to levels where she could somewhat reliably hit enemies now.

Joining the naginata club, fighting low-tier monsters over and over.

I blushed while looking at Darkness.

I-Isn't Darkness kind of cool?!

Eh, someone like that is my lover?

"...Why are you all looking at me like that?"

Darkness said, confused as we looked at her with admiration.

A lizardman interrupted us and said,

"Next group, you may address his majesty!"

We broke out of our moment of admiration for Darkness and approached the king. We bowed down in front of him. Perhaps because they were affected by that talk about the ranking of liabilities, Megumin and Aqua didn't make a fuss about lowering their heads to a Lizardman.

King Lizardia was a Lizardman with a wise visage. He had strong eyes and a commanding aura about him. He seemed to have been a fighter in his past, as there was a scar on the right side of his neck.

"...You are all app-users, correct? I assume you're here for a quest."

Accepting a quest from the king will unlock an optional quest.

Since Random Loot Boxes were quite hard to come by as you level up, optional quests like these were very valuable.

"Yes, your majesty."

He stared at us and his eyes widened slightly.
"...This party… This party is a contender to become the Hero's Party…!"

I suppose he used some kind of analytic skill while staring at us.

He was able to tell that I was close to unlocking the Hero class.

There were murmurs in the court. Some of the app-users chuckled.

"Heh… So his majesty recognized Kazuma's Party, huh?"

"They were the ones who beat all those Demon King generals, after all."

"Hoh… Their journey is starting now, huh? Welcome to the gates of hell!"

These app-users were hyping us up for some reason.

…Actually, that was bad for us.

To gain the favor of the king, usually he will just give some kind of moderately easy quest.

This was to ensure that the app-users would have a good relationship with the kingdom and they will become trading partners.

It would also ensure that troublemakers who just want loot will quickly get out if they finish the quest.

But if we're identified as the hero party…

"Hero candidates… I have an important quest for you."

Just as I feared.

Part 4

The task King Lizadia gave us was to apprehend the terrorist that was using detonation magic.

I wanted to decline, but the optional quest prompt already popped up.

"You can do it, Kazuma's party!"

"You're the party that will defeat the Demon King! This quest is nothing for you!"

"Three cheers for Kazuma's party!"

Those app-users just increased the king's expectations for us.

We left the castle after receiving the quest.

"...I guess it would be a bad look if we don't do that quest."

I said, sighing as we went back to the streets outside the castle.

"Heh… It was destiny that I would meet my brethren…"

Megumin nodded to herself. She had a curious look on her face, as if she was imagining what those terrorists would look like.

Before that.

I promised that I would testify for Kikuchi, but the others had no interest in that whatsoever.

I split ways with them, agreeing to meet up at the marketplace later.

A guard gave me directions to the courthouse when I asked, and when I arrived, a receptionist showed me to the room where the trial would be held.

While I waited for the session to begin, I took a booklet about the court system of Lizardia and read it.

Due to the use of divination magic, trials here only lasted one or two hours.

Divination magic can immediately produce the best verdict. The trial itself was just there for the sake of due process, allowing the accused to form the best defense. Still, no matter how good the defense was, if the diviner can see the past, there wasn't really much the criminal could do to change the final verdict.

As such, unlike in the real world, lawyers and prosecutors were actually seen as rather menial professions. However, guards and policemen, who have to find and arrest the criminals who were evading the divination magic's reach, were seen as prestigious positions.

I put the booklet away when Kikuchi arrived.

"Ah, Satou! You actually came!"

He sounded like he doubted that I'd come.

Well, I was tempted to ditch, so his worries were valid.

He had me sit with him, along with a Lizardman lawyer. He was wearing a cheap-looking suit and didn't have an ounce of confidence in him. He had the mannerisms and appearance of a disillusioned minimum-wage worker, rather than a lawyer at the top of society.

He took out a piece of paper from his suitcase and put it down on the table. He looked at me and Kikuchi.

"Ahem… So, Satou-san here will be our key witness. You only need to say Kikuchi-san was the original owner of the Female Orc Brothel…"

Kikuchi grinned and said,

"Heh. The diviner will know we're telling the truth and I can bring that brothel down!"

I turned to the lawyer and said,

"You know, I was thinking… Even if Kikuchi proves he's the original owner, it's not like he invented the concept of a brothel. What will he even gain from this?"

"...Eh?"

Kikuchi blinked at me.

"But… It was my idea!"

"So? Did you register the brothel as a business? Did you even have any paperwork? Did you patent the idea of a shapeshifting brothel?"

"W-Wait, this case made it through for approval, so that means that I have a legitimate case!"

The lawyer coughed into his hand.

"Actually, our case is that the female orcs are using the name 'Female Orc Brothel'. They will have to pay royalties to you if it's proven that you're the original owner, otherwise they will have to cease all activities."

"Yes, exactly!"

"But they can just change the name to something else and circumvent that."

"What?!"

Is this guy stupid?

Well, I already knew that.

In fact, I was the stupid one for coming here, thinking that I could help abolish the brothel with such weak claims.

Just then, the doors opened and a group of female orcs arrived. Based on their lavish clothing, it was apparent that the business was doing well.

They didn't even spare Kikuchi a glance as they took their seats.

"Che… It's those bitches…"

"Please refrain from calling them that."

The lawyer advised Kikuchi.

I looked at the female orc's lawyer. He was another down-on-his luck lizardman who was wearing a cheap suit as well. He had a bored look on his eyes as he went over the case with his clients.

I guess all lawyers in this kingdom really were like this. They treated this job as if it were a part-time gig at a burger joint.

The judge arrived soon after. Unlike the lawyers, the judge was much more confident and well-dressed. The elderly, female lizardman wore diviner robes and carried a crystal ball.

This was one of the kingdom's diviners.

There were three diviners in total. This one was assigned to everyday cases, while the top diviner was assigned to high-profile cases. The third diviner was tasked with finding criminals who didn't have means to elude divination magic. Every hour, the third diviner will ask a crystal ball if there have been any crimes that were committed in the kingdom. The police will then use this information to make arrests.

The judge/diviner took her seat and ordered for the court to begin. We took our seats as well.

"Let's see… Kikuchi-san versus the Female Orc Brothel… There is contention about the name of the brothel…"

Kikuchi's lawyer stood up.

"Actually, your honor… It seems that Kikuchi-san is demanding the abolishment of the brothel, as well as to sue them for infringement and damages. He is not concerned about the name."

"Oh?"

The judge said, only showing a hint of interest.

The other lawyer stood up.

"...That's too much! Besides, my clients are fine with changing the name! They don't owe Kikuchi-san anything beyond that!"

The judge glanced at Kikuchi's lawyer, who replied,

"Actually, there are the initial costs of the [Change Shape] scrolls that Kikuchi-san gave to the female orcs…"

Right, there was that detail.

Kikuchi could try and gain compensation for that.

He won't gain a profit, but at least he will regain his initial investment.

Honestly, Mitsurugi and I could have caught up to him, but it was probably a bad idea to show such feats.

"Hah… Hah… How long is he gonna make us do this!"

One of our teammates said, looking like he was on the verge of collapsing.

Meanwhile, I hadn't even broken a sweat yet. I was just using [Create Water] to make my skin look wet.

Your 'Cunning' went up by +1!

My Cunning was now at 149.

Unless I unlock an advanced class or a skill that can raise 'Cunning' like I could with 'Luck' with the Gambler class, I won't be able to raise it past 150, which is the stat cap provided to me by [Growth].

A class that could raise 'Cunning' would be the 'Dark Stalker' class that Chris took a few levels in.

I guess I'd have to go on more raids to unlock that class…

While I was thinking of this…

Suddenly, [Enemy Detection] activated.

"Gahh! A bear!"

One of our teammates yelled.

Certainly, there were some bear warning signs here.

But the bears were known to fear people and avoid them, so it was very safe to go on this trail.

Otherwise this wouldn't be a popular tourist spot or a destination for school training camps.

But this bear wasn't an ordinary one.

It was a One-shot Bear, waiting ahead of us.

"Grrr…"

It growled, as drool went down its chin.

"W-What kind of bear is that?!"

The coach said, swerving his bike around.

Of course they would panic upon seeing such a monstrous creature.

Mitsurugi came and whispered to me, as we all started slowly walking backwards, not making any sudden actions.

"...What is a One-Shot Bear doing here?"

"I think it's a creature that slipped through a dimensional tear."

The boundary between the two dimensions was getting weaker by the day.

Not to mention the creatures that were getting in were becoming more dangerous.

First Cecily, now a One-Shot Bear?

A bunch of dangerous threats to society were pouring in.

"D-Don't make any sudden movements. Walk slowly."

The coach said, keeping the rest of the students calm.

Now, that advice would normally be effective against a real bear.

But a One-Shot Bear isn't an animal, it's a monster.

"Graaarrr!"

It roared, starting to charge towards us.

I chanted and activated the spell [Bottomless Swamp].

"Grrrar…?!"

It slowly started sinking down into the swamp.

"F-For some reason it started slowing down…"

"Yosh! I think it's scared! There's no way to outrun a bear, so let's just try to intimidate it! Everyone, start yelling!"

The coach is saying all the right things, but not for a One-Shot Bear!

"Go away bear! Rawwr!"

"Go back! Go back! Go back!"

"Shooo! Shooo!"

Ah, this is gonna be a disaster.

The reason being that from using [Lore Reading], I saw that this One-Shot Bear has a Rank 7 [Overwhelm] skill.

That meant that it already got out of the swamp.

This really isn't good!

Anything Mitsurugi and I could do to defeat this thing would raise questions.

Especially Mitsurugi. If he took Gram out right now to defeat this monster, there was no way he could explain it.

In this situation, I needed a moment to think, but the bear was already freed from the swamp.

That was when I used [Parallel Processing].

Using the clone that I reabsorbed, I doubled the speed of my thoughts.

I needed a way to disable or kill this bear in as discreet a way as possible.

Not only in an efficient way, but in a way that would be perceived as natural as possible.

Why don't you summon me?

The clone thought of this idea.

Without hesitating, I summoned an Earth Golem.

I put the clone into the golem's body.

Then the golem casted [Lurk] to sneak away from the group.

And when it gained some space from us…

Since it was technically me, we both had access to our inventory.

It brought out a rifle.

So guns would end up being useful after all…

The clone then used [Disguise], along with [Smithing], to make itself look like an animal control specialist.

The clone raised the rifle and fired.

The only thing I had to do was use [Meta-Control Spell] on the bullet.

Raising its frequency to a deadly level of vibration once the bullet made contact with the bear's skull.

The One-Shot Bear normally had a high defense, and the clone didn't share my stats, aside from Intelligence.

But with the way the golem-rhino horn bullet vibrated…

Blood and brain matter burst out of the bear's skull before it fell over.

The group yelled in terror at the sight, since it was probably the first time they had seen such a violent scene in real life.

The clone then revealed himself. The disguise wasn't perfect, since he didn't have any proper clothes to make a disguise with. The clothing he was wearing right now was part of its body, which was altered with [Smithing], with [Disguise] adding some final touches to at least make it look realistic.

Right now, I doubted that the others were scrutinizing every last detail. They were just glad that someone saved them.

"Oh, thank god!"

"You're my hero, dude!"

"We're saved!"

The golem raised his hand and said,

"Please vacate the trail and warn anyone you encounter along the way. We will deal with the situation here."

Without needing to be told twice, the group quickly exited the scene.

"Good job, Satou…"

Mitsurugi said, whispering to me.

"...Even monsters are starting to get through."

"Yeah, this is bad…"

We shared a look, before joining the others in descending the mountain, warning everyone we encountered, as well as those who were staying in the ryokan we would be staying at.

After that encounter, it was decided that the training camp would end early, although we would stay in the ryokan for the night.

Part 6

I thought that after the run in with a monstrous bear would lower the spirits of my teammates, but…

When we safely arrived at the ryokan, and after the authorities arrived to make sure we were safe, they went on about their 'plan'.

"You already know what we want to do, right, Satou?"

"Of course… We've gotta peep at the women's bath!"

They said this ridiculous thing.

If I was still a horny, single dude, I might have gone along with their plan.

But right now, there wasn't really a reason for me to act in such a desperate manner.

"Go have fun with that."

"We've got Mr. Big Shot over here!"

"He shoots he fucking scores, huh?!"

What are these ill-mannered chimps even getting upset about?

Rather than join them in the men's baths, where they would carry out their 'operation', Mitsurugi and I just went to the mixed-gender bath.

"Hah, those guys can get wild sometimes, huh?"

Mitsurugi said, as we began to get changed.

"Tell me about it… Besides, if they just wanna ogle naked women, they'd have a better chance in the mixed-gender bath.

He paused while staring at me.

"Wait, that's not why you're going in here, right?"

"Of course not. But if there happens to be a beautiful woman in here, then I'm not in the wrong for looking at her, right? After all, it's a public space."

"...Yeah, you're right, but… No, that's just as bad! Oi, don't tell me that's really why you're coming here?!"

"Hah? Where else am I gonna go? If I go to the men's side, I'll just get in trouble by association. If I come here, I'll be much safer."

"Yeah, but why are you making all those suspicious comments?!"

Once we had towels around our waists, we entered the mixed-gender bath.

"...!!!"

"There's guys here!"

Mitsurugi froze in place when he saw a bunch of girls around.

They were the girls that our teammates mentioned earlier, the one from the all-girls school.

They were all wearing towels around themselves, covering as much of their chests as they could with their hands.

"S-Sorry! We didn't enter the women's baths, did we?!"

"...No, but we knew you boys would try to peep on us like last year, so we moved here."

"I apologize for my teammates!"

Mitsurugi hurriedly bowed to them.

I raised my hands.

"Eh? What's this? I just joined the team pretty recently! I'm not a perv, I swear!"

Mitsurugi shot me a betrayed look as the girls softened their gazes on me.

"Ah, sorry. We don't blame you! It's your perverted teammates fault!"

I slowly nodded and said,

"Yeah… I actually came here because I heard that they were going to try to peep on the women's bath from the other side… I'm sorry for intruding on you now… I didn't mean to violate your safe-space. I'm a male feminist, after all…"

They hurriedly rushed to comfort me.

"No, no, this is a mixed bath! Please don't apologize!"

"Yeah, you have every right to be here! Thanks for being so concerned for us!"

"You're such a gentleman~!"

Mitsurugi looked at me in disbelief as I was surrounded by all these girls.

After earning approval from the girls, Mitsurugi and I washed ourselves before entering the open-air bath.

"...Satou, you're unbelievable, you know that?"

"Hm? I don't know what you're talking about…"

"You were acting so nonchalant, but this was your plan, wasn't it?!"

"There's no way I could have predicted this."

"Somehow, you always find a way!"

"Really, I didn't intend to do this at… all!"

Once I was finished dumping a bucket of water over my head, I threw aside the towel.

"Kyaa~?!"

The girls squealed as I revealed my naked body.

What I'm doing is only natural.

This is the mixed-gender bath, after all.

While confidently strutting, showing off my superhuman-levels of ripped muscles, I made my way to the bath.

"You're enjoying this too much…"

Mitsurugi said, being a lot more modest than me, although he also received attention from the girls.

"W-Wow, look at their bodies…"

"Are they supermodels?!"

"No, their bodies are too perfect…!"

Fufu…

Rather than me checking the girls out, they were the ones checking me out.

As someone who lived for so long as a NEET that no woman paid attention to, of course I would enjoy showing off like this.

Even if I wasn't desperate for female companionship these days, I still sought after their attention.

…Perhaps that really did make me some kind of narcissist.

But it's not like I'm harming anyone.

Although I said that I wasn't here to gawk at women, I couldn't help but notice a big pair of breasts floating on the water.

…Damn, those are huge.

But as a gentleman, I won't look.

A quick, respectful peek should be fine, though.

I turned over to look at this woman.

"..."

I froze in place as I instantly recognized her.

Her eyes also widened when she saw me.

I suppose that Wolbach did mention before that she liked baths.

To think I'd find her in this specific ryokan, though.

"Satou… Why are you staring at…"

Mitsurugi also froze in place when he saw her.

We were both naked, with our phones in our room.

There's no way it'd be in range for me to command Aika-chan.

That meant no access to our inventory.

No weapons, no armor.

Meanwhile, Wolbach, the goddess of destruction, could use her powerful magic to wipe us out at any moment.

Mitsurugi and I both knew this.

I reached forward to grab Mitsurugi, trying to teleport us out, but Wolbach raised a finger.

"I can cast faster than you, don't even try."

Crap.

We were both screwed.

Part 7

Wasn't I supposed to have good luck?

Why was I meeting our enemy while I was buck ass naked, then?!

Just when I thought it was over, Wolbach sighed and leaned back.

"I'm not gonna attack you. I'm on vacation, so I'd rather not have to do that, if you behave."

That's right…

I often forgot that aside from 'destruction', she also ruled over the aspect of 'sloth'.

And so, right now, Wolbach didn't make a move to attack us.

That didn't mean that we could make any sudden moves, though.

Mitsurugi and I slowly sank down into the water, after Wolbach gestured for us to do so.

I looked at her head. Her horns were missing, as well as her long ears and the mark on her forehead.

"...What happened to your horns?"

"I'm using illusion magic, of course. You think I'd walk around in your world looking like I usually do?"

I suppose she wouldn't.

Mitsurugi opted to stay quiet, so I was left to get as much information out of her as I could.

"How's Wiz. Is she with you?"

"No, although I did invite her. She's doing well."

When I sighed in relief, she looked at me questioningly.

"She betrayed you, so why are you concerned about her?"

"She's still my friend."

That would never change.

Besides, the fact that Wiz was so loyal, even to a being like the Demon King, just made her more admirable to me, weirdly enough.

Even if that meant we'd both have to be enemies now.

"I see. And how's Megumin?"

"She's doing fine. She was really hurt, you know? When she found out you've been using her as a spy this whole time, it nearly broke her."

She glanced away at that.

"It would have been great if Megumin joined us. Actually, it's not too late, why don't you all just join the Demon King?"

Mitsurugi almost stood up, but he held himself back from yelling. He said,

"And why would we do that?"

"I'm just saying. It's the best way to prevent tragedy. Sure, you defeated a bunch of us, but Wiz is on our side now. If you really knew what she was capable of, you would have given up already just from that fact alone."

Wolbach smirked and continued,

"And she's only getting stronger… We both are. Thanks to you."

Just when I was wondering what she was talking about, I gasped when I realized something.

The divine laptop. That came from Wolbach.

And if Wolbach got access to another one…

"...You made a dungeon, too?"

"Yup. I learned everything from watching you. And here's something about Liches. They have the [Level Drain] skill. What it does is that it drains levels and stats… But it could also be used on oneself…"

"...Why would you want to do that?"

Mitsurugi said, but I understood where she was going with this.

"You do it to keep gaining levels and skill points endlessly."

She grinned and nodded.

"Exactly."

It didn't matter if your levels and stats were going to drop, if you have a steady EXP source. Since Wiz has Advanced Classes, she could just raise her stats back after they are drained, with all the skill points she gets.

"...Why are you telling us all of this?"

Mitsurugi asked, even though we both had a good idea why.

"It's to show that there isn't really a point in fighting this war anymore. Surely, you can see that it's hopeless now."

"..." x 2.

Mitsurugi and I both went quiet at that.

If Wiz was going through that training, of course Wolbach would as well.

And we hadn't even gotten around to seeing what the Demon King was capable of yet…

This really did seem hopeless.

"Even if you're right, there's no point in surrendering now."

I said, which seemed to surprise the both of them.

"Oh? And why's that?"

"If we surrender now, it won't end with good terms on our side."

We'd be surrendering in a place of weakness. But if we continued to fight, and we were able to survive long enough to draw out the war, we might be able to get more favorable terms.

After all, it was way too naive to hope for a victory. The only thing we could hope for was to surrender without our world becoming completely enslaved to the Demon King.

On a more optimistic note, we might be able to come up with something to fight them if we stall hard enough.

There wasn't really any strategic value in just giving up.

"I see… That's unfortunate. I was hoping to just take it easy… But I guess we'll have to fight, huh?"

She sighed and stood up, while grabbing a towel to quickly cover herself.

"...You're really not going to attack us now?"

I asked, as we watched her leave.

"I told you. I'm on vacation."

What a weird goddess.

Almost as weird as a certain blue-haired goddess.

Once she left, Mitsurugi let out a deep exhale.

"Hahhh… That was way too close."

First, the One-Shot Bear attack, and now, an encounter with Wolbach.

Really, when is my good luck going to activate now?

When we headed back to the room, the other guys were in a foul mood.

"Sniff… The only thing we saw were a bunch of naked grannies…"

"I mean, one of them looked pretty hot for her age."

"Ahhh! What a waste!"

Not knowing that a dangerous individual was in these grounds, they were all saying such stupid things.

I wished that my biggest worries just had to do with failing to peep on some girls.

Well, I guess there's no point in being bitter about it.

We had a big feast before we went to bed.

We'd head back home the next morning due to the bear attack, and the ryokan would also be closed as a precaution. I already relayed a message to Sena, and the government was already acting to scour the area, to see if there were more monsters.

The next morning, no matter how much I looked, Wolbach was also nowhere to be found.

I didn't have to wait long until her next appearance, though.

About two hours later, I received a text from Sena.

A military base had been attacked by an explosion.

Since this was a favorite tactic of Wolbach's back when I was her puppet, I already knew it was her.

And not only that…

But a second explosion occurred on another military base, at the same time.

I was willing to bet that was Wiz.

Chapter 61: An Opening For This Fake Mall!

Part 1

As expected, the culprits behind the explosions were nowhere to be found, even after a search team was sent to scan the surrounding area.

"...There were casualties, but Aqua-san used the [Resurrection] spell on them. If it wasn't for her…"

Sena reported this to me, once I got home from the cancelled training camp.

What a disaster.

Wiz and Wolbach could destroy every military base in the country, without getting caught.

In fact, if Wiz had no morals, they could also start exploding the areas with dungeon doors in them, preventing app-users from entering and leaving the dungeon.

This would not only terrorize the app-users, it would also limit their means to gather EXP.

But of course, Wiz would never target civilian areas, and Wolbach would never want to anger Wiz by going behind her back to do so.

"See?! I told you that evil Lich was up to no good! I told you from the very moment I saw her!"

Aqua said, although there was a noticeable lack of conviction there.

She'd never admit it, but she also saw Wiz as a friend.

We were all in the living room, gathering after we received the news.

Along with getting the report from Sena, I also told her about the One-Shot Bear attack, although she already heard about it from the news she received.

"...Onii-sama, things are getting serious. I suggest that we take a more active approach in preparing for this war."

Iris said, making us all look at her in concern, seeing the usually cheerful Iris speak in such a professional, battle-hardened manner.

I didn't want to have her involved in this, as much as possible, but since we were up against Wiz, there wasn't really much of a choice.

I nodded to Iris and said,

"What do you suggest?"

She was younger than all of us, but she had way more real battle experience than any of us combined.

"Wouldn't it be a good idea to hide the military forces in the dungeon? After all, onii-sama already figured out a way to allow non-users to enter it."

"...You have a point there."

The military was too vulnerable otherwise. We had no means to detect when the next attack was coming. They'd be safer in the dungeon.

And if they were in the dungeon, they could be more easily deployed through the use of the dungeon doors.

Darkness rubbed her chin thoughtfully.

"...If the military is safe, then the enemy will have to change targets… But who will they attack next?"

Megumin raised a finger.

"I got an idea. How about we use the other app-users as bait?"

We all stared at her. She frowned at all of the attention.

"...What's with all the stares?"

"Megumin, this isn't the first time I had this thought, but… You're a bit of a sociopath, aren't you?"

Chris said, making Megumin gasp at the accusation.

"Hah?! I just made a suggestion! What about that makes me a sociopath?! I only said that we should take those app-users who are liabilities anyway, and use them as bait!"

That did sound rather sociopathic.

"Megumin… I knew it was bad, but do you really have no regard for your fellow human beings?"

Yunyun looked at her best friend as if she was seeing her for the first time.

"I'm not saying to sacrifice them! Think of it like this! We have them gather in a base, then put in some dungeon doors inside so they can escape! The high-level app-users should be able to survive long enough to do that!"

Now that she explained it like that, we all nodded.

"...I guess Megumin really does have high Intelligence…."

Megumin glared at Mitsurugi, the one who commented that.

"You know, Kyouya… I know I told you to be more casual with me, but you're really taking advantage of our closeness to be an asshole to me, huh?!"

"...I'm not trying to be mean!"

"You sounded exactly like Kazuma! There's already one jerk in our group, don't copy him!"

"I'm not!"

Since we had all been living in this mansion for a while now, everyone had gotten to the point of regularly bickering like this.

Which was rather counterproductive in such an intense situation.

"OK, let's start the preparation now. Sena, how is the mall doing?"

"..."

They all stared at me when I said this.

Rin gave me a blank look.

"Senpai… Is this really the time to be worried about your mall project?"

She looked so disappointed.

"It's a source of Dungeon Points! More Dungeon Points means expanded capabilities! Since our plans rely so much on the dungeon, raising our DP sources is a priority!"

The sooner that mall gets set up, and the more customers it gets, the more DP I will have to spend.

"Ah… That makes sense. Sorry for doubting you, senpai."

"As long as you understand. Ah, Aqua, Aika-chan, how about we go to vegas and start gambling?"

"Oi?!!"

In a rare moment, Rin raised her voice at me.

"Senpai, aren't you just fooling around?!"

"...I'm not! Geez, have some more trust in me!"

Aika-chan jumped up from her seat excitedly.

"Can we go to the buffet, too?!"

She wasn't exactly helping my case here.

"...Hey, Kazuma, how come I have to go to the dungeon everyday, practicing my martial skills as I train my body… Meanwhile, your idea of getting stronger is to run a mall and gamble?"

Darkness said, giving me quite the demonic look right now.

Aqua also started glaring at me.

"You know what, you have a point. Isn't this guy just slacking off?!"

Even Yunyun was giving me a doubtful look.

"C-Come to think of it… Kazuma-san also has clones that study and do tasks for him…"

"...They're on a break right now!"

"So even your clones are slacking off, Kazuma-kun…?"

Chris, meanwhile, just seemed like she wanted to add fuel to the fire. She was giving a cheeky grin as she watched the others all ganging up on me.

Instead of facing their scrutiny, I teleported away.

Part 2

After raising my Luck by 10 points at the casino, I worked on unlocking those Arch-Wizard skills next.

First of all, there was the [Mage Rank-Up] skill that allowed one to increase Advanced magic past Rank 5.

This came with the class, so I didn't need to try to unlock it.

[Mage Rank-Up] Skill Rank: 1, Passive Skill

All magic related skills have their max Skill Rank increase to Rank 6. However, the skill points required to level those skills increases by 2 skill points.

As for how to unlock the other skills, I just asked the crystal ball again to give me shortcuts.

Although to be honest, most of the exclusive skills could be unlocked just by casting spells.

For example, with [Advanced Magic Increase], I just needed to use [Bottomless Swamp] while using [Charge Spell].

[Advanced Magic Increase] Skill Rank: 1, Passive Skill

Increase the power or effectiveness of an Advanced Magic-type spell by +1.

This was probably the type of spell that Megumin loved dumping her points into, as there was probably an explosion version for this spell.

Just to test it out, I cast a charged explosion in the training grounds I made for myself in the dungeon.

Once I reabsorbed mana to prevent myself from collapsing, I looked at the app.

[Detonation Magic Increase] Skill Rank: 1, Passive Skill

Increase the power or effectiveness of a Detonation magic spell by +1.

As I thought.

And since this was a mage skill, it could be further ranked up using [Mage Rank-Up].

Now I knew how Megumin was able to use up all those skill points.

That explosion addict…

Next, the crystal ball advised me to use my lowest mana cost spell.

I ended up just using tinder to create the smallest flame I could muster.

That was enough to unlock [Spell Efficiency].

[Spell Efficiency] Skill Rank: 1, Passive Skill

Decrease all mana cost of spells by 1 (minimum 1).

Most, if not all of these skills, were passive skills, huh?

They were pretty straightforward, too.

I suppose the main feature of the class is to support the use of Advanced Magic.

[Speed Casting], [Arcane Recovery], [Arcane Learning], [Elemental Proficiency] and [Signature Spell] were pretty straight forward, too.

With the last two, I didn't even have to unlock them. I just had to choose an elemental proficiency and a signature spell.

For the element, I chose ice and for my signature spell, I chose [Freeze].

This was all to compliment my ice arrows.

[Elemental Proficiency] Skill Rank: 1, Passive Skill

When you are using spells of this element, the power of the spell increases by +1 (Ice Magic).

[Signature Spell] Skill Rank: 1, Passive Skill

When you are using your signature spell, add +1 power and effectiveness to the spell. You will also need 1 less mana to cast the spell, with a minimum cost of 1. [Freeze] is your signature spell.

There were now more easy ways to increase the damage of my ice arrows.

As for the other skills…

[Mana Restoration] Skill Rank: 1, Passive Skill

Increase mana recovery by x0.5.

[Arcane Recovery] Skill Rank: 1, Passive Skill

Half of your full mana is automatically recovered after ten minutes of resting. This can only be used once a day.

[Arcane Learning] Skill Rank: 1, Passive Skill

The speed at which you learn spells is doubled. When someone teaches you how to cast the spell, your learning rate will further increase by x0.5.

And that was all the Arch-Wizard exclusive skills.

With all of the passive golem EXP earning, I was now at level 85.

I also had 25 skill points to spend.

Instead of spending it all on Luck, I decided to put it on [Smithing].

I did so after putting [Smithing Rank-Up] up to Rank 5.

[Smithing Rank-Up] Skill Rank: 5, Passive Skill

All Smithing related skills have their max Skill Rank increase to Rank 10. However, the skill points required to level those skills increases by 2 skill points, with an additional +1 per Rank-Up.

Out of all my skills, I felt like [Smithing] had the highest potential.

And so, I spent 14 total skill points to get [Smithing] all the way up to Rank 10.

[Smithing] Skill Rank: 10 (MAX), Active Skill (X mp)

You are proficient in creating and repairing items! The success rate of this skill is determined by your 'Creativity' (133). At Rank 10, you can create, combine and repair items of the 'Artifact' variety, although doing so will cost 100 mp to start 1 day of work, and 1 week of total work to finish the project. You cannot combine items of 'Artifact' variety.

Just like I thought…

This skill is insane!

Artifact level items were on the same plane as cheat items.

The fact that I could make them now…

Although there was the steep mana cost and the prep time.

By the way, the previous ranks actually decreased this cost and time.

At Rank 8, which was when Artifacts were unlocked, it costs 150 mana and 3 weeks of total work to make an artifact.

So Rank 10 actually massively decreased those costs.

Still, even legendary items could be made instantaneously…

Artifact-level items must be extremely powerful.

Now all I had to do was get materials for one…

I asked the crystal ball.

"Where can I get materials for an Artifact?"

It would have to be in the divine realm, where they are created, or you could use an Artifact and disassemble it for materials.

So it was either ask Eris-sama for a favor, or use a cheat-item as material.

…To be honest, I didn't want to try my luck with Eris-sama.

I was already on thin-ice in heaven after the stunt I pulled during the Winter Shogun fight.

I didn't want to risk it.

There was also the Chris incident. Considering that Eris-sama even sent a vision to Darkness, I imagined that she wouldn't want to do me any favors right now.

If only Chris could convince her to forgive me!

Instead, I set my eyes on the other option.

That is, to use an existing cheat-item.

I was also interested in the Dark Stalker class.

And in order to unlock that, I'd need to go on 5 thief raids.

Perhaps I could try to convince Chris to go with me, but she'd also just try to confiscate the cheat-item.

Whereas I'd want to keep it.

But going on a solo-raid might be too risky.

These cheat-item users were very powerful, after all.

And there might be some kind of artifact with a niche, incredibly situational ability that would completely counter me.

"I-I'm just saying! I'm grateful that you value Megumin so much to worry about her like this! What's so weird about that?!"

"...I-I'm not saying it's weird. She is a good friend…"

After a few moments, I said,

"I hate to rely on Megumin like this, but she's the only one who can do it."

I wouldn't be able to place a teleportation mark the instant Wolbach or Wiz showed up, and none of our magic users could even come close to Megumin's firing speed, much less firepower.

Megumin's skillset was practically built for this operation.

I looked at another monitor, which showed a room in the app-user base, where Megumin was waiting for Wolbach or Wiz to strike.

"Alright, I'm gonna move over there now, I'll rely on you to monitor us."

"Roger."

I took the crystal ball before teleporting over to Megumin's room.

"Yo."

"Ah, you're here."

I placed the crystal ball on a table and joined Megumin on the couch.

Since we didn't know when Wolbach and Wiz would strike, I made sure to make this room as comfortable as possible, with stocked fridges, a PC, a TV and video game consoles.

Megumin was watching some variety show and eating chips. A laptop was on the table in front of her, showing hidden camera footage of the surrounding area.

"Are you OK?"

"Yeah. Listen, I know how important this is. I'm not gonna choke. I was able to do it once… I can do it again."

She already knew what I was gonna say.

She looked at the crystal ball and said,

"Kazuma, have you tried asking that thing if any of us are gonna die after this?"

"..."

Of course, that did occur to me.

"No way. I don't think I can perform rationally if I knew something like that."

She chuckled as she leaned her head on my shoulder.

"It's Aqua's turn tonight, isn't it? Shouldn't you be with her?"

It was indeed Aqua's turn on the 'babymaking schedule'.

But we hadn't expected to get enough app-users to agree to this plan. Our schedule got pushed ahead.

It wasn't like I could stall the plans just because of the 'babymaking schedule'.

"...If worse comes to worse, Aqua already has Aika-chan."

"That's so morbid."

Well, it wasn't like we were even sure that a human could impregnate a goddess.

Of course, there were legends of gods and goddesses breeding with humans.

But the reality was that such a thing hadn't occurred yet. There was no way of knowing what would happen.

I couldn't really explain that to the others, though, so I just kept my mouth shut.

Part 5

An attack occurred two hours later.

It seemed like Wiz and Wolbach couldn't resist attacking an app-user base.

I pulled the alarm while quickly asking the crystal ball where the explosion came from.

The crystal ball then gave accurate coordinates to Megumin.

I watched as Megumin hurriedly chanted.

Then…

"Explosioooon…!"

Without hesitation, she launched the counterattack.

At Rank 10, the attack range of explosion increased dramatically, at 800 feet.

That was the same distance as about two city blocks.

I looked at the monitor and saw the patch of woods where Megumin exploded. Fire engulfed the trees as bright flames lit the dark night.

I then used my new divine item, the brain-scanning ear piece.

Commanding the divine laptop with my mind, I created a new dungeon door to the impact site. Megumin and I both stepped through, after I gave Megumin enough mana to walk with [Drain Touch].

In front of us, within the smoking crater, was Wolbach.

She looked hurt, her body filled with soot as she clutched her arm.

Even as a dark goddess, even with all the levels she gained and reset, Megumin's explosion magic was bound to severely harm anyone.

"[Tele…]!"

"[Skill Bind]!"

I countered her attempt to escape with a perfectly timed [Skill Bind].

"Tch… It was a trap after all…"

She muttered, opting to save her mana rather than have her spell be countered again. Instead, she watched our movements carefully.

I used my radio.

"Wolbach spotted, everyone, come out…!"

"Calling for reinforcements, huh? I can do that, too…!"

Shadows extended from her feet.

"[Skill Bind]!"

I tried to counter it, but nothing happened. This wasn't a skill, more like an inherent ability.

Out of her shadows, Arnes and Hoost came out.

"Hoh… Time for a rematch, huh…?"

"...I'll try not to be tricked by Kazuma again…"

Arnes said arrogantly, while Hoost seemed more sheepish.

These guys again…

Wolbach by herself was difficult enough.

Not wanting to be outnumbered, I sent another message with my mind, opening more dungeon doors behind me.

Quickly, Mitsurugi and the others all came out.

"Ahh… Why'd they have to attack in the middle of the night?! It was supposed to be my turn tonight, too! I'll massacre all you demons!"

Aqua yelled, as she quickly put on her goddess outfit from her inventory, after coming out in her pajamas. She also made her staff materialize.

"[Sacred Exorcism]!"

"...!!!" x 3.

The three devils all moved quickly to avoid the beam of light Aqua summoned, giving us some space as we all oriented ourselves.

"Are the other app-users safe?"

Mitsurugi asked, as he summoned his gear.

I nodded, making him sigh in relief.

I did think about making those app-users fight, but…

To be honest, they were way too disorganized and selfish.

Not to mention that a lot of them weren't willing to fight Wiz and Wolbach.

I couldn't really blame them, considering the danger.

That also made them unreliable, even with how powerful they were.
"So, what's our plan?"

Chris said, as she took out her special dagger, which shone brightly with the devils present.

"...Let's disrupt their formation. Darkness, I'm relying on you!"

Darkness, with her improved stats, was now a formidable Crusader.

She grinned, happy that I was relying on her.

"You got it! It's my job to create space, after all! And… I can finally use this…!"

Darkness, after equipping the Winter Shogun armor and wielding the Winter Shogun sword, charged at the enemies.

"This time, my attacks will land…!"

"[Inferno]!" x 2.

Both Arnes and Hoost tried to stop Darkness.

Chris and I glanced at each other and combined our efforts as well.

"[Skill Bind]!" x2.

We prevented them from activating their spells, letting Darkness have a clear path ahead.

However…

"[Random Teleport]!"

My stomach sank as Wolbach did something I didn't expect.

Everyone here had lesser Magic Power than Wolbach.

Meaning that she could use her max rank [Teleport] to 8 targets of her choosing.

"Papa…!!!"

Aika-chan yelled as she was randomly teleported to who knows where.

"Aika-chan…!"

And then, it was my turn.

My vision went black as I was pulled and blasted away in spacetime.

When I could finally see, the only thing I saw was water below me.

Then, I felt the first brain-tingling sensations of freefall.

"Gah…?!"

I didn't know where I was. All I knew was that the ocean was rapidly approaching, and I was in the air.

I created another dungeon door in front of me before I could drop.

If it weren't for the earpiece, I wouldn't have been able to do this in a matter of moments.

I went through the door and ended up back in the battlefield.

When I got back, I saw that only Megumin remained.

There were nine of us, meaning that one person had to be left behind.

…Wolbach intentionally left Megumin there, since she knew that she was already close to empty after using explosion magic.

"Kazuma! You're back!"

I could see the panicked expression on Megumin's face.

I gave her a small smile, before working on looking for the others.

"Aika-chan! Where are you and everyone else?!"

I said, trying to contact Aika-chan through the earpiece.

AI is temporarily offline. Please wait.

My body went cold. Something must have destroyed Aika-chan's golem body. Maybe she was teleported to a volcano and fell into lava, or ended up in the bottom of the ocean and was crushed by the water pressure.

She was going to come back online eventually, but…

Without her, I had no way to contact everyone else.

I glared at Wolbach.

This just became personal…!

I took out my bow and started shooting arrows at them.

"[Wind Wall]!"

Because of my wyvern bow, the arrows went through the wall of wind and pierced Hoost's body.

"Urk!"

He grunted in pain from the unexpected attack.

Arnes changed her strategy and summoned a wall of earth next time to deflect the arrows.

I guess my archery won't work now…

Unless I took them off guard…

But without a frontline, there was no way I could sneak around like I usually did.

"Kazuma, you can't find them?!"

Megumin said, when she saw me trying to contact Aika-chan.

"Not yet… And the fact that Yunyun and Rin hasn't teleported here yet is…"

Something must have happened to them, too.

For now, I summoned a dungeon door, touched the inside and restored my mana, along with Megumin's.

I could also just escape, but…

I don't want to lose this chance while we still have them!

There's no way they will fall for the same trap again.

This was our only chance!

Maybe I was also emotional from having everyone just up and disappear.

I guess I couldn't really think straight at the time.

Wolbach, knowing that she had the advantage, didn't try to escape again.

She sent Hoost and Arnes to attack us.

"[Inferno]!"

Arnes attacked from afar, while Hoost flew forward to try and crush us with his fists.

Megumin met Hoost's charge, while I used [Skill Bind] to prevent Arnes and Wolbach from trying to destroy us from afar with spells.

I was being forced into the defensive.

Meanwhile, Megumin was able to match Hoost, but she wasn't a true front-line fighter. I didn't expect her to last long.

Then, when all hope seemed lost…

"S-Sorry! I was unconscious for a bit…!"

Yunyun suddenly teleported beside us. She had a bit of blood running down her forehead, but otherwise, she seemed fine.

And then shortly after, came flying in, carried by her wind spirits, which looked like small clouds.

"Ah… That [Teleport] spell is really useful…! My teleportation mark was all the way back in the base, though!"

Yunyun was the veteran teleporter and had the presence of mind to instantly set a mark on this area, but Rin only just learned it after reaching level 100. That was something I needed her to keep in mind from now on.

But I was just glad that she was safe.

"Everyone's back…"

If only I had enough time to make earpieces for everyone to access the divine laptop.

The only ones who could come back were the spellcasters who learned [Teleport].

Still, this was a huge relief. At least I knew that Rin and Yunyun were fine.

And I could increase our fighting forces even further.

"[Summon Familiar]!"

Mary appeared in front of me. She was shivering, with ice forming on her skin.

"Finally! What took you so long?!"

"...Sorry. My head was a mess. I can think a bit clearer now, though."

Knowing that some of them were safe allowed me to think more rationally now.

With our fighting forces slowly returning, now it was their side that was outnumbered.

But that didn't last long.

The shadows of Hoost and Arnes also stretched out.

Then, from within their shadows, more devils emerged.

All of them had adamantite armor and weapons that looked magical.

"Arnes-sama, Hoost-sama… What are your commands…"

"Defeat those humans!"

"Right away!"

My [Lore Reading] told me that these were Greater Devils, not like the imps and such that I encountered in the dungeon, or the succubi in the shop.

Devils summoning devils, huh…?

Their abilities were just too broken!

Part 6

With Mitsurugi and Darkness missing, I had to fulfill the role of a frontliner.

Especially with Yunyun, Rin and Mary all needing frontline support.

So, I put on the adamantite full-plate armor and took out my trusty partner, Chunchunmaru.

"Let's go, partner…!"

"Y-Yes, let's go, Kazuma-san!"

…I didn't have the heart to tell poor Yunyun that I wasn't talking to her.

As I charged into the horde of devils, I tried a new skill combination.

"[Rune Warrior]! [Drain Touch]!"

Most attack skills required mana to use, so I had been avoiding them, as I needed to save my mana for my spells and other useful skills.

But with [Rune Warrior] and [Drain Touch], I could now apply the effects of [Drain Touch] with my weapon attacks.

Purple aura surrounded my body, and my eyes and hair turned the same color. Necrotic energies radiated from the blade of Chunchunmaru as I attacked.

"[Sonic Strike]! [Mighty Slash]! [Side Slash]!"

Using [Combo] along with my animation-cancelling technique, I disappeared in a blur of motion and dealt numerous strikes to the devils before me, all in one, uninterrupted motion.

Fighting like a true Swordsmaster, I demolished every enemy in my sight with my blade.

Heh, I'm so cool right now.

With my mana constantly refilling, I was able to spam these attacks endlessly, as I sapped the health, stamina and mana of the demons.

That said, this [Drain Touch] state will only last one minute.

So, I made the most of it.

"[Surpass Limits]!"

This was the skill that I was the most interested in with the Swordmaster class.

My physical stats doubled while my stamina and health was quickly drained, however, with me absorbing everything that was drained…

I unleashed several combos at once, which would have ordinarily made me pass out already.

"H-How did he kill off our devils so quickly?! They were no slouches!"

Arnes said, gasping as she watched all her summons fall so easily.

Fifty seconds left…

"[Sonic Strike]!"

I disappeared in a burst of speed and appeared before Arnes. Before she could react, I unleashed a combo of attack skills on her.

"Gahhh!"

Not used to fighting in melee range, all she could do was try to escape.

But as soon as she flew away…

"[Rune of Saber]!"

A large slash of devastating energy emerged from my blade towards Arnes.

"[Cursed Crystal Prison]!"

I thought that Arnes would try to freeze me, but…

She created a frozen barrier around herself just in time to block [Rune of Saber].

Then, she reappeared outside, likely using [Teleport] to escape.

"Hah!"

To my surprise, she kicked the frozen barrier towards me. The force of the kick meant that there was now a large pillar of ice hurtling towards me.

I tried to move out of the way, but…

"]Bottomless Swamp]!"

I couldn't react in time as Hoost lifted his hand and prevented me from moving.

"[Inferno]!"

Thankfully, Yunyun melted the ice before it could hit me.

"Gah!"

The steam that came out of it still stung, though.

I tried to teleport away from the bottomless swamp, but…

I guess I can't do that against an enemy that had way more magic power than me.

"[Overwhelm]!"

Instead, I used [Overwhelm] to break from the crowd control effect. It was a slow process though, and Hoost was charging forward to attack me again.

"Wind spirits! Protect senpai!"

Rin commanded her wind spirits, which created a powerful gust that prevented Hoost from following up with an attack.

Meanwhile, Mary…

She snuck up to flank Hoost and launched a vine from her body.

At the tip of the vine was her 'beloved's' dagger.

"Gahhh!"

Not even Hoost could walk away unscathed from the cheat item that bypassed defenses. He was forced to retreat.

All this time, it seemed that Wolbach and Megumin were eyeing each other.

With Wolbach's increased stats, she could probably cast another explosion.

But she knew that Megumin could do that as well, with her mana refilled.

Both were at a stalemate, like two countries with hundreds of nukes, holding back only due to the threat of mutual destruction.

My [Rune Warrior] state was running out. Only twenty seconds now.

Arnes was in flight, but Hoost stayed on the ground to protect his master.

Even if Wolbach had increased her mana capacity, there was no way she could freely spam spells after already casting explosion and a forced teleport.

Which meant that if we dealt with her minions, she was vulnerable, and the nuclear stalemate wouldn't matter anymore.

"Yunyun, Rin! Focus on Arnes! Mary, attack Hoost with me!"

"Got it, senpai!"

"O-OK!"

"Hah… What a demanding father I have…"

This brat Mary is talking back in such an important moment like this…?!

I'll have to spank her later!

Putting that aside, I focused on the combination attack with Mary.

"[Challenge]!"

Using the Knight skill, I engaged Hoost's attention.

Now that we were locked in a 'duel', he couldn't even attempt to block Mary's attack.

"[Triple Attack]."

"Grahhh!"

The dagger pierced through his shoulder three times in rapid succession, drawing blood.

"[Defuse]!"

With the skill I learned from Regina, I ended Hoost's focus on me and used [Sonic Strike] to disappear from his vision, going behind him.

His focus naturally went to Mary, who had dealt the most damage to him so far.

Using that opening…

I sheathed Chunchunmaru and summoned my bow.

I formed an ice arrow, drew back the string.

Using [Smithing] to combine the Hyper-Rhino horn and the vibrating golem arrows into the attack…

"[Power Shot]! [Snipe]! [Meta-Control Spell]!"

With a maxed out [Headshot], even with [Signature Spell] and [Signature Attack] adding onto the damage…

Not to mention all the crit bonuses I had…

He didn't stand a chance.

The defenseless, unaware Hoost disappeared in a black mist, returning to Hell as I took a life from him.

…He seemed like a cool guy when I was captured. Hopefully I can see him again someday on better terms.

As for Arnes…

"Ponko-sensei! I'm relying on you…?!"

"...?!"

I turned in surprise towards Rin, who summoned Ponko in such a deadly fight.

"Hah…? I told you I had to finish this manuscript, why the hell are you summoning me?!"

Ponko was summoned while wearing only a loose t-shirt over her body. Her hair was also a mess and she was wearing round-glasses over her eyes.

"I'm sorry! But I really need your help!"

"...Fine… Let's just get this over with… Pon!"

Ponko clapped her hands together and smoke surrounded her.

When the smoke dispersed, I saw that she had transformed into a copy of Arnes.

"What…?!"

Arnes exclaimed, as her clone flew upwards to attack her.

I see… Since she was a Tanuki spirit, Ponko was capable of taking the form of others.

Just like how Tanukis were depicted in myth.

With Arnes distracted by an evenly-matched clone of herself, Yunyun could focus on taking her down.

"[Cursed Lightning]!"

Yunyun summoned black lightning from the sky, which struck Arnes, who couldn't avoid it.

She fell down, twitching, before she too, disappeared in black smoke.

Seeing this, Wolbach had no choice.

"[Teleport]!"

"[Skill Bind]!"

Except that I countered her again.

"..."

Looking around, seeing that she was alone…

She sighed and raised her hands.

"...I surrender."

With no other option left, the Dark Goddess Wolbach had surrendered.

You have defeated enough Demon King generals!
