Chapter 63: An Apology To This Princess!

Part 1

Ponko, still in her Arnes form, along with Yunyun, Rin and Mary, kept an eye on the captured Wolbach. She was currently tied up with my [Bind] after I drained all of her mana, leaving her in a mana exhausted state. I didn't want to take any risks with her.

Meanwhile, I kept trying to contact Aika-chan over and over.

Until, eventually…

"Papa! Sorry, I went offline for a bit there!"

"Aika-chan! What happened to you?!"

"...I actually ended up being teleported into a high-level dungeon trap, I think… My golem body got destroyed…"

"I see…"

I didn't even think about that.

If [Teleport] could work in and out of the dungeon, then a random teleport would be the same.

But still, that trap must be on the highest floors if it managed to destroy Aika-chan's golem body like that.

What an unfortunate turn of events.

"Quickly! You need to find the others! Open dungeon doors to them!"

"On it!"

Aika-chan worked quickly to find where the others were. After a few seconds, several dungeon doors opened to us.

"...Blasted Dark Goddess! I'll smite you once and for all!"

Aqua was the first to come out. For some reason, there were chicken feathers and hay all over her clothes and hair.

Mitsurugi, Chris and Darkness came out next, also coming out with their weapons.

Mitsurgi and Darkness also looked quite dirty, while Chris was completely unblemished.

They all looked at Wolbach, tied up with a look of defeat on her face.

"Wait… We won?"

Mitsurugi said, lowering his sword in relief.

"Yeah… Everyone is safe, thank goodness!"

Darkness sighed as she found us all in one piece.

"You're welcome!"

Aqua said, hands on her hips proudly.

…She didn't even do anything.

"I'm glad everyone made it out OK…"

Chris said, with a smile. Although she soon turned to Wolbach with a cold look on her face.

"So… What should we do with her? Maybe have Aqua-sen… I mean, Aqua-san exorcise her?"

Aqua grinned and raised her staff.

"Ohhh… Good idea, Chris! Let's start!"

"Hold it."

I raised my hand before Aqua could start blasting away.

I glanced at Megumin, who was giving Wolbach a conflicted expression, then said,

"No, let's keep her as a prisoner of war."

Using the same logic for when we captured Dante, I didn't want to give the DK army an excuse to mistreat future POWs. If we executed Wolbach now, they could use that as precedent for indiscriminate executions of their own.

"...We don't have a way of preventing her from teleporting away, though."

Rin said, bringing up that problem.

I did think about having a clone watch over her and constantly using [Drain Touch].

But Wolbach could probably overpower the clone, even if I used a high-level golem.

While thinking of a way to properly imprison her, I thought about the prison system of Lizardia.

There is a special property to the jails there, where one's skill points, levels and stats will go down with each day spent there.

"I think I know where to put her."

"...Kazuma, you've got quite the nasty grin there… I wish you'd reserve those looks for me."

Darkness said, when she saw the expression I had as I came up with my idea.

The only issue was getting the king of the lizardmen to agree on having Wolbach as a prisoner.

They did get along with app-users, but they had nothing to do with the outside world.

And I couldn't exactly lie to him due to the lie detecting magic items and divination magic they had.

Still, it was the only thing I could think of to properly contain Wolbach.

When I told the others, Mitsurugi said,

"Well… That does make sense, but I'd argue that having her lose all her stats and levels is quite a severe punishment…"

He looked at Wolbach with pity.

Wolbach herself sighed and said,

"It's actually pretty lenient as far as prisoner treatment goes."

"Yeah, considering what you did to me last time…"

She averted her gaze from me as I remembered those war crimes she committed by forcing herself on me.

…Well, I did enjoy it, but…

Nobody needed to know that.

There was the issue, however, of transferring Wolbach to the dungeon.

Wiz could enter before, while Vanir couldn't.

So I was wondering if Wolbach could enter.

Aika-chan did some communication with the dungeon AI upon my request, to see if Wolbach would be allowed inside.

"It seems that we can bring her in as a prisoner!"

I see.

It was fitting, since this was a dungeon, after all.

I didn't think that the dungeon would actually be used to take in prisoners, though.

We took the teleportation circle to the 60th floor.

As we entered the dungeon door leading to Lizardia, the guards recognized us.

"Ah, it's the party that captured the terrorist. Thank you for your service!"

Oho. It's always nice to have NPCs recognize your past achievements.

"About that. We seek an audience with your king. It's important, so we'd rather not wait in line like before."

They looked down at their table, at what looked like a small bell. Since I was telling the truth, it didn't ring. After a few seconds, they nodded.

"It seems you're telling the truth. Go ahead."

Lizardia's system was way too convenient.

I wish our world operated like this.

…Although being unable to lie was a blatant violation of freedom of speech.

I suppose no system of governance is ever perfect.

We all had our IDs from last time, but Wolbach didn't have one. They also noticed that Wolbach was tied up.

"...What's this? Some kind of kinky play?"

Wolbach was being treated like she had Darkness' proclivities. I noticed her blushing at the misunderstanding.

"No, she's our prisoner. That's what we want to see your king about."

"Your prisoner?! …Well, I guess it's the king's business. Go ahead."

These guys really just let their king handle everything, huh?

Based on what I saw last time, the king seemed to deal with a lot of requests everyday.

Poor guy seems overworked.

And now I was going to ask him to jail a Dark Goddess for us.

I kinda felt bad for him.

Wolbach obediently followed us into Lizardia. She looked around with awe in her eyes.

"A kingdom built by lizardmen… Fascinating…"

That surprised me.

"Eh? Does something like this not exist in the otherworld?"

"Not to this extent. At most, lizardmen only built villages. Most of them rely on banditry to make ends meet."

Just like the lizardmen in the lower floors, who formed groups to attack app-users.

I suppose most monsters aren't able to form an advanced society like this.

So how did the lizardmen here get this advanced?

Aqua chuckled and put a hand on her chest.

"You seem curious, Kazuma. Do you want me to explain?"

"...You barely know anything about the dungeon you supposedly helped create, so why should I rely on you? Aika-chan, do you know?"

"How rude, papa! Obviously, mama knows! Right, mama?!"

"Yes, I do! You see, the lizardmen here are blessed by my creation of this dungeon, that's why they're smarter!"

Aika-chan gave Aqua a thumbs up.

"Excellent answer, mama!"

I stared at Aika-chan.

"OK, now give me the real answer."

"...The lizardmen in this floor have no natural predators, as they exclusively own this floor as the boss monsters. The abundant resources and safety has led to them learning how to use magic, create technologies and produce social advancements that have led to the development of this near-utopian society."

So it had nothing to do with Aqua's blessing.

Or should I say curse.

"A peaceful world leads to advancements, huh? I doubt that will last long."

Wolbach didn't seem satisfied with that explanation as she muttered that.

"...Is peace really so bad?"

Megumin asked her. Wolbach couldn't meet Megumin's eyes, but she responded.

"A society like this will just stagnate if it remains peaceful forever. Stagnation leads to people losing purpose and meaning. An unsatisfied and confused populace leads to any empire's ruin."

As expected of the god of destruction. She seemed to hate the concept of peace.

"...Although, this would be a nice place to live in since there's nothing going on."

And then there's the sloth aspect of Wolbach that made her seek out peace.

I must say, her aspects were incredibly misaligned.

Whoever gave her those aspects played a cruel joke.

"Wait, Satou! Where's Iris-chan!"

Mitsurugi said, after he did a head count.

I glanced away from him.

"Well, the thing is…"

At the last second, I chose not to open a dungeon door for Iris.

"Satou… She's gonna be very upset with you."

I knew that, but we had other things to focus on right now.

Or, I guess, I just didn't want to think about how Iris would react.

Part 2

We were given a private audience with King Lizardia.

"Thank you once again for apprehending the terrorist last time."

He said, after leading us to a private reception room. We were seated along couches and the servants put a tower of snacks in front of us, along with tea. Aqua, Aika-chan and Megumin immediately leapt for the snacks.

King Lizardia crossed his legs and gave me a studious look, before glancing over to Wolbach.

"...This is the prisoner you mentioned?"

Wolbach looked away, appearing annoyed that she was going to be held captive by a bunch of Lizardmen, although there wasn't much she could do about it.

"Yes. I would like to keep her in your prison."

They were much better equipped to deal with Wolbach than I ever could in my own holding cells.

King Lizardia looked over at a scroll a servant handed to him.

"I see. She's incredibly dangerous and can even use teleport… But no worries about the teleport. We have [Dimensional Anchor] runes set up in our cells.

Wolbach's eyes widened at that. I asked,

"...What's that spell?"

"It's a spell that ensures one is anchored in their current location. So that means teleportation magic isn't possible in our cells."

"Oho! That's just what we need!"

These lizardmen were truly advanced!

"But there's a problem. Why should we keep such a powerful prisoner here? In the low chance that she does escape, then our civilization is doomed."

I knew he would bring this up.

With the hero class, I had access to every class's skills now, after all.

And there were also other martial classes like Berserker…

Which I still had One-Shot Bear materials to create armor for.

I found them eating dishes cooked from monster parts.

Your Strength, Stamina, Speed, Dexterity, Health, Magic Power and Mana Capacity increased by +7!

"...I know we have golem bodies, but the psychological impact of gorging on monster food all day isn't good for our sanity."

"I'm just doing it because of a quest."

"...At least pretend like you're actually interested."

His enthusiasm died as soon as he heard my real intentions.

Still, he told me that they were meeting tonight. I came along with him later on to the dungeon.

"You guys meet in the dungeon?"

That place really has become a main hub for app-users…

They all had adamantite armor and had all kinds of magical swords. Most of them probably chose those swords as their cheat items.

They all looked like Mitsurugi clones, basically.

That was why they were all wearing the same armor.

Chapter 64: A Training Camp For These Clubmates!

Part 1

I snuck out of the Swordmaster meeting early. This was because they didn't actually provide me with any useful information.

Instead, to make better use of my time, I headed home to start reading those spell tomes I received.

I received spell tomes for the [Light of Saber], [Light of Refraction] and [Tornado] spell.

With my [Arcane Learning] skill, the speed at which a spell could be learned increases. It also increases when someone who knows the spell teaches it to you.

Yunyun knew [Light of Saber] and [Light of Refraction] but didn't know Tornado. I had her teach me the first two spells first.

"Hmm… With [Light of Saber] it feels like gathering mana into your hand and converting it into light energy… As for how to do that, you just have to use the same feeling you have when casting light spells."

The reason why magic took longer to learn compared to other skills was because no one in this world really had a natural aptitude for magic.

Even if you read from a spell tome, a lot of the terms and concepts were so alien to us.

Things like becoming one with the spirits, learning how to attune to elements… None of it really makes sense.

For an otaku who had vast knowledge of fictional worlds and magic systems, some of it did make sense, but that kind of media knowledge couldn't cover the more esoteric concepts.

Not to mention having to memorize the chants required for advanced magic.

Having the correct intonation, pace and even the emotional state required to evoke certain spells meant that every component of a spell had to be perfect.

And not to mention that one could just not be a good match for the element of the spell they're attempting to cast. It was all very complicated.
No wonder why the Arch-Wizard class required a genius-level intellect.

Yunyun and Megumin who started off with the Arch-Wizard class were, quite frankly, outliers.

"...[Light of Saber]!"

In the practice room, I attempted to slice a target in half by releasing a blade of mana converted into magical light.

Only for the spell to fizzle out before it could reach the target.

"...Ah… D-Don't worry, Kazuma-san! You'll get it eventually!"

Yunyun said, lifting my spirits with her encouraging words.

I sat down on a chair, feeling frustrated, as I grabbed the spell tome again to read it.

"This is harder than I thought…"

I tried using [Soul Transfer] to switch with Yunyun's body, but I found that I couldn't even use the spell in her body.

Unlike other skills, there were no immediate shortcuts for Advanced Magic…

Although when I thought about it, I didn't have as many problems with learning [Bottomless Swamp].

…Maybe I was just incompatible with the spell?

I went to the crystal ball to see what the problem was.

…The darkness in your heart means that you are incompatible with Advanced light magic. You can use Intermediate and Elementary light magic just fine, though.

"Hah?! What does that mean?!"

I lost my temper when I heard its explanation.

"Hey, you better give me a better explanation, before I melt you down and reshape you into an unflattering shape that will make women and children cry!"
This is what I meant by darkness in your heart…

"P-Please calm down, Kazuma-san! Even if it's tougher for you to learn light magic, you can keep working hard at it! You can also just learn [Tornado] in the meantime!"

What was even the point of trying to learn a spell if it was going to be less effective for me?

Still, I knew she was right and there was no point in getting upset over this.

I took a break for the night, since I already spent many hours trying to learn [Light of Saber].

Besides, I had plans for tomorrow.

It was time for the training camp trip with the naginata club.

While the soccer training camp was suddenly disrupted, I hoped that nothing would happen this time.

My goal was to rest before then, but…

"Um… Kazuma-san… Tonight do you want to…?"

Yunyun just had to give me an adorable gaze.

So, instead of resting for the trip tomorrow, I spent it having babymaking sex with Yunyun.

"Hmm… What will we need for this trip? Maybe a swimsuit?"

"...Are you coming to train or play around?"

I told her, when I saw the things she was packing.

Aside from clothes, she brought board games, a swimsuit and some kind of portable disco ball.

"T-This is my first time going on a training camp, so I'm excited!"

I guess they didn't have training camps for school clubs in England.

Or this rich girl was just so sheltered that she didn't have those kinds of experiences.

I let her off easy and didn't tease her too much for overpacking.

We met up at the train station with Terada-senpai and Lia.

…Along with another person.

Terada-senpai's classmate, the girl who obviously had a crush on him, was also there.

"We don't have a manager, so Mio-san here volunteered to help out."

Terada-senpai explained, as he gestured to the girl with short, side-swept hair.

Her neat hair and straight-laced impression made her look like the serious, studious type, but she had long, painted nails, perfectly applied makeup and looked more like a popular girl than a class-rep like Lia's classroom persona.

She bowed to us with a nonchalant expression.

"...Yeah, I'll be your manager for this trip, I guess."

She didn't seem all that motivated about being a manager.

She did seem motivated about Terada-senpai, though.

Lia and I exchanged a knowing glance, as Darkness helped Mio-san with carrying the equipment. We leaned close to each other and said,

"...That girl is being really assertive right now, huh?"

"Well, this is their last summer as highschoolers together."

So it was her all-out attack.

Knowing Terada-senpai, he probably didn't notice that Mio-san was pursuing him this whole time.

Like a stereotypical dense MC.

"Hmm… Maybe we should try to hook them up together?"

I told Lia, who shook her head.

"Let's just see where this goes. I don't like interfering in people's business unless I have to."

She sounded super respectful, if not for the fact that she still planned on interfering if things didn't go smoothly.

Part 2

Terada-senpai booked two rooms in a ryokan for us to stay in, one for the guys and one for the girls. The ryokan was in close proximity to the beach and was a popular destination for students on a budget, as well as tourists.

Of course, since this was a budget ryokan, it had only basic facilities, which included an onsen and a minimalistic recreation room with a beat-up ping pong table. The ventilation was a bit of an issue, as the whole place smelled faintly like sulfur from the onsen, although it was a smell that most locals were used to, due to the close proximity to the hot spring source. I saw a bunch of foreigners complaining about the rotten egg smell on the review page, though.

There was a dinner service, but they wouldn't be served directly in our rooms by the hostess. We'd have to go to a communal area, where the food was served in a semi-buffet service. I say semi-buffet because it wasn't on an 'all you can eat' basis. It was self-serve, but visitors were limited by one plate's worth of food.

As far as most ryokans go, this one was definitely a bit of an outlier in terms of its lackluster provisions and hospitality, however, I suppose the old adage of 'you get what you pay for' applies to the mediocre, yet inoffensive, experience.

I couldn't exactly show off my wealth, so I didn't offer to upgrade our amenities, even though I wanted to treat everyone again. They already started to have suspicions about me when I treated everyone to expensive sushi. If I offered to treat everyone to a luxury ryokan stay, Terada-senpai and Lia would definitely start asking questions that I wouldn't have an answer to, regardless of how high my 'Cunning' stat was.

After the hostess led us to our rooms, we dropped off our luggage for the three day stay in our rooms. Terada-senpai wanted to change his clothes since the ride here was long and hot. While he was switching out his shirt for a tanktop, I started to probe him about Mio-san.

"So… Terada-senpai, you seem close with Mio-san…"

"Hm? Well, I guess? She's close to everyone in the class, though."

How clueless was this guy?

What kind of female classmate follows you along on a camping trip just to help out?

"You two seemed to have a good mood going on."

"I hope so. We're classmates, after all!"

Yeah, this guy was impenetrable.

This girl looked at him like she was about to go down on her knees to give him head as soon as he asked for it, yet here he was going on about classmates and whatever else.

Get a clue!

I decided to give up for now as we went out to rejoin the others. Sometimes there's such a thing as a lost cause. If he woke up in his thirties one day in a pool of cold sweat thinking to himself, 'Wait, was she flirting with me?!', it was none of my business. And to spare his sanity, if he called me years later to confirm his suspicions, I'd tell him that he was just imagining it. Nothing hurts a guy more than knowing you missed a girl's very obvious signals, you can trust me on that.

We met up outside the ryokan, with the girls taking a few minutes longer to freshen up from our trip. I noticed that Mio-san reapplied her makeup and even fixed her hair before she came out. Lia went over to me and whispered,

"...Poor girl was in a panic, asking us if she looked presentable."

"She's trying so hard, but…"

I looked at Terada-senpai, who had an oblivious, goofy look on his face as Mio-san talked to him. She was practically giving him 'fuck me' eyes, but he didn't respond at all.

Darkness joined us as well and lowered her voice.

"Um, Mio-san just asked me to give her as much alone time with Terada-senpai as possible…"

Was this really a training camp, or a lovers' retreat?

My questions were answered when Terada-senpai announced that our training officially started, causing Mio-san's face to fall from a cheerfully seductive look, to one of hopeless apathy. He instructed us to run three laps around the beach. Lia was wearing short-shorts and a loose t-shirt, while Darkness wore an active tank-top and compression shorts. Meanwhile, our so-called manager was dressed for a photoshoot, with that sundress of hers. She also constantly reapplied her lip balm and always checked a hand mirror.

…It must be tough, being a maiden pursuing a dense guy.

The beach run was easy for Darkness and I, who had superhuman stats, and Lia also managed to keep up. Of course, Darkness and I made sure to hold back, but it was impressive how Lia was able to keep up with us. Still, she was out of breath by the end of it, while Darkness and I hadn't even broken a sweat yet. We made sure to act like we were tired, though.

There was a community center near the beach, which we would use for our actual naginata training. We went back to our rooms to retrieve the equipment before heading to the center. We welcomed the cool air conditioning inside, as we waited in the lobby for Terada-senpai to get day passes for all of us.

We also reserved a room with mats for our training. Once we were properly equipped, we took turns sparring one another.

"You haven't gotten rusty at all, Satou-kun…!"

Terada-senpai said, once we started sparring.

It was all due to my maxed out [Spear] skill, so I felt a bit bad that he was praising me so much.

Not wanting to expose myself, or make Terada-senpai feel bad about his skills, I just played defensively and focused on keeping him at bay, as well as countering his attacks.

Once we were done sparring, I went to get some water. When I checked my phone, I was surprised to see a notification.

You learned a Lancer skill!

[Polearm Sentinel] Skill Rank: 1, Passive Skill

Keep opponents at bay using the superior reach of your weapon. When using a defensive stance with a polearm, gain a temporary +1 to your AC.

[Fancy Footwork] Skill Rank: 1, Passive Skill

You gain +5% movement speed when wielding a polearm.

[Lunge] Skill Rank: 1, Active Skill (10 mp)

Lunge forward 10-feet with your pole arm. Ignore +1 evasion points from the enemy when executing this move.

Since I had the hero class, I was now learning skills even from classes that I didn't equip yet.

I didn't really use spears so much these days, which was why I didn't take the Lancer skill.

But there was no harm in learning these skills, since I didn't need to switch classes now with the Hero class.

The Hero class really was incredibly OP…

We switched partners now, with Darkness sparring Terada-senpai and me fighting Lia.

Once Lia and I finished our spar, she said,

"...Darkness really improved so much, didn't she? I noticed it during our club activities, but… She really has worked so hard."

Considering how Darkness looked like she was dropped on a deck and flopping around like a fish when she first joined the club, it was understandable that Lia was impressed.

Thankfully, Darkness's hard work made it a natural progression, so Lia and Terada-senpai weren't suspicious of any unnatural growth.

Even if Darkness used the golem trap method like I did to gain a bunch of levels, I knew that she worked hard enough. She didn't take any shortcuts, so she deserved all the praise.

"Yeah, I'm proud of her."

Lia smiled, as I felt a bit embarrassed for admitting this.

"There's that nice side of you I like so much. Show it more often!"

"If I'm nice all the time, you'll just get used to it and it will become something you expect, not something you look forward to."

Her smile dropped when I said this.

…I was just joking around, though.

Maybe.

Part 3

At the very least, the quality of the onsen was quite good, compared to everything else in the ryokan, although that was more a testament to the natural formation of the springs, rather than human intervention. After the bath, we had some coffee milk before meeting up with the others on the beach again. The ryokan only offered the 'buffet' service at night, meaning we had to have lunch somewhere else. "Of course I'm not! I'm a proper maiden who is very delicate and feminine!"

A maiden doesn't even know about her own feminine charms. If I were to compare it to something, living as a maiden was an existence equivalent to an Eldritch sleeping god, one unaware of its own terrifying powers, yet inexplicably affects every facet of reality. A maiden's modesty had the same property of omnipresent naivete.

Which circles back to my previous point, what a brute.

And maybe a bit of sexual tension sometimes.

OK, maybe a lot.

We stopped in our tracks as we heard an unfamiliar male voice.

Standing in front of us, under a streetlight, was that guy from earlier.

I immediately stepped forward in front of Lia. She stared at him in shock and said,

"Um… Do I know you?"

"I'm your biggest fan, Lia-chan! Yet, here you are, cozying up with some guy! I-I bet he's your boyfriend, right?"

"...Look, I'm not her boyfriend, I'm just her club member."

I said, trying to deescalate the situation. But he wasn't having it.

"You think I was born yesterday?! I thought you were different from the other girls, Lia-chan… But you're just another whore!"

I could see the distress on Lia's face. I turned to her and said,

"Let's just head back."

"Like hell I'll let you leave!"

He ran towards us with a speed that no ordinary human should be capable of.

I saw a glint of steel appear on his hand. I dodged back, but his speed meant that he got a clean cut on me.

"Nghk…!"

The fact that he was actually able to damage me…

This guy was an app-user.

I was about to grab Lia and teleport away with her, not risking a fight with an app-user while she was around.

But for a moment, I couldn't move, not even to cast a spell.

Warning! You have been poisoned! You are unable to take an action for five seconds!

Using my paralysis to his advantage, he grabbed Lia, lifting her on his shoulders. She struggled, trying to kick away, but he was too strong. He then ran away with her.

A poisoned dagger…

Considering his speed and usage of poisons, he was probably a Thief or Assassin. Maybe he multiclassed to both, along with Dark Stalker.

How troublesome.

And I didn't even know what his cheat item or ability was yet…

As soon as I was able to move, I put on the earpiece and created a dungeon door in front of them. He gained quite a considerable distance with his speed, but I was able to immediately catch up.

"...?!"

He was surprised when I suddenly stepped out of the door.

He tried to attack me with the poisoned dagger again.

But I took out Chunchunmaru from my inventory to parry the attack.

"You're an app-user, too, huh?! I'll kill you!"

He attacked again, but when I moved to block the attack…

I suddenly couldn't lift Chunchunmaru anymore.

I was forced to abandon Chunchunmaru, or risk taking another attack from that poisoned dagger.

I didn't want to risk harming Lia, so I didn't fire off any spells or arrows.

This psycho could use her as a shield, after all.

"[Steal]!"

I went ahead to steal the dagger.

Even though I stole his weapon…

He grinned and another one appeared in his hands.

"You think I don't keep multiple copies? Any cheap dagger will do, as long as I can put poison on it!"

I guess as a Thief, he knew how effective the [Steal] skill was.

There was no point trying to see how many daggers this guy had.

Instead, I pulled out my Spear of Thunder to attack him.

But just like last time, the spear became too heavy, and I was forced to put it back in my inventory.

This guy might have some kind of weight manipulation ability.

But he wasn't using it on me to slow my movements or freeze me altogether… Maybe it only works on items?

"...Aren't you gonna explain your ability?"

I asked, as my mind raced for a solution to this.

"What, you think this is some kind of anime? Screw you!"

I guess he wasn't just gonna expose his weakness like that.

"[Create Water]! [Freeze]!"

Anything stronger than Elementary magic was a no-go, as Lia might get caught up in it.

So, I attempted to make him slip by creating a frozen puddle under him.

But I guess his 'Dexterity' was too high for that. He easily leapt away from the puddle.

"Using that kind of weak magic… You're a total noob, aren't you?"

He grinned confidently.

…What can I do? I can't use anything that would take too much firepower.

Should I summon Mary?

No, if he's outnumbered, this coward might use a skill like [Escape] to run off with Lia.

Even if I use dungeon doors, as a thief, he will have ways to elude my capture.

But it wasn't like I could use weapons against him… He'll just make it too heavy.

…Although, maybe I could also disarm him?

Something that would catch him off guard, unlike [Steal], which he was already used to fighting against.

I had an idea.
I hadn't tried this before, though…

Still, it was worth the gamble. One wrong move and this bastard will just run away.

And who knows what he'd do to Lia while I was looking for him.

I went ahead and used [Lightning].

But rather than use it offensively…

"[Meta-Control Spell]!"

I used the electric charge and converted it to a magnetic force that repulsed the knife.

"Gahhh!"

He wasn't expecting it at all and the knife was magnetically snatched away.

It was a rather complicated way to deal a nonlethal attack, but it worked…

Then…

I used my own superhuman speed to take advantage of his surprise.

I appeared in front of him, and used Sena's lessons…

"Gack…!!!"

…I hit him in the gut with an uppercut, [Unarmed Combat] adding to the potency of the attack.

And followed it up with a combo of punches.

Finally, I caught him with a knee strike.

I grabbed Lia before he fell over, unconscious.

"[Bind]!"

Once Lia was safe, I tied him up before he could wake up, then put him in a holding cell in the dungeon.

I'd have to send him over to Lizardia like with Wolbach, but I kept him in the cell for now.

"...You OK?"

I asked Lia, who was crying and shaking.

"W-What was that, what just happened?! Oh my god, Kazuma, you're hurt!"

I looked down at the cut that guy gave me. It was a small wound, so I didn't think much about it.

Even though such a wound would have made me cry out in panic early into my days as an App-User.

I chuckled and used [Heal] to close the wound.

Lia stared in shock as she saw my skin close up.

"How did you…"

After what she just witnessed, she probably had a bunch of questions.

"...Let's go somewhere safe for now. I'll explain everything."

She nodded, as I ushered her away into a dungeon door. She hesitated for a moment, but eventually followed me inside.

Part 5

Lia looked around at the main room of my dungeon. I gestured to the couch, as I went to the fridge to get some juice.

"Go ahead and take a seat."

She warily sat down, still confused by everything.

"...This all feels like a fever dream."

Maybe I could have gotten away with that explanation, but I wanted to tell her the truth.

"Sorry, it's all real. Here, drink this."

I gave her a glass of apple juice. She nodded and sipped it.

"So, who are you really, Kazuma…?"

I scratched the back of my head, trying to think of the best way to explain this.

"Well, one day, I suddenly gained powers by entering a dungeon…"

"A dungeon…?"

"You know, like in RPGs and stuff."

"And that guy, he had powers, too?"

"Yeah, but obviously, he's misusing them."

My image of app-users weren't improving at all after the stunt this guy pulled.

If they weren't going to take the fight against the Demon King army seriously, the least they could do was not cause problems.

"So, like… You're some kind of superhero?"

I chuckled at that, not expecting Lia of all people to call me a superhero.

"Do I seem like a superhero? I don't have a cape or a mask, do I?"

Her expression, which had been apprehensive so far, melted into a soft smile.

"Well, you did rescue me and all… That was certainly very heroic."

I gave her a smile back. I sat down with her and looked seriously into her eyes.

"Are you OK? That must have been really scary."

She nodded before looking down at her lap.

"Yeah. When he attacked you… I was so scared."

"Don't worry. He only did about 15 damage to me."

"...What does that even mean?"

Of course, she didn't understand. She went on to say,

"I never thought I'd get a crazy fan like that. It kind of makes me feel scared to continue as an idol."

She sank her face in her hands. It was a normal reaction. No matter how much she loved her fans, one psychotic fan would distort her perspective of the entire fanbase. Every time she performed, she'd look out at that crowd and wonder if there was some creep out there, watching her every movement, willing to cross the line if they had a chance.

I carefully put my arm around her. She didn't move away, leaning into the touch.

"Don't let that bastard get in the way of what you wanna do. You love Axel Hearts. I can tell."

After a moment, she let out a shuddering breath.

"Yeah, I do."

She stayed in my arms for a few moments, before she said,

"So… As a superhero, do you fight villains like that guy on a normal basis?"

She was still stuck on that whole superhero thing.

It was the most convenient explanation, so I just went along with it for now.

"Yeah. I've actually saved the world a couple times now."

"Really?!"

I wish I could say that I was exaggerating.

But with all those Demon King generals I defeated, I was telling the truth. The world was scarily close to being in the Demon King's clutches.

"...My best friend is a superhero… That's kind of crazy to think about."

She said, her hand going to my chest to idly draw vague shapes on it, as she laid her head on my shoulder.

"Well, you're the best friend of a superhero now, so I trust you to keep my identity a secret, all that typical superhero stuff."

She grinned, before saying,

"So, what are your powers like? Can you fly?"

I guess she'd get curious about that.

"...I can fly for a minute or so."

Using [Rune Warrior] along with wind magic, I could fly a little bit like I did against Mitsurugi, back when I was still a puppet. But it was more like hovering than flying.

"Only a minute? Why? That's not a lot…"

…Why did it feel like my manhood was being questioned when she says it like that?!

I coughed into my hand.

"W-Well, not all superheroes can fly."

"Then what can you do?"

"I can steal panties whenever I want."

"Are you sure you're a hero?! That sounds pretty villainous!"

She backed away, looking at me doubtfully.

However, she started chuckling again.

"Thanks, Kazuma."

"...Hm? Why are you thanking me all of a sudden?"

"I mean, you saved me, and now you're doing all this to make me feel better."

I glanced away.

"Not sure what you mean by that."

"You always do that, don't you, Kazuma? I noticed, you know? Sometimes you act like the butt of the joke when the mood gets too serious or tense, just to make the other person feel better."

Well, I guess she was right about that.

I couldn't really deny it.

"...Maybe we should head back to the ryokan. The others will wonder why it's taking so long."

"We don't even have any ice cream yet…"

I went back to the fridge and took out some ice cream.

"It's not their exact order, but I'll just let them complain a bit."

I opened a dungeon door near the ryokan. Lia looked out of it, gasping when she felt the cool, night air as she opened the door.

"...You can just create these doors anywhere?"

"Yeah, pretty much."

"So, you can take me wherever I wanna go if I call you?"

"You think I'm some kind of taxi service?"

I thought about it. Lia would be a lot safer if she had access to the dungeon door system.

"Give me your phone. I'll connect you to the system."

"Wait, you can seriously do that?"

I grinned as I took her phone.

"I'm a superhero, after all."

Part 6

Your bond with Konno Lia has reached its max rank!

Konno Lia (Idol-In-Disguise), Bond Rank: 7 (MAX)

There are no more secrets between you and Lia. You know that she's an idol, and she knows your role as the Hero of this world. She trusts her life with you, especially after you saved her from her crazy fan. In turn, you also trust her to always have your back, no matter what. With Lia, you have discovered the definition of a true friendship. You two have an unbreakable bond, but it is also one that will continue to grow from here on. Where will this road take you? That's up to you two!

Bond Reward: You learn the skill [Showmanship]!

[Showmanship] Skill Rank: 1, Passive Skill

Display your showmanship and stylistic flare in combat to increase your damage output! At rank 1, style ranking is graded by S, A, B, C and D. Starting from the 'D' grade, you will gain a 0.5x damage modifier to all attacks. This multiplier will increase by 0.5 with each grade above 'D'. These rankings will go down due to inactivity. If you go 3 seconds without attacking, the grade will go down by one, disappearing entirely if it goes below the 'D' grade.

After reading this skill I gained from our max bond rank, I thought…

Wait, isn't this a combat skill?!

The rules were that those who didn't have much potential to become an app-user could still establish bonds with an app-user, however, they could only provide non-combat Bond Ranks.

Just like with my family, they only provided real-world benefits, rather than those that had to do with the dungeon.

Up until now, Lia also didn't even provide me with combat-related bond rewards. Most of them were [Versatile Entertertainer] rank-ups and stat raises.

But the very last skill was clearly a combat skill!

"Hold on, Lia. I wanna try something."

I said, just as we arrived at the ryokan.

I opened another dungeon door and asked her to follow me inside. She nodded and did as I asked.

I then gave her my Spear of Thunder.

"Whoa… Is this a real spear…?"

She said, examining the weapon. She was only used to using those blunted naginata, after all.

"Yeah, I want you to try killing a monster with it."

"Hah? How do you expect me to do that?!"

"...Just give it a try."

I created a common golem in front of her.

"This thing isn't alive. It's a construct I just made. Just think of it as target practice."

"Well… OK…"

With a practiced, proficient movement, she lunged forward and killed the golem in one attack.

All of a sudden, her phone rang.

She took it out and narrowed her eyes.

"Kazuma, there's some weird app on my phone now."

"..."

Just like I expected.

The same as with Rin, Lia had hidden potential inside her.

Although it wasn't as high as Rin or even what I started out with.

After all, she didn't show any combat skills until the final rank.

Still, this was huge news.

Not only could she escape from hostile situations now with the dungeon doors. I could even have her level up as an app-user.

And now that she has a Rank 7 bond rank with me…

[Power of Friendship] would also grant her the effects of the Hero class.

"Wait, is this the app thing you mentioned earlier?!"

Lia said, as she looked at her phone, scrolling through the app.

I nodded and said,

"Yeah, with this, you can be a superhero like me."

"...I'm not sure about suddenly getting powers, though."

"You'll be a lot safer this way."

In the end, Lia couldn't disagree with that logic.

Using the [Teaching] skill, it didn't take me long to teach her the [Create Trap] skill.

I then had her make some traps for the golems, to quickly gain EXP.

She gained 20 levels on the spot.

It was already getting late, so we headed back to the ryokan while the new golem farm was operating.

"...Does it really take that long to get ice cream?"

Terada-senpai said, when we finally made it back.

"We ended up hanging out at the 7-Eleven for a while."

I lied, which the others accepted without arguing about it.

Your 'Cunning' has increased by +2!

We played some more Uno, but the punishment games were restricted to those we could do within the ryokan, since it was already getting late. An hour later, the girls headed back to their rooms.

The next morning, I woke up early to meet up with Darkness and Lia. I asked them to create dungeon doors and meet up in the dungeon's main room.

Darkness and Lia were surprised to see each other there. I then explained how Lia was attacked last night, and how she also awakened her potential as an app-user.

"I see… So it's possible to have late bloomers."

"Wait, Darkness is a superhero, too?!"

Lia said, looking at Darkness with surprise.

Darkness gave her a guilty look and even bowed.

"...Sorry. It's because I'm an app-user that I made such fast progress with the naginata!"

Lia just smiled at her and said,

"Aw, come on, Darkness. I know how hard you've been working. Powers or not, I still recognize you as a hard worker, OK?"

"...Lia… Thank you. I feel much better now."

Even though I told Darkness that same thing, I guess it meant much more coming from Lia.

I clapped my hands together to get their attention back and said,

"OK, I'm gonna take Lia to the heavenly realm and get her a cheat-item or ability. Darkness, stall for time for us."

"...Why do I have to do it…? Well, fine."

There was going to be a morning meeting over breakfast, so I wanted Darkness to buy us some time.

Meanwhile, I teleported with Lia to the same door that I used to get Rin a cheat item.

Since Lia unlocked her potential, it automatically reappeared in front of our school.

That same angel that replaced Aqua was still there.

However, she had a briefcase open and was putting personal effects in it.

"Ah, sorry, we're about to close! Eh? Oh, it's Satou Kazuma-sama!"

The angel looked at me with admiration, clasping her hands together.

…Is it just me, or was she treating me way differently from last time?

"I am blessed to be in the presence of the hero!"

Ah, so it was about that.

I guess an angel would treat the hero who was tasked to defeat the Demon King with reverence.

"Wait, you said you were closing, Angel-san?"

She nodded as she continued to fold a dress and put it in the briefcase.

"Yes, I'm being reassigned. Since the hero has been chosen, there is no more need for prospective heroes. Besides, we've received reports that the prospective heroes are causing more trouble than anything…"

"Yeah, we actually captured one of those troublemakers last night."

The angel nodded at that and said,

"We are sorry for the trouble!"

I gestured to Lia and said,

"Can you make an exception for her? She's an irreplaceable companion for me. I can vouch for her as the hero."

The angel looked at Lia, then smiled.

"Oh, yes! Actually, lots of us angels are big fans of Lia-sama! There are even those shipping you two together!"

"Hah…?" x2.

Both Lia and I said, in tandem.

The angel blushed and put her hands on her face.

"It's the hottest ship in the office right now! Of course, the other girls are all very sweet and have excellent chemistry with Kazuma-sama, but that tense, 'will they, won't they' dynamic you two have going on is so gooood! Oh, but of course I'm also a big fan of Kazumin and Kazuqua! Aqua-sama is my superior, after all, so I've gotta cheer for her!"

What is this angel on about?

Were they really watching my life that closely?!

Did they have nothing else better to do?!

They were like those ghosts who now currently live in Norse! I guess ghosts and angels have a lot of spare time. Way too much, I'd say, if they get bored this easily.

Lia shook her head.

"...So are you telling me that even angels are shipping me? Seems I can't escape it."

Since Lia was a popular idol, she was constantly shipped with other talents. Of course, this was only restricted to female talents, as idol fans would never even want her to interact with a man.

How idol fans were convinced that their oshis were only attracted to the same sex was some next level delusion.

"A-Anyway, of course we can make an exception for Lia-sama… But…"

"But what?"

"Please give me some fanservice."

Out of nowhere, she took out a phone and turned the flash camera on.

"...What do you mean by that?"

"I want some Kazuma x Lia action! Kazulia! Liakazu! That's what I mean! Come on, do you know how long we have been watching you?! All that tension and no progress… Is this some kind of 80s shoujo?! Are you trying to extend the serialization, or what?!"

This angel was quickly becoming unhinged.

Her eyes were bloodshot.

Still, we didn't really have much of a choice.

Lia shrugged and said,

"It's fine. I'm used to baiting fans with shipping service, anyway."

So she was used to yuri baiting, huh?

Well, I guess her agency asked her to do that.

This wasn't yuri baiting, though.

And so, we were forced to do some romantic posing for the Angel to take pictures of.

Stuff like forming hearts with our hands, giving each other a passionate hug, even using props such as heart-shaped pillows and a red string that was tied to our pinkies.

The kind of poses you'd see on the cover of some generic shoujo manga.

"Ahh… I'm healed… Thank you very much~!"

"Are you done now?"

I said, wondering if the angel had her fill.

"Yeah, I'm done. OK, go ahead and choose your cheat!"

She snapped and a book appeared in front of Lia.

"...I don't really know what to choose."

Lia said, when she looked over the list of overpowered items and abilities.

"Maybe choose something defensive. We're doing this so that you remain safe."

"...Alright. Then, how about this magical keyboard? It creates barriers once you play a song… I can also play the piano, so it suits me really well."

A barrier ability, huh?

In terms of protecting her, this would certainly be very useful.

"That sounds good."

The book closed and a bright light spread from it. When I opened my eyes, I saw a keyboard appear in front of us.

"There you go! I hope it serves you well!"

We thanked the angel before leaving the dimension.

Once we were outside, there was a bit of an awkward mood between me and Lia.

"W-Well, let's head back to the others, then."

"Yeah, sure…"

Even though we were normally so honest with each other, I guess having our 'chemistry' spelled out in front of us by a third party, so directly, was bound to make us feel awkward.

…And I knew for a fact that we'd start to get even more conscious of each other from now on.

Ah, that shipper angel just had to say all that!

Chapter 65: A Final Day For This Training Camp!

Part 1

Breakfast ended up being a trip to 7-Eleven. We had a potluck of fruits, noodles and tamagoyaki. We washed it down with tea. Since this place was a tourist hotspot, we even spotted one of those foreign travel YouTubers filming a video inside the 7=Eleven. Lia wisely stayed out of the recording, but Mio-san seemed to have a bit of a liking for the camera, always making sure she was in the shot.

When we finished our breakfast, we burned it off with a light jog on the beach, making sure not to overexert ourselves since we just ate. Once we finished our lap, we headed over to the community center. Lia checked her phone and said,

"It seems like my 'Stamina' went up a bit."

"It sure is convenient to keep track of your progress, huh?"

"Yeah… This makes me even more motivated to train, to be honest."

I knew the feeling well. Even when I was a lazy NEET, I felt a surge of excitement every time I saw my stats going up in real time. Of course, a lot of that initial wonder went away as I started gaining a whole bunch of levels and stats.

With Lia learning the [Spear] skill, as well as the Lancer skills, her movements improved dramatically during sparring. I felt bad for Terada-senpai, who was now the only one who wasn't an app-user. But he was still gracious in defeat.

"I see that this training camp has been benefiting you all a lot!"

Lia leaned in to whisper to me.

"...Do you think Terada-senpai can be a superhero, too?"

She was still calling app-users superheroes, huh?

"I'm already very close with him, but we haven't even developed a bond yet. I don't think he has the potential."

It pained me to say it, but if I could form a bond with Vanir, there was no reason I couldn't form a bond with Terada-senpai, who I considered a good friend.

We were given free time again after we finished the sparring session. This time, instead of heading to the onsen, we took a shower and planned on spending a day at the beach. Terada-senpai and I put on our swim trunks and took a duffel bag with sunscreen, extra clothing and blankets inside.

While we were packing up, I looked at some new notifications on the app.

You gained 5 levels!

You gained +5 Willpower from enduring poison!

You learned the skill [Poison Resistance]!

[Poison Resistance] Skill Rank: 1, Passive Skill

You can endure poisons of a 'Common' variety. Your ability to endure poisons is determined by your 'Willpower' (106).

…So surviving that poison from before earned me this skill.

I made sure to max it out right away, seeing how effective that poison was in disabling me.

But to max it out, I needed to max out the [Holy Rank-Up] feature first, as it seems to be a Crusader and Priest skill.

Thanks to the Hero class, I was able to access it without the Crusader class or the Priest class.

[Holy Rank-Up] Skill Rank: 20 (MAX), Passive Skill

All Holy-magic related skills have their max Skill Rank increase to Rank 20. You no longer have to spend extra skill points to level up Holy magic related skill past Rank 6.

[Poison Resistance] Skill Rank: 20 (MAX), Passive Skill.

You are completely immune to all forms of poison or hazardous effects such as toxins. This includes magical or natural poisons or toxins.

This skill gave me a lot of peace of mind.

If even a random app-user could poison me, then who knows what a more powerful being with poison could do.

Even if it was a huge investment in terms of skill points, in a field of magic I didn't really specialize in, I felt like it was worth it.

Now, as for my remaining points…

I decided to put four points into [Rune Warrior] next.

Since [Rune Warrior] belonged to the Rune Knight class, which wasn't an Advanced class, unfortunately, it could only go up to Rank 5.

Even with the Hero class, if there was no 'Rank-Up' class feature, I couldn't put it past a certain limit.

[Rune Warrior] Skill Rank: 5 (MAX), Active Skill (10 mp)

Once you cast a spell, you can absorb it. Melee weapon and unarmed attacks are then imbued with the effects of that spell, which will change situationally depending on the spell absorbed. If the spell deals damage, that damage will be applied on-hit. This transformation will change your eyes and hair to reflect the nature of the spell absorbed. This transformation state will last 5 minutes and cannot be used again for another hour.

The transformation state went from 1 minute to 5 and the mp cost went down by ten. I wished that there was a higher ceiling to this skill, but considering its powerful effect, I suppose I should just be happy with the improvements.

As for the rest of the skill points, I decided to put it all on my 'Smithing' skills.

I wanted to make a weapon and gear to properly protect Lia. And [Smithing] was such an overpowered skill, anyway. There was no way to go wrong with it.

[Smithing Rank-Up] Skill Rank: 20 (MAX), Passive Skill

All Smithing related skills have their max Skill Rank increase to Rank 20. You no longer have to spend extra skill points to level up Smithing related skills past Rank 6.

[Smithing] Skill Rank: 20 (MAX), Active Skill (X mp)

You are proficient in creating and repairing items! The success rate of this skill is determined by your 'Creativity' (133). At Rank 20, you can create, combine and repair items of the 'Primordial' variety, although doing so will cost 100 mp to start 1 day of work, and 1 month of total work to finish the project. For 'Artifacts', you no longer have to spend time working to create them, as long as you have the materials. You cannot combine items of 'Primordial' or 'Artifact' variety.

"..."

Primordial… What the hell is 'Primordial'?!

I didn't even know anything went beyond artifact-level!

I snuck into the bathroom while Terada-senpai was still packing and went to the dungeon's main room.

I then activated the Crystal Ball.

A Primordial artifact is one that has existed before the universe has been created, at the beginning of time. It could be considered an artifact of creation, one that even predates the gods. It can represent a concept that is essential to reality itself, like 'death' or 'life'.

…What kind of crazy items are these?!

Rather, how would I even get to creating one of them!

As expected of a Rank 20 [Smithing] skill…

Its potential was absurd.

Part 2

Terada-senpai and I came out to the beach once we were done packing up. We waited for a few minutes until the girls came out.

They were all wearing bikinis, with Darkness wearing an orange bikini, Lia wearing a white one with a floral pattern and Mio-san putting out all the stops with a yellow, strapless bikini.

Mio-san… You sure are assertive.

But Terada-senpai wasn't even looking at them.

"Make sure you all stay hydrated!"

He said, while pulling out some water bottles from his bag.

Mio-san almost crushed that water bottle with a death grip.

I was really starting to feel bad for her now.

My eyes went over to Darkness and Lia next.

As always, Darkness had an amazing figure. Her bikini wasn't as revealing as Mio-san's was, but considering the size of her chest, it was somehow even more erotic, despite its tame design.

"You look great, Darkness."

She blushed and rubbed her arm.

"Not gonna tease me like you always do, Kazuma?"

"...You'd like that too much."

"So it's deprivation play today, I see!"

Anything is a play for this crazy girl.

As for Lia…

After everything that shipper angel said, I couldn't even look at her for too long.

"Run for the exit…!"

"Eh?"

The Beholder blinked all of its eyes as we made a collective dash to the exit.

"C-Come back here, cowards…! What kind of heroes run away in a fight, huh?!"

"Heroes who wanna live another day?"

It kept firing beams at us, but we all just ran without even trying to engage with him.

Once we closed the door behind us, we all fell down in exhaustion.

"Hah… Hah… How is anyone supposed to beat that thing?!"

I said, as I slumped back against the wall.

"...Hah… Gah… And we've already broken the level limits… Perhaps we'd have to form a much larger raid party?"

Mitsurugi said, while wiping sweat from his brow.

Since we had the Hero class and surpassed every App-user when it came to levels, we thought our party size was sufficient.

Well, it would have been, but…

"Oh? You guys ran away, too?"

I looked at Dust, who was relaxing outside.

"You piece of shit!"

"Kazuma, wait."

Darkness said, putting her hand on my shoulder to stop me.

"Let's beat the shit out of him together."

"Pin him down!"

"W-What are you all… Gyaa?!"
