Chapter 72: Blessing These Victors With A Pool Of Gold!

Part 1

"Mary, what was that for?!"

Aika-chan immediately started having a tantrum as soon as she was revived. Mary glanced away with her hands behind her head, looking completely remorseless.

"...It was the only way to get out of that situation."

"P-Papa could have just undone the golem body!"

"No, I know since I'm a monster who specializes in charming victims, the golem was also under the effects of the charm."

…So it wasn't like in RPGs where inorganic creatures such as golems were immune to charms.

Rather, wasn't charm magic too OP?!

Maybe that was why things like illusion magic had a flat ability score rather than one that raised exponentially with a stat.

"So, what should we do now?"

Mitsurugi asked, once Aika=chan seemed to have been temporarily placated.

"I guess we can head back to the mansion and collect ourselves. I'm also gonna ask the crystal ball what the best way is to deal with a beholder."

I tried to rely on my own abilities this time, but with how dangerous that fight actually was, I wasn't going to risk it again. I didn't want to develop an over-reliance on things like divination magic, but there was no point risking a party wipe over it.

"...Kazuma, perhaps it would be better to simply recruit other app-users?"

Darkness said, surprising me with her suggestion.

"Wait, that's too reasonable of a request. Kazuma, I think Darkness has been charmed! [Sacred Break Spell]!"

"I-I'm not charmed!"

Aqua blasted Darkness with holy magic, attempting to purify her.

"Well, the only downside to that is that we'd just get used to relying on app-users."

Rin seemed confused by that and said,

"Why not? We fought with other app-users in the past."

And since then, my opinion of them got worse.

Whether it was the stalker who attempted to assault Lia, or the master of Moneyball, or even that Crusader with the holy battle axe who harassed the succubi.

My opinion of app-users was at an all-time low.

But perhaps that was just my personal bias in the way. In terms of pure firepower, they were indeed reliable.

I ended up shaking my head.

"Let's just try to do this on our own."

Aside from some misplays, we were confident enough to tackle this without a large raid party. We just needed to regain that confidence.

But first, I needed to consult the crystal ball-sama.

Once we teleported away, I went to my dungeon room.

"Oh, great crystal ball! Please illuminate my ignorant self…!"

Fuu… You can't do anything without me, huh?

This smug bastard…

You simply need more manpower. The anti-magic gaze doesn't affect golems, so you should swarm the beholder with a bunch of weaker golems. You should also look to buff the golems, since holy magic is different from normal magic and cannot be affected by the gaze.

That was the same reason why our buffs didn't go away.

Well, mine did when Aqua accidentally dispelled it.

Using divination magic really was a cheat code…

As for swarming the beholder with golems, it was true that for the weakest golem variety, which was 'Common', I could create an endless amount.

And as for the other golem varieties, I could have 7 Uncommon, 6 Rare, 5 Very Rare, 3 Super Rare, 2 Ultra Rare and 1 Legendary golems active.

Since the boss room for the beholder area was quite spacious, it could fit in a lot of golems.

"...Well, the whole point is to gain battle experience as a party… This strategy might work on the beholder, but it won't work on someone like Wiz or the Demon King."

I could only assume that they'd just one shot the golems.

We could also just wait a day for Ponko to come back, but what if there was another situation in the future where we couldn't rely on Ponko's shapeshifting abilities?

This was a good chance to practice for that scenario.
Geez, you sure are demanding! Whatever, you're on your own!

"Oi… Are you ignoring me?! You're ignoring your master?!"

I started yelling at the crystal ball who stopped talking.

I suppose it did provide me with the perfect idea.

But it relied on a crutch and would defeat the purpose of this training.

It did have a good idea with the golems, though.

And then I got an idea of my own.

I would use golems, but rather than just swarming the beholder with them, I thought of another usage that would still get the others involved.

"[Create Golem]!"

I immediately set about creating common golems.

Once I was done, I led them out on a march to the mansion, as I stepped out of the dungeon door. Sena, who was lounging in the living room, screamed in panic as she saw all the golems.

"Eeeek?! Get those creepy things away from me!"

Since they were small, swarming things, she was immediately creeped out by them.

Aika-chan pouted when she heard that.

"Sena-san… Even though I use a golem body, you think golems are creepy?"

"...?! No, of course not! It's just that these things aren't cute at all!"

Rin bent down to pick one up and said,

"I don't know, I think they're pretty cute."

Yunyun nodded and also picked one up.

"I would have liked a golem companion back then…"

There was no need for Yunyun to admit that.

I then thought of an idea and used [Golem Manipulation] and [Smithing] to change the shape of the golems.

"Ohhh! They're much cuter now!"

I made them look like miniature versions of me.

I got the idea from those Vanir dolls.

Yunyun picked one up and hugged it to her chest.

"Ehe… It's like having Kazuma-san's baby…"

"...!"

I suppose since we were currently trying for babies, Yunyun's maternal instincts were on fire right now. It should be the same for all of them.

Rin chuckled as she nuzzled a Kazuma doll with her cheek.

"It's like an early preview, huh?"

Having a bunch of babies in the house…

Ah, I tried not to think too much about it, but that kind of future was waiting for me, huh?!

Aika-chan looked at me suspiciously and said,

"Papa… You better not be having second doubts…"

"What did I say about snooping?!"

"I'm not snooping, I can just tell because you're sweating a lot right now."

"A-Anyway, please gather everyone again and I'll tell them my plan…"

"He's avoiding the question."

I ignored Aika-chan's gaze as I gathered everyone.

Part 2

Once I told my plan to everyone, they seemed to be confident about it.

"I see, that could work."

Mitsurugi said, while nodding slowly.

Dust, who was currently eating a sandwich Sena made for him, said,

"I can use [Spear Throw] to take out one of the eyes, but I'll be pretty useless after I do so."

Apparently, with [Spear Throw], the user throws a spear that is affected by the skill [Signature Weapon]. So it couldn't be spammed even if I made a bunch of spears for him with [Smithing].

But in exchange for that steep cost of throwing one's main weapon away, it was an incredibly powerful attack that managed to take the beholder's eye stalk out easily.

It was pretty much a guaranteed kill on whichever eye stalk Dust wanted to target.

Of course, we would assign him to the most dangerous eye stalk, the death ray.

"That was a good sandwich. Can I have another one?"

Dust said while licking his fingers. He looked to Sena, whose eyebrow was twitching at his request.

"One is enough."

I could tell that Sena didn't want Dust to be a permanent resident in this house.

Although with the way he was eating a sandwich on the couch with his feet reclined, with the crumbs from the sandwich falling all over the carpet, he seemed to already be at home here.

After everyone understood my new plan, we teleported back to the dungeon.

I made sure to kill some more ogres to create undead soldiers out of them.

Then I prepared the 'common' golems.

"[Golem Manipulation]."

I then shrunk the golems down as they attached themselves to our bodies.

"Alright, let's go!"

Aqua said excitedly, before we headed back into the Beholder's boss room.

The beholder chuckled once it saw us.

"Fufu… Back for more?"

This time, we didn't even give it a chance to prepare itself for our assault.

"[Spear Throw]!"

Dust dashed forward, then threw the spear at the eye stalk with the death ray.

Since each eye stalk could only shoot one kind of ray, it was an easy matter to identify which ones we needed to target using the data from the previous encounter.

"Gahhh…?!"

The beholder let out a scream of pain as its most dangerous eye stalk was ripped off by Dust.

Then Yunyun and Iris teleported from its blindspot after Yunyun undid her invisibility.

Iris leapt forward and cut the disintegration ray eye stalk.

"You… You cretins…!"

The beholder used its telekinetic ray to push Yunyun and Iris away, while Dust was forced to retreat without his main weapon in hand.

"[Challenge]!"

Instead of using [Taunt], Darkness used the more focused taunting skill, [Challenge].

Since I unlocked this skill with the Knight class back then, I was familiar with its effect.

Since [Taunt] didn't work as the beholder had too many eye stalks to divert its attention from, I figured that Darkness would be better off attracting an eye stalk with [Challenge].

She used it on the telekinesis ray eye stalk, which was too versatile to ignore.

With that eye distracted…

Chris appeared from her [Lurk] and quickly sliced the eye stalk off.

"Tch…! I was expecting you, pesky thief!"

The beholder was prepared for Chris this time and shot a charming ray at her.

However…

One of the golems I prepared flew forward.

"[Golem Manipulation]!"

I turned the golem into the shape of a shield.

"...?!"

The golem was affected by the charm ray, but it wouldn't make for an effective minion for the beholder.

It was used as a sacrificial pawn.

The undead ogres then charged at the beholder, further overwhelming its senses.

"Damn it…! Argggh!"

The beholder started spamming its beams everywhere again.

But this time, I stayed back to use [Golem Manipulation] to block the rays just as my allies were about to get hit.

Still, with that main eye still active, our heavy hitters couldn't do much to attack it.

"[Challenge]!"

And so, I used [Challenge] myself to attract its main eye.

Once they were freed, the others attacked.

"[Light of Saber]!"

Rin and Yunyun both unleashed a blinding blade of light.

"[Rune Warrior]!"

Then Megumin burst forward like a living fireball. The beholder was engulfed in flames.

The frontliners then came to finish the beholder off, cutting eye stalks and stabbing it until it was no longer moving.

"Damn it…"

The beholder said, before falling down and being absorbed by the dungeon.

"Yay, we did it!"

Aika-chan started jumping up and down.

"It was much easier the second time, huh?"

Chris said with a smirk, as she flicked away the beholder's blood from her dagger.

"I almost felt kind of bad for it since it didn't even stand a chance the second time around…"

Darkness said, as she smiled at Chris and the two of them exchanged a high-five.

"We were just too good this time, huh, Darkness?"

"You said it!"

Just like with the Giant Dullahan boss raid, there was an extra EXP bonus reward for the top damage dealers.

Since I didn't really do damage this time, I was exempt from the EXP bonus.

But I still gained EXP due to my contribution to the fight.

"...How does that work, anyway? We only get EXP normally if we deal the final blow, so where is this EXP coming from?"

I asked, as I checked my phone and saw that I gained 10 levels from this.

That meant 90 skill points for me to use…!

Aika-chan explained as I fiddled with my phone.

"Well, this is normally top secret information, but I'll tell you! The dungeon releases a gas that is infused with the essence of dead Onion Ducks! As you may know, Onion Ducks are very high in EXP, especially if they are massacred at a high-volume! The gas is then inhaled by those in the raid boss room, and so they gain EXP as if they killed the onion ducks themselves!"

"Wait, that's horrible?!"

Yunyun covered her mouth when she heard what Aika-chan said.

"S-So we're breathing in this… 'essence' right now…?"

"Yup! Make sure to breathe deeply! You may gain some extra EXP if you do!"

I wish I had never learned this information.

Maybe I shouldn't ask questions from now on.

"...Let's leave this room, onii-sama. I'm getting lightheaded."

Iris said, her face looking green as we all nodded and left the room together.

Meanwhile, Megumin…

We saw her breathing deeply and exhaling.

"I see. This is an efficient way to gain levels, huh?"

…Nothing fazes this girl, huh?

Part 3

Since this floor was originally meant for a large raid party, even those who didn't get bonus EXP got a huge leap in levels.

And considering we were already over the normal cap, it really was a lot of EXP.

Considering how we faced this beholder twice already, we figured it was about time to head back.

But of course, the loot goblin Megumin wanted to dissect the beholder first before the dungeon could completely absorb its body.

"Hmm… It seems that looting the beholder is a high difficulty task. I have some Ranger skills that help me with harvesting, but those aren't at a very high level…"

Since Megumin had been the one in charge of harvesting materials from monsters, she unlocked the related Ranger skills for that.

Of course, Megumin wouldn't allocate her precious skill points away from explosion magic more than what was necessary.

Still, she managed to gather one item from the beholder, which was one of its eye-stalks.

The main eye was probably the biggest treasure, but the one Megumin received was good in its own right.

It was the eye stalk for the disintegration ray.

…Now, of course this was an amazing treasure that could only be received in these end-game floors.

"Megumin's the one who harvested it, and you need more combat options, anyway, so you should keep it. I'll add it to your staff."

"...Who said I wanted this?"

Megumin said, shaking her head.

"Hah? It's an incredibly powerful magic item… You can shoot disintegration beams from your staff. I thought a chuuni brat like you would appreciate that?"

"Chuuni brat… Oi, Kazuma, you said it yourself. It's a disintegration ray, not an explosion ray! An explosion goes kaboom and blows things up! Meanwhile a disintegration ray… Well, it disintegrates! Don't you see the fundamental difference?!"

"Hm… Well, I suppose you're right."

"I-Is there really a difference?"

Mitsurugi said, taken aback that I actually understood what Megumin meant.

Of course, the only reason why was because I was an explosion sommelier.

I took Megumin on many explosion walks and even joined her sometimes with my own explosion.

Although, those times were rare since I would also faceplant into dirt when I did that.

And last time, Megumin recovered before I did and had her way with me.

Well, I enjoyed that kinda play, too, but…

An alpha-male like me could only be dommed by such a tiny girl so many times before it stopped being a kinky thing and more like a blow to my pride.

But enough about that tangent. I said,

"...You've already made so many concessions, so why don't you make one more, Megumin? Stop being unreasonable."

"D-Do you even hear yourself talk?! You're right that I've already made so many concessions, so you should let me off this time!"

"Then, I'll give this item to Yunyun."

"I'll take it."

She immediately changed her mind.

Like a child who didn't want a toy but suddenly wants it after you offer it to their sibling. It was this kind of childish pettiness.

"Besides, I can probably modify it since I'm combining it with your explosive rune staff. I have a max-level smithing after all, so I can probably do such a thing."

"You should have started off with that…"

While we were discussing this, Chris called out to us.

"I found a treasure room!"

Since this was a raid boss room, a beholder's at that, there was bound to be a hidden room with treasure.

Dust got excited and ran to Chris, who just barely moved out of the way before she got ran over by Dust.

"H-Hey, watch it, pal!"

She said, even though Dust paid her no heed.

"S-So much gold?! I'm rich!"

There was a pit full of gold and other treasures. The girls let out cries of disgust as Dust started taking off his clothes, leaving himself in a pair of boxers with holes in them.

"What are you doing, Dust-san?!"

Rin said, with her eyes covered as she blindly stepped forward to try and stop Dust.

"Don't get between a man and his dreams, young girl! If you weren't dating my best bud right now, I would have kissed you out of pure adrenaline, so back off while I still have my senses with me…!!!"

"Ewww!"

Rin ran away from Dust as he started making a kissy face.

"No, really, what are you doing, Dust?"

I said, unable to make any sense of his actions.

"...Isn't it the romance of all men to dive into a sea of gold and swim in it?"

"Well, I guess that's true, but… You'll just break your bones as soon as you land."

Aika-chan smiled and stepped forward, seemingly unbothered by Dust's near-nudity as she explained,

"Actually, there is alchemical magic that is used by the dungeon to allow those to swim into treasure hoards like this!"

"Why is that a thing?!"

I said, knowing full well that energy was a precious resource, and how expensive coronatite cores were.

In fact, since I was buying coronatite cores for my own dungeon, the market price had spiked.

So why were frivolous features like this included?!

"Morale is important in cultivating a strong app-user, after all. The Dungeon's AI made sure to incorporate that."

That was a weird way of increasing morale!

Well, the dungeon's AI wasn't like Aika-chan. It had no personality and who knows what kind of training data it possessed.

Actually, I knew the answer to that. It was a mixture of Aqua and that lunatic Japanese who ended up being one of the first, and last, isekai cheaters that went to the otherworld.

I glanced at Aqua, who smiled and started doing some stretches.

"Time to drive right in!"

She was also planning to go in?

I watched as Dust, and then Aqua dived into the treasure hoard.

"Woohoooo! This is the dream!"

Rather than having all their bones break from the fall, I saw them swim through the gold as if it was made out of water.

Aqua squealed in joy as she threw the gold around.

"Wait, it feels so good! Why does my skin feel so fresh and moisturized?!"

Aika-chan explained once more.

"Allow me to explain, dear maman! The alchemical magic in this room also gives rejuvenating properties to the gold!"

Yet another useless feature.

Still, when the girls heard that, they started to get interested.

"W-Well, I suppose a dip wouldn't hurt…"

Darkness said, as she looked to the others.

"If everyone's doing it, I'll of course follow along."

Yunyun sounded so confident in saying that, even though she was just following the crowd.

I mean, she was certainly making improvements in self-esteem, but…

Becoming more confident in your status as a wallflower isn't really considered development, is it?

And so with that, the girls also dove into the treasure hoard.

"...Wait for me!"

Of course, I ended up joining, too.

Part 4

I must say… It was surprisingly fun.

The gold coins and bars felt almost gelatinous, just solid enough to give you the feeling that this was still material treasure you were swimming in, but there was an inexplicable softness to it, activating upon contact, that would let one dive into a mountain of gold without instantly perishing.

Just like they noted, I felt like my skin was being cleansed upon contact with the treasures, even though you'd think that such items would be abrasive to the skin.

If the dungeon's intent was to encourage app-users to keep going further ahead and face raid bosses even more powerful than the beholder, then I guess this little pool of gold gimmick was a successful reprieve, because I did feel motivated to keep going. I was curious to see if there were other fun little diversions like this further ahead.

This dungeon really was run by an AI that was tasked to fully optimize the dungeon… Vanir could learn a thing or two here.

Not that I'd give him any ideas to improve upon his beloved hellhole.

Still, I kept that urge to explore in check. It was time to head back.

Before we did, however, Darkness and I decided to check up on Pocky-chan, formerly Bei-chan, while the others returned to the mansion.

Darkness's Giant Toad 'daughter' was still hanging out with the goblins in the forest. I did want to move her to my own dungeon, but I kept resisting the temptation. She had grown attached to the goblins, and I knew that altering the dungeon ecosystems was a terrible idea.

However, when I saw what was happening, I had a change of mind.

"Ahh…! Yesh, ahnnn~!"

What I was seeing was a certain famous female celebrity getting gangbanged by goblins.

…It seems that some female orcs with the shapeshifting spell did come here, huh?

When I made that suggestion to the goblins, I didn't think that there were many female orcs who would actually come.

Especially since they won that lawsuit against Kikuchi, the crazy guy who made the orc brothel.

But it seems that the shapeshifting female orc community wasn't a monolithic one.

Just as there were nomads and those who settled in Lizardia, it seems that there were those who grew fond of goblins.

"W-Why are you doing this out in the open, and in front of my child?!"

Darkness immediately leapt to cover Pocky-chan's eyes.

And she had to use all of her height to do so, since Pocky-chan had grown quite big.

I looked around and saw all around me that there was a full-on orgy in the goblin forest.

I knew it was my idea, but…

"Ahhh… Right there…! It feels so good~!"

"Gobu! Gobu! You're gonna get pregnant with all my goblin children, right?! Take this goblin sperm!"

"Yes! Give it to me, Gaddy!"

Gaddy?

Was that supposed to be a portmanteau of goblin and daddy?

I felt sick.

"...Alright, you all will have to move now."

I said, while using the [Monster Talk] skill and switching my title to [Monster Ally].

They all stopped mid-thrust and turned to me.

"...I don't understand, we've obeyed all your rules…"

The goblin chieftain said as he walked over to me.

This old goblin had hickeys all over his neck.

"That's right! We promised not to transform into any of your companions, and we haven't touched any of the other humans!"

A female orc, who was transformed into a certain pop star, said as she stood up from a squatting position on a goblin's face.

"The fact you're doing this out in the open disgusts me. No, it's not just that… You're gonna run out of space eventually, aren't you?"

I said, looking at all the children running around.

Rather, they were really having a full on orgy with all these kids around, huh?

I had to remind myself that these weren't humans, even if the orcs were transformed into them.

"Well, I suppose that's true…"

"Kazuma, are you planning on moving them to your dungeon? But what about their role in the dungeon's ecosystem?"

I turned to Darkness and said,

"Do you really think all of these goblins reproducing at a high rate is good for the ecosystem? We're gonna need to migrate them."

"Still… What are you going to do to replace the goblins?"

"We'll just have to create some artificial goblins."

Of course, for this plan, I planned to use golems.

Goblins were very weak, anyway.

In terms of pure fighting power, they were about as strong as a common golem, which I could create endless copies of.

Of course, goblins had the ability to use weapons as well, and were smarter than golems.

So I suppose I would need to program some kind of 'training data' for the golems.

Golems could obey simple commands as well as more complicated ones, as long as they were physically able to do so.

So if I were to give the golems a set of instructions and data on how to fight in combat, they could execute those commands.

And so, the plan to migrate the goblins was made.

Part 5

Before making the golems, I first played with Pocky-chan.

She hopped in place, causing a small tremor, then proceeded to lick my face.

"She sure is affectionate, huh?"

I said, while patting her head. She nuzzled her face against my hand.

Thanks to Pocky-chan, I could feel my Giant Toad related traumas melting away.

Well, some of them.

"I hope she'll acclimate well to her new home… I heard moves are difficult on kids…"

"...Rather, since she's a monster who is heavily dependent on her environment, she might struggle."

"Don't say it's because she's a monster!"

Darkness was a lot like those 'dog parents' who treated their pets like children.

It might seem cruel to say this about Pocky-chan, but she wasn't an intelligent monster like Mary-chan, so treating it like an actual kid is absurd.

That doesn't mean we still couldn't care for her, but Darkness's mannerisms were kind of embarrassing.

Well, what else was new?

"I wish I could take a picture of her and show her off on social media… Oh, maybe even make a fan page on Insta."

She really was becoming a full on insufferable 'dog parent'!

"Listen, Darkness, there's only so much the nice version of me I can tolerate before I start insulting you, so please don't test me."

"...This is supposed to be the nice version of you?"

She looked at me doubtfully.

"Besides, what am I doing wrong?"

"You remind me too much of a characteristic I despise seeing online, so I would like for you to stop at once."

"...Maybe that just means you spent too much time online as a friendless, girlfriend-less NEET, have you considered that?"

"?!"

Since when was Darkness so sharp when it came to comebacks?!

Or rather, wasn't she the type who would prefer to be insulted than to insult?!

"W-What happened to the Baka-sader that I used to know?!"

"You know, Kazuma, you actually did a huge favor for me… By taking care of my needs in bed I feel like I'm no longer as desperate to satiate them as I was before…"

For some reason, there was a radiant glow about her.

I see. So this was something like post-nut clarity?

"Then maybe I won't do it with you for a while and see you go back to your Pent-upness mode…"

"...?! Don't you know that threatening to withhold intimacy from your partner is a form of abuse?!"

Ah, my facade of niceness is fading.

No, I probably shouldn't admit that it's a mask.

What can I do?! I can't be nice all the time!

Pocky-chan came between us both, perhaps sensing that her parents were fighting. Then she licked both of our cheeks.

I smiled and petted her once more. I said,

"Awww… So precious, my little toad. I should create a social media page for you and spread your cuteness to the world!"

"Oi."

Darkness gave me a death glare.

I poked a finger against her cheek and said,

"Hah? You know, you can't just act like a complete sex fiend for the majority of my time with you and then now you've entered a temporary period of pseudo-enlightenment, you're gonna expect me to completely change how I act around you? No way! If you can show that this isn't just a temporary period of good behavior, then perhaps I won't treat you like the deranged freak you are!"

"I-I can say the same about you! You know, we've all talked with Rin and Lia and they told us that their relationship with you was a lot different from ours at the start! Ah, I see how it is. Kazuma is the type to put on a fake gentleman personality whenever he sees a beautiful girl, then once you've sunk your insidious claws into them, you drop the act and show how much of a scumbag you really are, huh?!"

"I-It's normal to be nice at the start! How else are people gonna like you?!"

"You really think that's normal?! Wow, you really are messed up!"

This time, Pocky-chan was a lot more assertive with her licks, actually pushing us back with the force of it.

…It's really hard to back down from an argument especially if the other party is pointing out your flaws!

It's like you know they're right but you don't wanna back down and just keep digging a hole for yourself.

"We are in the great city of Norse, after all. There must be some kind of store or restaurant that's open…"

"It's quite late in the night, though."

"Fufu… This is a city run by ghost golems… The city quite literally never sleeps."

There were also small businesses popping up here and there. More specifically, those who were chefs in their former lives were one of the first to create their own restaurants in Norse. In fact, there were quite a few famous chefs who were now citizens.

After asking around, we found out there was a pastry shop run by a renowned French pastry chef. When I suggested that we go there, Rorisa happily agreed. Rather, she was ecstatic.

She flew around me while waving her hands.

"Let's go, Kazuma-san!"

Despite being a succubus, she acted like the typical young girl who loved sweets.

"Aww, you're gonna go out on a date, huh?"

The succubus receptionist greeted us. Rorisa nodded and she held my arm.

"I hope it's alright if I leave early!"

"Well, we're all thinking of exploring the city, anyway."

So that was the reason why they closed around earlier than usual.

Even though the shop is normally open until much later.

"Ah, I wish I had a date…"

The receptionist said, watching us enviously.

"You could take one of the customers!"

"Rorisa can do that but I don't personally feel like I should date a customer…"

She was a lot stricter on herself than others, huh?

Rorisa looked away with some guilt in her eyes.

"I'm sorry for bending the rules so much."

"Oh, it's no problem! Kazuma-san has done a lot for us!"

The receptionist looked at me with gratitude.

"Now, if it were another customer… We might have had a problem with it."

She had a scary look in her eyes.

After saying good night to the receptionist, Rorisa and I headed out to that pastry shop.

On the way there we enjoyed the sights of Norse.

I gave Rorisa a tour, although a lot of what I had to show her was empty space.

"Hopefully there will be a lot more citizens in the future."

"I'm sure that will be the case, Kazuma-san!"

She was always so bright and cheerful.

She was fascinated by the mix of ancient and modern architecture, as well as the various golem bodies all around. And now there were app-users, too.

As troublesome as these app-users were, at the very least, I knew that they managed to function well enough in a place like Lizardia.

Granted, Lizardia had that divination system, but here's the thing.

They didn't know that Norse wasn't as advanced as that yet.

All they knew was that this was a 'city in a dungeon', much like Lizardia.

So the logical assumption would be that they needed to behave in a similar fashion.

What they didn't know won't hurt them.

There was a line in front of the pastry store, so Rorisa and I chatted while in line.

Holding hands in line while chatting…

Such simple moments were so healing to my heart.

…If I think about the fact that I was just tormenting Wolbach not that long ago, I guess I can't really view myself as completely wholesome, huh?

And that reminded me of Darkness' criticism, that I change the way I act completely depending on who I'm talking to…

Well, I'm pretty sure most people were like that.

Although I assume most people don't go from 'punishing' a dark goddess to having a wholesome date with a succubus…

When it was finally our turn, we went inside.

"...! M-My muse! My muse has finally arrived!"

As soon as we stepped in, the chef saw Rorisa and started acting in a weird way.

The chef was an older gentleman who was quite built. He had a handlebar mustache that bounced around when he moved. He was bald underneath his chef's hat.

Rorisa blinked as the chef took her hands and leaned way too close.

"Eh…? Um, do I know you?"

"So beautiful! What a beautiful, elegant lady! Surely you will inspire me to create even more delicious works of art!"

…It seemed that Rorisa had an admirer.

"U-Um, I'm flattered, but…"

Rorisa looked to me for help.

I coughed into my hand.

"Sorry, but she's already taken, so don't get any funny ideas."

"...? What does that have to do with anything? She is my muse! I care not about her relationship status! Rather, it would be an insult for you to assume that I would even consider myself worthy of dating such a beauty!"

So it was like an idol fan's admiration for their oshi.

I understood that feeling of wanting to support your oshi from afar.

Although I ended up going against that belief and got close to my oshi.

"Please, my muse! You must allow me to bake a cake in your honor!"

"Well… I guess that's fine…"

Since it seemed like a relatively harmless request, Rorisa allowed it.

He took a picture of her to use as a reference.

Then he gave us a bunch of cakes for free.

"You will never have to pay for my cakes, my muse!"

Rorisa seemed overwhelmed by his praises, but she still enjoyed the cake very much.

Once we were done, we went outside with Rorisa chuckling a bit awkwardly.

"...To think someone would become a fan of me so quickly…"

"Rorisa is cute, after all."

"G-Geez!"

Despite her shyness, it was clear that Rorisa enjoyed my compliment.

"So he's gonna make a cake of you, huh? I wonder if it'll be a famous cake that goes down in the history of this nation…"

"If you put it like that, isn't that a huge burden?!"

Rorisa started panicking when I suggested this.

That chef was already famous in his previous life.

It wouldn't be unreasonable to assume he would make history again, but this time with Rorisa as his muse…

"I'm looking forward to it."

"...Kazuma-san, you do realize I'm actually nervous about all this?!"

Rorisa didn't share my excitement.

Part 5

I went home after my midnight date with Rorisa. It was a busy day so all I wanted to do was sleep.

I woke up the next morning feeling refreshed.

After going through my morning routine, Mitsurugi approached me after breakfast.

"Satou, I'm gonna see Cecily for lunch. Are you coming?"

"...I was hoping you'd deal with that yourself."

"Why would I?!"

I guess I couldn't just dump this off on him.

I promised Mitsurugi that I'd go meet Cecily with him for lunch. Satisfied, he left me alone.

I then went over to Aika-chan to ask what to do with the Yen I would exchange for Norse gold.

"You can just launder it using Kazumall, right?"

Aika-chan said, in a casual manner.

"You better not say that with Sena around… But yes, that's what I'm planning to do."

The only question was how I'd go about doing it.

"Just use Kazumall as an excuse. Expand the business and launder the money that way. Then have the government turn a blind eye since you're an important asset to the world's security."

"...What a smart daughter I have!"

"Hehe… Thanks, papa! How about we get started right now?"

"That's true, but we better not involve Sena this time."

Knowing Sena, once she catches wind of the laundering scheme, she'd shut it down herself.

And so, before I had to meet Cecily for lunch, Aika-chan and I set about expanding Kazumall.

I transformed Aika-chan's body into that of an adult, this time older than the form I gave her when we went to the casino.

Then I used the [Disguise] skill myself to make myself look like an adult.

Sena already gave me fake documents for business purposes, so I didn't have to create a fake identity.

Our first step was to go shopping for property.

"I'm scanning the market… Oh, it seems like this shrine over here is trying to sell their land."

"...That's unusual, isn't it?"

I said, once I looked at the location.

"Wait, I recognize this place…"

It was the shrine run by the man who refused to evacuate when Hans and Sylvia were invading.

He said that his wife died while they were young and they never had any children. As such, he didn't care about his life.

…I guess a guy like that wouldn't care about things like preserving the shrine.

Last time, I pretty much just left him to his fate.

I knew that I couldn't save everyone.

A part of me did end up wishing I could do more, though.

Rather, I should see if I can help him now that there is no apparent danger of attacks from the Demon King army.

And so, I went to the shrine with Aika-chan.

…

…

"Are you the folks coming to buy the land? 1 billion is my final price. Take it or leave it."

Just like before, this old man was rather curt.

That was quite a lot.

A lot of investors and real estate companies probably hesitated once they learned the price.

"...Oi, I know this is a famous shrine in Tokyo, but don't you think you're being a bit too greedy?"

"I said take it or leave it, didn't I?!"

"...What does a head priest of a shrine need so much money for, anyway?"

"Bah. I stopped caring about religion after my wife died… Well, that's none of your business."

This guy really didn't care about much of anything at all, huh?

I felt bad for him.

He was probably just drifting through life at this point, waiting for death to arrive.

With the money he'd earn from selling his ancestral property, he was probably going to burn through all of it in material pleasures before he died.

What a corrupt priest.

"Alright, I'll take it."

"Hold on, papa… You're not even gonna try to negotiate? Your charisma is high enough…"

Aika-chan whispered to me. I shook my head.

I didn't know this guy, but I still felt sympathetic to him.

I knew what it was like to feel like life wasn't worth living.

I had such a dark period in my life. But I knew that period of teenage angst couldn't compare to the death of a spouse.

The money probably wouldn't do anything to fill the hole in his heart, but maybe if he used that money to travel, see the big world outside the walls of his shrine, he'd find something out there worth living for.

"Hoh? I didn't think anyone would agree."

He turned from his task of idly sweeping the grounds. He faced me with a curious look in his eyes.

"I'm sure that there's plenty of corporations interested in this land. I'm just trying to beat them out."

"Fufu… Then let's get the papers signed before you change your mind."

He truly was a corrupt priest.

We followed him to his home. As he was getting papers to sign, I saw a picture of him and his wife.

He noticed me looking and he frowned and placed the picture down.

"...Don't your lawyers need to confirm my identity, or something?"

He said, as he laid the papers down on the table.

He laid the deed down, along with his ID and papers confirming his identity.

"No, it's fine."

Aika-chan nodded to me, confirming he was the legitimate owner of the property.

"Well, if you say so…"

He signed and stamped the transfer documents I gave him, then signed his own papers confirming the transfer.

We shook on it and I presented him with a check for 1 billion Yen.

"Whoo, I'm rich! What should I buy first? A maybach?"

He said, while raising the check up and doing a dance.

…This guy really didn't care about his religion at all, huh?

Once we left the shrine, Aika-chan said,

"Congradulations on the purchase, papa! I didn't really get why you gave that man so much money, though…"

"I guess I saw myself in him."

"That's true… You are both greedy…"

"That's not what I meant…"

"Then what did you mean?"

She said, looking curiously at me.

"I'm just hoping that man can find happiness."

"Ah, you were probably thinking about how you were such a loser back then, huh, papa?"

"I'm sure there was a kinder way to say that, my dear daughter…"

Aika-chan giggled before she hugged her arm.

"You know, papa, I take some pride in knowing I made your life better…"

It was easy to forget that Aika-chan was just an app back then.

Back when I called her Appuri-chan, she had been tracking my growth since then.

Rather, if it weren't for Aika-chan, I wouldn't have grown to the man I am today.

I patted her head and said,

"Some father I am, huh? I should be the one taking care of you, but you ended up improving my life."

"Fufu… That's right, I'm the greatest daughter ever!"

"You sure are."

"...But don't beat yourself up, papa. You're a good papa, too."

She looked up at me with sincerity in her eyes.

I wasn't sure if I would have one day grown up to become jaded and miserable like this head priest.

If it weren't for Aika-chan and everyone else I met, I could have turned out to be a different person.

But I learned my lesson.

Rather than think about what-ifs, I should just be grateful for the people who have changed my life.

And I'll always be grateful for them, no matter what happens.

Your bond with Aika has deepened!

Part 6

Satou Aika (A.I. Daughter), Bond Rank: 5

It's nice when we get to bond, papa, and I feel like I learned a lot about you! I'm still learning how humans think and how they see the world. Not only is it interesting, but I get to learn more about you, so it makes me happy! I also won't be where I am without you, so I think we've helped each other out a lot! That still doesn't take away from the fact that I'm the best daughter ever, though!

Bond Reward: You learn the skill [Mirror Guard]!

[Mirror Guard] Skill Rank: 1, Passive Skill

When an opponent uses a skill against you that you also know, reduce its damage and effectiveness by 5%.

…I learned another defensive skill.

Although there were so many now that it was getting harder to decide which one to upgrade.

This one might have to take less priority though since it is quite situational. This skill depends on the likelihood that I would share a skill with my opponent. Considering how many of my opponents had unique skills, this skill probably wouldn't be too useful most of the time.

"Papa, you just thought that the skill you got from our bond rank-up was useless, huh?!"

"...What did I say about being nosy?"

"Well, stop having rude thoughts about me!"

Even though we were in such a good mood before, she got mad out of nowhere.

We went back into the mansion before my daughter's mood could get worse.

There was still time left before the meeting with Cecily, so I worked on creating that disintegration implementation for Megumin's staff.

Even though this was a legendary-level gear, since I had the max rank [Smithing] skill, it only took me an instant to create it.

I then handed it to Megumin to try out.

We went to the usual forest area where we had our explosion dates.

She then fired off the explosive ray and watched it ignite a row of trees before they exploded.

"...It's not as strong as my explosions, but I suppose I can use it."

"You sound so disappointed even though this is a legendary item."

Not to mention it still caused a lot of destruction.

"Nothing can beat a true explosion…"

This explosion addict was truly hopeless.

I also told Megumin about Wolbach and how I transferred her to Norse.

"...Can I visit her?"

Megumin said quietly.

Even after everything Wolbach did, she was still an important figure for Megumin.

I nodded and said,

"You can visit her anytime."

I wasn't going to insist on coming along. There was probably a lot Megumin wanted to discuss with her former master in private.

She had chances to visit before in Lizardia, but maybe she was putting it off.

She didn't have much of an excuse this time with how easy it was to access Norse.

As Megumin went to Norse to pay her master a visit, it was time for the lunch meeting with Cecily.

I met Mitsurugi at the place we agreed to meet, a cafe.

Cecily and Mitsurugi were already there by the time I arrived. I caught them as Cecily was feeding Mitsurugi some cake.

"Oh, Satou, there you are."

Mitsurugi said, while quickly wiping the stupid grin off his face.

This guy…

Was all he cared about a pretty face?

Moving from Aqua to Cecily… This guy's taste in women was atrocious.

I suppose I couldn't judge since I was dating Aqua, but…

Cecily was the number one kind of woman every man should avoid!

"So, what's all this about?"

Cecily asked, as she sipped her coffee.

"...You didn't tell her?"

Mitsurugi glanced away from me.

"Well, I was waiting for you, Satou."

This guy was totally spineless.

I guess this falls on me.

"You see, Cecily, as a representative of the Axis-cult, we want you to formally apologize to the Belzerg royal family…"

"Hah? Why would I do that?"

She looked at me as if I was crazy.

Even though she was the lunatic here.

"Your cult's actions have broken the peace treaties between Belzerg and the Demon King army…"

"Whose actions? Do you have any proof?"

Why was she being so difficult?!

"...Oi, we both know that the Axis-cult was the one who did it! You were the only ones with that kind of motive, anyway! Both sides wanted peace!"

"And how would you know that? Perhaps there were greedy nobles on Belzerg's side who wanted to prolong the war so they could keep taxing people? Blaming the Axis-cultists seems like a bit of a stretch!"

…I didn't expect her to put up this much of a fight.

"Well, there's one way to prove this quickly. We should use a lie-detecting bell…"

"Lie detecting bells, you say…?"

She immediately got worried.

Since she was from the otherworld, she probably knew how effective those things were.

I decided to bluff a little and say,

"Yes, that should be enough to clear your name if you're telling the truth, right?"

"E-Eh? What's this, Kyouya-kun? I'm scared! You said this was just gonna be a friendly hangout with Kazuma… Why is he interrogating me like this?"

This crafty girl was batting her eyelashes at Mitsurugi.

"K-Kazuma, I did promise her that we were just gonna talk… There's no need to bring lie-detecting bells and such into this…"

Whose side is this guy on?

I leaned over to him and said,

"Oi, remember what we're doing this for! Stick up for yourself already!"

He sighed and nodded his head.

"Cecily-san, I'm sorry, but please cooperate."

"But Kyouya-kun…"

"I mean it."

Cecily looked at Kyouya then smiled.

"Hehe… This assertive side of you is hot as well, Kyouya-kun… You should be more assertive like that in bed~!"

"E-Eh, but that's…"

Why were they flirting in front of me?

Cecily sighed and said,

"Fine, fine, so what do you want me to do?"

"Like I said, just apologize to the royal family… That would be Princess Iris."

"Oh, you should have just started with that! I'd do anything for that S+ tier loli! Huff, huff!"

As I expected.

Cecily would do anything to get close to Iris because of her 'preferences'.

But an insincere apology isn't enough.

"...You will need to promise to do everything you can to make it right to Iris and Belzerg. Do you understand?"

"Child belly, child armpits… Huh? Oh, yeah, sure."

Should I really let these two meet?

Part 7

It was a tense mood when I called Iris and Aqua down to the living room.

However, the tenseness was dispelled as soon as Cecily saw Aqua.

"This divine aura… That appearance… Can it be?! Are you Aqua-sama?!"

Aqua chuckled and placed a hand over her chest.

"Yes, it is I, child. It's nice to finally meet one of my followers…"

"Oh, my goddess!"

Cecily threw away the cookies Sena served her and bowed before Aqua.

Aqua had a proud look on her face. She was certainly enjoying this a lot.

However, when Cecily saw Iris…

"...?!! T-There she is! The loli of my dreams!"

"...Excuse me?"

Iris backed away when Cecily moved from Aqua to her. She held Iris's hands and started snorting.

"Guhihi… I-It's nice to meet you, Iris-chan~! Can I see your armpit real quick?"

"W-Why would you want to see that?!"

Iris snatched her hand away, but that didn't deter Cecily.

"F-Feisty little one, huh? How about your navel, then?"

"No!!!"

Iris hid behind me, frightened by this crazy lady.

"...If you don't behave, I'll tie you up with [Bind]."

"Fine…"

Cecily managed to calm down. She returned to her seat.

Meanwhile, Aqua didn't even try to stop Cecily or condemn her for her actions.

That was because the tenets of the Axis-cult allowed its members to do as they pleased without consequence.

Which would make it incredibly difficult to get a sincere apology out of Cecily.

What a troublesome group!

I looked to Mitsurugi, who nodded.

"Um… So, Iris-chan, Cecily-san here came to give an apology… Cecily-san, if you will."

"Oh, yeah. I'm sorry for everything. And, uh, I'll do my best to make it up to you."

…That was the most insincere apology I've ever heard.

Aqua was all smiles however.

"See? I told you my followers were reasonable!"

She really fell for that?

Iris didn't fall for it whatsoever.

"Did you really think I'd accept such a half-hearted apology? My family died because of you! Not to mention all those innocent people!"

Cecily rolled her eyes and said,

"Listen, do you really think that agreeing to peace terms with the Demon King army was a good idea?"

"Of course it is! We wouldn't have had all this destruction if we settled the matter back then!"

"Do you really think so? You do realize that they have devils on their side, masters of deception and contract magic. They know the ins-and-outs of geas spells. Even if you signed the most strict geas contract possible to maintain peace, they would still find a loophole around that."

"...That's just a hypothetical!"

Cecily grinned and raised a finger.

"Then consider this hypothetical. You agree to peace with the Demon King army, meaning that they cannot wage war on you and harm you in any way. Now that you are allies, they start invading the rest of the world. After all, they technically only have a peace pact with you, not the rest of the world. And since you can't wage war against them… Well, Belzerg, the strongest military force in the continent, is now powerless to stop the Demon King's advance."

When Iris couldn't respond, Cecily continued,

"And then they create those portals to the other world. Without anyone stopping them domestically, they accomplish their goal without any hindrance. After all, your hands are tied. All you can do is watch as the Demon King army controls not just only your world but multiple realms… Is that the kind of ending you desire?"

"They only lashed out because they lost their faith in humanity after your people attacked!"

Iris said confidently, finding a weak point to attack.

"...Do you really think that such a group that would 'lose their faith' so easily intended to keep the peace in any way? If they were sincere in their motives to make peace with humanity, they would have overlooked our little stunt. After all, it was just a small ambush force by a minority religion… Why would that ruin all the peace talks you've had thus far?"

"..."

Iris couldn't find a way to respond.

I sighed and stepped in for Iris.

"Cecily you're only basing this off assumptions… There's no use in arguing about things like that."

"So that means you can't argue against my points. I win!"

So annoying!

…It's always these types of people who demand proof from you despite having no evidence themselves.

"Well, then, let's just consult the almighty crystal ball!"

I opened a dungeon door and took out the crystal ball.

Cecily glared at it and said,

"So you're a practitioner of divinity magic! Even though divinity magic is considered the devil's work!"

She really was a pain in the ass!

"Even if it's devil magic, you do understand that divination is a legitimate field of magic…"

"Hmph…"

She crossed her arms but didn't argue further.

I then asked the crystal ball.

"Would the demon king army have proceeded with their invasion if the Axis-cult hadn't sabotaged the peace talks?"

After a moment, we received our answer.

Inconclusive. There are too many factors at work. Multiple outcomes could have resulted from such a hypothetical.

Seeing that response, both of them seemed unsatisfied.

"As you can see, there's no point in debating it. So, Cecily, please apologize."

"Hah? Why? The ball said that the answer is inconclusive!"

"Yes, but it was still your faction's actions that led to the death of Iris's family and countrymen. You can't argue about that."

Weasiling out of this by saying that it was for the greater good wouldn't cut it.

Cecily was clearly struggling, but Aqua stepped forward.

"...I'm sorry, Iris."

"...?! Aqua-sama?!"

I was also surprised, considering how much Aqua pushed back before.

"Putting who is right or who is wrong aside… I've done a lot of thinking. I consider you a friend, and as a friend, it is only right that I apologize for my followers' actions."

"B-But Aqua-sama! Our religion allows us to do whatever we want without consequences!"

"Yes, and what I want to do right now is apologize. Do you have a problem with that?"

"Uh… Um…"

I didn't even think about this solution.

A way to circumvent that rule without making Aqua seem like a hypocrite to her followers.

The fact that Aqua came up with this herself was impressive.

Considering how she usually is.

"If… If Aqua-sama is apologizing… Then I must also apologize. I am sorry."

Cecily grit her teeth and lowered her head.

This time, her apology seemed sincere.

Sure, she was just going along with Aqua, but her devotion to Aqua was legitimate.

Iris had a conflicted expression, but she eventually nodded.

"...I cannot truly forgive the Axis-cult but… Thank you for apologizing to me. It means a lot."

Mitsurugi let out a deep exhale of relief.

"Thank goodness…"

Of course, this was only the starting point.

I wasn't so naive to believe that everything between the Axis-cult and Iris was OK from here on out.

But it was a good starting place, at least.

Chapter 74: Blessing This Dragon Knight With A Loli!

Part 1

"That wasn't so bad now, was it?"

I told Cecily, once Iris left the room.

She was quick to leave, too. I guess she didn't want to be around Cecily for longer than what was necessary.

"Are you kidding me? She was perfect."

She completely misunderstood me.

"I meant the apology."

"Oh, right… Well, if Aqua-sama feels that strongly about it, I have no choice but to align with her!"

Was this actually a good resolution?

All that happened was Aqua using her influence on her follower.

But still, it was better than nothing.

"Rather… I can't believe I'm seeing Aqua-sama in the flesh right now! I kneel!"

Cecily did just that, kneeling in front of Aqua, who chuckled as she had an arrogant look on her face.

"Yes, yes, it is I, my dear follower. Thank you for your support."

Why did she sound like a celebrity thanking a fan?

We let the two of them talk as Mitsurugi and I stepped outside the room.

"...I'm glad that turned out relatively well."

Mitsurugi said, with a relieved sigh.

"Aren't you the least bit concerned that you're dating a psychopath?"

He got all defensive when I said this.

"She's not a psychopath… She's just had a different life than us. I'm sure that I can eventually teach her not to be so difficult…"

So he was saying 'I can fix her'.

Well, if Aqua of all people could show emotional growth, perhaps her followers could follow her example.

Aqua and Cecily talked for a while, although from what I heard outside, it was mostly just Cecily worshipping Aqua, who was enjoying the attention.

I suppose that was the appropriate response from a woman of the cloth meeting her deity.

For me, Aqua was just Aqua, so I didn't treat her any differently even if she keeps telling me to treat her more like a goddess.

Another half hour later…

"If there's anything at all that you require, Aqua-sama, please do not hesitate to tell me!"

We heard Cecily say this as she left the living room.

"I'll keep that in mind!"

Aqua smiled as they both waved goodbye to each other.

Once we stepped out of the mansion into the garden, Cecily let out an excited squeal.

"Today is the best day of my life!"

Talk about an exaggeration.

Still, not wanting to dampen her spirits after she played nice today, I said,

"Remember, you're gonna try your best to make amends to Iris."

"Yeah, yeah. Hmm, to start with, how about I teach her the pleasures of the female body…"

This woman is irredeemable!

Mitsurugi coughed into his hand and said,

"Cecily-san, I told you that such behavior isn't acceptable."

"Kyouya, I'll make sure to reward you later for letting me meet Aqua-sama… Fufu, how about your favorite thing later on…"

"Gulp… You mean…"

I see.

So Mitsurugi was the type who was easily controlled by women.

"I also have you to thank, Kazuma. It seems that you've been taking good care of Aqua-sama, too, so I'm grateful for that."

I was surprised to see a tender look on Cecily's face.

So she was capable of showing such care?

Only if it was regarding her beloved Aqua-sama, I guess.

"If you're really grateful then don't just try and weasel your way out of what we've told you."

She might have distracted Mitsurugi, but I wasn't going to let it go.

Your bond with Cecily has deepened!

Already we were attracting an audience.

"Uwaa… She's pregnant? What a scumbag…"

"She's so pretty… This guy must be a horndog if he still felt the need to sleep with another woman…"

"Why is it always the trashy bastards that get girls like her?"

I see.

So this was Marika-san's revenge against me for making them do this, huh?

I'm not the type to back down, though.

"I only cheated on you because you gave me an STD! Why didn't you tell me that you used to be a famous pornstar in America named Sally Strokes?!"

Marika-san's face went completely red when I turned the tables on her.

And because of my newly raised Cunning stat…

"OK… I can kinda see why he cheated on her."

"...She looks so pure and innocent but… I guess you can't judge a book by its cover, huh?"

"Come to think of it, that guy is really hot…"

The public opinion was turning in my favor.

Still, I guess she accomplished her mission at the end of the day.

With everyone's attention on us, I saw that the others had dealt with the golems.

I cut off my [Golem Scrying] as I saw a soldier dispatching a golem with a silenced pistol.

When we met up back in the dungeon, Marika-san glared at me.

"Sir… Was that really necessary?"

"You started it."

"Even so…"

I patted her on the head as she pouted.

"Good job, Sally. That was a good plan."

"Don't call me Sally!"

The others were confused and the glare Marika-san gave me promised certain harm if I explained the joke to them.

For now, I spared her further embarrassment and kept it to myself.

Your Cunning went up by +1!

This stat sure doesn't take a break.

Part 5

"Wait, Satou, this was you?!"

Mitsurugi said in shock, when I told him that I was disguised as the chairman of China and made that announcement.

"It seems like something crazy happened this afternoon…"

Rin said, staring curiously at the TV.

"Oh, I thought that stream was just a prank."

Mary-chan said thoughtfully.

Of course this chronically-online girl would be watching that streamer.

It was now time to go to the dungeon and challenge that dragon.

Since Dust got what he came for, he didn't even bother showing up when it was time to go.

Well, I already expected that.

He had a lot of catching up to do with Faitfore, anyway.

"That Dust sure is unreliable…"

Rin had this to say, though. I said,

"When it comes down to it, he's a guy you can count on."

"I doubt it."

She had zero faith in Dust.

And so, we teleported to the 92nd boss floor room.

This time, the dragon didn't kick us out.

"Alright, let's get this over with. I have a show I wanna binge later."

I glanced at Mary-chan. She said,

"...What?"

"You're gonna become like that if your eyes are glued to the screen all day."

"You're way too young to be saying things like that."

I guess I was starting to sound like some grandpa by saying that.

The dragon approached us in the wide field that would be our battleground.

"Alright, I'm gonna choose my opponent now."

"Oi. We never agreed to let you choose your opponent."

"Hah?! I'm pretty sure we did! Are you trying to trick me?!"

This guy was pulling out all the stops to gain an advantage.

He looked around and didn't even look at Mitsurugi and Iris.

I guess he sensed their power level.

"...Eeek?!"

He squealed when he saw Megumin.

I guess he sensed her magic power.

His eyes settled on me.

"...You'll be my opponent."

This guy went with the one he could safely take on, huh?

Well, when it comes to a 1v1, I guess I was the opponent he'd want.

"Go beat him up, daddy!"

Aika-chan cheered.

"D-Do your best, Kazuma-san!"

Yunyun waved her hands encouragingly.

"I can heal you up when you get beat up!"

Aqua was trying her best, but that was hardly encouraging.

I faced off against the dragon.

We went over the rules once more. No killing, which meant we'd have to be careful about the power of our attacks.

Once we agreed on that, the battle started.

The dragon immediately flapped its wings and flew to the skies.

This guy had no shame whatsoever!

"Oi, that's cheating!"

"You'd forbid me from using my wings? That's like me telling you not to use your legs!"

"You have legs, too, dumbass!"

Aqua laughed at me and said,

"Hey, this guy is as much of a scumbag as you, Kazuma. Maybe it's because it has green scales?"

Is she saying those who have the color green on are immediately considered scumbags?

Still, I actually had a counter for this.

"[Tornado]!"

Using the spell that let me wipe out those flying cabbages, I surrounded the dragon with violent winds.

"Gahhhh!"

I made it fall down.

"[Bind]!"

Then I bound its wings together to make sure it couldn't fly.

Keeping up the momentum, I drew ice arrows and pelted it with ranged attacks.

"Owww!"

However, even if I had a crit build…

It didn't seem to be doing a lot of damage after the first volley.

"Papa… I feel bad so I guess I'll help you out…"

I heard Aika-chan's voice through my earpiece.

She then told me about this ability I was seeing.

[Dragon Scales]

If faced with an attack made consecutively, decrease the damage by 90% after the first instance of damage.

…What a broken ability.

That meant that I couldn't just spam the same attack.

Well, if I had to use a bunch of different attacks anyway…

I might as well make use of that skill.

I put the bow away and took out two pistols.

Then, I started firing them in a dual-wielding style.

Style Ranking: D for 'Dawwww!

I made use of the [Showmanship] skill I got from Lia to take advantage of its damage multiplier.

Even if firing with two pistols at a time is impractical, it was considered stylish enough to activate the skill.

And besides, I needed to switch up my methods of damage, so trying out a bunch of different things was necessary.

"K-Kazuma, you look so cool right now!"

Of course this chuuni Megumin liked what she was seeing.

Once [Dragon Scales] started decreasing the damage of the bullets, I put them away and drew out Chunchunmaru.

"[Quick Draw], [Sonic Strike]!"

I attacked the dragon with a lightning-fast slash.

Style Rating: C for Cuuuute!

…First it was 'Dawww and now Cute?

Well, I guess this skill was from the Idol class.

The dragon didn't just take the attacks without retaliating, though.

It opened its mouth and released a fire breath.

Thankfully, [Auto Dodge] allowed me to evade the point-blank blast.

"Oi?! We're not supposed to kill?! That would have been bad if it hit me!"

"Says you! You're hurting me a lot, you know?!"

"If you can feel pain, that means you're not dead yet! [Bind]!"

I used [Bind] to trap its mouth shut.

Then I equipped the Brutal Gator Gloves and attacked it with a combo of hooks and straights.

Style Rating: B for Beautiful!

"Keep it up, senpai!"

"Y-You should beat me up like that, Kazuma!"

Rin and Darkness were going me complete opposites of the spectrum when it came to cheers there.

However, just when I was in the groove…

"Mnnpphhh… [Overwhelm]!"

The dragon broke out of its bindings.

"[Dragon Lance]!"

"...?!"

It suddenly used the skill I just learned.

Instead of a lance, it dashed forward before I could react and hit me in the gut with a brutal punch.

I was sent flying backwards, tumbling on the ground.

As I was regaining my footing, Aika-chan fed me more information.

[Natural Weapon]

Any part of your body can become a weapon. If a skill requires a weapon, use an applicable body part instead.

So that was how it was able to use [Dragon Lance].

If it was using a priority move, my [Auto Dodge] was useless against it.

Not to mention it was already free and was now flying again.

"[Escape]!"

I started running away as it flew above and started breathing fire on me.

I guess it's obvious but…

Dragons are way too broken…!!!

Part 6

"Oi, oi, oi, why are you running away!"

Now that it had the upperhand, the dragon was cackling as it breathed fire on me.

I could use [Tornado] again, but…

I couldn't use [Drain Touch] on this floor to replenish my mana since there was an environment blocking the walls.

And I already used up a lot of mana. I only had 45 mana points left.

And if I used [Drain Touch] on Aqua or something, I bet this petty dragon would say, 'you cheated! You're disqualified!'

He totally would.

So I needed to finish this guy off in one shot.

But was there even anything in my arsenal that could do that?

Just bringing it down with [Tornado] would bring me down to 15 mp.

What did I have that could take down a dragon with 15 mp?!

I suppose I had to use something that was either low mp cost.

Or none at all.

And then I realized something.

I looked at the skill description for [Tornado] while I was running.

…Any additional objects or creatures within the tornado that hits the target will deal an additional 5 bludgeoning damage upon collision.

I could use that…!

I took out my Hyper Rhino Sword.

Then…

"[Tornado]! [Smithing]!"

While summoning a tornado, I dismantled the Hyper Rhino Sword and recreated it.

It was now a bunch of shurikens.

"What the…?! Gyaaah…?!"

The dragon screamed in pain as it was trapped in the tornado and pelted by the shurikens spinning around it.

The effect of the weapon then took effect.

Hyper Charge - When this sword is used for attacking after momentum has been gathered, deal an extra +5 damage. This bonus damage ignores armor resistances.

Now that the sword was in the form of shurikens, and they were spinning around in the tornado…

Along with the tornado's effect, even with [Dragon Scales], the amount of accumulative damage was hard to ignore.

"This isn't enough…! [Regenerate]! Eh…?!"

This busted dragon even had a healing ability…

Thankfully, my [Anti-Heal] skill took effect.

As an added bonus, since it was a passive skill, it didn't take any mana.

When you attack a target, they cannot heal for the next 3 seconds after that attack, whether it's by a regeneration effect or holy magic. This effect does not stack, but you can attack again after the 3 seconds are over to reset the effect.

Since it was constantly assaulted by shurikens, the effect kept reactivating after the 3 seconds were up.

Still, it would take too long to chip its health down with [Dragon Scales].

It could endure until the tornado disappeared.

So before it did, I took out my other weapons.

With the Spear of Thunder and Chunchunmaru in hand, I transformed them into shurikens and tossed them into the tornado.

Of course, tossing items into an active tornado is a bad idea.

But…

"[Control Spell]!"

By expending 5 more mp, I was able to control the tornado just enough to let the new items slip in.

"Gahhh! What's wrong with you…?!"

The sharp blades of Chunchunmaru and combined with the knockback effect of the spear of thunder caused even more devastation.

And since there were now different attacks pelting it, [Dragon Scales] was now worthless.

By the time the 1 minute was up, the dragon fell to the ground, its scales covered in shurikens.

It was still trying to get up.

This guy sure is durable.

I didn't wanna risk killing him with a crit, so I didn't use arrows.

So instead, I created a cudgel with ice magic.

"[Charge]!"

I used the knight skill to charge forward and give him a big bonk to the head.

"Ughh…"

That managed to knock him out.

"...Is he dead?"

Chris said, as the others came up to look at the dragon.

"No, he's fine. Just taking a nap."

"He's not moving, Kazuma-kun."

Just in case, we had Aqua heal him up.

"...Ugh, you sure are merciless…"

The dragon said, when it finally woke up.

It sniffed the air and looked at us.

"Are you having a barbeque?!"

It said, when it saw us roasting meat over a fire.

"We got bored waiting for you to wake up."

I said, while passing Iris a skewer.

It then saw what we were barbequing, a big, reptilian tail.

In a panic, it looked behind it to see its tail was still intact.

Did this dragon think we cut it off and ate it?

We just hunted some random lizard monster.

Although Megumin was giving him some concerning looks while he was passed out.

I guess it's best not to mention that.

"Funfun… You were strong, for a human. Very well, I guess I can let you pass."

"We were gonna do that anyway."

"...I thought you waited for me to wake up to give you permission?"

"Actually, we wanted some treasure from you."

"Hah?!"

"You're a dragon, so you must have treasure, right?"

It even had that magic mirror from Lizardia.

"Well, I guess I can share them with you…"

Aqua went to the dragon with a scowl and said,

"Oi, you do realize we could have just taken your treasure while you were asleep?! We know where you live! Now give the boss man what he wants or we'll chop your tail off and barbeque it!"

"Eeeek?! Alright, you can have it!"

She started talking like a yakuza for whatever reason.

Maybe she was influenced by some drama.

Like mother, like daughter… Both Mary-chan and Aqua were glued to the screen.

The dragon then reluctantly led us to its treasure.

"Ohhh! Look at all this gold! Let's dive in!"

I watched as Aqua dove into the pool of gold.

Just like with the beholder's lair, she was able to swim in it.

"Tsk…"

The dragon let out an annoyed sound watching outsiders swim in his treasure.

I would put my portion into Norse's reserves again.

"Oh, there's some high-grade manatite crystals here!"

Mitsurugi said, holding them up to inspect.

"Give me."

Before anyone could do anything, Megumin stashed them away in her inventory.

Well, I guess out of everyone, she was in the most need of them.

There were also some spell books.

"Crimson Laser…? Does anyone want this?"

I said, while looking at the book with [Lore Reading].

"I only need explosion magic."

The expected reply from Megumin.

"Um, I'm fine with my current arsenal, so…"

Yunyun said, while Rin also shook her head.

…Do I even need this?

I felt like my crit archery could already do more damage than an advanced spell that provided no other use other than damage.

Still, I kept the book just in case.

The other books were much more interesting, though.

There was one for the spell Crystal Prison, as well as Silent.

I kept those as well.

Part 7

Since I was the only one who did any fighting, we decided to continue onto the 93rd floor.

This time, I made sure to stick to a more supportive role since I already did a lot of fighting.

The others were bound to get angry if I took more EXP from them, so I made sure not to get any killing blows from the monsters we encountered.

Megumin was also banned from attacking, due to her completely wiping out the King Cabbage army.

Still, when there were monsters with tricky abilities, I made sure to help when I could.

"Gyaa?! What are these things! Hot!"

Aqua ran away as some creatures that blended in with the material of the dungeon wall. It was hard to spot them at first, and I didn't detect them right away, so they must have some kind of powerful stealth skill.

They looked like floating pieces of meteorite with cavities all around it. It then released steam from those cavities, and based on Aqua's reaction, it was incredibly hot.

"[Heal]! Don't let that steam touch you! It shaved off 50 HP in one hit!"

"...It's that deadly?! You could have reacted a bit more!"

She yelled 'hot!' as if she entered the bath without letting the water cool.

"[Light Arrows]!"

When Rin tried to attack them with magic, the meteorites disassembled themselves to avoid it.

I saw that the inside of the meteorite was the steam itself, but I also saw a flash of a glowing crystal, which looked like the manatite that Megumin just received. Was that its power source? A creature like this didn't seem like a living thing, but rather a magical construct.

"[Steal]!"

The manatite appeared in my hands.

Just like I suspected, the exterior fell apart.

But the steam exploded all at once.

"Ahhh…!!!"

Everyone ended up taking a significant amount of damage from the steam explosion.

"...! It dares attack me with an explosion?!"

Rather than focusing on the pain of the attack, Megumin seemed more offended by that.

Aqua and I immediately set out to heal everyone.

"...So I guess stealing the manatite isn't the best way to go…"

Chris said, as I healed her burns.

"I guess I should have trapped it first before stealing the manatite."

Mitsurugi rubbed his head apologetically as Aqua healed him.

"Sorry… Thai is my first time encountering that monster, and I've never heard anything about them."

That was because these parts were rarely explored by the app-users.

A lot of the rare creatures were never seen before, or those that did encounter them didn't live to tell the tale.

This kind of monster seemed like it could kill even the most powerful app-users who didn't understand what they were dealing with.

"...Let's be extra careful moving forward."

I said, to which everyone nodded.

…

…

Thankfully, the rest of the monsters we encountered were relatively straightforward.

They were either monsters we encountered before or slightly stronger versions of them.

But since we knew what they were capable of in terms of gimmicks, we were able to easily handle them.

And the traps we came across were easily dismantled by Chris and I.

We soon reached the door to the raid boss room.

Thankfully, Mitsurugi did have information on this raid boss.

"...It's an elemental titan called an 'Aether Titan'."

We encountered an absorption titan before, but not an elemental titan.

Elemental Titans, as the name suggested, were huge monsters that embodied a particular element.

Such as Fire, Wind, Earth, Ice, Water, or Lightning.

"Wait, what's Aether?"

I asked, to which Mitsurugi just gave a sheepish smile.

"Well… No one has really figured it out."

So it was an unknown element?

From the rare few who did challenge this raid boss, they said that they had to fight what seemed like a giant invisible hand.

Or at least, that was all they could tell after their party members were squashed by a giant handprint. They soon ran for their lives after that.

So there wasn't much information to go off.

I looked to Aqua, who chuckled.

"Do you really want to know?"

"Spit it out already."

She was relishing the fact that she knew something we didn't.

"You see, Aether is actually one of the elements! It's very rare and is not commonly studied in magic. As for what Aether is, the closest thing mortals can compare it to is what you know as 'gravity'."

Wait, was this the same Aether that early philosophers used to explain invisible forces like gravity and electromagnetism?!

…I guess since the magic system revolved around the ancient idea that compounds and chemical reactions like fire and water were 'elements', I suppose such alchemical ideas would also include Aether…

Or rather, perhaps the ancients were actually on the right track.

"...Are there any other elements we should be aware about?"

"There is also 'Quintessence'... I guess you could call it dark energy."

What's with all these insane lore drops?!

"So this thing we're fighting is essentially a giant hand-thing made out of gravity? How are we even gonna beat it?"

I said, already thinking about just cutting our losses and giving up on the rest of the floors.

Mitsurugi went on to say,

"I did hear reports that the hand itself can be damaged, and there is one party that managed to beat it with a bunch of OP artifacts."

…That was the main strategy of those cheaters, anyway.

But we didn't have a bunch of OP artifacts.

Although…

I looked at Mary-chan.

We did have someone here with a dagger that could deal some serious damage to this thing.

I suppose all hope wasn't lost.

"...How would it feel to use explosion magic on gravity itself… I can't wait…"

Meanwhile, Megumin still only had one thing in mind.

"Ah, whatever, let's just see what happens…"

Since we did have a win condition, all hope wasn't lost.

We did have three artifact users in Mitsurugi, Mary-chan and Rin.

And Iris herself was pretty OP.

Not to mention two goddesses…

Yeah, maybe I was worrying too much.

And so, we opened the dungeon door.
