#1,753
Chapter 76: A Punishment For This War Criminal!

Part 1

The environment for this floor wasn't too dissimilar from the dragon's floor.

There were green fields as far as the eye could see and a stretch of mountains in the horizon.

The difference was that there were stone pillars scattered here and there.

"...What are those things?"

I said, pointing to the structures that kind of looked like Stonehenge. Mitsurugi said,

"I'm not sure… The app-users never mentioned them."

So they were likely new additions.

Most app-users just skip the raid bosses, even going so far as to hire parties to set up teleportation points for them to advance.

That was because it was more efficient to grind on the normal floors of the 90th level than face the raid bosses.

And by more efficient, I mean that it will lead to a higher chance of survival.

So even though there were app-users technically grinding on these levels, most of them have never even seen this floor.

"Well, let's inspect these structures for now."

I said, leading the way.

Since the Aether Titan hadn't shown up yet, the best move here was to investigate.

However, when we got close to the structures…

"Eeee!"

A bunch of strange creatures pretty much blinked into existence in front of the structures.

They were like big starfishes that somehow walked on two of its arms, like they were legs.

"...What are these things?"

I asked, as I watched the creatures not making any hostile actions against us yet. My [Monster Talk] wasn't at a high enough level for me to communicate with them, so I just heard them yelling 'eeee!' over and over as they waved their arms about.

I looked at Aika-chan, who pouted.

"Papa… I've already broken the rules a lot to give you information during the dragon fight…"

"Are we still on about that? We're the hero party anyway! Do you want us to beat the Demon King or not?!"

"And how are you gonna beat the Demon King if I keep giving you tips! Ahh… Fine! These are Void Stars. They are native to this floor. They have the ability to turn invisible and ambush their foes while hidden…"

She looked at the Void Stars curiously.

"It's strange… Void Stars are only meant to attack, not communicate. This behavior is unusual."

Yunyun stepped forward and then started speaking to the Void Stars.

Unlike me, she invested in the [Monster Talk] skill, a product of her days as a loner.

I watched her speak to the Void Stars. After a few moments, she said,

"...It seems that these Void Stars made these monuments to serve their god, the Aether Titan."

"Their god?"

I turned to Aika-chan again, who shrugged.

"The Void Stars aren't known to have any such religions… After consulting the Dungeon A.I., it seems that this is indeed a fairly recent development."

It was just like the lizardmen forming an advanced society. The dungeon ecosystem was developing in ways that even the A.I. couldn't predict.

"...Considering how we're going to fight their 'god', won't we be in trouble if these Void Stars come to attack us as well?"

I said, knowing that they won't take kindly to us beating up their god.

Rin had a concerned look and said,

"Well, they went so far as to warn us not to touch their structures… If they meant harm, they would have attacked us without warning us."

I suppose she was right.

Any normal monster would have just attacked without asking questions.

These monsters were developing their own religion and even attempting to peacefully communicate with outsiders.

These were clear signs of a developing society.

What was the right thing to do in this scenario?

"Hmm… I suppose I should consult the crystal ball."

"Papa… You're relying on that thing too much! Especially since it's magic that relies on devil powers!"

"Who cares about that?"

"Hah?"

I mean, our powers were either tied to some eldritch-mystery of an A.I. or some unknown gods.

Things like 'this power comes from a devil!' didn't really mean much to me.

I remembered how messing with the Kobolds led to the evolution of the Kobold Hero.

That was why I didn't want to risk things with creatures that were even more powerful than kobolds.

And so I set a teleport point and then went back to my dungeon.

"Oh, great crystal ball…!"

…What now?

It was annoyed by all my constant questions.

"I'm here to abuse your oh-so broken mechanic…"

That's all you're good at.

I ignored its rude comments.

Once I asked the question, it said,

…The best course of action is to just wipe them out.

"Oi, are you really suggesting to commit genocide?"

Yes, I am.

This thing wasn't even trying to sugarcoat it.

"...Doesn't that seem too drastic?"

They are powerful creatures that can use true invisibility… This means that if they continue to evolve, they could even bypass the dungeon's detection system.

"Hah?! Why is the dungeon even transporting creatures like those in?!"

That's because the chances of these creatures evolving are very low. But would you take that chance? If these creatures get out into the real world, there would be no way to stop them.

…If these things really had such a way to escape detection, then the crystal ball was right.

But could I really wipe out an entire emerging society based on such a slim risk?

When I teleported back to the others, I told them what I learned from the crystal ball.

"I don't really know what to do, so let's just put it to a vote…"

Mitsurugi nodded his head then sighed.

"Even if there's a risk… I don't feel right about eliminating an entire species…"

"Bomb them all."

Megumin suddenly said this.

This was like the good and evil routes in an RPG.

Mary-chan chimed in and said,

"We can't beat the Aether Titan if those things attack us, anyway. The only option is to eradicate them."

Megumin nodded at her.

"See? She gets it."

Doesn't Megumin realize that a monster was agreeing with her?

Well, this is my daughter, so I should trust her more…

In the end, I just had them cast their votes.

Those in favor of killing them were Megumin, Mary-chan, Iris and Chris.

The rest voted nay, which included me, Mitsurugi, Yunyun, Aqua, Rin and Aika-chan.

…I was a bit surprised with Iris's answer, although I guess after what happened to her country, she wasn't willing to take chances…

And well, Chris disapproved of most of Aqua's decisions, anyway.

As for why Aqua and Aika-chan were interested in keeping them alive…

"There's no way my A.I. imouto has the wrong judgement!"

"That's right! I built this dungeon so I trust it!"

They had a clear bias here.

In the end, I voted in favor for the non-genocide route.

I didn't want to develop the method of 'the ends justify the means'.

After all, I didn't want some other species deciding that humans were too dangerous to exist.

Viewing it from that perspective, I couldn't do it to these Void Stars.

Since we agreed not to judge each other for our choices, and to agree with the majority, we didn't discuss the results further.

Instead, we talked about how to fight the Aether Titan without worrying about the Void Stars.

Part 2

"[Taunt]!"

"[Focus Fire]!"

Darkness and Aqua led the Void Stars away from their stone pillars.

Then…

"Eeee?!"

They fell into a pit trap I set up.

Of course, there were some comfy cushions underneath that made sure they didn't receive even a tick of damage.

It took a while to get them all lured into these traps.

Once this was done, we focused on finding the Aether Titan.

"...It can't be that hard to find a big hand made out of gravity, right?"

Aqua said, not realizing how ridiculous she sounded.

But surely enough, after walking for a while…

"Look out…!"

Once [Enemy Detection] activated, I warned the others.

As we jumped away, a handprint suddenly appeared on the ground, and there was a huge tremor.

"It's attacking us!"

"Wait, this thing is practically invisible!"

Aqua said, as we started running away.

We felt one tremor after another as the hand kept trying to pummel us down into paste.

"Do you not understand what gravity is or what?!"

I said, shuddering as the last attack was actually close to hitting.

"How are we even gonna fight that thing! We can't see it!"

"...Obviously it's time to blow it up in one shot!"

This Megumin really had a one-track mind.

"Wait, I have an idea!"

I said, as I waited for the hand to make contact with the ground once more.

Once it did…

"[Tailor]!"

I used my skill that makes clothing.

"Hah?! Why are you using that skill, Kazuma?! Have you given up?! You might have a death wish, but I don't!"

Aqua's screeching was making it hard to focus.

Once I was done, we all saw the results.

There was now a glove around the hand, the material of which was made out of the grass in the fields.

"...! We can see it now! Good thinking, senpai!"

Rin eagerly praised me.

The hand tried to take the glove off, but since it was just one hand…

"Pfft! It's trying to take it off by grinding itself on the ground! Bwahaha!"

Aqua laughed as we saw the glove's futile efforts.

Well… I had to admit it was pretty funny.

"[Bind]!" x2.

Dust was also there as expected.

But I didn't expect him to actually bring along Faitfore with him to the succubus shop.

"...Should I report you to the authorities?"

I said, as I watched Faitfore eating a cake that Rorisa gave her.

Apparently that cake was donated to the shop by that famous pastry chef.

Since Rorisa was his muse, he had been supplying treats to the succubus shop.

"I'm keeping an eye on her, aren't I?"

"Hardly."

I said, as Dust was letting out obscene giggles while ogling the receptionist succubus.

I looked at Faitfore and said,

"If this guy neglects you too much, be sure to tell Uncle Kazuma."

"...I will do as master wishes me to, even if it is unpleasant."

"Has he done anything unpleasant to you? Please show me where on this doll."

I created a Faitfore doll with [Smithing].

"He patted me on the head here…"

"Which 'head' are you referring to?"

"Oi, knock it off."

Dust said, finally taking his lecherous gaze away to glare at me instead.

"Really, Dust, are you going to spend your nights just bumming around here?"

"Bumming around… You come here every night as well! At least I'm a paying customer! You only come here to see Rorisa!"

He got me there.

"Still, you need some kind of work."

"Changing the subject, huh?"

I thought about it and said,

"Say, I got you a bunch of intel jobs before, but you never actually gave me much to work with…"

"Hah? I was tailing that Dullahan for you!"

"Yeah, and like I said, you never actually got me any information, did you?"

He glanced away.

"So, why don't I give you another job? This time, I want you to tail a Lich."

"...Going from a Dullahan to a Lich… Do you want me to die?"

"It's not like you'll die. Wiz is pretty harmless if you don't attack her. Well…"

"Oi. That 'Well…' doesn't sound so certain!"

Now that Wiz was taking her work seriously as a Demon King general, I wasn't sure if she'd actually remain her non-violent self.

"In any case, you have your dragon now, so it's not like you're helpless."

"...I guess so. But still, a Lich is a Lich!"

"I'm telling you that you don't actually need to fight her."

"Hmm… Well, I guess I am a bit bored. Fine, then."

This was gonna be a huge help.

Of course, someone better suited to the task was probably Chris.

But I needed Chris to get stronger.

As for Dust, he was plenty strong enough and had a different leveling system than us, anyway.

He also had the most experience.

Not to mention he had a dragon with him.

I then told Dust the information I just got about Wiz.

And then I had another thought.

"I should probably send Cecily with you."

He'll need someone who could actually see ghosts.

And I knew for sure that Cecily was loyal to Aqua. She wouldn't betray us, especially to help the Demon King army.

And if Aqua gave her strict instructions, she wouldn't do anything crazy.

Like attacking Wiz on sight.

Once we finished discussing things, he said,

"Alright, I got it. It should be easy to look for her if she's still recruiting undead from graveyards."

If Dust managed to find her, then all we needed to do was get strong enough to finally confront her.

It's been a long time coming but…

It's time to bring Wiz back.

Chapter 77: A Festival Outing For This Group!

Part 1

Since it was the last week of summer vacation, with only a couple days left, we decided to go to a fireworks festival.

That said, I was also getting invitations from everyone, including Terada-senpai from the naginata club, Lia, Ame and even Kuruko, a.k.a. Dark+Angel. So I just ended up inviting them as well.

I kinda felt bad that I was sending Dust out on a mission to look for Wiz while everyone else was having fun… Well, it's not like he got along with most of the people going.

Did he even get along with anyone else other than me and Faitfore?

M-Maybe I should have held off on sending him off…

While we were arranging plans, Mitsurugi sighed,

"If only Cremea and Fio didn't have to go back… You're also sending Cecily-san out, so I don't even have a date!"

"Sorry about that…"

Yet another one I accidentally screwed over with my plans.

As for Cremea and Fio, the tourists that fell in love with Mitsurugi, they were only on a trip, so they had to eventually come back.

"You didn't tell them about the app?"

If they knew about it, he could just go to them anytime using the dungeon doors.

"No… It doesn't seem they have the potential. I can't even form a bond with them. I'm going to them every weekend using the dungeon doors, though."

"...They don't even question that?"

Wouldn't it be strange to have a foreign guy fly over to your country every weekend to see you?

"Well, I'm rich anyway, so it's not like I have to come up with an excuse."

"So you're fine with them knowing you're rich, but you don't want them to know about the app…"

"What's with all these questions?!"

I suppose I was getting nosy.

I left Mitsurugi alone and went to the living room. Aside from Aqua and Aika-chan at their usual posts on the couch, along with Mary watching a stream on her tablet, Yunyun and Megumin were playing chess at the gaming table while chatting.

"Megumin, let's invite our f-friends from school as well!"

Megumin nodded as she used the knight in a way that it shouldn't be used.

"That's true. Alright, I'll call them since Yunyun is too awkward to invite people to hang out."

"I'm not awkward! …And Megumin, why are you using your Knight like a Rook…"

"Didn't I just say that my Knight was upgraded to the Crusader class? So it can move like a Rook now."

"I see… Wait, that makes no sense! Well, you left a pawn hanging, so… I'll just advance my queen and…"

"You dare advance your queen into my territory?! Very well, then my Arch-Wizard will use [Bottomless Swamp] to halt the advance of your queen!"

"Megumin, stop making up all these stupid rules! You're a higher rating than me online, anyway!"

"...Is Megumin actually good at chess?"

I asked, as I went over to watch them play.

I expected Megumin to brag like she always did, but she just shrugged.

"I'm 2000 elo online."

"Wait, that's amazing, isn't it?"

"I guess? Wait, Yunyun, how are you still moving your queen after I cast [Bottomless Swamp] on her?!"

"...My Queen was enchanted by, um, my Arch-Priest, so it can… Resist your magic…?"

"Well played, Yunyun…"

Yunyun looked at me and whispered,

"She'd win if she played normally, but she uses these weird rules…"

What's with that?

It almost seemed like Megumin was leveling out the playing field…

Hm, was that what this was about?
"I see… So this tsundere Megumin just wants to give Yunyun a fighting chance…"

"How did you come to that gross conclusion, Kazuma? That's defamation… I'll sue!"

I did see Megumin playing these weird rules before, when she played chess with Darkness and Aqua.

This Megumin…

She's way too sweet sometimes, huh?

Aqua let out an annoyed sigh.

"Can you quiet down? I'm trying to watch something here."

I was about to apologize, but then I saw she was just watching commercials.

"How addicted are you to the TV that you're actually watching the commercials?!"

"...?! What if my favorite actor or idol appears in a CM?! Obviously I'd wanna see it! I already put up with Megumin and Yunyun over there flirting, now I gotta deal with Kazuma's whiny voice, too?!"

"W-We're not flirting!"

"Aqua-san, please take that back!"

Those two were quick to defend themselves.

…Although, the trope of couples going easy on each other in games came to mind.

So maybe Aqua wasn't far off.

I went down to whisper to Megumin and Yunyun.

"...You know, with our arrangement… You two don't have to hide it from me if you're 'experimenting' with each other…"

I mean, with all the threesomes we had… Perhaps they decided to try it out between themselves.

Going the full yuri route.

"...My Arch-Wizard casts explosion."

Megumin took the chessboard and flung it at me.

Megumin stormed off in a huff, while Yunyun bent down to pick up the pieces.

"You shouldn't have teased her so much, Kazuma-san…"

I picked up the pieces with Yunyun and offered to play with her, but it seemed that she had enough chess for now.

She then left to go to her room, while I sat by the gaming table. I watched Aqua and Aika-chan avidly watching the commercials.

"Look, mama! That actor from that one drama you like is in this CM!"

"Ohhh! I wish they would have paired him with his costar rather than some random girl…"

"They're just using an audience surrogate to entice his fans to buy the products."

"I see! There sure are some gullible consumers out there!"

Says the one avidly watching these commercials. I said,

"I don't understand how you can actually watch these commercials seriously… I just look at my phone while an ad is on."

Mary-chan nodded and said,

"That's what I do. I watch a YouTube short in another tab while an ad plays during a stream."

"Nevermind, that was bad advice."

I should save my family from their terrible fate as screen addicts…

"Papa, stop being such a nag and go away! The show is about to start!"

"Shoo, shoo."

I left in a depressed manner as my daughters chased me out.

Part 2

"[Light of Saber]!"

I was in my magic practice room again.

I had been steadily practicing [Light of Saber].

Taking Yunyun's advice, I imagined forming my mana into a sharp beam of light.

It's hard to explain, but using magic almost feels like using a muscle that you've never used before.

And since I had a disaffinity with light magic, it felt like using a muscle that had atrophied.

But this time…

"I did it!"

I exclaimed as I was able to cut a wooden dummy in half.

All that practice finally paid off.

[Light of Saber] Skill Rank: 1, Active Skill (30 mp)

Unleash a blade of light. The blade shoots out in a 30-foot line and is 5-feet wide. It can be directed into one slashing motion with your hand. Those hit by the blade receive 30 light damage plus your Magic Power modifier (+10).

I finally learned this damn spell…

Fortunately, I didn't have any further debuffs to light magic aside from learning it at an extremely slow pace.

Even with [Arcane Learning], it took so long…

There was another light spell I was trying to learn.

Since I finally learned [Light of Saber], I tried to see if this one would work.

"[Light of Refraction]!"

I looked at my hands and saw that it wasn't fully effective.

My form was semi-transparent, but I wasn't fully invisible.

"...I guess it still doesn't work."

I had experience gathering mana to use an attack spell before, but I couldn't even begin to understand how to refract light to make myself invisible to the naked eye.

Understanding magnetism is one thing, but this is too advanced for me.

I decided to leave it at that for now, since I did manage to learn [Light of Saber].

Next, there were the new spell tomes I got.

I summoned the Clonezumas.

"Oi, read these."

I said, tossing them the books.

They sighed as they took the books.

"...You had us reading those difficult as hell tomes for light magic… And now you have more advanced magic tomes for us to read?"

"You sure are a tyrant, boss…"

They started complaining.

"'Tis the life of a clone. By the way… What happened to that woman?"

I said, asking about the OL I had to keep safe in the dungeon during the Moneyball fight.

They put on some lewd grins.

"Yuriko is still with us…"

"That's her name huh… Wait, she's still there?"

Since there was so much DP now with the golem traps turned off, I didn't even notice if resources were being used.

But still… I had a whole freeloader in my dungeon for this long without even knowing about it.

"She'll need to leave eventually. You do realize this, right?"

"She already knows about the dungeon, so what's the point in kicking her out, boss?"

"Yeah, besides, she's so eager in bed…"

I didn't need to hear about my clones' love lives.

Rather… This Yuriko lady sure was taking advantage of the situation!
"If you're gonna do that much, at least move her to Norse."

"Eh… But we already have a love nest going…"

"Ah, whatever."

I was done arguing with them.

Besides, they were doing me a favor reading all those complicated tomes, anyway, might as well have their fun.

"While you're here, I want you to help me with something."

"...More work?"

"Maybe we should form a union or something."

I interrupted them before they could get any crazy ideas.

"I want to unlock the [Protection Against Arrows] skill from the Lancer class, but it seems that I can't unlock the skill unless the attack is lethal."

"...Why is the requirement so difficult? Other skills aren't as hard to learn…"

"Well, it's a very powerful ability."

I didn't want to risk going to the dungeon and facing a lethal attack.

So I relied on the clones.

I created a crossbow for them.

Since their golem bodies didn't have good stats, they couldn't use my shortbow.

Crossbows were easier to use, they should be able to make use of them.

Well, it wouldn't be lethal if I was wearing armor. If I did, they wouldn't be able to hurt me, which means I can't learn the skill.

"Hold on a sec."

I said, having second thoughts.

"...What now?"

They said, clearly wanting to get this over with.

"Well… Getting shot with a crossbow takes some serious guts…"

"Just man up and take it."

"Easy for you to say…"

I grit my teeth as I activated [Ignore Pain].

Then…

The clone shot the crossbow.

"Gackk…!"

I quickly healed myself before [Ignore Pain] could wear off.

Even though it was called [Ignore Pain], it didn't actually dull the pain at all.

Still, the damage mitigation saved me.

Your 'Bravery' increased by +5!

…I guess taking on an attack like that would increase my bravery.

You learned the skill [Protection Against Arrows]!

[Protection Against Arrows] Skill Rank: 1, Active skill (30 mp)

For one minute, you are resistant to all projectile attacks launched from a bow, sling or crossbow. Such attacks only deal half damage to you.

The app-user I faced was practically immune to arrow attacks, though…

Well, he probably put levels into it.

Ahh… Another instance of me suffering from only having a skill at Rank 1…

There were so many skills I wanted to level up.

"..."

Should I just consider resetting my levels?

There was that method I was thinking about.

In Lizardia's prison, there were runes that drained one's levels. This ensured that powerful criminals were punished without giving them a chance to escape.

Of course, along with levels, stats were also reset.

Then again, stats could also be raised through the use of class features.

For example, Arch-Wizard could raise magic power using Skill Points.

…Which was what Megumin was doing to absurd amounts.

Well, I couldn't fault her, since I also did that to increase my luck stat to obscene levels using the Gambler class.

The only reason why I didn't reset my stats this way, was because I worked way too hard to raise my stats.

Not to mention the stats I received as a crystallization of my bonds with people.

These weren't just power-ups, they had become a core part of my soul and my memories with my friends and family.

The potential I got from Iris, the strength I got from Mitsurugi…

Even the faith I got from Aqua.

Just thinking about how disappointed I was at the faith upgrades already made me laugh.

These were precious memories indeed.

…But those memories didn't matter if I died.

It was likely that the gods wouldn't let me resurrect again.

Of course, I didn't have any regrets about that. It took all we had to defeat the Winter Shogun.

So I had to face the consequences.

Still, the fight with Wiz was drawing ever closer.

And according to Wolbach, Wiz didn't even hesitate to use [Level Drain] on herself.

…Not to mention she's been constantly doing that.

And here's another problem.

Like Dust, Wiz operated on a different system than us.

She used the Adventurer Cards from the otherworld.

That meant that even if she didn't have the Hero class, she didn't have a cap on her level like we did.

"..."

I decided to talk about it with the others after the festival.

There was no sense in bringing the mood down.

And I wasn't ready to do this at the moment, anyway.

…For some reason, this felt like I was about to undergo a life-altering procedure…

Well, technically, it was like that.

Part 3

My next task was to upgrade my gear.

Of course, I encountered lots of powerful weapons and armor in the dungeon, as well as materials that could be used with [Smithing].

But honestly, I didn't really need to upgrade most of my weapons, and I was fine with my armor.

My composite plate armor was the perfect balance between giving me enough protection, while not gutting my stealth abilities completely.

Sure, I could have replaced it with stronger armor from the dungeon, but I had a stealth, crit-archer build. It wouldn't do for me to use Heavy Armor too often.

And Chunchunmaru was a unique custom weapon that was already customized to deal as much damage as possible.

As for my bows, my wyvern bow had the special ability to pierce through wind resistance that I couldn't afford to replace.

And the longbow of the bark people gave me extra damage when fired from a long distance.

So even if they were technically a lower rarity than other weapons I've seen, their special properties made it hard to replace them.

The same could be said about the Spear of Thunder. It didn't provide any damage bonuses, but its knockback properties were good for Crowd Control. Adding adamantite or combining it with other gear will just lose this useful property.

So, I guess the only thing left to upgrade were my Brutal Alligator gloves.

As for what I wanted to upgrade it with…

I took out my storage box and brought out the dragon scales I took from that dragon.

That's right. While we were taking treasure from the dragon's lair, I also took the liberty of stealing some scales that it shed.

Well, is it really stealing when I just took something that he didn't have any use for? Rather, I helped him clean his lair by taking the scales.

"[Smithing]!"

With the dragon scales, I created a new item.

Green Dragon Gloves and Greaves (Legendary)

Made from green dragon scales that you stole. When equipped, you gain the [Natural Weapon] ability. If a skill requires the use of a weapon, apply it to any part of your body instead.

Durability: 60/60

Weapon Accuracy: Dexterity modifier + [Unarmed Combat] = 140% chance of hitting

Weapon Damage: 5 bludgeoning damage + Strength modifier (+12) + Bonus (+0) = 18 damage

Sells for: 20,000,000 Yen

Even if it didn't provide a crazy amount of damage, that ability alone was legendary worthy, especially since there wasn't really a way for a human to unlock such an ability.

Satisfied with the new gear, I put it away in my inventory.

Your 'Creativity' went up by +5!

Creating a legendary weapon from the dragon scales boosted my creativity by a lot…

Aside from that, I didn't really know how to boost my other stats naturally.

I also stopped getting stats from having the clones eat monster food. They were simply too high now.

I guess this was even more reason to do a reset.

…

…

"Ah, Zell, close your eyes…!"

When I came back to the living room, Aqua was still watching TV.

This time, she also had Zell on her lap.

She covered his eyes as a KFC commercial came on.

"Hoh…? I thought this child was supposed to be a dragon… Is there a reason why that commercial would upset him?"

I didn't miss this chance to challenge Aqua's stupid insistence that this chicken was a dragon.

Aqua didn't expect me to be there and looked like she was in a panic thinking of what to say.

"...For some reason, dragons take on a chick's appearance when they are infants… Zell might be confused as to why those that look like him are being treated as food by humans…"

"What a creative lie. Your 'Cunning' and 'Creativity' must have went up by 10 points with that one!"

"Don't compare me to you, Kazuma! Aika-chan tells me that your Cunning stat is starting to reach the realm of the divine now! Aren't you ashamed of that?!"

Aika-chan glanced away as Aqua said this.

"Oi… We made a lot of promises about maintaining privacy, didn't we?"

"...How can I refuse a request from mama?"

She made no efforts to hide her true loyalties.

"Sniff… Mary-chan, the whole family is turning on me!"

I embraced Mary-chan, who just leaned her head away as I rubbed my cheek against hers.

Of course, she was still watching a stream on her tablet.

"...You can do whatever you want to me, as long as I can keep watching my stream."

I felt like she said something that could be interpreted badly there.

Still, I placed Mary-chan on my lap as I watched TV with my family.

I already finished my tasks, so I was using this as break time.

Even so…

"How can you do this all day?"

I said, already getting bored from the show they were watching.

"Hah? Kazuma who spent all that time as a NEET is saying that?"

"Tsk… When I was a NEET, I was playing games that are still considered masterpieces, same with the anime, manga and light novels I enjoyed."

"You sure were busy doing a whole bunch of nothing, papa."

"..."

Aika-chan was quick to shoot me down.

"But these shows are actual garbage! I can already predict where the plot will go, the characters are stale and the pacing is so bad! It's just slop!"

I turned to Mary-chan.

"And you… The streamers you adore make me feel like I'm losing brain cells when I watch them. How can you enjoy this?!"

"OK, Kazuma, we let you go on your self-righteous, pretentious ass rant, so can we go back to watching now?"

"Yeah, papa. No one cares."

"..."

I ended up keeping my mouth shut and let them watch in peace.

Part 4

The bonding time with my family just equated to us sitting on the couch the entire afternoon.

Well, I guess most families were like this.

"Sniff… I miss the days when Aika-chan loved going to places like Disneyland and Vegas…"

"We can still go to those places, papa, but I really wanted to watch that drama!"

"Stop being overbearing, Kazuma."

Is this what being a dad feels like?
At the very least, Mary-chan didn't mind at all even as I held her the entire time.

She was probably just focused on her stream, though.

After they finished their drama, they started to prepare for the festival.

Since I had the [Tailor] skill, it was an easy task to prepare yukatas for everyone.

"Ohh, it's my first time wearing a yukata!"

Megumin said, as she admired the red yukata I made for her.

"My mother made one for me when I was a kid. It was made out of a rice bag."

I couldn't even picture what that would have looked like.

Also, hearing these episodes from Megumin's childhood was depressing. I asked,

"Your family is coming as well, right?"

We invited our families as well, since a bunch of people were already going.

I also pulled some strings and had Sena reserve us a VIP spot to watch the fireworks.

"Yeah. You know, I'm surprised my dad hasn't caught on to all the supernatural stuff going on in his workplace…"

Since Hyoizaburo-san worked as an inventor for the military, he probably saw a lot of weird things.

Like how I went to the base to ask for helicopter parts before.

"He's the best for this kind of work, because he will turn a blind eye to anything as long as he gets paid."

The fact they were paying him a massive salary meant that the government could be doing NERV levels of crazy stuff, and he still wouldn't say anything about it.

He was the opposite of a whistleblower… A whistleswallower perhaps?
"How's your family doing these days, Kazuma?"

"Hmm… Actually, I've been thinking about their potential as app-users…"

"...Seriously?"

I've been thinking about it for a while now.

I had Lia and Rin turn into app-users for their safety, so I should probably do the same for my family.

After all, they had a bond with me, even if it wasn't individual.

So they had the barest minimum requirement to become app-users.

Not only that, but they will get the blessings of the hero class as well.

In the upcoming war, I wanted them to be safe, but…

"...I just can't imagine my parents becoming app-users."

"It's kind of embarrassing, isn't it?"

Imagining my dad wearing plate armor and my mom wearing a female thief outfit…

I shuddered thinking about it.

And as for Kazuto…

"I don't think my little brother can be trusted, to tell the truth."

"What do you mean by that?"

Early on, Kazuto gave me what was essentially pick-up artist lessons.

For a while, he was my most consistent source of Charisma bonuses.

Let's just say that the things he was telling me were absolutely horrid.

"You see, nii-san… Girls are only attracted to guys they can't get. When you show the slightest bit of interest in them, they immediately get turned off. Also, they're superficial creatures that only care about looks, but they also have this obsession about always having the moral high ground. So if they find a guy physically unattractive, they'll say socially-acceptable buzzwords like 'he's a red flag' or 'he gives me the ick' instead of just outright saying they find him ugly."

I don't even know where he learned those things from.

"If he becomes an app-user, he'll become an absolute menace."
"He can't be worse than you."
She was quick to say that.

The others looked at their yukatas and were buzzing with excitement.

"Thanks, senpai! This color looks great!"

Rin said, as she picked up the yukata I made for her.

"I always wanted to go to a festival with my boyfriend… Promise me we'll have at least a few minutes to walk around the place together, OK?"

"Of course."

I didn't hesitate to agree.

Although I should probably set up some kind of schedule with everyone.

"I've always been curious about festivals as well."

Chris said, smiling as she held up her Yukata.

"One of your many fantasies from spying on humans in heaven, huh?"

"...Kazuma-kun, why do you always have some kind of weird twist for everything I say…?"

While maintaining eye contact with Chris, I placed my arm around Yunyun's waist and pulled her in. She let out a surprised squeak.

"Chris, you're like a perverted version of Yunyun."

"W-What does that mean?!"

"...You were both outcasts who longed to interact with others, but whereas Yunyun at least existed in our realm, you were watching like some kind of voyeuristic pervert from a separate dimension…"

"T-That isn't…!"

"Furthermore, you even went down from heaven and started walking around wearing the most revealing outfit possible… Seriously, was there really a need to wear a crop top that is essentially just a bra, and the tightest little booty shorts possible?"

She sputtered for a response. I kept going.

"Yunyun wore revealing outfits as well! But she did it out of a desire for a human connection, and I'm pretty sure she was tricked into doing it! As for you… 'It helps with my mobility in the dungeon, teehee~!' Who the hell believes that?! There's a bunch of skills that reduce such penalties when wearing armor! So, why aren't you wearing any armor?! I know for a fact that the Thief class has a [Light Armor] skill, so where is it? Ahhh… What a freak! If any man made a move on you back then, you would have absolutely folded, wouldn't you?!"

"Why would you even say that?! You think I'd put out for any man?!"

As soon as she said it, she blushed upon remembering a little incident.

"That's right. Even back then, I could sense the degenerate in you. Need I remind you that during our raid at that hotel, you jerked me off and even stuck your little tongue out when I came! You lapped it all up unprompted, didn't you? You were probably dying to have that kind of scenario forced on you, huh!"

Everyone was basically listening now, which made Chris blush even harder.

Darkness stepped in front of Chris to defend her.

"Kazuma, I will have to ask you to stop exposing Chris like this."
"E-Expose…?! Darkness, you have to tell them that he's lying!"

"There's a reason I became friends with Chris and started worshipping Eris-sama…"
"...!!!"

Chris went silent, then started crying.

"Wahhh! Kazuma-kun, you're so mean!"

She ran off to her room.

Megumin stared at me, then said,

"Are you sure your brother is the problem?"

Ah.

I might have gotten carried away.

Part 5

Thankfully, Chris's bad mood didn't stop her deciding to come along with us to the festival.

"Hoh…"

I admired everyone in their yukatas.

"This is an interesting outfit."

Iris said, as she lifted her sleeves to inspect it.

"You look great, Iris. Are you sure you don't want to hang out with any of your friends from school?"

"I did receive some invites, but I want to spend time with onii-sama and everyone."

I smiled while patting her head.

"Oh, but Kazuto-kun is coming, right? Perhaps I'll hang out with him."

"...Hell no."

I immediately put a stop to that.

Thankfully, it seemed that Kazuto wasn't trying to pursue Iris as hard as he was before.

Knowing him, he probably moved on to some other girl after Iris didn't show any immediate interest in him.

Or he was just playing the hard-to-get approach.

"Listen, nii-san. Girls like the thrill of the chase…"

He often said things like that as well.

Not to mention that he was still in that wannabe nonchalant phase from before.

Ah, crap!

Sure, we had some discussions about keeping the whole daughter thing a secret but…

I guess she couldn't help it!

"...This little girl is Aqua's relative… She really misses her grandparents, so just play along."

'This is my daughter!'… As if I could say something like that!

"Nice to meet you! What's your name, little one?"

"It's Aika!"

"OK, Aika-chan, why don't we check out some of these booths, hm?"

"Yeah!"

Both my mom and dad were dragged along by Aika-chan. Thankfully, they didn't seem to mind. In fact, they were immediately charmed by Aika-chan.

Your Cunning went up by +1!

It's not like I enjoy lying to my parents.

I looked down at Mary, who was watching them while licking an ice cream.

"Don't you wanna join them?"

As expected of a Tranquility Girl… She was still quite lacking in the sentimentality department.

I took out some cash and gave it to her.

"Just join them for now. I'll have to spend some time with the others individually, anyway."

"Well, if you say so."

She gave a casual shrug, took the cash and jogged over to join my parents and Aika-chan."

"Heh. That was a good play, nii-san."

Meanwhile, Kazuto had this to say.

"...What do you mean?"

"Getting rid of the parents and those kids… You want to get those girls alone right?"

Girls, girls, girls… That's all this horndog ever thinks about!

"Kazuto… Once you get past this pubertal horniness of yours, you'll soon find that there's more to life than girls…"

"Ohhh! Look at those cuties over there!"

He wasn't even listening to me.

As expected of a celebrity…

She was good at cutting unwanted interactions short.

"Cielo is the one you need to impress."

"...I humbly ask for your blessings, ma'am."

Cielo petulantly stomped her foot.

Part 7

Since those two were dating now, why did he even invite me?

Wait, no matter how you think about it, this was this blockhead Terada-senpai's fault.

You have a girlfriend, so why are you hanging out with us?! Not to mention it's only been a few weeks since they started dating, so why is he so lax around her?! He should be doing his best to treat her well!

Still, what a blockhead.

"Blockhead… I mean, Terada-senpai…"

Your Cunning increased by +1!

"It's gonna take a while to set up the spot I reserved, so why don't you hang out with Mio-san for now? It's gonna be hard to move in a big group, and it's not like you know all of my friends and family."

"...Let's meet up with Satou-kun and co. later, Terada-kun! I'm hungry, so let's check out some stalls together! Platonically, of course!"

She was about to reflexively hook her arms around his, but only managed to stop at the last second.

Darkness said lamely.

Even though that crisis was only narrowly averted.

As for the last two I invited, there was Kuroko and Ame.

"Oh, Kazuma, there you are!"

As for what her business was…

"...You're here too, huh, kid?"

She was running a stall with her father.

They had a stall that ran a toy rifle target game, where you shoot down the prizes you want. Kuroko told me that they do this every year.

I knew that the blacksmith oji-san had quite a lot of wealth now as an app-user, which he could explain away with the government contacts I introduced him to.

So rather than do this for profits, I guess he just wanted to keep up the tradition with his daughter.

I excused myself from the others to say hi to Kuroko, but her old man was giving me a suspicious glare.

Ever since I accidentally crashed her birthday party, he had been suspicious of my relationship with her.

Kuroko smiled and said,

"My old man doesn't have a lot of friends, so it'll be cool if he makes friends with your folks!"

With that resolved, I secretly passed Sakamoto-san a note.

As for that note, it was about my medicine research.

With the [Medicine] skill I had been continuing to study the plants and herbs I gathered in the dungeon.

I remembered Kuruko mentioning last time that Sakamoto-san had diabetes.

Of course, I didn't want him to suffer from such an ailment, so I wanted to give him the medicine I developed with him in mind.

…Hopefully that would also increase his opinion of me.

Chapter 78: A Grand Reveal In This Festival!

Part 1

Sakamoto-san told Kuroko that he needed to take a break to check on his blood sugar.

"I'll handle things here, dad!"

She cheerfully said, waving as he stepped away.

We met up at a secluded area away from the festival, away from the stalls and people, near some trees. For extra measure, I put up a dungeon door and had him step inside.

He was a bit wary of it, never having seen someone summon a dungeon door out of thin air before, but he seemed to trust me enough to enter, at least.

"...What is this place?"

He asked, as he looked around at the elegant living room styled as a traditional Japanese reception room. I made a little hobby out of designing different kinds of rooms based on different cultures. It was like playing an interior design game.

He tested the genuine tatami mat floors after taking his shoes off. I also made some light runes to replicate the artificial sunlight in the main dungeon, to have a faint glimmer of sunlight peeking from outside, along with a garden that was growing the various herbs and plants I took from the dungeon.

I pointed to a low table for him to set on. He nodded and sat on a seat cushion. He jerked in surprise when a hostess came out, wearing a formal kimono with sunflower print.

"It's a golem that's constructed to serve guests."

"Kid, what kind of insane shit have you been doing…?!"

He was yelling but immediately quieted his voice, affected by the serenity of the location. The hostess bowed and served both of us tea. I sat across from him.

"Nevermind that…"

"How can I not mind it?!"

"In any case, your medicine is in that tea."

I pointed to the green tea the golem served.

"...You're just gonna casually give me a miracle cure, just like that?"

"What, do you want a whole ceremony or something?"

"No, not really… Well, I guess I can't call it anti-climactic considering the setting…"

He seemed a bit conflicted on what to think, but I guess I kind of understood him. I guess just having the cure placed directly in front of him, the steam going to his face, was startling, to say the least.

Still, he took the cup and drank the tea in one go.

"...It's good. Wait, the taste isn't the issue."

"You probably shouldn't go to the doctor. They'll wonder how you got rid of your diabetes."

"Yeah, good call. I'll just report that my blood sugar levels are good… Although I guess I don't have to worry about that anymore."

He blinked, as if unable to believe he just said those words, before he chuckled. I didn't miss how he blinked a few times, probably to stop himself from crying. I felt like I shouldn't be witnessing a grown man emotionally breaking down from having his disease cured, but I was involved in the process of helping him. I felt I deserved at least some of the emotional payoff.

"I kind of wish Kuroko could be here with me to share the moment…"

"Do you want to bring her here?"

I said, which surprised him.

"...I won't say that I haven't considered telling her about all this dungeon business. Considering what's at stake."

"Yeah, I've been considering telling my family as well…"

"It's the right move, I think."

It made me feel better about my decision having a man like Sakamoto-san validate my decision.

"Tell you what, Sakamoto-san, when you come to meet my parents later, how about we just reveal everything to them and Kuroko later?"

Not only to them, but everyone who was involved with me, even Ame and Terada-senpai.

And perhaps I'd ask Megumin and Yunyun if she wanted to involve their friends, who were coming later.

I didn't want to risk things anymore. Even for those without the potential to become app-users, I wanted a way to have them be prepared for the upcoming danger.

He looked down at the tea cup he just finished, before slowly nodding.

"Let's do it."

We both shook on it.

Your bond with Sakamoto Daichi has deepened!

Sakamoto Daichi (Blacksmith oji-san), Bond Rank: 3

After curing Daichi, his respect and trust for you has risen considerably. He feels bad for being rude to you at the start of your relationship, and will make efforts to treat you better from now on. He's still not sure if he could handle it if you started dating Kuroko, but he won't beat you up anymore if you do. Your bond will not break anymore if he finds out about you and Kuroko.

Bond Reward: You learn the skill [Storefront]!

[Storefront] Skill Rank: 1, Active Skill (10 mp)

Select a location. You will create a small space that only app users can see, where you can store your goods. This space can be made outside or within a dungeon. It will take the appearance you desire. The store has an inventory space separate to your own and can hold 10 items at Rank 1. Your Charisma stat determines how many customers will be attracted to your store. You can hire employees to run the store, and their Charisma scores can contribute to the total (3 max).

I finally learned this skill, huh?

I was interested in it before, but it wasn't like I wanted to make those irresponsible app-users stronger by selling gear to them. And I have more than enough money these days.

Still, it could have some use, so I didn't immediately disregard it.

Once we agreed to share the secret with the others, Sakamoto-san and I exchanged a handshake before leaving the room.

I watched him return to Kuroko, who was surprised when he suddenly embraced her.

Well, he can tell her the good news later on.

Part 2

Aika-chan did call 'dibs' on me, but when I looked for her, it looked like she was having plenty of fun with my grandparents. They were doting on her and Mary-chan, spoiling them with treats.

I wondered how my parents would react not only to the app-user thing, but with the knowledge that those two really were their granddaughters.

I left them to have fun and went back to the group, who were still checking out stalls together. Mitsurugi and Rin came back with Rin carrying a plastic bag with a goldfish inside. I guess they already went goldfish scooping. Joining the group were three girls I hadn't seen before.

"M-Megumin, another handsome guy is coming here?!"

A girl with twintails said, causing a girl with a ponytail beside her to gasp in shock. Meanwhile, the third girl, one who was wearing an eyepatch similar to the one Megumin used to always wear, just looked at me curiously.

It looked like these two girls were blushing while looking at me and Mitsurugi.

"You must be Megumin and Yunyun's friends. Nice to finally meet you."

I said, coming to greet them.

"Y-Yeah, I'm…"

"This is Funifura, Dodonko and Arue."

"Oi! I told you to stop calling us with those weird names!"

"These hot guys will think we're weird!"

From what I remembered, Megumin roped her schoolfriends into the Crimson Demon lore she made up.

But Arue didn't seem to mind it. In fact, she seemed to embrace it.

"Fufun… Forgive these two. They haven't unlocked their memories from their past lives yet…"

She struck a chuuni pose, putting her hands over her eyes mysteriously.

…That confident pose… Could it be that Arue was actually the ringleader when it comes to that roleplay stuff?

"Why do I hang out with these weirdos…"

Funifura muttered, looking embarrassed.

Yunyun tugged on Arue and Megumin's yukata sleeve.

"Um, Fumino-san and Momoko-san don't really like playing along with the Crimson Demon stuff… I mean, I got used to it, but it's not like I'm as passionate about it as you two…"

Fumino and Momoko… Those must be their real names.

Well, I can kinda see Funifura coming from Fumino, but Momoko… How did that even lead to Dodonko?

"Megumin… You really have the worst naming sense…"

"Y-Yeah, go ahead and tell her!"

"Megumi calls us that everyday! It's annoying! And because Yuna here goes along with everything her lover Megumi says, she even calls us with those stupid names sometimes!"

"L-Lover…?! H-Hey, I was trying to help you two but maybe I should stop?!"

Yunyun was actually standing up for herself. Did it really count if she could only do it when it came to her friends, though?

Mitsurugi chuckled, perhaps finding the argument between the middle schoolers endearing.

"Megumin-chan… It's kind of mean how you gave yourself, Yunyun-chan and Arue-chan nicknames that are at least kind of cute… Funifura-chan is kind of cute-sounding, too, but Dodonko-chan's is, well, it's really the weirdest one."

"U… Uuu…!"

Having this ikemen call her nickname weird actually made Dodonko tear up. Mitsurugi started waving his hands.

"Ah, wait! Sorry, I didn't mean that! H-How about I treat you to some ice cream, or something?!"

"Sure, let's go!"

"Wait, I'm coming along, too!"

Dodonko instantly cheered up and Funifura somehow managed to tag along.

Megumin sighed as she went to follow them.

"Let's go, Yunyun."

"R-Right!"

Since Megumin promised Yunyun that they'd spend time with their friends, she was following them as they split off with Mitsurugi.

Arue was about to follow them, but before she could, she gave me a small bow.

"It's nice to finally meet you. You're Kazuma-senpai, right?"

"Ah, yeah nice to meet you… I can call you Arue, but I'd like to know your real name."

"There was once a time when I used to think that my relationship with senpai was something like a youth romcom… Ah, those were the days…"

"What would you classify it now?"

"...Let's just say that you can't really learn to care for someone unless you accept all their faults."

I thought Rin had just sabotaged my relationship with Lia, but Lia just chuckled and nodded.

"That makes sense. I never thought that Kazuma was virtuous, anyway."

Should I feel relieved?

Meanwhile, Megumin's yukata had suddenly disappeared and she was in her combat gear, complete with the staff.

"Kazuma, the easiest way to show them is to reveal the terrifying might of explosion…!"

"[Bind]!"

I threw a rope on Megumin to subdue this terrorist.

"Eeep! He tied Megumin up!"

"Let's get out of here! This is some kinda creepy party!"

Ah, this grand reveal was going rougher than I expected.

Well, I guess it was mostly my fault.
