Chapter 79: A Climax For This Festival!

Part 1

"Hey, Kazuma, you've recently worked on yourself and became popular… Please don't regress back into a chuuni…"

Kuroko said, still not convinced. She seemed shocked at seeing Mitsurugi, Cremea and Fio step out of the dungeon door, but I guess she thought it was an elaborate magic trick, like Komekko did.

I guess that was the natural reaction.

I shared a look with Sakamoto-san and he nodded.

"Actually, Kuroko-chan, this is all real."

"Ugh, dad, not you too! I know you wanna relate to me by copying what kids these days do, but trust me when I say that this isn't cool!"

"I'm not trying to be cool! You see, magic actually exists. In fact, Kazuma here helped my diabetes with a magic cure…"

"See what you did, Kazuma?! All your chuuni posturing made my dad delusional!"

Aqua stepped forward and took out her fans.

"Maybe this will convince you. [Nature's Beauty]!"

"Ohhh! Impressive! …But this isn't anything supernatural, is it?"

"Hah?! How dare you! This is a goddess's party trick! I knew I shouldn't have put my skill points into luck and intelligence!"

Clearly, she needed to put more into intelligence if she'd say something like that.

My parents looked at me in concern. My dad said,

"Kazuma… You've entered this kind of phase again, huh?"

My mom wiped the corner of her eye, where a tear came out.

"Just when I thought you were improving these days…"

Kazuto sighed and shook his head.

"Did I waste all my time giving you those invaluable life lessons?"

Not only was I failing to convince them, they were starting to piss me off.

Erika turned to Lia and said,

"Hey, was your boyfriend always this weird?"

Cielo hid behind Lia while looking at me warily.

"H-He won't try to steal my panties too, will he?"

"...!!!"

Having the idols I admire treat me like this feels horrible!

Yunyun, true to her kind nature, stepped forward to help me.

"Kazuma-san is telling the truth! Funifura-san, Dodonko-san, please look at this! [Fireball]!"

She pointed her hand to the sky and shot a fireball.

"You're in on this too, Yunyun?"

"Megumin really corrupted her… In all sorts of ways…"

Thanks to Aqua, they saw every instance of magic as some kind of cheap party trick.

Of course she'd screw something up!

Fio and Cremea seemed to have gained their bearings and said,

"Cremea… I think this is actually real. I mean, we were in Milan just a minute ago…"

"Y-Yeah… We're in Japan now, right? What is everyone saying…?"

Since they didn't have the app, they couldn't understand what the others were saying.

They were only convinced because they were instantly transported to Japan. I guess that was the only way to convince the others.

I created another dungeon door and said,

"...If you all really think this is some kinda trick, then step through this door…"

Kazuto sighed and shook his head, before going to the door.

"Hah, nii-san… You really don't know when to drop a joke, huh? Fine, I guess I'll humor you…"

He opened the door and stepped inside, before quickly going back and closing the door.

"C-Cold! Where was that?!"

I created a door leading to the arctic.

The others also opened the door and immediately closed it. They were all shivering at the end.

I created more doors, each one leading to vastly different environments and temperatures. With each door I created, the more they started to see that this wasn't a trick.

"H-Hey, Lia, is this actually real?"

Lia nodded at Erika who said that.

"Yes, it is. So please listen to what Kazuma has to say, because it's important."

All eyes were on me now.

I then told everyone about the app, the powers one can get from it, as well as the dungeon, and most importantly, the threat of the Demon King army.

While I was at it, I also told them about Iris. Meanwhile, Aqua…

"I'm actually a goddess!"

She couldn't help it and announced this.

"T-This is all like the plot of some cliched Light Novel…"

Kazuto said, once I finished explaining. He turned to Iris.

"Iris-chan, are you really a princess from another world?!"

Iris gave him a weak smile.

"Yes. Sorry if it's hard to believe…"

"No, I can believe it. You're an otherworldly beauty, after all…"

Oi, I thought he gave up on Iris?!

"And Aqua nee-chan is a goddess, huh? I can also believe it."

"Fufu, you're the first one to believe me so quickly, Kazuto! You're smart unlike your nii-san!"

And I thought he gave up on Aqua, too…

Kazuto stuck his chest out.

"Well, as someone destined to fight the Demon King army… Of course I am."

I see.

Upon finding out that such fantasy tropes actually existed in real life, he was currently undergoing a surge of self-confidence.

That was why he started flirting with all the girls he once gave up on.

"By the way, Kazuto, your potential is very low, so we're not sure yet if you can use the app."

"O-Oh…"

I made sure to humble him before he could get any crazy ideas.

My parents were looking at me worriedly.

"Kazuma… Have you really been fighting dangerous things like demons this whole time?!"

My mom said, making me feel guilty since she looked so worried about me.

"This isn't something kids like you should be doing! We should be telling the government about this!"

I looked to Sena, who blushed at the eye-contact.

She was still embarrassed about what we did, huh? Adorable.

Still, she did her job and faced my parents.

"Actually, the government is already involved. They are working directly with Kazuma-kun and his friends to fight the Demon King army."

Hyoizaburo-san gasped and said,

"Wait, you mean to tell me that the 'gifted children' program was just a cover up by the government, so they could use our kids to battle these demons?!"

He managed to put two and two together.

Sena nodded her head and bowed.

"Yes, I'm sorry for lying to you!"

"T-This is unacceptable! How could the government betray our trust like this?! Not to mention making kids fight their battles…! And you, Kazuma-kun! I trusted you with my daughter's safety, and you've been having her involved in this shady business!"

I coughed and said,

"By the way, the government also gave you that job upon my request."

"...C-Come to think of it, I did find it strange that Kazuma-kun came to the military base… No, actually, I had an inkling that this was all happening… Of course, I trust you, Kazuma-kun, so I have no problems with this…"

He sure changed his tune quickly.

Part 2

I then explained the dungeon system more to them.

When I was done, I asked if they had any questions for me. Arue raised her hand.

"...So we really don't have any innate potential?"

Rather than look disappointed, she only seemed confused.

It was as if she was wondering why someone like her wasn't destined to be a magic user.

"You haven't developed a bond with Megumin yet despite your closeness. That normally means you naturally don't have potential."

"...But someone who doesn't embrace the dark arts like Yunyun has high potential…"

"I don't think it really has to do with that…"

One's disposition did have to do if you could see the dungeon doors or not. Rin and Lia weren't able to see them despite having some potential.

Rin did want to see fantasy worlds like in her favorite fairy tales, but she was ultimately a realist at the end of the day, while Lia was a realist through and through.

In Arue's case, she did have the disposition to see the dungeon doors but not necessarily the inherent potential.

As for what determined potential, it seemed to be completely random. If it was linked to genetics, then Megumin's family and Kuroko would also have potential.

I suppose my family was lucky in the sense that we all had some form of potential.

"Kazuma… You said you have a plan to turn us into these app-users… What do you mean by that?"

It made me feel weird that my mom was talking to me with such caution. She looked at me as if she didn't know if I was still really the same Kazuma she once knew.

I guess this was how a parent would normally react to finding out their son is practically a super hero.

Megumin's parents were the abnormal ones.

I could also see that Kuroko and Sakamoto-san were having some issues. In fact, Sakamoto-san tried to get Kuroko to speak to him in private, but she just shook her head and remained with the others.

…I'd like to help him, but I had the important task of explaining this to everyone.

I turned to my mom and said,

"I can make legendary grade clothing with my [Tailor] skill that drastically raises one's potential. I don't really know if this will help you install the app or not, but it's worth a try."

I asked the crystal ball, but it told me that the chances were not impossible, but they were very slim. Even if they couldn't access the app, I could still give them items to protect themselves, at the very least.

Once I answered all the questions, I then began to tell them about my permadeath status.

I was planning on coming clean with everything, anyway. This was my chance to do so.

"W-What?! Kazuma, why didn't you say anything about this?!"

Megumin said, coming up to me to lift my collar.

Oi, how is she lifting me up?!

"...I didn't want to worry anyone…"

Iris shot me a glare.

"There you go again, onii-sama… I thought we were done hiding things from each other? Not only is it a breach of trust, you're severely compromising our tactics if you hold things back like this!"

Aika-chan started panicking.

"P-Papa! Several of your bonds are in danger of decreasing! Ah, maybe I shouldn't have announced that…"

Aika-chan covered her mouth.

My dad looked at Aika-chan, then at Aqua.

"Um… You know, Aika-chan has been calling you 'papa' and Aqua-chan 'mama' this whole time… She's also been calling us her grandparents… Is she actually…?"

Ahhh! Too many of my secrets are unfolding!

I backed away as the mob started to gather around me. I said,

"Anyway, there's also my plan to reset our skill points…"

"Who cares about that?! You owe us some answers, Kazuma!"

Not only was the main group grilling me, I also noticed Erika shaking her head at me as she patted Lia on the shoulder.

"Oi, Kazuma… You have a lot of explaining to do to Lia here…"

I didn't even want to see Lia's expression right now, but I immediately felt chills.

"...You're right, Erika. He does."

However, I immediately felt dread as Rin stepped forward.

"...Megumin-chan, keep holding him up like that."

"Yes, ma'am!"

Ah, I'm screwed.

Part 3

"Hold on now, you're gripping my neck a bit too tightly, Megumin. And Rin, why are you cracking your knuckles?"

I said, as these two were surrounding me like sharks.

The others were also quickly drawing closer.

"Hoh? You were brave enough to keep secrets from me, but you can't handle this?"

Rin said with a dark scowl.

"Kazuma… I'm disappointed that you kept this from us…"

Darkness said, making Iris nod along.

"Lalatina, make sure to choke onii-sama after Megumin is done."

Why were they taking turns choking me?!

However, what hurt the most was when I saw Yunyun starting to tear up.

"Kazuma-san… You don't trust us, huh?"

"...?!!"

Gah, my heart!

"I'm so sorry!"

When Megumin released me, I went down to do a full bow.

The others, however, were just confused.

"Permadeath… I don't get it. Don't people die when they're killed?"

My mom said, not understanding why the others were surprised.

Mitsurugi rubbed his chin.

"Come to think of it… Aqua-sama's power is very rare, anyway. The fact that we assume we can be resurrected anytime isn't something we should consider normal."

That actually managed to take the heat off me.

Rin's glare softened.

"...I suppose that's true. From here on out, we should just assume that we only have one life to live."

My mom and Mitsurugi saved me!

I looked at them in gratitude.

However, my mom brought up another tricky subject.

"Are you gonna tell us why Aika-chan keeps calling you 'papa'?"

More than the permadeath thing, which she couldn't understand, she was more focused on that.

"You see… Aika-chan and Mary-chan here are my daughters…"

My parents stared at me.

"W-What?! How are they already so big?!"

"That can't be possible, can it?!"

Of course they wouldn't believe me.

I then explained to them Aika-chan's true nature as an AI, as well as Mary-chan being a monster.

"I see… So they're more like your adoptive daughters…"

My mom said, making Aika-chan gasp. She said,

"No, I'm really mama and papa's daughter!"

"Ah, I'm sorry, Aika-chan!"

My mom instantly went down on her knees to pat Aika-chan's head.

She already had a grip on them.

Mary-chan didn't seem concerned at all. She just looked at my dad curiously, who smiled at her.

"What is it, Mary-chan? Wanna give your grandpa a hug?"

"...Hmm… OK…"

He knelt down and pulled her in for a hug. She asked,

"Aren't you scared that I'm a monster?"

"Why would I be when you're so cute!"

Thankfully that went well.

It would honestly break my heart if my parents were scared of Aika-chan and Mary-chan.

It was a good thing they were open minded.

"...So Aqua-chan is the 'mother', huh?"

"But that's just in a figurative sense, right?"

I scratched my cheek, trying to think of the best way to say this. I just decided to go for it.

"Actually, I'm trying to be a father in the literal sense, too… With these girls."

"W-What?!"

I pointed to the girls in my harem aside from Rin, who chose to be more cautious in the regard to having children.

Hyoizaburo-san looked at me in shock before shaking his head and saying to Megumin.

"This is absurd, right, Megumin? He's claiming that you're gonna have his child… Haha…"

"No, it's true. We're seriously trying for children."

"Come here, bastard!"

"Oi, don't you touch my son!"

Surprisingly, my father came to my defense.

Only to back down when Sakamoto-san stepped forward.

"...Oi. Kuroko isn't in this weird arrangement of yours, is she?"

My dad and Hyoizaburo-san quickly went away once this muscular man got involved.

And this man was giving me quite the death glare.

"No, of course not."

I was telling the truth so far.

But let's not tell him that I did hook up with her daughter.

It's just that I wasn't planning to have kids with her.

Ame's eyes were wide and she pointed a shaking finger at me.

"Kazuma… I knew about your arrangement, but you're really going that far?! What happened to you?!"

I looked Ame in the eyes and said,

"We don't know what's gonna happen to any of us, so… I don't want to have any regrets."

The mood turned somber when I said that.

Sena quickly nodded her head in agreement.

"T-That's right… Morals and common sense don't apply in this scenario, so even if we were to do something that would be considered highly inappropriate, it should be allowed…"

Was she trying to cover herself because she slept with me?

Yuiyui-san, of course, picked up on this. She said,

"Is there something you want to admit, Sena-san?"

"...?! I-In any case, the fireworks show will start in half an hour, so let's stop the serious talk for now and enjoy the show! Who wants barbeque?!"

She swiftly avoided the question.

Part 4

I turned to Hyoizaburo-san next, who regained his confidence only after Sakamoto-san stepped back.

"...I'm sorry for not telling you. But yes, I'm planning to have a baby with your daughter."

"You bastard…!"

"Hey, don't touch my son!"

My dad leapt to my rescue, even though I highly doubted Hyoizaburo-san could hurt me.

My mom went forward and said,

"Kazuma, out of all the absurd things you've said so far, this is the most unbelievable one! What do you mean you'll have a child?! Do you even know what that means?!"

I looked for help, but the others were already getting barbeque.

Oi.

Were they really leaving me in this mess?!

Megumin was also trying to leave, but Yuiyui-san held her shoulder.

"Young lady, where are you going?"

"...Even though my stealth should be high… How did you spot me?"

"Did you really expect to get past your mother?"

Meanwhile, the others were gathering around the barbeque.

Mitsurugi refused to make eye-contact with me, and even Rin just shrugged.

As if to say 'this is why I didn't agree to getting pregnant'.

OK, OK, I get it. I brought this upon myself!

I coughed as the parental figures were surrounding me. I couldn't even rely on Sena, who went back to serve barbeque to everyone.

Even though I treated her so well earlier…

They've all abandoned me!

Meanwhile, Megumin's friends were all staring at her in shock.

"T-That Megumin is really wild, huh?!"

"The most surprising part is that she's not a virgin!"

"...It kind of makes you reflect on your own life, huh?"

Funifura, Dodonko and Arue said, while Yunyun ushered them away.

"Let's not get involved in this…"

"Yunyun, you're not off the hook. Give us details!"

"...! This is 'girl talk', right?! Very well, I'll share everything!"

That girl was really planning to yap about all our intimate moments?!

Things were complicated enough as it was!

Before I could stop her, though, Hyoizaburo-san said,

"Fine, I won't resort to violence! I'm an adult, so I shouldn't beat up a child, anyway."

"As long as you don't harm my son, that's fine. Is there anywhere we can talk in private?"

Upon my dad's request, I made a dungeon door appear. I made it lead to the same room where Sakamoto-san and I talked.

They stared at the interior in shock, although they did see the dungeon doors in effect earlier, so they weren't completely taken off guard.

"D-Dear, look there's treats over here!"

"We can grab as many as we like, right?!"

Even though they were well to do now, I guess old habits die hard.

I was about to close the door, but…

"Wait, I wanna see what all this baby talk is about! Am I gonna be an auntie?!"

Komekko tried to join the meeting.

"...Komekko, this is grown up talk, so please enjoy some barbeque… Actually, maybe we can bring some barbeque here with us while we talk?"

Hypozaburo-san said while drooling.

Komekko raised her hand.

"If I bring barbeque, can I join?"

"Ah, then bring enough plates for everyone…"

My father shook his head.

"I'm sorry… Um, Komekko-chan, but this really is for adults only."

He paused a bit before saying her name. It was weird, after all.

Komekko finally gave up, or more like she wanted to start eating the barbeque and didn't have time to argue.

The golem hostess came out to bring us tea and snacks. Once the tea was served, and I had to explain the golems once more, I sat across the table from my parents, with Megumin beside me.

…This did seem like a marriage interview.

We weren't wearing full on kimonos, but the settings and our traditional clothes added to the feeling.

"First of all, I don't think we need to say this, but having a baby while you're still in high school is a bad idea!"

Hyoizaburo-san said, to which I nodded.

"I do realize that, Hyoizaburo-san, but that only applies to normal circumstances."

"You think that all this supernatural stuff going on makes it OK for you to impregnate my daughter?!"

"Dad at least let him talk."

Megumin said. He turned to her next.

"I also expect you to explain yourself, young lady!"

"What's there to explain? I fell in love with Kazuma and I know he'll be a great father."

"...!!!"

I started blushing, not expecting Megumin to be this straightforward. She was putting on a brave face at the start but started blushing as well, especially as her parents stared at her.

"Ah, geez… Kazuma, you have to say something equally embarrassing!"

She was trying to split the embarrassment?

"Um, well… I also love Megumin… We've been through a lot and she's helped me with a lot."

My mom slowly shook her head.

"You're still teenagers. How can you be sure you actually love each other? And Megumin-chan, are you really fine with my son having all these girls?! If you love him, you'd want him for yourself, right?!"

Megumin nodded in understanding.

"Of course, at the start I wanted him for myself. I'm not the type to share, really. But… I want the others to be happy. I realize that now."

"Still, even if you want the others to be happy… What if you come to regret it later?"

"The only thing I'll regret is if I don't do this. Like Kazuma said, we'll never know what happens during this war."

"Even so…"

Yuiyui-san clapped her hands together, making everyone's eyes turn to her.

"I'm not saying that we should delay this conversation, but perhaps we should take some time to consider this."

My dad's eyes widened.

"Yuiyui-san, you can't be serious. This isn't even something we should consider."

"We're not dealing with ordinary circumstances here. At the very least, we should try to absorb all the new information first. After all, isn't the matter of the Demon King more pressing than our concerns over their pregnancy plans?"

"I guess… That's true. We should cool our heads off a bit."

Thank you, Yuiyui-san…!!!

You sure saved my ass.

I hurriedly stood up.

"For now, we should head back and enjoy the fireworks show. I'm willing to talk about this later."

"Why are you saying that as if you have a choice, Kazuma?! We will talk about this later, young man!"

I guess I wasn't in the clear yet.

Part 5

"Sorry about my dad, Kazuma."

Megumin apologized to me when we stepped out of the dungeon room.

"No, it's perfectly normal for a father to be concerned about that."

"He's only acting this way because we're financially secure now. Back when we were poor, he wouldn't have complained much."

I could see that coming.

Still, I was glad that her parents were secure enough that they could actually act like normal parents.

Back then, I could have probably just flashed my bank account and Hyoizaburo-san would ask me what we were planning to name the child.

When we reconvened with the others, I saw everyone split off into their own groups, with at least one app-user doing some explanations of their own.

Among all those explaining, Lia was the least experienced app-user, so I went over to her as she was trying to answer the Axel Hearts' questions.

Erika noticed me first and gave me a smile. She said,

"You're oddly composed for someone who just changed everyone's lives here."

"So are you for having your life changed so drastically."

She shrugged.

"It's better than panicking. I'll probably start freaking out once I get home and finally digest everything, though."

Cielo met my gaze, and to her credit, she held it for a few seconds before looking away.

"...I'm not taking it as well as her. Are there actually scary things out there like monsters and demons?!"

"Yeah, but they're not all evil. My daughter is a monster."

Lia giggled.

"You know, Kazuma, saying things like that won't make Cielo feel safer. The fireworks show is starting, why don't we just focus on that for now?"

I nodded, seeing that everyone could use a break from all the explaining.

From what I could hear, it was much less about explaining and more about reassurances.

I saw that the one explaining things to Ame was Rin. Since Ame didn't come in a group, Rin took it upon herself to orient her. I gave Rin an appreciative look. She winked back.

I also gave Ame a look that promised I'd have my own discussion with her later. But for now, I clapped my hands and got everyone's attention.

"OK, I realized that you're probably still shocked by now…"

"And whose fault is that?!"

Kazuto yelled.

"...But for now we should just relax and take our minds off things…"

"As if we can do that, dummy!"

This kid needs to shut up!

While I was talking, the first firework went into the sky.

Kazuto finally shut up as he was instantly mesmerized.

I guess he's just a kid at the end of the day.

Some people took seats in the blankets Sena prepared, but I opted to stand behind to get a good view of everyone.

Rather than the fireworks themselves, I wanted to ingrain this image of everyone in my mind.

After all those years of isolation, I'd never take moments like this for granted.

Moments where I feel like I'm actually a part of something, rather than a lonely existence just barely managing to hold himself together.

Back then I would insult events like this, saying that it was a waste of time.

I'd hear the fireworks from outside my window during a guild raid and scoff.

'Those peasants sure like wasting their time!'

It's obvious now, but I was just trying to protect my own ego.

If there's anyone who's ever been in that place, they would know what I mean.

"Whatcha thinking about?"

I looked beside me and saw Lia.

I was captivated by the way the fireworks were reflected in her hair. Deep purple, red and orange flashed in her hair and made her eyes sparkle.

It looked like she took off her disguise. No one noticed her yet, as they were focused on the fireworks.

She probably didn't mind sharing her secret with everyone here, though, considering what I revealed.

"I guess I'm just appreciating the moment."

"I get what you mean. This really does feel like the calm before the storm, huh?"

I nodded.

Things were gonna get crazier from here on.

For the first time, I finally had a lead on Wiz.

I didn't want to let her go again. As soon as Dust finds her, I'll stop everything and come find her.

Lia held my hand.

"Don't worry, Kazuma. I'll protect you."

I chuckled.

"Shouldn't I be the one saying that?"

She shook her head.

"I'll protect your happiness. Even if you're powerful, there are times where you'll feel despair because of that power, and the burdens that come with it."

I blinked, not expecting her to say such a thing. Eventually, I got over the shock and grinned.

"Does that mean you'll join my harem?"

"Oh, no. This and that are different things. I'm still gonna get you for myself."

I gave her a sad smile.

"Sorry. That's not gonna happen."

I felt a pit in my stomach. It wouldn't surprise me if Lia decided to end things here and there.

After all, even if she wanted to protect me, she could do so as just a friend.

But I'm sticking to my convictions no matter what.

She just smiled and said,

"I won't give up."

Then she leaned in to kiss me.

The fireworks reached its climax in the background.

Part 6

When the fireworks finished, I approached Kuroko, who I hadn't had a chance to speak with yet after the reveal.

"Hey, how are you holding up?"

She glanced at her dad, who went to talk to my parents.

"Well, this is a lot to take in."

"Sorry, it must have been quite a shock."

"What's more surprising is that my dad is involved in this whole thing."

"...Do you blame him for not telling you?"

"I guess I can't really blame him… I'll need a while to take this all in, though."

"Don't worry. I'll be there for you every step of the way."

"Aww, you're so sweet!"

She gave me a hug, which immediately earned Sakamoto-san's attention.

However, instead of making a big deal out of it, he understood that I was only comforting Kuroko and didn't say anything.

Still, I excused myself from Kuroko to avoid a confrontation.

"Hey, Kazuma, I wanted to talk to you about something."

Chris said, once I finished talking to Kuroko.

"What's up?"

"You mentioned a plan to reset your levels… I just want to warn you that you'll lose your Hero class if you do that."

"...Eh?"

"Well, resetting your levels will reset your skill points, stats and classes, too…"

"Won't heaven just grant me the Hero class again?"

"I'm sorry to say this, but my superiors really don't like you… Rather, they're just barely able to tolerate you right now. If you do something crazy like reset your levels, they might not give you the Hero class anymore and award it to someone else."

"What?! Are they stupid?!"

Chapter 81: A Sharing Plan From This Idol!

Part 1

You have superhuman levels of cold resistance! When up against magical cold, the success rate of this skill is determined by your 'Willpower' (106). You gain +20 Cold Resistance to attacks using ice and cold.

[Medium Armor] Skill Rank: 20 (MAX), Passive Skill

You are proficient in wearing Medium Armor. You no longer suffer the stealth penalty when wearing Medium Armor. Damage reduction increases by +20.

[Steal] Skill Rank: 20 (MAX), Active Skill (5 mp cost)

Megumin was wearing a dress as well. She looked at Wolbach but they both glanced away from each other.

I guess things were still very much awkward between them.

"Nyaa…"

Wolbach's other half came out from the living room, surprising Megumin.

"Why's a cat here?"

She leaned down to pick it up.

"Apparently this is Wolbach's other half… But because she's been weakened so much, what was supposed to be evil incarnate turned out to be a cute, harmless cat."

"Does it have a name?"

I turned to Wolbach, who shook her head.

"Well, it's technically still me… So I guess its name would just be Wolbach."

"That would be confusing, though."

Megumin stroked the cat's fur and said,

"I'll name it Chomusuke, then."

Yet another weird name came out.

Wolbach's brow twitched, perhaps not appreciating the fact that her other half suddenly got a weird name, but she didn't want to go against Megumin. In order to get along with Megumin again, she forced herself to smile.

"W-What a good name."

Chomusuke remained sitting on Megumin's lap as we went to the dinner table.

For a while, it was just us silently eating.

Oi, isn't this too awkward?

What would they have done if I wasn't here?

I coughed into my hand.

"Megumin… Why don't you tell Wolbach about the new gear you got."

I gave Megumin something to talk about.

She finished chewing an ebi-fry and said,

"I got an orichalcum staff now that makes my explosion even more powerful…"

Wolbach gave her a gentle smile.

"You still love explosion magic after all this time, huh?"

Megumin looked down at Chomusuke, a faint blush on her cheeks.

"...It's thanks to you."

Wolbach took a deep breath.

"I know I apologized before but… I'm really sorry for betraying your trust, Megumin."

Megumin sighed then finally looked Wolbach in the eyes.

"...I know. I can tell you mean it. And besides…"

She looked at me and started to smile.

"...If you didn't trick me, I would have never met Kazuma and the others… I would have never fallen in love with explosion magic…"

She smiled in full now.

"Everything I am now, this identity of Megumin the Crimson Demon, the number one mage in the world… The master of explosion magic… I have you to thank for it."

"But still… I lied to you…"

"Let's just say that you lied to Megumi and not Megumin."

Wolbach blinked then started to giggle.

"That's so silly…"

I smiled then started to stand up.

"I'll leave you two alone."

Since they were talking naturally now, I didn't need to be there anymore.

There were probably some things they wanted to talk about that they didn't want me to hear.

I was curious, but I decided to respect their privacy.

…

…

When Megumin got back to the mansion, I noticed that Chomusuke was with her.

"Wolbach said that I should bring this one with me."

I suppose that since her other half didn't commit any crimes, she wanted it to have freedom.

I didn't have a reason to refuse, so I let Chomusuke stay with us.

"Megumin… What's that cat with the imperious look…? I also sense something bad from it."

Aqua, who looked like she had been drinking, said this.

She stumbled her way into the living room and looked at Chomusuke.

"Don't tell me that you're one of those superstitious people who hate black cats…"

"This goes beyond superstition! My goddess instincts are flaring up!"

I didn't explain Chomusuke's origin to Aqua, because I didn't want her to start nagging us about unholy beings or whatever.

Since she didn't have any proof, she didn't pursue the matter any more. Instead, she said,

"Just be careful to keep that cat away from Zell…"

I raised my brow.

"Oh? Why should a dragon fear a cat?"

She went stiff and started rambling.

"You should know that your child isn't an adult dragon yet! Of course it's going to be vulnerable to lots of things!"

"Yeah, like a frying pan…"

"Kazuma… You better not say the 'C' word again…!!!"

Somehow the word 'chicken' got banned in this household.

Once Aqua stomped away, Megumin chuckled and sat down on the sofa with me, with Chomusuke on her lap.

Then, Megumin leaned her head on my shoulder.

"Thanks, Kazuma."

Knowing that she was talking about Wolbach, I nodded.

"I wanted to pay you back for helping me with Ame."

"We can rely on each other, huh?"

"Always."

We were both pretty clumsy and very stubborn.

So, we'd always help each other out, when it came to relationships or whatever else.

She's my soulmate after all, the one who Vanir said I was fated to be with.

That didn't mean that I played favorites, but that meant that Megumin would understand me the most out of everyone.

And vice versa.

Whether it comes to reuniting with dark goddesses or childhood friends…

All we needed was to give each other a little push.

Part 6

The next day, I went to the training center again.

This time, everyone could make it at the same time without schedule conflicts.

Kuroko gave me a wink when she entered the training center.

This girl sure never stops…

Meanwhile, Terada-senpai and Mio senpai were flirting as always.

Not to mention Mitsurugi and his girls.

But the ones flirting the most…

"Fufun… I can't wait to see that bikini armor you got from the lootbox…"

"Maybe we should use it tonight…"

I overheard my parents saying this as they headed upstairs to Megumin's segment.

I shuddered, trying not to imagine that.

Apparently, my mom unlocked some kind of ridiculous armor after finishing a quest.

Why a bikini armor, though?!

I hope to god I never see it!

I gave a silent thank you and sorry to Megumin.

Even though we had that moment last night, she'd probably hate me now.

And her mom was gonna be there, too.

With her friend Arue there to witness it all.

This time, Cremea and Fio ended up being App-Users, with Ame and Kuroko unlocking their potential near the very end.

It was good progress so far, even if they weren't unlocking their potentials all at once.

"Ahh… We haven't done it yet, huh?"

Erika said, with a sigh.

Cielo smiled at her and said,

"It's fine. I'm sure it'll happen eventually!"

I thought that they would head out as soon as practice ended, but it seemed that they had the day off.

"Oi, Kazuma, wanna hang out with us?"

Erika suddenly invited me.

"E-Eh? You shouldn't impose like that, Erika…"

I thought that Cielo would be against it because I was a man, it looked like she was just worried about imposing.

How sweet of her.

Of course, I wouldn't refuse an invitation from my idols.

And I was sure Lia wouldn't mind if I hung out with her friends.

We ended up going to a burger place that just opened, which Erika was interested in.

It was an American fast food chain called Shake Shack.

They open temporary stores every year to gauge market interest, and they usually come around summer.

We went with a full meal of burgers, fries and shakes.

"You're probably surprised that idols are eating so much, huh?"

Erika said, as she chowed down on a burger.

"Not at all. You guys burn through a lot of calories. I actually advised Lia to eat more."

"Aww… You really care a lot about her, huh?"

I gave them clothes to wear with [Tailor] and [Disguise].

This way, they could eat in public without wearing masks or hats.

It was a very minimal disguise, with Erika having her hair down and wearing glasses, while Cielo had her hair in short pigtails.

Anyone would recognize them just from looks alone, but thanks to my skills, even these slight changes managed to fool even the most dedicated fan.

And they also looked really cute like this…

While chewing a fry, Erika said,

"So, having some problems with Lia, huh?"

I paused.

Hearing that from one of your girlfriend's best friends is never a good sign.

"D-D-Did she say anything?"

"Pfft! Look at you stutter! Well, we all know that she won't accept your little harem…"

"...Yeah, I'm still trying to have her accept it."

"Hmm… I know Lia. She's very principled. That doesn't apply to cleanliness, though."

I sighed before slowly nodding my head.

"What should I do, then?"

"Hehe… The best way is to slowly get her used to the idea, right?"

"And how do I do that?"

She pointed at herself.

"Why don't you tell her you're planning to date me, too?"

"Hah?!"

I leaned in and quieted my voice once everyone's heads turned to us. Cielo huddled in on herself, while Erika tried to innocently sip her milkshake, as if she didn't just say all that.

"Oi… What are you on about?"

"As cool as your other girlfriends are, Lia doesn't really know them that well, right? She's not close to them like I am to her, so even if they try to convince her, it would just fall on deaf ears."

I would like everyone to be extremely close with each other, but I knew that was impossible.

It was good enough that they were friendly with each other, but if it was common to be best friends with all your acquaintances, then the term 'best friend' wouldn't exist in the first place.

Besides, what makes relationships so special is that you can't achieve that level of closeness with just anyone.

Just like how I had people I was extremely close with, those people also had others that they might be closer to than me. For example, Mitsurugi was pretty much my best guy friend, but he was closer to his girlfriends than me. Same with Dust. His bond with Faitfore seemed like it was unbreakable.

And in this case, Lia's bond with the Axel Hearts was probably something I wouldn't be able to surpass, no matter how intimate we got. It wasn't something I felt insecure about. In fact, I was happy that she had such strong friendships with her group. I knew that a lot of artist groups were just tolerating each other for the money and fame.

"You're right about that… But what does that have to do with dating you?"

"I mean, as one of her besties, she'd realize that sharing you with me is a better option than just keeping you to herself. I know for a fact that she'd compromise on her ideals for my sake."

"...So, what, you'll just pretend to date me to trick her? Sorry, but this leaves a bad taste in my mouth."

She raised a brow.

"Who said we'd be pretending?"

"...Eh?"

I looked to Cielo, as if to confirm if Erika was actually saying all this crazy stuff.

"S-Sorry about Erika! Um… She's quite weird, but I assure you that she's not the type to deceive her friends! She means well!"

…I guess Erika did strike me as the type who was a bit crazy!

She was a narcissist who thinks she's the cutest girl in the world, after all.

Her mind probably works differently than the normal person.

She clarified and said,

"Listen, I know what I want in a man. You're easy on the eyes, and you pretty much check all the boxes. You also made Lia open up to you, which means that I know I can completely trust you. I wouldn't mind dating you."

She smirked and rested her chin on her hand.

"And besides, you're an Axel Hearts fan, right? Are you telling me you're not attracted to me, too?"

I glanced away. Even with how high my Cunning was, I probably wouldn't be able to convince anyone that I didn't find Erika attractive.

I mean, who wouldn't? Even other girls were fans of her.

That was how her ego got so big!

"That would be amazing if it worked out. But if it doesn't, Lia will just dump me on the spot for making a move on her friend."

"Oi. I know Lia, probably better than you do. She trusts me completely. We all trust each other. She'll be annoyed at first, but she'll seriously consider it. And eventually, she'll say yes. At the end of the day, she wants everyone around her to be happy."

I guess I could see that happening.

Lia had her principles and ideals, but the one thing she wanted to do was make sure her loved ones were happy.

And it seems like Erika didn't mind this at all…

I thought about it for a minute and said,

"I'll leave it to you, then… What do you have in mind?"

She smirked and said,

"We're having an end of summer girls sleepover. I'll just ask her if we can invite you and I'll slowly bring up the topic then."

She said it with so much confidence that I trusted her right away.

Still, I looked to Cielo just to confirm I wasn't making a big mistake here.

"You can trust Erika… I also know she can convince Lia eventually."

If even Cielo was saying that, I guess I can trust Erika.

Ah, this is making me nervous!

But I just had to go along with Erika's plans.

Hopefully this doesn't bite me in the ass.

Part 7

I talked a bit more with Erika and Cielo before heading home.

Erika gave me a lot to think about, but before that…

I had to focus on the dungeon.

Just a few more floors to go before we conquered the whole thing.

That night, when we entered the dungeon, I tried out a new spell I learned.

It was from one of the spell tomes I received along with Crystal Prison.

"[Silent]."

I pointed at an area and the ground was suddenly covered in shadows.

I watched as Pocky-chan, as big as she was, managed to sneak into a crowd of ogres, crushing them with a stomp.

What an effective spell.

It perfectly suited my fighting style.

It also compensated for those who didn't have stealth skills.

[Silent] Skill Rank: 1, Active Skill (30 mp cost)

Designate a 15-foot cube anchored within an area. For the next minute until your concentration ends, no sound can be produced within this area.

I kept activating this spell around Darkness and Pocky-chan.

Darkness went back to using her spear to pierce through the enemies, while Pocky-chan charged at them.

Since the enemies couldn't hear the charge coming, they were instantly pulverized.

"...This is quite effective."

I said, after patting Pocky-chan on the head.

Aqua shuddered while looking at Pocky-chan.

"I still have trauma when it comes to Giant Toads…"

Megumin nodded and said,

"Not to mention those two that abandoned us…"

Pocky-chan technically had two sisters, but they went feral when they grew up.

This further added to their trauma.

Rin looked confused and said,

"Why are you all so scared of Giant Toads? Aren't they pretty easy to beat?"

"...!!! This girl who had a cheat item from the start has no right to say such things!"

Rin backed away as Megumin started yelling at her.

"Seems like I touched on a sore subject…"

She didn't even know the half of it.

We took turns taking care of the monsters in our way.

With [Silent], it was pretty easy to just straight up ambush the frontliners. When she saw this, Chris said,

"Since I'm a thief, using this spell practically makes me invisible…"

Along with her stealth, now that she produced no sounds whatsoever, no enemy was safe from her.

Her new magic dagger tore through even the most heavily armored foes.

The same could be said about Mary, who simply just produced vines to take down enemies with Grave Binder.

"It's kind of fun how easily I can take those monsters down…"

She said with a sadistic grin.

I guess since Tranquility Girls weren't seen as combat monsters, she took some kind of pleasure in dominating monsters who were originally more powerful than her.

My daughter was getting quite the big head.

We made it to the 98th floor with ease.

I turned to Aika-chan and said,

"OK, daughter of mine, cough up the info."

"How mean! I told you already that you need to learn on your own, papa!"

She was still insistent on that.

I sent some golems ahead to do scouting work.

But all I saw were wide fields and mountain ranges.

It actually looked a lot like the environment where we saw that dragon.

"...Don't tell me this is another dragon floor?"

I said, trying to make a guess.

I looked at Aika-chan's reactions.

She was trying not to show anything, but…

I know my daughter well enough that I could tell I hit it on the mark.

If there was truly a dragon in there, it would probably be way stronger than that green dragon from before.

Hopefully we could come to an agreement like last time, since Dragons were intelligent creatures.

We entered the floor.

After travelling around for a while, we heard the flapping of wings.

Mitsurugi drew his sword and stepped ahead, although he approached with hesitant steps. He said,

"Oi… Isn't that thing too big?!"

In front of us was a dragon that was way larger than the one we fought before.

It was almost as big as our mansion.

It was a dragon with red scales that reflected the dungeon's artificial light.

It glared at us with red eyes that had a contemptuous look in them.

"...I was wondering what kind of adventurers would show up… The first I see are these weaklings?"

What kind of party was it expecting to see?
This thing didn't seem concerned about us at all!

I could sense that this thing was way beyond any enemy we've encountered.

"Rin… Summon Ponko-sensei…"

But she just shook her head.

"Senpai… [Enemy Reading] is telling me that Ponko-sensei can't shapeshift into such a powerful creature…"

Gah, how strong was this thing?!

"Megumin, it might be explosion time."

"Fufu… You don't gotta tell me twice!'

She took her orichalcum staff out.

"I am Megumin! Disciple of the dark goddess Wolbach and master of explosion magic! It seems that you think of yourself as some kind of superior being just because you are a dragon… But nothing makes me happier than showing arrogant monsters like you their proper place!"

"Hurry up!"

She didn't need to say all that and provoke it!

"Here it comes… Explosion!"

I watched the biggest explosion yet hitting the dragon head on.

But even as it was surrounded by fire…

It laughed.

"Bwahahaha! Using explosion magic on me when I have fire resistance… You fools!"

I guess a dragon of this caliber would have such resistances…!

"Since you're fond of such introductions… I am Balagos! The dragon who has slayed over a 1,000 dragons! In my original world, they once called me Dragon Bane! Foolish adventurers… Today is when you will all perish!"

After that proclamation, Balagos opened his mouth and released a torrent of fire.

Chapter 82: A Visit To This Vampire's Dungeon!

Part 1

"Hot…! Why is this so freaking hot?!"

I created a shield using [Smithing], [Create Water] and [Freeze], while also relying on my [Heat Resistance].

The reason being to help form a frontline with Mitsurugi, Darkness and Iris.

But still, the fire breath of this dragon named Balagos was still too hot.

Even with my maxed out [Heat Resistance], I still took some damage.

The others took the time we bought them to drink those Fire Resistance potions.

It was better to take them now than save them for a future fight.

Once they all had time to drink the potions, the spellcasters started to attack the dragon.

But he simply flew away and continued to rain fire on us.

"How are we even going to beat this thing, senpai…?"

Rin said doubtfully, as she used her newly learned [Heal] to recover the HP I lost from tanking that attack.

"If I can get close enough to use [Bind] on it, we should be able to bring it down."

Even if it had high physical stats and ways to break out of crowd control, my [Bind] was Rank 20 now.

"If you need to get close, rely on me, Kazuma-san!"

Yunyun, ever the reliable one, said this.

She created a [Hand of Aether] and we both rode it to reach the dragon's height.

"Hoh? You humans know how to manipulate Aether? I haven't fought an Aether user in thousands of years!"

Balagos seemed impressed as it changed its attention to us.

Doing that, however, left it susceptible to the long-range attacks of the others.

"[Sacred Lightning Blare]!"

Iris pointed her sword at Balagos and summoned flashing arcs of lightning to attack it.

"Tsk… So many annoyances… Fine, I'll deal with you first, then!"

"[Decoy]!"

I tried to use [Decoy] to have it stop attacking the others on the ground, but I only had 1 rank on the skill.

Maybe I should have brought Darkness along, but I wanted to leave her down there to protect the others.

Still, Darkness did her job and attracted Balagos to her with [Decoy].

"You won't harm my friends!"

"Oh? You're quite the exemplary female knight, aren't you…? And quite beautiful, as well… Fufun… Perhaps I shall feast on your virgin blood after this…?"

Darkness blushed then slashed the dragon away with her lance.

"V-Virgin…?! I'll have you know that I have plenty of experience!"

"Please… I know your type. Holy warriors such as yourself dedicate yourself to training and do not know the pleasures of the flesh… Same goes to that blue-haired one over there wearing priest garbs…"

Aqua raised a brow at Balagos and said,

"...Is your common sense still stuck in the ancient era or something? There isn't really any rule forbidding those of the cloth from fornicating anymore."

"Eh? Really?"

Balagos stopped in his tracks. He reached up to scratch his face with his claw.

"Ah, that's embarrassing…"

…Can someone tell me why this dragon boss is getting embarrassed?!

Aqua grinned and leaned forward tauntingly.

"Are, are? Is this boomer dragon getting embarrassed? You really thought that girls as sexy as Darkness and I are still virgins? Pu, pu, pu! How cute… If anyone is actually inexperienced, isn't it the dragon that's been cooped up here for so long? Ah, I bet you haven't had any action, too. Is that why you slayed your fellow dragons in the other world? Maybe you only slayed female dragons, is that right? I bet you're one of those 'incels' I heard about!"

The dragon somehow blushed. I didn't even know dragons were capable of blushing.

"I-I don't know what this 'incel' is, but I bet it's incredibly insulting! Fine, if you really think I'm inexperienced, then I'll change into a human form and show you and that female knight what I can…!"

"[Bind]."

Both Chris and I had the same idea and used [Bind] while it was distracted.

"Ah."

It looked down at the ropes binding it.

For extra measure, Mary even wrapped it with her vines.

We then surrounded it, pointing our weapons at it.

Balagos started sweating, its eyes darting around.

"W-W-Wait, there's no need to do this! I can give you my treasure! I hid it, so you won't be able to find it if you kill me!"

Aika-chan smiled and said,

"Actually, this dungeon room will lead us to any treasure hidden by this boss monster, if we defeat it. Some rooms are designed like that."

"Ah, so that's why those stairs sometimes open up to lead us to a treasure room…"

"There's something like that?! Oi, don't you feel bad for me?! I was just randomly kidnapped and brought to this dungeon! I can't even go to the other floors because they're all scared of me! I tried to go to that city called Lizardia, but they asked if I committed murders in the past and some lie-detecting bell caught me! Now I'm stuck here all alone…!"

I was starting to feel bad for it now.

Especially since it was pleading for its life like this.

But we were fighting Wiz soon, we couldn't afford to fool around.

I smiled and said,

"You've had a rough life, I see."

"Exactly! So will you please…"

"[Merciless Slash]!"

At the very least, I gave it a swift, painless death.

Part 2

You have gained 20 levels!

Since I dealt the final blow on the 98th floor boss, I gained an insane amount of levels at once.

This puts me at level 160…

"You're so greedy for taking the last hit, Kazuma…"

Aqua said, which made me turn to her in irritation.

"Hah? Weren't you the one who went 'god bloooow!' against the Elder Brain for no reason?! I don't wanna hear that from you!"

I turned to Mitsurugi and pointed an accusing finger at him.

"Besides, isn't it this guy who almost always places in the top 3 of damage dealers, and gets a bunch of EXP every time even if he didn't deal the killing blow?! Why don't you accuse him?!"

"Come to think of it… Oi, Kyouya! You do end up in the leaderboard most of the time!"

Since Aqua was easily distracted, she turned her wrath to Mitsurugi this time.

Mitsurugi still respected Aqua a lot, so he panicked.

"B-But Aqua-sama… Um, doesn't Iris-chan also get a lot of leaderboard finishes? And she gets the final hit more than I do…"

Oi.

Was this guy really hiding behind Iris?

Aqua turned to Iris and immediately they stared at each other for a long time.

"...Got anything to say?"

Iris said, the usually cute imouto giving Aqua a cold look.

Ah, crap.

There was still tension between those two because of what happened to Iris's kingdom.

I was about to intervene, but Aqua just looked to the side.

"...Not really."

She was mature enough to let the matter drop.

No, arguing about who is getting more EXP is undoubtedly immature.

While Aqua was having her worthless fit, the usual stairs opened up to us, leading to the treasure room.

That poor Balagos really thought he could bribe us with treasure.

We went down to check out the loot.

"Ohh, look at all these crystals!"

Aqua said, once we saw a beautiful pile of glowing crystals.

"These are all high-grade manatite."

Chris noted, as she picked one up.

I turned to look at Megumin, who was already salivating as she saw all of these crystals.

"...Megumin, we've gotta divide them among us. You know that, right?"

"And why's that? Don't you have that busted [Drain Touch] already? Why do you need a share?"

Was she really trying to horde these for herself?!

"...[Drain Touch] only works if I'm directly touching the opponent."

"Nice try, but you can just create a dungeon door and absorb mana from within…"

She sure was insistent!

I managed to convince her to give me at least a couple high-grade manatite crystals.

Aside from that, there were also legendary grade health potions.

Health Potion (Legendary)

Fully restore your health and gain a temporary +20 health points.

Sells for: Priceless

There were enough of these for everyone.

We also took in the piles of miscellaneous treasure including gold.

I would put this in Norse's treasury once more.

…

…

The fight with Balagos went easier than we thought, but there were only two floors left. We didn't want to rush it.

There were also a couple days of summer break left.

While I was thinking about returning to school, I remembered my promise of retaining my normality.

That meant not skipping on important things like school, even if it was inefficient to go when I could train the whole day.

To be honest, it was still hard to stay disciplined enough not to head down that path.

Even though I knew that becoming obsessed with the dungeon, trying to acquire as much power as possible, even if I had good intentions, it would surely lead to a bad ending.

Becoming something like a machine that only functioned to get stronger, I didn't want that kind of life for myself.

So, I kept reminding myself that maintaining a balance was important.

Still, when I got back to the mansion…

I set my bottle of beer down.

"...Should I really be… hic! Spending the whole night like this drinking?"

I said to my drinking buddies, Aqua and Sena.

Additionally, Mitsurugi joined us that night.

He was more of a casual drinker and only joined us once in a while.

Still, we did share a few beers before, so I knew he liked his drink.

Tonight, though, with the battle against Wiz drawing so near, I was beginning to question why I myself wasn't a casual drinker too.

OK, I have been understating it, but I have been developing a bit of a bad habit when it comes to drinking these days.

I try to limit myself as much as possible, but…

It just feels too good to get drunk!

Aqua laughed as she finished chugging her beer and motioned for Sena to pour her more.

"What's the matter, Kazuma? Just loosen up!"

I don't wanna become like her!

Sena looked down in shame.

"...Perhaps I shouldn't have allowed you kids to drink…"

Mitsurugi sipped his drink and said,

"It's not your fault, Sena. It's just that these two lack moderation…"

"Oi, Kyouya, drink more!"

"Y-Yes, Aqua-sama!"

He sure folded right away.

After having drunk her fill, Aqua passed out on the couch.

Mitsurugi excused herself, leaving me with Sena.

"Sorry, Sena, I think I said some weird stuff there."

She gave me a gentle smile.

"It's fine. You have a lot on your mind, I imagine."

"...I'm just thinking if it's really alright to goof off like this, go to school and all that…"

She looked at me for a while and said,

"You're asking if it's OK to be human?"

I guess it did sound ridiculous if framed like that.

She smiled and said,

"Soldiers don't live on the battlefield. They have loved ones to return to. Don't let this war consume you, Kazuma-san. If that happens… I don't think I'll be able to live with myself…"

I stared at her, then stood up.

"Kazuma-san…? Mnn!"

I leaned down and kissed her.

I smiled as I pulled back.

"You said the right thing I needed to hear…"

"I'm glad to help… Mnn!"

I kissed her again.

"Sena, why don't we continue what we did in that tent…?"

Of course, she quickly nodded.

"I-I'd like that…"

She took my hand and we went to her room.

Part 3

"Kazuma-san…"

Sena gasped as I held her from behind and kissed her neck.

Once he appeared in front of Megumin, she swung her staff at him.

Of course it could use illusion magic…

"[Dimensional Anchor]!"

Golden, ethereal chains suddenly appeared from the vampire's palms and wrapped around our ankles. The chains then attached themselves to the ground. I tried to move, but found that it didn't restrict my movement at all.

"Papa! [Dimensional Anchor] is a rare spell that prevents targets from using spatial-transportation spells like [Teleport]!"

So that meant that we couldn't even retreat using [Teleport]?

That sounded familiar.

I heard about a vampire in the Demon King's army, who was the inventor of those portals that opened a gateway to our realm.

This guy was the ancestor of that vampire?

If a vampire as powerful as this is one of the Demon King's generals…

But there was no use thinking about that now.

We could try to physically escape, but I was sure this guy would just teleport towards us.

He wouldn't let us go out of that front door.

"[Flash]!"

"[Skill Bind]!"

"[Skill Bind]!"

Whenever it looked like he was about to teleport away or create an illusion, Chris and I would take turns using [Skill Bind].

Mary-chan extended her vines to try and grapple the vampire's feet. He flew back, his cloak flapping like wings.

Of course this vampire could fly too…

"[Aika-Chan's Amazing Triple Attack]!"

"I'm glad…"

"Oi… That makes it sound like you guys planned this…"

Her perception really was incredible.

The self-proclaimed cutest girl alive has taken an interest in you! She wants nothing more than to achieve her own happiness along with everyone in Axel Hearts. Chapter 84: Challenging This Final Boss!

Part 1

Even though we were having fun, I couldn't help but constantly look at Lia to see what she really felt about this.

I couldn't really tell much, though, because she was focused on the sleepover activities.

We ended up just playing a bunch of games and eating snacks.

That's not to say that it wasn't fun, but I suppose most guys would assume that sleepovers with girls would be much more exciting.

I certainly had such fantasies before.

Things like girls suddenly deciding to go nude or making out with each other.

Or pillow fights devolving into an orgy…

The male adolescent mind is prone to such delusions.

I should apologize to the others. I thought that my first sleepover with girls was a failure because no such fantastic events occurred.

But it seems this kind of thing is normal.

To further add to the regularity of this sleepover, Erika, the one who claimed that she would stay up all night, was the one to fall asleep first.

Lia giggled as she took a picture of Erika, who was sprawled on her sleeping bag with a goofy grin on her face.

"I think I'll head to sleep now, too…"

Cielo said, while rubbing her eyes with a yawn.

So cute.

She nodded to the kitchen.

"Have some tea with me?"

"It's midnight, though."

How do I say this without coming off as a douche?

Don't be a douche, don't be a douche.

I didn't think that Regina-sama's advice to me was incorrect.

Then again, she was a god, a being that was far from a human's comprehension.

And the reason why I could understand and resonate with her logic was that I was becoming something close to that.

This isn't a matter of hubris. Just take a look at my stats.

Two of my stats were already reaching divine levels, and most of my stats were beyond the levels of humanity.

A chance to bend her ideals, as unfair as it was.

In some ways, this might be a quest on par with defeating the Demon King.

That was how badly I wanted to earn Lia's trust.

But for now, they were viewing me more as an unattainable idol, rather than someone they actually had a shot with.

Although those same girls giving me longing looks actually had a shot with me if they tried.

It was always a fantasy of mine to have sex in the gym storage room, or the nurse's office…

Rin would probably give me a weird look if I asked for that, though.

Darkness would be much more willing, but the fact that she was so willing kind of ruined my desire to those things with her.

That was why I considered these girls.

It's kind of funny, how they don't think they had a shot with me, but I'd readily bend them over if they just asked.

Wait… Was this actually true for hot girls as well?!

Those same unattainable girls who I thought I had no shot with in the past… Maybe I actually had a chance if I caught them in a good mood?!

…Well, I was with several of those unattainable girls now.

And most of them fell for me before my Attractiveness stat even went up.

I see.

I looked towards my fellow guys, who looked like they were despairing going back to school.

With my look, I tried to convey this truth to them.

Have courage! You can do anything if you try!

When I gave such a look to a particularly gloomy guy, who was walking while staring at his phone, he scoffed.

"Damn pretty boy… What the hell is he looking at me for, damnit…?"
"..."

He walked past me, even though I was just trying to be nice to him.

Ah, I also had such thoughts about Mitsurugi in the past, huh?

I guess I really was clueless about the world back then.

Part 7

You're receiving a lot of attention!

Your 'Attractiveness' went up by +1!

My stats were going up so easily thanks to that potion…

We needed to attend a schoolwide assembly to start off the new semester.

After the principal gave us a boring speech about focusing on our studies after the long break, we headed back to our classrooms.

Sensei didn't waste time and immediately started collecting our summer homework.

I gave her the notebook that the clones worked on.

"It's a good time to rearrange seats, so let's do that."

Those who were already seated with their friends groaned, but sensei ignored them.

I suppose the idea was to get students to make new friends.

But for the most part, just gave their new seatmates a polite greeting before immediately turning to their friends to chat.

Now, because of my good luck…

"We're seatmates this semester, huh, Kazuma?"

Lia, the class rep, sat beside me.

I noticed that she was getting envious looks from the girls, who were all now treating me as the class idol.

By the way, the previous class idol didn't seem to care, because he apparently started dating the queen bee of the class.

That meant I didn't have to deal with any bothersome events.

Still, Lia was now getting unwanted attention.

Not like it even seemed like she cared.

"Let's get along."

I said, which made Lia smile.

"We get along pretty well already, no?"

"...Oh, my. Is the class rep flirting with me during class?"

She gave a coy grin.

"Is the class rep not allowed to flirt with a guy she's already dating?"

Some class rep this is…!

The fact that she's wearing glasses and braids didn't take away from that fox-like look she was giving me now!

"You know, Lia-san… I'm sure we can go to a private area during break and perhaps we can…"

"Nope. I'm not doing anything while we're at school, sorry."

I guess she was a real class rep, after all.

"Then how about a room in the dungeon…"

"Just focus on your studies, Kazuma."

"...Yis, ma'am."

She immediately shut that down.

…

…

During lunch break, I headed over to the cafeteria, where I agreed to meet up with Rin, Darkness, Terada-senpai and his not-so-secret girlfriend, Mio-senpai.

Of course, Lia came along with me.

Terada-senpai and Mio-senpai usually ate lunch at their third year classroom, but since it was the first day, we all wanted to spend lunch together.

"...You know, doesn't it kinda seem weird to go to school after all the dungeon stuff?"

Mio-senpai said, lowering her voice.

I guess the newbies would worry about that.

I didn't even think much of it, but it was understandable why they would.

"I guess it does feel a bit weird…"

Terada-senpai said, nodding along.

"By the way, you guys should still come to the training facility after school."

They nodded when I reminded them.

Darkness, meanwhile, asked Terada-senpai a question.

"Terada-senpai… Are we going to meet up for naginata club after school?"

It was a simple question, but for some reason, Terada-senpai had a conflicted expression.

"I don't know… It feels kind of wrong to compete when I'm gaining all these stats…"

I explained to him that the stats were an accumulation of his own effort.

And he accepted that until I told everyone to switch to the Warrior class and raise their Health stats.

Then it stopped becoming about natural stat growth. Now he thought it was unfair that he was gaining stats beyond hard work.

That made me feel bad about my own soccer club activities.

But there was something he didn't consider yet.

"Terada-senpai… You get a bunch of stat growths and even unique quests for participating in sports clubs. You can't afford to miss out on them."

"I see… I suppose that's true."

It was one thing to do this just because he wanted to beat up on regular people.

But I knew he wasn't that type of person.

Unlike those app-users I faced in soccer before.

Rin smiled and said,

"Just think of it as growing stronger for Mio-senpai. There's nothing wrong with that, right?"

"That's true… A-Ah, I want to protect Mio-san as my friend, that's it!"

"As your friend, huh…?"

"Mio-san, remember that we're keeping it a secret…!"

What's the point of doing that at this point?
